    \Pi(\ensuremath{\llbracket S \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)})},\, T,\, \ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)})
    \approx \Pi(\ensuremath{\llbracket S' \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')})},\, T',\, \ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')})
    \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R.
  \]

  \emph{Cross-relations.}
  We have established $\Pi$-relatedness for the outer pair and for the inner pair,
  both with element PER $R$.
  To get full four-way relatedness, we establish one cross-relation
  (outer-left versus inner-left) via a third \textsc{U-Pi} derivation; the
  remaining cross-relations follow by symmetry (\Cref{lem:univ-sym}) and
  transitivity (\Cref{lem:univ-trans}) of $\mathcal{U}_i$.

  The third \textsc{U-Pi} derivation uses:
  \begin{itemize}
  \@idxitem \emph{Domain.}
    From the \emph{Domain} four-value pattern (in
    $\mathcal{U}_i \searrow R_I$), the cross relation
    \[
      \ensuremath{\llbracket S[\sigma] \rrbracket(\rho)} \approx
      \ensuremath{\llbracket S \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)})} \in \mathcal{U}_i
    \]
    holds, with element PER $R_I$ by \Cref{lem:univ-functional}.
  \@idxitem \emph{Codomain.}
    Let $\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}_I :: a \approx a' \in R_I$.
    We must show
    \[
      \ensuremath{\llbracket T[q(\sigma)] \rrbracket((\rho, a/x))} \approx
      \ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket((\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)}, a'/x))}
      \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}_I).
    \]
    From the codomain four-value pattern, the cross relation
    \[
      \ensuremath{\llbracket T[q(\sigma)] \rrbracket((\rho, a/x))} \approx
      \ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket q(\sigma') \rrbracket((\rho', a'/x))})}
      \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}_I)
    \]
    holds (outer-left versus inner-right).
    By \Cref{lem:sem-ty-id} applied at the relatedness
    $\ensuremath{\llbracket q(\sigma') \rrbracket((\rho', a'/x))} \approx (\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)}, a'/x)
    \in R_{\Gamma, x:S}$ (which holds by symmetry and transitivity in
    $R_{\Gamma, x:S}$, bridging through the inner-pair relatedness of the lifted
    substitution four-value pattern):
    \[
      \ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket q(\sigma') \rrbracket((\rho', a'/x))})} \approx
      \ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket((\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)}, a'/x))} \in \mathcal{U}_i.
    \]
    By transitivity of $\mathcal{U}_i$, $\ensuremath{\llbracket T[q(\sigma)] \rrbracket((\rho, a/x))} \approx
    \ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket((\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)}, a'/x))} \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}_I)$.
  \end{itemize}
  By \textsc{U-Pi} with this domain and codomain:
  \[
    \Pi(\ensuremath{\llbracket S[\sigma] \rrbracket(\rho)},\, T[q(\sigma)],\, \rho)
    \approx \Pi(\ensuremath{\llbracket S \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)})},\, T,\, \ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)})
    \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R.
  \]
  This is the outer-left $\approx$ inner-left cross-relation.
  By symmetry and transitivity of $\mathcal{U}_i$ combined with the outer-pair and
  inner-pair relations, all six pairs among the four $\Pi$-values are related in
  $\mathcal{U}_i \searrow R$.

  Hence all four $\Pi$-values lie pairwise in $\mathcal{U}_i \searrow R$.
<!-- end proof-81 -->
<!-- lemma-83: body_md -->
\label{lem:fund-var-lookup}
  Suppose $\ensuremath{\vDash \Gamma}$, $\Gamma' \approx \Gamma' \searrow R'$,
  $\semtyeq[\Gamma']{\sigma}{\sigma'}{\Gamma}$, and
  $\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}} :: \rho \approx \rho' \in R'$.
  Then for every $x : T \in \Gamma$, there exists $R_T$ such that
  \begin{align*}
    &\{\ensuremath{\llbracket T[\sigma] \rrbracket(\rho)},\; \ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)})},\;
      \ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')})},\; \ensuremath{\llbracket T[\sigma'] \rrbracket(\rho')}\}
      \subseteq \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R_T \\
    &\text{and}\quad
      \{\ensuremath{\llbracket x[\sigma] \rrbracket(\rho)},\; \ensuremath{\llbracket x \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)})},\;
      \ensuremath{\llbracket x \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')})},\; \ensuremath{\llbracket x[\sigma'] \rrbracket(\rho')}\} \subseteq R_T.
  \end{align*}
<!-- end lemma-83 -->
<!-- proof-82: body_md -->
By induction on the lookup derivation $x : T \in \Gamma$, with $\Gamma'$, $R'$,
  $\sigma$, $\sigma'$, $\rho$, $\rho'$, and the witness $\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}$ fixed throughout.

  \medskip\noindent
  \textbf{Case}
  \begin{mathpar}
    \inferrule
    { }
    {x_0 : S[\Uparrow] \in \Delta, x_0 : S}
  \end{mathpar}
  Here $\Gamma = \Delta, x_0 : S$, $x = x_0$, and $T = S[\Uparrow]$.
  Inverting $\ensuremath{\vDash \Delta, x_0 : S}$ via \textsc{Sem-Ctx-Ext} gives
  $\ensuremath{\vDash \Delta}$, the packaged context PER
  $(\Delta, x_0 : S) \approx (\Delta, x_0 : S) \searrow R_\Gamma$, and
  $\semtyeq[\Delta]{S}{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$ for some $i$.
  Inverting the context PER via \textsc{Ctx-Ext} gives
  $\Delta \approx \Delta \searrow R_\Delta$, a head family $R_H$ with
  $\ensuremath{\llbracket S \rrbracket(\rho_0)} \approx \ensuremath{\llbracket S \rrbracket(\rho_0')} \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R_H(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}_\Delta)$
  for $\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}_\Delta :: \rho_0 \approx \rho_0' \in R_\Delta$, and the biconditional
  \begin{align*}
    &\rho_1 \approx \rho_1' \in R_\Gamma
      \;\leftrightarrow\;
      (\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}_\Delta :: \rho_1[\Uparrow] \approx \rho_1'[\Uparrow] \in R_\Delta
        \;\wedge\;
        \rho_1(0) \approx \rho_1'(0) \in R_H(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}_\Delta)).
  \end{align*}

  Instantiate $\semtyeq[\Gamma']{\sigma}{\sigma'}{\Gamma}$ at $\Gamma'$,
  $\semweak[\Gamma']{\ensuremath{\textsf{id}}}{\Gamma'}$ (\Cref{lem:sem-wk-id}), and $\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}$:
  using $\sigma[\ensuremath{\textsf{id}}] = \sigma$ and $\ensuremath{\llbracket \ensuremath{\textsf{id}} \rrbracket(\rho)} = \rho$ we obtain
  $\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)} \approx \ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')} \in R_\Gamma$.
  By the biconditional of $R_\Gamma$, there exists $\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}_\Delta$ with
  \begin{align*}
    &\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}_\Delta :: (\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)})[\Uparrow] \approx (\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')})[\Uparrow]
      \in R_\Delta
      && \text{(tail)} \\
    &(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)})(0) \approx (\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')})(0) \in R_H(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}_\Delta)
      && \text{(head)}
  \end{align*}
  Set $R_T := R_H(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}_\Delta)$.

  \emph{Type part.}
  We must show
  $\{\ensuremath{\llbracket  \rrbracket(\rho)},\; \ensuremath{\llbracket S[\Uparrow] \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)})},\;
    \ensuremath{\llbracket S[\Uparrow] \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')})},\; \ensuremath{\llbracket  \rrbracket(\rho')}\}
   \subseteq \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R_T$.
  We obtain this by two instantiations of $\semtyeq[\Delta]{S}{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$, bridged
  through a shared inner value.

  By \Cref{lem:sem-ctx-per}, $\Gamma \approx \Gamma \searrow R_\Gamma$.
  By \Cref{lem:sem-wk-shift}, $\semweak[\Gamma]{\Uparrow}{\Delta}$.
  By \Cref{lem:sem-wk-subst-pre} on $\semweak[\Gamma]{\Uparrow}{\Delta}$ and
  $\semtyeq[\Gamma']{\sigma}{\sigma'}{\Gamma}$:
  $\semtyeq[\Gamma']{\Uparrow \circ \sigma}{\Uparrow \circ \sigma'}{\Delta}$.

  \emph{First instantiation.}
  Apply $\semtyeq[\Delta]{S}{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$ at $\Gamma'$,
  $\semtyeq[\Gamma']{\Uparrow \circ \sigma}{\Uparrow \circ \sigma'}{\Delta}$, and $\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}$:
  for some $R_1$,
  \begin{align*}
    &\{\ensuremath{\llbracket S[\Uparrow \circ \sigma] \rrbracket(\rho)},\;
      \ensuremath{\llbracket S \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \Uparrow \circ \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)})},\;
      \ensuremath{\llbracket S \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \Uparrow \circ \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')})},\;
      \ensuremath{\llbracket S[\Uparrow \circ \sigma'] \rrbracket(\rho')}\} \subseteq \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R_1.
  \end{align*}
  By \Cref{lem:wk-subst-interact}\,(1), $ = S[\Uparrow \circ \sigma]$,
  so the outer values of the first instantiation match the goal's outer values.

  \emph{Second instantiation.}
  By \Cref{lem:sem-wk} on $\semweak[\Gamma]{\Uparrow}{\Delta}$:
  $\semtyeq[\Gamma]{\Uparrow}{\Uparrow}{\Delta}$.
  From $\semtyeq[\Gamma']{\sigma}{\sigma'}{\Gamma}$ at $\Gamma'$, $\ensuremath{\textsf{id}}$, $\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}$:
  $\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)} \approx \ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')} \in R_\Gamma$.
  Apply $\semtyeq[\Delta]{S}{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$ at $\Gamma$ (using $R_\Gamma$),
  $\semtyeq[\Gamma]{\Uparrow}{\Uparrow}{\Delta}$, and
  $\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)} \approx \ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')} \in R_\Gamma$:
  for some $R_2$,
  \begin{align*}
    &\{\ensuremath{\llbracket S[\Uparrow] \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)})},\;
      \ensuremath{\llbracket S \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \Uparrow \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)})})},\;
      \ensuremath{\llbracket S \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \Uparrow \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')})})},\;
      \ensuremath{\llbracket S[\Uparrow] \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')})}\} \subseteq \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R_2.
  \end{align*}
  The outer values here are exactly the goal's inner values.

  \emph{Bridge.}
  We have already established
  $\ensuremath{\llbracket \Uparrow \circ \sigma \rrbracket(\rho_0)} = \ensuremath{\llbracket \Uparrow \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho_0)})}$
  (from the proof of \Cref{lem:sem-wk-subst-pre}).
  Hence the inner-left values of both instantiations coincide:
  \[
    \ensuremath{\llbracket S \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \Uparrow \circ \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)})}
    = \ensuremath{\llbracket S \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \Uparrow \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)})})}.
  \]
  Analogously for the primed side.
  By \Cref{lem:univ-functional}, $R_1 \Leftrightarrow R_2$; set $R_T := R_1$.
  By symmetry and transitivity of $\mathcal{U}_i$ through the shared inner-left value, all
  four goal values are related in $\mathcal{U}_i \searrow R_T$.

  \emph{Term part.}
  Compute:
  \begin{align*}
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket x_0[\sigma] \rrbracket(\rho)}
      = \ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma(x_0) \rrbracket(\rho)}
      = (\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)})(0)
      && \text{(by definition of substitution and ev-var)} \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket x_0 \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)})}
      = (\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)})(0)
      && \text{(by ev-var)}
  \end{align*}
  The outer-left and inner-left values coincide as $(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)})(0)$; the
  primed pair coincides as $(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')})(0)$.
  By the head clause,
  $(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)})(0) \approx (\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')})(0) \in R_T$, so all four
  term values are related in $R_T$.

  \medskip\noindent
  \textbf{Case}
  \begin{mathpar}
    \inferrule
    {y : S \in \Delta}
    {1{+}y : S[\Uparrow] \in \Delta, x_0 : U}
  \end{mathpar}
  Here $\Gamma = \Delta, x_0 : U$, $x = 1{+}y$, and $T = S[\Uparrow]$.
  Inverting $\ensuremath{\vDash \Delta, x_0 : U}$ gives $\ensuremath{\vDash \Delta}$, the packaged
  context PER $\Gamma \approx \Gamma \searrow R_\Gamma$, and
  $\semtyeq[\Delta]{U}{U}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{j}}}$.

  By \Cref{lem:sem-wk-shift}, $\semweak[\Gamma]{\Uparrow}{\Delta}$.
  By \Cref{lem:sem-wk-subst-pre} on $\semweak[\Gamma]{\Uparrow}{\Delta}$ and
  $\semtyeq[\Gamma']{\sigma}{\sigma'}{\Gamma}$:
  $\semtyeq[\Gamma']{\Uparrow \circ \sigma}{\Uparrow \circ \sigma'}{\Delta}$.
  By \Cref{lem:sem-wk} on $\semweak[\Gamma]{\Uparrow}{\Delta}$:
  $\semtyeq[\Gamma]{\Uparrow}{\Uparrow}{\Delta}$.
  From $\semtyeq[\Gamma']{\sigma}{\sigma'}{\Gamma}$ at $\Gamma'$, $\ensuremath{\textsf{id}}$, $\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}$:
  $\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)} \approx \ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')} \in R_\Gamma$.

  We apply the IH on $y : S \in \Delta$ \emph{twice}, paralleling the two
  instantiations used in the Base case.

  \emph{First IH instantiation.}
  Apply the IH to $y : S \in \Delta$ at $\Gamma'$, the semantic substitution
  $\semtyeq[\Gamma']{\Uparrow \circ \sigma}{\Uparrow \circ \sigma'}{\Delta}$,
  and $\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}$: for some $R_1$,
  \begin{align*}
    &\{\ensuremath{\llbracket S[\Uparrow \circ \sigma] \rrbracket(\rho)},\;
      \ensuremath{\llbracket S \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \Uparrow \circ \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)})},\;
      \ensuremath{\llbracket S \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \Uparrow \circ \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')})},\;
      \ensuremath{\llbracket S[\Uparrow \circ \sigma'] \rrbracket(\rho')}\} \subseteq \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R_1, \\
    &\{\ensuremath{\llbracket y[\Uparrow \circ \sigma] \rrbracket(\rho)},\;
      \ensuremath{\llbracket y \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \Uparrow \circ \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)})},\;
      \ensuremath{\llbracket y \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \Uparrow \circ \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')})},\;
      \ensuremath{\llbracket y[\Uparrow \circ \sigma'] \rrbracket(\rho')}\} \subseteq R_1.
  \end{align*}

  \emph{Second IH instantiation.}
  Apply the IH to $y : S \in \Delta$ at $\Gamma$ (using $R_\Gamma$),
  the semantic substitution $\semtyeq[\Gamma]{\Uparrow}{\Uparrow}{\Delta}$, and
  $\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)} \approx \ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')} \in R_\Gamma$:
  for some $R_2$,
  \begin{align*}
    &\{\ensuremath{\llbracket S[\Uparrow] \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)})},\;
      \ensuremath{\llbracket S \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \Uparrow \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)})})},\;
      \ensuremath{\llbracket S \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \Uparrow \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')})})},\;
      \ensuremath{\llbracket S[\Uparrow] \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')})}\} \subseteq \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R_2, \\
    &\{\ensuremath{\llbracket y[\Uparrow] \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)})},\;
      \ensuremath{\llbracket y \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \Uparrow \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)})})},\;
      \ensuremath{\llbracket y \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \Uparrow \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')})})},\;
      \ensuremath{\llbracket y[\Uparrow] \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')})}\} \subseteq R_2.
  \end{align*}

  \emph{Match outer values to the goal.}
  By \Cref{lem:wk-subst-interact}\,(1):
  $ = S[\Uparrow \circ \sigma]$, so the first IH instantiation's
  outer-type values are exactly the goal's outer-type values.
  The second IH instantiation's outer-type values
  $\ensuremath{\llbracket S[\Uparrow] \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)})}$ are exactly the goal's inner-type values.

  For the term values:
  \begin{align*}
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket (1{+}y)[\sigma] \rrbracket(\rho)}
      = \ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma(1{+}y) \rrbracket(\rho)}
      = \ensuremath{\llbracket (\Uparrow \circ \sigma)(y) \rrbracket(\rho)}
      = \ensuremath{\llbracket y[\Uparrow \circ \sigma] \rrbracket(\rho)} \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket 1{+}y \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)})}
      = (\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)})(1{+}y)
      = \ensuremath{\llbracket y[\Uparrow] \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)})}
  \end{align*}
  (using $(\Uparrow \circ \sigma)(y) = \sigma(y+1)$ and
  $\ensuremath{\llbracket y[\Uparrow] \rrbracket(\rho_0)} = \ensuremath{\llbracket \Uparrow(y) \rrbracket(\rho_0)} = \rho_0(y+1)$).
  Hence the first IH's outer-term values equal the goal's outer-term values, and
  the second IH's outer-term values equal the goal's inner-term values.

  \emph{Bridge via shared inner.}
  By the identity established in the proof of \Cref{lem:sem-wk-subst-pre},
  $\ensuremath{\llbracket \Uparrow \circ \sigma \rrbracket(\rho_0)} = (\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho_0)})[\Uparrow]$
  for any $\rho_0$.
  Also $\ensuremath{\llbracket \Uparrow \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)})} = (\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)})[\Uparrow]$
  by the pointwise definition of weakening evaluation.
  Hence the inner values of the two IH instantiations coincide:
  \begin{align*}
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket S \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \Uparrow \circ \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)})}
      = \ensuremath{\llbracket S \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \Uparrow \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)})})}, \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket y \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \Uparrow \circ \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)})}
      = \ensuremath{\llbracket y \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \Uparrow \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)})})},
  \end{align*}
  and analogously for the primed side.
  By \Cref{lem:univ-functional}, $R_1 \Leftrightarrow R_2$; set $R_T := R_1$.
  By symmetry and transitivity through the shared inner value, all four goal type
  values are related in $\mathcal{U}_i \searrow R_T$, and all four goal term values are
  related in $R_T$.
<!-- end proof-82 -->
<!-- lemma-84: body_md -->
\label{lem:fund-var}
  If $\ensuremath{\vDash \Gamma}$ and $x : T \in \Gamma$, then $\semtyeq[\Gamma]{x}{x}{T}$.
<!-- end lemma-84 -->
<!-- proof-83: body_md -->
By \Cref{lem:sem-ctx-per}, $\Gamma \approx \Gamma \searrow R$ for some $R$,
  giving the first premise of the semantic term judgment.
  Let $\Gamma' \approx \Gamma' \searrow R'$, $\semtyeq[\Gamma']{\sigma}{\sigma'}{\Gamma}$,
  and $\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}} :: \rho \approx \rho' \in R'$ be given.
  By \Cref{lem:fund-var-lookup} on $\ensuremath{\vDash \Gamma}$, $x : T \in \Gamma$ at this
  instantiation, the four-value patterns hold for some $R_T$.
<!-- end proof-83 -->
<!-- lemma-85: body_md -->
\label{lem:fund-ze}
  If $\ensuremath{\vDash \Gamma}$, then $\semtyeq[\Gamma]{\textsf{zero}}{\textsf{zero}}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}$.
<!-- end lemma-85 -->
<!-- proof-84: body_md -->
By \Cref{lem:sem-ctx-per}, $\Gamma \approx \Gamma \searrow R$ for some $R$.
  Let $\Gamma' \approx \Gamma' \searrow R'$,
  $\semtyeq[\Gamma']{\sigma}{\sigma'}{\Gamma}$, and
  $\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}} :: \rho \approx \rho' \in R'$ be given.
  We must show
  \[
    \{\ensuremath{\llbracket \ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}[\sigma] \rrbracket(\rho)},\;
    \ensuremath{\llbracket \ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}} \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)})},\;
    \ensuremath{\llbracket \ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}} \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')})},\;
    \ensuremath{\llbracket \ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}[\sigma'] \rrbracket(\rho')}\}
    \subseteq \mathcal{U}_0 \searrow R_T
  \]
  for some $R_T$, and
  \[
    \{\ensuremath{\llbracket \textsf{zero}[\sigma] \rrbracket(\rho)},\;
    \ensuremath{\llbracket \textsf{zero} \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)})},\;
    \ensuremath{\llbracket \textsf{zero} \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')})},\;
    \ensuremath{\llbracket \textsf{zero}[\sigma'] \rrbracket(\rho')}\}
    \subseteq R_T.
  \]

  \emph{Type part.}
  Since $\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}$ is closed, all four type values collapse to $N$:
  \begin{align*}
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket \ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}[\sigma] \rrbracket(\rho)}
      = \ensuremath{\llbracket \ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}} \rrbracket(\rho)}
      = N
      && \text{(closed term, by evaluation)} \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket \ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}} \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)})} = N
      && \text{(by evaluation)}
  \end{align*}
  and analogously for the primed pair.
  \begin{align*}
    &N \approx N \in \mathcal{U}_0 \searrow R_T
      \text{ with } R_T \Leftrightarrow \textsf{Nat}
      && \text{(by \textsc{U-Nat})}
  \end{align*}

  \emph{Term part.}
  Since $\textsf{zero}$ is closed, all four term values collapse to $\texttt{ze}$:
  \begin{align*}
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket \textsf{zero}[\sigma] \rrbracket(\rho)}
      = \ensuremath{\llbracket \textsf{zero} \rrbracket(\rho)}
      = \texttt{ze}
      && \text{(closed term, by evaluation)} \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket \textsf{zero} \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)})} = \texttt{ze}
      && \text{(by evaluation)}
  \end{align*}
  Since $R_T \Leftrightarrow \textsf{Nat}$, it suffices to show $\texttt{ze} \approx \texttt{ze} \in \textsf{Nat}$.
  \begin{align*}
    &\texttt{ze} \approx \texttt{ze} \in \textsf{Nat}
      && \text{(by \textsc{Nat-Ze})}
  \end{align*}
  Hence $\texttt{ze} \approx \texttt{ze} \in R_T$, and the four-value pattern follows.
<!-- end proof-84 -->
<!-- lemma-86: body_md -->
\label{lem:fund-su}
  If $\semtyeq[\Gamma]{t}{t'}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}$, then $\semtyeq[\Gamma]{\textsf{succ}~t}{\textsf{succ}~t'}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}$.
<!-- end lemma-86 -->
<!-- proof-85: body_md -->
Let $\Gamma' \approx \Gamma' \searrow R'$,
  $\semtyeq[\Gamma']{\sigma}{\sigma'}{\Gamma}$, and
  $\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}} :: \rho \approx \rho' \in R'$ be given.

  \emph{Type part.}
  Identical to \Cref{lem:fund-ze}:
  $\{\ensuremath{\llbracket \ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}[\sigma] \rrbracket(\rho)}, \ldots\} \subseteq \mathcal{U}_0 \searrow R_T$ with
  $R_T \Leftrightarrow \textsf{Nat}$ by \textsc{U-Nat}.

  \emph{Term part.}
  We compute the four term values, using that substitution and evaluation distribute
  over $\textsf{su}$:
  \begin{align*}
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket (\textsf{succ}~t)[\sigma] \rrbracket(\rho)}
      = \ensuremath{\llbracket \textsf{succ}~t[\sigma] \rrbracket(\rho)}
      && \text{(by definition of substitution on $\textsf{su}$)} \\
    &\quad = \texttt{su}(\ensuremath{\llbracket t[\sigma] \rrbracket(\rho)})
      && \text{(by evaluation of $\textsf{su}$)} \\[4pt]
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket \textsf{succ}~t \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)})}
      = \texttt{su}(\ensuremath{\llbracket t \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)})})
      && \text{(by evaluation of $\textsf{su}$)}
  \end{align*}
  Analogous computations apply to the primed pair, giving
  $\texttt{su}(\ensuremath{\llbracket t' \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')})})$ and $\texttt{su}(\ensuremath{\llbracket t'[\sigma'] \rrbracket(\rho')})$.

  By the hypothesis $\semtyeq[\Gamma]{t}{t'}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}$ applied at $\Gamma'$,
  $\sigma \approx \sigma'$, and $\rho \approx \rho' \in R'$, the term part gives
  \begin{align*}
    &\{\ensuremath{\llbracket t[\sigma] \rrbracket(\rho)},\;
      \ensuremath{\llbracket t \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)})},\;
      \ensuremath{\llbracket t' \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')})},\;
      \ensuremath{\llbracket t'[\sigma'] \rrbracket(\rho')}\}
      \subseteq \textsf{Nat}
      && \text{(by hypothesis on $t, t'$)}
  \end{align*}
  Applying \textsc{Nat-Su} pointwise (using transitivity of $\textsf{Nat}$,
  \Cref{lem:nat-per}, to chain the four values):
  \begin{align*}
    &\texttt{su}(\ensuremath{\llbracket t[\sigma] \rrbracket(\rho)}) \approx \texttt{su}(\ensuremath{\llbracket t \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)})}) \in \textsf{Nat}
      && \text{(by \textsc{Nat-Su})} \\
    &\texttt{su}(\ensuremath{\llbracket t \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)})}) \approx \texttt{su}(\ensuremath{\llbracket t' \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')})}) \in \textsf{Nat}
      && \text{(by \textsc{Nat-Su})} \\
    &\texttt{su}(\ensuremath{\llbracket t' \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')})}) \approx \texttt{su}(\ensuremath{\llbracket t'[\sigma'] \rrbracket(\rho')}) \in \textsf{Nat}
      && \text{(by \textsc{Nat-Su})}
  \end{align*}
  By transitivity of $\textsf{Nat}$, all four are related in $\textsf{Nat}$, hence in $R_T$.
<!-- end proof-85 -->
<!-- lemma-87: body_md -->
\label{lem:fund-lam}
  If $\semtyeq[\Gamma]{S}{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$ and $\semtyeq[\Gamma, x:S]{t}{t'}{T}$,
  then $\semtyeq[\Gamma]{\lambda x.\,t}{\lambda x.\,t'}{\Pi(x:S).\,T}$.
<!-- end lemma-87 -->
<!-- proof-86: body_md -->
Let $\Gamma' \approx \Gamma' \searrow R'$,
  $\semtyeq[\Gamma']{\sigma}{\sigma'}{\Gamma}$, and
  $\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}} :: \rho \approx \rho' \in R'$ be given.

  \emph{Type part.}
  By \Cref{lem:fund-pi-wf} applied to the hypotheses $\semtyeq[\Gamma]{S}{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$
  and $\semtyeq[\Gamma, x:S]{T}{T}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$ (the latter follows from
  $\semtyeq[\Gamma, x:S]{t}{t}{T}$ via type extraction):
  \[
    \{\ensuremath{\llbracket (\Pi(x:S).\,T)[\sigma] \rrbracket(\rho)},\;
    \ensuremath{\llbracket \Pi(x:S).\,T \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)})},\;
    \ensuremath{\llbracket \Pi(x:S).\,T \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')})},\;
    \ensuremath{\llbracket (\Pi(x:S).\,T)[\sigma'] \rrbracket(\rho')}\}
    \subseteq \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R
  \]
  where $R$ is the function PER characterized by:
  $f \approx f' \in R \;\leftrightarrow\;
  (\forall \ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}_I :: a \approx a' \in R_I.\; f \cdot a \approx f' \cdot a' \in R_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}_I))$.

  \emph{Term part.}
  We compute the four term values using the substitution behavior of $\lambda$:
  \begin{align*}
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket (\lambda x.\,t)[\sigma] \rrbracket(\rho)}
      = \ensuremath{\llbracket \lambda x.\,(t[q(\sigma)]) \rrbracket(\rho)}
      && \text{(by definition of substitution under $\lambda$)} \\
    &\quad = \lambda(t[q(\sigma)],\, \rho)
      && \text{(by evaluation of $\lambda$, forming a closure)} \\[4pt]
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket \lambda x.\,t \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)})}
      = \lambda(t,\, \ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)})
      && \text{(by evaluation of $\lambda$)}
  \end{align*}
  Analogously, $\ensuremath{\llbracket \lambda x.\,t' \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')})} = \lambda(t',\, \ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')})$
  and $\ensuremath{\llbracket (\lambda x.\,t')[\sigma'] \rrbracket(\rho')} = \lambda(t'[q(\sigma')],\, \rho')$.

  By the biconditional characterization of $R$, it suffices to show that for every
  $\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}_I :: a \approx a' \in R_I$ (where $R_I$ is the domain PER), the four closure
  applications are related in $R_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}_I)$:
  \[
    \{\lambda(t[q(\sigma)], \rho) \cdot a,\;
    \lambda(t, \ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)}) \cdot a,\;
    \lambda(t', \ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')}) \cdot a',\;
    \lambda(t'[q(\sigma')], \rho') \cdot a'\}
    \subseteq R_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}_I).
  \]

  We compute these closure applications:
  \begin{align*}
    &\lambda(t[q(\sigma)],\, \rho) \cdot a
      = \ensuremath{\llbracket t[q(\sigma)] \rrbracket((\rho, a/x))}
      && \text{(by closure application)} \\
    &\lambda(t,\, \ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)}) \cdot a
      = \ensuremath{\llbracket t \rrbracket((\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)}, a/x))}
      && \text{(by closure application)}
  \end{align*}
  Analogous identities hold for the primed pair (using $t'$).

  By \Cref{lem:sem-q} on $\semtyeq[\Gamma']{\sigma}{\sigma'}{\Gamma}$ and
  $\semtyeq[\Gamma]{S}{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$:
  $\semtyeq[\Gamma', x:S[\sigma]]{q(\sigma)}{q(\sigma')}{\Gamma, x:S}$.
  By the first premise of this judgment,
  $(\Gamma', x:S[\sigma]) \approx (\Gamma', x:S[\sigma]) \searrow R_{\Gamma',x:S[\sigma]}$
  and $(\Gamma, x:S) \approx (\Gamma, x:S) \searrow R_{\Gamma,x:S}$.

  By \Cref{lem:univ-functional} on the same left type $\ensuremath{\llbracket S[\sigma] \rrbracket(\rho)}$
  governing both $R_I$ (from \Cref{lem:fund-pi-wf}'s domain step) and the head PER
  $R_H'$ of $R_{\Gamma',x:S[\sigma]}$, $R_I \Leftrightarrow R_H'(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}')$ for
  $\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}' :: \rho \approx \rho' \in R'$.
  Hence $a \approx a' \in R_H'(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}')$, so by the biconditional of
  $R_{\Gamma',x:S[\sigma]}$,
  $(\rho, a/x) \approx (\rho', a'/x) \in R_{\Gamma',x:S[\sigma]}$.

  Apply the hypothesis $\semtyeq[\Gamma, x:S]{t}{t'}{T}$ at $\Gamma', x:S[\sigma]$,
  the lifted substitution
  $\semtyeq[\Gamma', x:S[\sigma]]{q(\sigma)}{q(\sigma')}{\Gamma, x:S}$, and
  $(\rho, a/x) \approx (\rho', a'/x) \in R_{\Gamma',x:S[\sigma]}$:
  \begin{align*}
    &\{\ensuremath{\llbracket t[q(\sigma)] \rrbracket((\rho, a/x))},\;
      \ensuremath{\llbracket t \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket q(\sigma) \rrbracket((\rho, a/x))})},\\
    &\quad \ensuremath{\llbracket t' \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket q(\sigma') \rrbracket((\rho', a'/x))})},\;
      \ensuremath{\llbracket t'[q(\sigma')] \rrbracket((\rho', a'/x))}\}
      \subseteq R_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}_I)
      && \text{(by hypothesis on $t, t'$)}
  \end{align*}
  The outer two values are the closure applications
  $\lambda(t[q(\sigma)], \rho) \cdot a$ and $\lambda(t'[q(\sigma')], \rho') \cdot a'$.
  The inner two values are $\ensuremath{\llbracket t \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket q(\sigma) \rrbracket((\rho, a/x))})}$ and
  $\ensuremath{\llbracket t' \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket q(\sigma') \rrbracket((\rho', a'/x))})}$, which we must relate to
  $\ensuremath{\llbracket t \rrbracket((\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)}, a/x))} = \lambda(t, \ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)}) \cdot a$
  and $\ensuremath{\llbracket t' \rrbracket((\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')}, a'/x))} = \lambda(t', \ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')}) \cdot a'$.

  We now show
  $\ensuremath{\llbracket q(\sigma) \rrbracket((\rho, a/x))} \approx (\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)}, a/x) \in R_{\Gamma, x:S}$.
  Unfolding $q(\sigma) = (\sigma[\Uparrow], x_0/x)$, the environment
  $\ensuremath{\llbracket q(\sigma) \rrbracket((\rho, a/x))}$ has tail $\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma[\Uparrow] \rrbracket((\rho, a/x))}$ and
  head $a$ (since $\ensuremath{\llbracket x_0 \rrbracket((\rho, a/x))} = a$).
  The environment $(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)}, a/x)$ has tail $\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)}$ and
  head $a$.
  By the biconditional of $R_{\Gamma, x:S}$ (from \textsc{Ctx-Ext}), it suffices to
  show:
  \begin{itemize}
  \@idxitem \emph{Tails:}
    $\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma[\Uparrow] \rrbracket((\rho, a/x))} \approx \ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)} \in R_\Gamma$.
    By \Cref{lem:sem-wk-shift}, $\semweak[\Gamma',x:S[\sigma]]{\Uparrow}{\Gamma'}$.
    Apply $\semtyeq[\Gamma']{\sigma}{\sigma'}{\Gamma}$ at $\Gamma', x:S[\sigma]$,
    $\Uparrow$, and $(\rho, a/x) \approx (\rho', a'/x) \in R_{\Gamma',x:S[\sigma]}$:
    the four-value pattern includes
    $\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma[\Uparrow] \rrbracket((\rho, a/x))} \approx \ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \Uparrow \rrbracket((\rho, a/x))})} \in R_\Gamma$.
    Since $\ensuremath{\llbracket \Uparrow \rrbracket((\rho, a/x))} = \rho$ definitionally (the shift on
    environments drops the head), this gives the desired relatedness.
    Let $\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}_\Gamma$ denote this evidence in $R_\Gamma$.
  \@idxitem \emph{Heads:}
    $a \approx a \in R_H^\Gamma(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}_\Gamma)$, where $R_H^\Gamma(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}_\Gamma)$ is the
    head PER governed by
    $\ensuremath{\llbracket S \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma[\Uparrow] \rrbracket((\rho, a/x))})} \approx \ensuremath{\llbracket S \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)})}
    \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R_H^\Gamma(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}_\Gamma)$.
    By $\semtyeq[\Gamma]{S}{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$ instantiated at $\Gamma'$,
    $\semtyeq[\Gamma']{\sigma}{\sigma}{\Gamma}$ (reflexive, by
    \Cref{lem:sem-sym,lem:sem-trans}), and $\rho \approx \rho \in R'$: the type part
    gives the commutation
    $\ensuremath{\llbracket S[\sigma] \rrbracket(\rho)} \approx \ensuremath{\llbracket S \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)})} \in \mathcal{U}_i$.
    By \Cref{lem:univ-functional}, $R_I \Leftrightarrow R_H^\Gamma(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}_\Gamma)$.
    From $a \approx a \in R_I$ (reflexive of $a \approx a' \in R_I$), we conclude
    $a \approx a \in R_H^\Gamma(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}_\Gamma)$.
  \end{itemize}
  By \textsc{Ctx-Ext}'s biconditional,
  $\ensuremath{\llbracket q(\sigma) \rrbracket((\rho, a/x))} \approx (\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)}, a/x) \in R_{\Gamma, x:S}$.
  By \Cref{lem:sem-ty-id} on the reflexive instance
  $\semtyeq[\Gamma, x:S]{t}{t}{T}$ (from $\semtyeq[\Gamma, x:S]{t}{t'}{T}$ by
  \Cref{lem:sem-sym,lem:sem-trans}) applied to this related pair:
  \[
    \ensuremath{\llbracket t \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket q(\sigma) \rrbracket((\rho, a/x))})} \approx
    \ensuremath{\llbracket t \rrbracket((\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)}, a/x))} \in R_O'(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}_I)
  \]
  for some $R_O'(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}_I)$.
  By \Cref{lem:univ-functional}, $R_O'(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}_I) \Leftrightarrow R_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}_I)$
  (governed by the same type $\ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket q(\sigma) \rrbracket((\rho, a/x))})}$ which lies in
  $\mathcal{U}_i \searrow R_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}_I)$ by the type part of the four-value pattern).
  Analogously on the primed side (using the reflexive instance $\semtyeq[\Gamma, x:S]{t'}{t'}{T}$):
  $\ensuremath{\llbracket t' \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket q(\sigma') \rrbracket((\rho', a'/x))})} \approx
  \ensuremath{\llbracket t' \rrbracket((\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')}, a'/x))} \in R_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}_I)$.

  Combining via symmetry and transitivity of $R_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}_I)$, the four closure
  applications
  \[
    \{\lambda(t[q(\sigma)], \rho) \cdot a,\;
    \lambda(t, \ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)}) \cdot a,\;
    \lambda(t', \ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')}) \cdot a',\;
    \lambda(t'[q(\sigma')], \rho') \cdot a'\}
    \subseteq R_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}_I).
  \]
  Hence the biconditional is satisfied, and the four closures are related in $R$.
<!-- end proof-86 -->
<!-- lemma-88: body_md -->
\label{lem:fund-app}
  If $\semtyeq[\Gamma]{S}{S'}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$, $\semtyeq[\Gamma, x:S]{T}{T'}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$,
  $\semtyeq[\Gamma]{r}{r'}{\Pi(x:S).\,T}$, and $\semtyeq[\Gamma]{s}{s'}{S}$,
  then $\semtyeq[\Gamma]{r\;s}{r'\;s'}{T[s/x]}$.
<!-- end lemma-88 -->
<!-- proof-87: body_md -->
Let $\Gamma' \approx \Gamma' \searrow R'$,
  $\semtyeq[\Gamma']{\sigma}{\sigma'}{\Gamma}$, and
  $\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}} :: \rho \approx \rho' \in R'$ be given.

  By $\semtyeq[\Gamma]{s}{s'}{S}$ at $\Gamma'$, $\sigma \approx \sigma' : \Gamma$,
  $\rho \approx \rho' \in R'$:
  \begin{align*}
    &\{\ensuremath{\llbracket S[\sigma] \rrbracket(\rho)},\;
      \ensuremath{\llbracket S \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)})},\;
      \ensuremath{\llbracket S \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')})},\;
      \ensuremath{\llbracket S[\sigma'] \rrbracket(\rho')}\}
      \subseteq \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R_I
      && \text{(by hypothesis on $S$)} \\
    &\{\ensuremath{\llbracket s[\sigma] \rrbracket(\rho)},\;
      \ensuremath{\llbracket s \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)})},\;
      \ensuremath{\llbracket s' \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')})},\;
      \ensuremath{\llbracket s'[\sigma'] \rrbracket(\rho')}\}
      \subseteq R_I
      && \text{(by hypothesis on $s, s'$)}
  \end{align*}
  In particular, let $\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}_I :: \ensuremath{\llbracket s[\sigma] \rrbracket(\rho)} \approx \ensuremath{\llbracket s'[\sigma'] \rrbracket(\rho')} \in R_I$.

  By $\semtyeq[\Gamma]{r}{r'}{\Pi(x:S).\,T}$ at the same data, the four evaluations of
  $r, r'$ are related in the function PER $R$ for $\Pi(\ensuremath{\llbracket S[\sigma] \rrbracket(\rho)}, T[q(\sigma)], \rho)$:
  \begin{align*}
    &\{\ensuremath{\llbracket r[\sigma] \rrbracket(\rho)},\;
      \ensuremath{\llbracket r \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)})},\;
      \ensuremath{\llbracket r' \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')})},\;
      \ensuremath{\llbracket r'[\sigma'] \rrbracket(\rho')}\}
      \subseteq R
      && \text{(by hypothesis on $r, r'$)}
  \end{align*}

  \emph{Term part.}
  We compute the four term values:
  \begin{align*}
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket (r\;s)[\sigma] \rrbracket(\rho)}
      = \ensuremath{\llbracket r[\sigma]\;s[\sigma] \rrbracket(\rho)}
      && \text{(by definition of substitution on app)} \\
    &\quad = \ensuremath{\llbracket r[\sigma] \rrbracket(\rho)} \cdot \ensuremath{\llbracket s[\sigma] \rrbracket(\rho)}
      && \text{(by evaluation of app)} \\[4pt]
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket r\;s \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)})}
      = \ensuremath{\llbracket r \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)})} \cdot \ensuremath{\llbracket s \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)})}
      && \text{(by evaluation of app)}
  \end{align*}
  Analogous computations for the primed pair (with $r', s'$), yielding
  $\ensuremath{\llbracket r' \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')})} \cdot \ensuremath{\llbracket s' \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')})}$ and
  $\ensuremath{\llbracket r'[\sigma'] \rrbracket(\rho')} \cdot \ensuremath{\llbracket s'[\sigma'] \rrbracket(\rho')}$.

  Denote the four $r$/$r'$-values as $f_1, f_2, f_3, f_4$ (in order) and the four
  $s$/$s'$-values as $a_1, a_2, a_3, a_4$.
  By hypothesis, $\{f_1, f_2, f_3, f_4\} \subseteq R$ and
  $\{a_1, a_2, a_3, a_4\} \subseteq R_I$.
  For each pair $(i, j)$ with $1 \leq i < j \leq 4$, we have $f_i \approx f_j \in R$
  and $a_i \approx a_j \in R_I$; let $\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}_I^{ij} :: a_i \approx a_j \in R_I$.
  By the biconditional of $R$ applied to $f_i \approx f_j \in R$ and $\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}_I^{ij}$:
  $f_i \cdot a_i \approx f_j \cdot a_j \in R_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}_I^{ij})$.
  By \Cref{lem:univ-functional} (right irrelevance), $R_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}_I^{ij})$ is independent
  of the witness, agreeing with $R_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}_I)$ for any fixed
  $\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}_I :: a_1 \approx a_4 \in R_I$.
  Hence
  \begin{align*}
    &\{\ensuremath{\llbracket r[\sigma] \rrbracket(\rho)} \cdot \ensuremath{\llbracket s[\sigma] \rrbracket(\rho)},\;
      \ensuremath{\llbracket r \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)})} \cdot \ensuremath{\llbracket s \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)})},\\
    &\quad \ensuremath{\llbracket r' \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')})} \cdot \ensuremath{\llbracket s' \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')})},\;
      \ensuremath{\llbracket r'[\sigma'] \rrbracket(\rho')} \cdot \ensuremath{\llbracket s'[\sigma'] \rrbracket(\rho')}\}
      \subseteq R_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}_I).
  \end{align*}

  \emph{Type part.}
  We instantiate $\semtyeq[\Gamma, x:S]{T}{T}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$ at two semantic substitutions
  to obtain the goal's outer and inner values, then bridge via \Cref{lem:sem-ty-id}.

  \emph{Pattern A (outer instantiation): $(\sigma, s[\sigma]/x)$ vs $(\sigma', s'[\sigma']/x)$.}
  \begin{align*}
    &\semtyeq[\Gamma']{(\sigma, s[\sigma]/x)}{(\sigma', s'[\sigma']/x)}{\Gamma, x:S}
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:sem-ext-pre} on $\sigma \approx \sigma'$ and $s \approx s'$)}
  \end{align*}
  Apply $\semtyeq[\Gamma, x:S]{T}{T}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$ at $\Gamma'$, this semantic substitution,
  and $\rho \approx \rho' \in R'$:
  \begin{align*}
    \{&\ensuremath{\llbracket T[\sigma, s[\sigma]/x] \rrbracket(\rho)},\;
      \ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket (\sigma, s[\sigma]/x) \rrbracket(\rho)})}, \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket (\sigma', s'[\sigma']/x) \rrbracket(\rho')})},\;
      \ensuremath{\llbracket T[\sigma', s'[\sigma']/x] \rrbracket(\rho')}\}
      &&\subseteq \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}_I).
  \end{align*}

  Identify the four values syntactically and definitionally:
  \begin{align*}
    &T[\sigma, s[\sigma]/x] = 
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:subst-ext-comm})} \\
    &T[\sigma', s'[\sigma']/x] = 
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:subst-ext-comm})} \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket (\sigma, s[\sigma]/x) \rrbracket(\rho)}
      = (\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)}, \ensuremath{\llbracket s[\sigma] \rrbracket(\rho)}/x)
      && \text{(by pointwise definition of substitution evaluation)}
  \end{align*}
  Hence the four-value pattern reads:
  \begin{align*}
    \{&\ensuremath{\llbracket  \rrbracket(\rho)},\;
      \ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket((\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)}, \ensuremath{\llbracket s[\sigma] \rrbracket(\rho)}/x))}, \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket((\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')}, \ensuremath{\llbracket s'[\sigma'] \rrbracket(\rho')}/x))},\;
      \ensuremath{\llbracket  \rrbracket(\rho')}\}
      &&\subseteq \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}_I).
  \end{align*}
  The outer-left value matches the goal's outer-left
  $\ensuremath{\llbracket  \rrbracket(\rho)}$.
  The outer-right value $\ensuremath{\llbracket  \rrbracket(\rho')}$
  governs the same PER as
  $\ensuremath{\llbracket  \rrbracket(\rho')}$ by
  \Cref{lem:univ-functional} once we establish
  \[
    \ensuremath{\llbracket  \rrbracket(\rho')} \approx
    \ensuremath{\llbracket  \rrbracket(\rho')} \in \mathcal{U}_i,
  \]
  which holds by another instantiation of
  $\semtyeq[\Gamma, x:S]{T}{T}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$ at the related env-pair
  \[
    (\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')}, \ensuremath{\llbracket s[\sigma'] \rrbracket(\rho')}/x) \approx
    (\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')}, \ensuremath{\llbracket s'[\sigma'] \rrbracket(\rho')}/x)
    \in R_{\Gamma, x:S}
  \]
  (using the four-value relatedness of $s, s'$).

  \emph{Pattern B (inner instantiation): $(\ensuremath{\textsf{id}}, s/x)$ vs $(\ensuremath{\textsf{id}}, s'/x)$.}
  By \Cref{lem:sem-ext-pre} on $\semtyeq[\Gamma]{\ensuremath{\textsf{id}}}{\ensuremath{\textsf{id}}}{\Gamma}$ and
  $\semtyeq[\Gamma]{s}{s'}{S}$:
  $\semtyeq[\Gamma]{(\ensuremath{\textsf{id}}, s/x)}{(\ensuremath{\textsf{id}}, s'/x)}{\Gamma, x:S}$
  (using $s[\ensuremath{\textsf{id}}] = s$ and $s'[\ensuremath{\textsf{id}}] = s'$).
  From $\semtyeq[\Gamma']{\sigma}{\sigma'}{\Gamma}$ at $\ensuremath{\textsf{id}}$, $\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}$:
  $\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)} \approx \ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')} \in R_\Gamma$.
  Apply $\semtyeq[\Gamma, x:S]{T}{T}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$ at $\Gamma$ (with $R_\Gamma$),
  this semantic substitution, and
  $\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)} \approx \ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')} \in R_\Gamma$:
  \begin{align*}
    \{&\ensuremath{\llbracket T[\ensuremath{\textsf{id}}, s/x] \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)})},\;
      \ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket (\ensuremath{\textsf{id}}, s/x) \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)})})}, \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket (\ensuremath{\textsf{id}}, s'/x) \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')})})},\;
      \ensuremath{\llbracket T[\ensuremath{\textsf{id}}, s'/x] \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')})}\}
      &&\subseteq \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R_O^B.
  \end{align*}
  Identify $T[\ensuremath{\textsf{id}}, s/x] = T[s/x]$, $T[\ensuremath{\textsf{id}}, s'/x] = T[s'/x]$, and
  $\ensuremath{\llbracket (\ensuremath{\textsf{id}}, s/x) \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)})}
  = (\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)}, \ensuremath{\llbracket s \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)})}/x)$ (pointwise;
  $\ensuremath{\llbracket \ensuremath{\textsf{id}} \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)})} = \ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)}$).
  So the four-value pattern reads:
  \begin{align*}
    \{&\ensuremath{\llbracket T[s/x] \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)})},\;
      \ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket((\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)}, \ensuremath{\llbracket s \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)})}/x))}, \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket((\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')}, \ensuremath{\llbracket s' \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')})}/x))},\;
      \ensuremath{\llbracket T[s'/x] \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')})}\}
      &&\subseteq \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R_O^B.
  \end{align*}
  The outer values match the goal's inner-left
  $\ensuremath{\llbracket T[s/x] \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)})}$ and inner-right
  $\ensuremath{\llbracket T[s'/x] \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')})}$ (modulo
  \Cref{lem:univ-functional} on $T[s/x]$ vs $T[s'/x]$ at
  $\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')}$, established as in Pattern A).

  \emph{Bridging Pattern A and Pattern B.}
  Pattern A's inner-left is
  \[
    \ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket((\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)}, \ensuremath{\llbracket s[\sigma] \rrbracket(\rho)}/x))}
  \]
  and Pattern B's inner-left is
  \[
    \ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket((\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)}, \ensuremath{\llbracket s \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)})}/x))}.
  \]
  We bridge them via \Cref{lem:sem-ty-id}. We show
  \[
    (\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)}, \ensuremath{\llbracket s[\sigma] \rrbracket(\rho)}/x) \approx
    (\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)}, \ensuremath{\llbracket s \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)})}/x)
    \in R_{\Gamma, x:S}
  \]
  by \textsc{Ctx-Ext}'s biconditional:
  \begin{align*}
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)} \approx \ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)} \in R_\Gamma
      && \text{(reflexive; let $\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}_\Gamma$ be this witness)} \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket s[\sigma] \rrbracket(\rho)} \approx \ensuremath{\llbracket s \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)})} \in R_I
      && \text{(outer-left vs inner-left of the four-value pattern of $s$)} \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket S[\sigma] \rrbracket(\rho)} \approx \ensuremath{\llbracket S \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)})} \in \mathcal{U}_i
      && \text{(outer-left vs inner-left of the type part of $s$)} \\
    &R_I \Leftrightarrow R_H^\Gamma(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}_\Gamma)
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:univ-functional}, both governed by $\ensuremath{\llbracket S[\sigma] \rrbracket(\rho)}$)} \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket s[\sigma] \rrbracket(\rho)} \approx \ensuremath{\llbracket s \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)})}
      \in R_H^\Gamma(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}_\Gamma)
      && \text{(transferring across the biconditional)}
  \end{align*}
  Apply \Cref{lem:sem-ty-id} on $\semtyeq[\Gamma, x:S]{T}{T}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$ at this
  related pair:
  \begin{multline*}
    \ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket((\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)}, \ensuremath{\llbracket s[\sigma] \rrbracket(\rho)}/x))}
    \approx \\
    \ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket((\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)}, \ensuremath{\llbracket s \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)})}/x))}
    \in \mathcal{U}_i.
  \end{multline*}
  Analogously on the primed side, bridging Pattern A's
  inner-right and Pattern B's inner-right:
  \begin{multline*}
    \ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket((\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')}, \ensuremath{\llbracket s'[\sigma'] \rrbracket(\rho')}/x))}
    \approx \\
    \ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket((\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')}, \ensuremath{\llbracket s' \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')})}/x))}
    \in \mathcal{U}_i.
  \end{multline*}

  \emph{Combining.}
  By transitivity of $\mathcal{U}_i \searrow R_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}_I)$ through the bridges:
  \begin{align*}
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket  \rrbracket(\rho)} \approx
      \ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket((\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)}, \ensuremath{\llbracket s[\sigma] \rrbracket(\rho)}/x))}
      && \text{(Pattern A: outer-left vs inner-left)} \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket((\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)}, \ensuremath{\llbracket s[\sigma] \rrbracket(\rho)}/x))} \approx
      \ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket((\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)}, \ensuremath{\llbracket s \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)})}/x))}
      && \text{(bridge above)} \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket((\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)}, \ensuremath{\llbracket s \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)})}/x))} \approx
      \ensuremath{\llbracket T[s/x] \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)})}
      && \text{(Pattern B, with $R_O^B \Leftrightarrow R_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}_I)$
        by \Cref{lem:univ-functional})}
  \end{align*}
  Hence the goal's outer-left $\approx$ goal's inner-left in
  $\mathcal{U}_i \searrow R_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}_I)$.
  Analogously for outer-right $\approx$ inner-right (using the primed bridge).
  Combined with Pattern A's outer pair and Pattern B's outer pair (which directly
  relate inner-left to inner-right in their respective four-value patterns), all
  four type values lie pairwise in $\mathcal{U}_i \searrow R_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}_I)$.
<!-- end proof-87 -->
<!-- lemma-89: body_md -->
\label{lem:sem-rec}
  Suppose:
  \begin{enumerate}
  \@idxitem $\semtyeq[\Gamma, x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}]{T}{T'}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$,
  \@idxitem $\semtyeq[\Gamma]{z}{z'}{T[\textsf{zero}/x]}$,
  \@idxitem $\semtyeq[\Gamma, x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}, y:T]{s}{s'}{T[\Uparrow \circ \Uparrow, \textsf{succ}~x_1/x]}$,
  \@idxitem $\Gamma \approx \Gamma \searrow R_\Gamma$ and
    $\rho \approx \rho' \in R_\Gamma$.
  \end{enumerate}
  Then for every $a \approx a' \in \textsf{Nat}$, there exist domain values
  $b, b'$ with
  \begin{align*}
    &\mathsf{rec}(a,\, T,\, z,\, s,\, \rho) \searrow b, \\
    &\mathsf{rec}(a',\, T',\, z',\, s',\, \rho') \searrow b',
  \end{align*}
  and $b \approx b' \in R_T$, where $R_T$ is determined by
  $\ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket((\rho, a/x))} \approx \ensuremath{\llbracket T' \rrbracket((\rho', a'/x))} \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R_T$.

  Symmetric/reflexive instances also follow: by symmetry and transitivity of the
  hypotheses (\Cref{lem:sem-sym}, \Cref{lem:sem-trans}), the lemma can be applied
  at $T \approx T$ (using only $T$ on both sides) when needed.

  Furthermore, this $\mathcal{U}_i$-relatedness of types holds.
<!-- end lemma-89 -->
<!-- proof-88: body_md -->
We first establish the second claim.
  \begin{align*}
    &(\Gamma, x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}) \approx (\Gamma, x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}) \searrow R_{\Gamma, x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:fund-ctx-ext} on $\semtyeq[\Gamma]{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{0}}}$)} \\
    &\text{the head PER of $R_{\Gamma, x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}$ is $\textsf{Nat}$}
      && \text{(by \textsc{U-Nat})} \\
    &(\rho, a/x) \approx (\rho', a'/x) \in R_{\Gamma, x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}
      && \text{(by \textsc{Ctx-Ext}'s biconditional)} \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket((\rho, a/x))} \approx \ensuremath{\llbracket T' \rrbracket((\rho', a'/x))} \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R_T
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:sem-ty-id} on $\semtyeq[\Gamma, x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}]{T}{T'}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$)}
  \end{align*}
  for some $R_T$.

  We prove the first claim by induction on $a \approx a' \in \textsf{Nat}$.

  \medskip\noindent
  \textbf{Case}
  \begin{mathpar}
    \inferrule[\textsc{Nat-Ze}]
    { }
    {\texttt{ze} \approx \texttt{ze} \in \textsf{Nat}}
  \end{mathpar}
  Here $a = a' = \texttt{ze}$.
  \begin{align*}
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket z \rrbracket(\rho)} \searrow b
      && \text{(some $b$, by termination via \Cref{lem:sem-ty-id})} \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket z' \rrbracket(\rho')} \searrow b'
      && \text{(some $b'$)} \\
    &\mathsf{rec}(\texttt{ze},\, T,\, z,\, s,\, \rho) \searrow b
      && \text{(by \textsc{rec-ze})} \\
    &\mathsf{rec}(\texttt{ze},\, T',\, z',\, s',\, \rho') \searrow b'
      && \text{(by \textsc{rec-ze})}
  \end{align*}
  We must show $b \approx b' \in R_T$.
  \begin{align*}
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket z \rrbracket(\rho)} \approx \ensuremath{\llbracket z' \rrbracket(\rho')} \in R_z
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:sem-ty-id})} \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket T[\textsf{zero}/x] \rrbracket(\rho)} \approx \ensuremath{\llbracket T[\textsf{zero}/x] \rrbracket(\rho')}
      \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R_z
      && \text{(type part of \Cref{lem:sem-ty-id})}
  \end{align*}
  Hence $b \approx b' \in R_z$.
  We show $R_z \Leftrightarrow R_T$.
  \begin{align*}
    &\semtyeq[\Gamma]{(\ensuremath{\textsf{id}}, \textsf{zero}/x)}{(\ensuremath{\textsf{id}}, \textsf{zero}/x)}{\Gamma, x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:sem-ext-pre} on $\ensuremath{\textsf{id}}$ and \Cref{lem:fund-ze})} \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket T[\textsf{zero}/x] \rrbracket(\rho)} \approx \ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket((\rho, \texttt{ze}/x))} \in \mathcal{U}_i
      && \text{(outer-vs-inner of $T$ at $(\ensuremath{\textsf{id}}, \textsf{zero}/x)$, $\rho \approx \rho'$,} \\
    & && \text{using $T[\ensuremath{\textsf{id}}, \textsf{zero}/x] = T[\textsf{zero}/x]$ and ev-ze)} \\
    &R_z \Leftrightarrow R_T
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:univ-functional})}
  \end{align*}
  Hence $b \approx b' \in R_T$.

  \medskip\noindent
  \textbf{Case}
  \begin{mathpar}
    \inferrule[\textsc{Nat-Su}]
    {a_0 \approx a_0' \in \textsf{Nat}}
    {\texttt{su}(a_0) \approx \texttt{su}(a_0') \in \textsf{Nat}}
  \end{mathpar}
  with $a = \texttt{su}(a_0)$, $a' = \texttt{su}(a_0')$.
  By IH on $a_0 \approx a_0'$, there exist $b_0, b_0'$ with
  \begin{align*}
    &\mathsf{rec}(a_0,\, T,\, z,\, s,\, \rho) \searrow b_0
      && \text{(by IH)} \\
    &\mathsf{rec}(a_0',\, T',\, z',\, s',\, \rho') \searrow b_0'
      && \text{(by IH)} \\
    &b_0 \approx b_0' \in R_T^0
      && \text{(by IH, with $R_T^0$ governed by $\ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket((\rho, a_0/x))}$)}
  \end{align*}
  By \textsc{rec-su}:
  \begin{align*}
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket s \rrbracket((\rho, a_0/x, b_0/y))} \searrow b
      && \text{(some $b$)} \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket s' \rrbracket((\rho', a_0'/x, b_0'/y))} \searrow b'
      && \text{(some $b'$)} \\
    &\mathsf{rec}(\texttt{su}(a_0),\, T,\, z,\, s,\, \rho) \searrow b
      && \text{(by \textsc{rec-su})} \\
    &\mathsf{rec}(\texttt{su}(a_0'),\, T',\, z',\, s',\, \rho') \searrow b'
      && \text{(by \textsc{rec-su})}
  \end{align*}
  We must show $b \approx b' \in R_T$.
  Build the env-pair in $R_{\Gamma, x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}, y:T}$:
  \begin{align*}
    &(\rho, a_0/x) \approx (\rho', a_0'/x) \in R_{\Gamma, x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}
      && \text{(by \textsc{Ctx-Ext}, head PER $\textsf{Nat}$)} \\
    &(\rho, a_0/x, b_0/y) \approx (\rho', a_0'/x, b_0'/y) \\
    & \quad \in R_{\Gamma, x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}, y:T}
      && \text{(by \textsc{Ctx-Ext}, head PER $R_T^0$)}
  \end{align*}
  Apply \Cref{lem:sem-ty-id} on
  $\semtyeq[\Gamma, x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}, y:T]{s}{s'}
  {T[\Uparrow \circ \Uparrow, \textsf{succ}~x_1/x]}$ at this env-pair:
  \begin{align*}
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket T[\Uparrow \circ \Uparrow, \textsf{succ}~x_1/x] \rrbracket((\rho, a_0/x, b_0/y))} \\
    & \quad \approx
      \ensuremath{\llbracket T[\Uparrow \circ \Uparrow, \textsf{succ}~x_1/x] \rrbracket((\rho', a_0'/x, b_0'/y))} \\
    & \quad \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R_s
      && \text{(type part of \Cref{lem:sem-ty-id})} \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket s \rrbracket((\rho, a_0/x, b_0/y))} \approx
      \ensuremath{\llbracket s' \rrbracket((\rho', a_0'/x, b_0'/y))} \in R_s
      && \text{(term part of \Cref{lem:sem-ty-id})}
  \end{align*}
  where $R_s$ is the PER governed by
  \[
    \ensuremath{\llbracket T[\Uparrow \circ \Uparrow, \textsf{succ}~x_1/x] \rrbracket((\rho, a_0/x, b_0/y))}.
  \]
  Hence $b \approx b' \in R_s$.

  We show $R_s \Leftrightarrow R_T$ by instantiating hypothesis on $T$ at the
  substitution $\tau := (\Uparrow \circ \Uparrow, \textsf{succ}~x_1/x)$ over
  $\Gamma, x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}, y:T$ (mapping into $\Gamma, x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}$).
  Semantic well-formedness of $\tau$:
  \begin{align*}
    &\semtyeq[\Gamma, x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}, y:T]{\Uparrow \circ \Uparrow}{\Uparrow \circ \Uparrow}{\Gamma}
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:sem-wk-shift} (twice), \Cref{lem:sem-wk-comp}, and \Cref{lem:sem-wk})} \\
    &\semtyeq[\Gamma, x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}, y:T]{x_1}{x_1}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:fund-var}, lookup $x_1 : \ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}[\Uparrow] = \ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}$)} \\
    &\semtyeq[\Gamma, x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}, y:T]{\textsf{succ}~x_1}{\textsf{succ}~x_1}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:fund-su})} \\
    &\semtyeq[\Gamma, x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}, y:T]{\tau}{\tau}{\Gamma, x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:sem-ext-pre})}
  \end{align*}
  Apply $\semtyeq[\Gamma, x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}]{T}{T}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$ at $\Gamma, x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}, y:T$,
  $\tau \approx \tau$, and the env-pair
  $(\rho, a_0/x, b_0/y) \approx (\rho, a_0/x, b_0/y) \in R_{\Gamma, x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}, y:T}$
  (reflexive):
  \begin{align*}
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket T[\tau] \rrbracket((\rho, a_0/x, b_0/y))} \approx
      \ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \tau \rrbracket((\rho, a_0/x, b_0/y))})} \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R'
      && \text{(outer-left vs inner-left)} \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket \tau \rrbracket((\rho, a_0/x, b_0/y))} = (\rho, \texttt{su}(a_0)/x)
      && \text{(by pointwise eval: $\Uparrow \circ \Uparrow$ projects to $\rho$,} \\
    & && \text{$\textsf{succ}~x_1$ evaluates to $\texttt{su}(a_0)$ via ev-su, ev-var)}
  \end{align*}
  Hence:
  \begin{align*}
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket T[\Uparrow \circ \Uparrow, \textsf{succ}~x_1/x] \rrbracket((\rho, a_0/x, b_0/y))} \approx
      \ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket((\rho, \texttt{su}(a_0)/x))} \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R'
      && \text{(by the above)}
  \end{align*}
  Combining with the second claim
  $\ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket((\rho, \texttt{su}(a_0)/x))} \approx \ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket((\rho', \texttt{su}(a_0')/x))} \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R_T$
  (applied at $\texttt{su}(a_0) \approx \texttt{su}(a_0')$):
  \begin{align*}
    &R_s \Leftrightarrow R' \Leftrightarrow R_T
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:univ-functional} on shared values)}
  \end{align*}
  Hence $b \approx b' \in R_T$.

  \medskip\noindent
  \textbf{Case}
  \begin{mathpar}
    \inferrule[\textsc{Nat-Ne}]
    {e \approx e' \in \textsf{Ne}}
    {{\uparrow}^N(e) \approx {\uparrow}^N(e') \in \textsf{Nat}}
  \end{mathpar}
  with $a = {\uparrow}^N(e)$, $a' = {\uparrow}^N(e')$.
  Compute the eliminator outputs by \textsc{rec-ne}:
  \begin{align*}
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket((\rho, {\uparrow}^N(e)/x))} \searrow A
      && \text{(by the second claim, governing $R_T$)} \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket((\rho', {\uparrow}^N(e')/x))} \searrow A'
      && \text{(analogously)} \\
    &A \approx A' \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R_T
      && \text{(by the second claim at ${\uparrow}^N(e) \approx {\uparrow}^N(e')$)} \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket z \rrbracket(\rho)} \searrow a_z,\;\; \ensuremath{\llbracket z' \rrbracket(\rho')} \searrow a_z',\;\;
      a_z \approx a_z' \in R_z
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:sem-ty-id} on $\semtyeq[\Gamma]{z}{z'}{T[\textsf{zero}/x]}$)} \\
    &b = {\uparrow}^A(\mathsf{rec}(T, a_z, s, \rho, e))
      && \text{(by \textsc{rec-ne})} \\
    &b' = {\uparrow}^{A'}(\mathsf{rec}(T, a_z', s', \rho', e'))
      && \text{(by \textsc{rec-ne})}
  \end{align*}

  We must show $b \approx b' \in R_T$.
  By \Cref{lem:ne-in-R} on $A \approx A' \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R_T$, it suffices to show
  \begin{align*}
    &\mathsf{rec}(T, a_z, s, \rho, e) \approx \mathsf{rec}(T, a_z', s', \rho', e') \in \textsf{Ne},
  \end{align*}
  i.e.\ for every depth $n$ both sides read back via $\textsf{R}^{\textsf{Ne}}_n$ to the same neutral
  normal form.
  By rule \textsc{Re-rec}:
  \begin{align*}
    &\textsf{R}^{\textsf{Ne}}_n(\mathsf{rec}(T, a_z, s, \rho, e))
      \searrow \ensuremath{\textsf{elim}_{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}~(x.\,W_T)~w_z~(x, y.\,w_s)~u}
  \end{align*}
  whenever
  \begin{align*}
    &\textsf{R}^{\textsf{Ty}}_{n+1}(A_x) \searrow W_T
      && \text{where $\ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket((\rho, {\uparrow}^N(\ell_n)/x))} \searrow A_x$} \\
    &\textsf{R}^{\textsf{Nf}}_n({\downarrow}^{A_z}(a_z)) \searrow w_z
      && \text{where $\ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket((\rho, \texttt{ze}/x))} \searrow A_z$} \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket s \rrbracket((\rho, {\uparrow}^N(\ell_n)/x, {\uparrow}^{A_x}(\ell_{n+1})/y))} \searrow b_s \\
    &\textsf{R}^{\textsf{Nf}}_{n+2}({\downarrow}^{A_x^{\textsf{succ}~}}(b_s)) \searrow w_s
      && \text{where $\ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket((\rho, \texttt{su}({\uparrow}^N(\ell_n))/x))} \searrow A_x^{\textsf{succ}~}$} \\
    &\textsf{R}^{\textsf{Ne}}_n(e) \searrow u
  \end{align*}
  (and analogously for the primed side, producing
  $\ensuremath{\textsf{elim}_{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}~(x.\,W_T')~w_z'~(x, y.\,w_s')~u'}$).
  We show each component reads back to the same syntactic form.

  \emph{Motive $W_T = W_T'$.}
  Apply $\semtyeq[\Gamma, x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}]{T}{T}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$ at the env-pair extended with the
  fresh level $\ell_n$:
  \begin{align*}
    &{\uparrow}^N(\ell_n) \approx {\uparrow}^N(\ell_n) \in \textsf{Nat}
      && \text{(by \textsc{Nat-Ne}, $\ell_n \approx \ell_n \in \textsf{Ne}$)} \\
    &(\rho, {\uparrow}^N(\ell_n)/x) \approx (\rho', {\uparrow}^N(\ell_n)/x) \in R_{\Gamma, x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}
      && \text{(by \textsc{Ctx-Ext})} \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket((\rho, {\uparrow}^N(\ell_n)/x))} \approx
      \ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket((\rho', {\uparrow}^N(\ell_n)/x))} \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R_T^\ell
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:sem-ty-id})} \\
    &W_T = W_T'
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:type-readback})}
  \end{align*}

  \emph{Zero branch $w_z = w_z'$.}
  Apply $\semtyeq[\Gamma]{z}{z'}{T[\textsf{zero}/x]}$ at $\Gamma$, $\ensuremath{\textsf{id}}$, and
  $\rho \approx \rho' \in R_\Gamma$ (term and type parts):
  \begin{align*}
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket  \rrbracket(\rho)} \approx \ensuremath{\llbracket T[\textsf{zero}/x] \rrbracket(\rho')}
      \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R_z
      && \text{(type part)} \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket z[\ensuremath{\textsf{id}}] \rrbracket(\rho)} \approx \ensuremath{\llbracket z' \rrbracket(\rho')} \in R_z
      && \text{(term part)} \\
    &a_z \approx a_z' \in R_z
      && \text{(using $z[\ensuremath{\textsf{id}}] = z$, $z'[\ensuremath{\textsf{id}}] = z'$)}
  \end{align*}
  Bridge $R_z \Leftrightarrow R_T$-at-$\texttt{ze}$ via the same outer-vs-inner pattern as
  the \textsc{Nat-Ze} case (instantiate $T$ at $(\ensuremath{\textsf{id}}, \textsf{zero}/x)$).
  By \Cref{lem:R-readback} on $a_z \approx a_z' \in R_T$-at-$\texttt{ze}$:
  \begin{align*}
    &w_z = w_z'
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:R-readback})}
  \end{align*}

  \emph{Step branch $w_s = w_s'$.}
  Build the env-pair at fresh levels:
  \begin{align*}
    &(\rho, {\uparrow}^N(\ell_n)/x) \approx (\rho', {\uparrow}^N(\ell_n)/x) \in R_{\Gamma, x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}
      && \text{(as above)} \\
    &(\rho, {\uparrow}^N(\ell_n)/x, {\uparrow}^{A_x}(\ell_{n+1})/y) \approx \\
    &\quad (\rho', {\uparrow}^N(\ell_n)/x, {\uparrow}^{A_x'}(\ell_{n+1})/y) \in R_{\Gamma, x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}, y:T}
      && \text{(by \textsc{Ctx-Ext}, head PER $R_T^\ell$;} \\
    & && \text{${\uparrow}^{A_x}(\ell_{n+1}) \approx {\uparrow}^{A_x'}(\ell_{n+1}) \in R_T^\ell$} \\
    & && \text{by \Cref{lem:ne-in-R})}
  \end{align*}
  Apply $\semtyeq[\Gamma, x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}, y:T]{s}{s'}{T[\Uparrow \circ \Uparrow, \textsf{succ}~x_1/x]}$ at this env-pair
  (term and type parts, after bridging $T[\Uparrow \circ \Uparrow, \textsf{succ}~x_1/x]$ to $T$ at
  $\texttt{su}({\uparrow}^N(\ell_n))/x$ as in the \textsc{Nat-Su} case):
  \begin{align*}
    &b_s \approx b_s' \in R_T \text{-at-} \texttt{su}({\uparrow}^N(\ell_n))
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:sem-ty-id} and bridging)}
  \end{align*}
  By \Cref{lem:R-readback}:
  \begin{align*}
    &w_s = w_s'
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:R-readback})}
  \end{align*}

  \emph{Underlying neutral $u = u'$.}
  By hypothesis $e \approx e' \in \textsf{Ne}$:
  \begin{align*}
    &\textsf{R}^{\textsf{Ne}}_n(e) \searrow u,\;\; \textsf{R}^{\textsf{Ne}}_n(e') \searrow u
      && \text{(by definition of $\textsf{Ne}$)}
  \end{align*}

  Combining:
  \begin{align*}
    &\textsf{R}^{\textsf{Ne}}_n(\mathsf{rec}(T, a_z, s, \rho, e)) \searrow
      \ensuremath{\textsf{elim}_{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}~(x.\,W_T)~w_z~(x, y.\,w_s)~u} \\
    &\textsf{R}^{\textsf{Ne}}_n(\mathsf{rec}(T, a_z', s', \rho', e')) \searrow
      \ensuremath{\textsf{elim}_{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}~(x.\,W_T)~w_z~(x, y.\,w_s)~u}
      && \text{(same syntactic form)} \\
    &\mathsf{rec}(T, a_z, s, \rho, e) \approx \mathsf{rec}(T, a_z', s', \rho', e') \in \textsf{Ne}
      && \text{(by definition of $\textsf{Ne}$)}
  \end{align*}
  Hence $b \approx b' \in R_T$.
<!-- end proof-88 -->
<!-- lemma-90: body_md -->
\label{lem:sem-rec-subst}
  Suppose:
  \begin{enumerate}
  \@idxitem $\semtyeq[\Gamma, x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}]{T}{T'}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$,
  \@idxitem $\semtyeq[\Gamma]{z}{z'}{T[\textsf{zero}/x]}$,
  \@idxitem $\semtyeq[\Gamma, x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}, y:T]{s}{s'}{T[\Uparrow \circ \Uparrow, \textsf{succ}~x_1/x]}$,
  \@idxitem $\Gamma' \approx \Gamma' \searrow R'$,
    $\semtyeq[\Gamma']{\sigma}{\sigma'}{\Gamma}$, and
    $\rho \approx \rho' \in R'$.
  \end{enumerate}
  Then for every $a \approx a' \in \textsf{Nat}$, there exist domain values
  $b, b'$ with
  \begin{align*}
    &\mathsf{rec}(a,\, T[q(\sigma)],\, z[\sigma],\, s[q^2(\sigma)],\, \rho)
      \searrow b
      && \text{(substituted, left)} \\
    &\mathsf{rec}(a',\, T',\, z',\, s',\, \ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')}) \searrow b'
      && \text{(unsubstituted, right)}
  \end{align*}
  and $b \approx b' \in R_T$, where $R_T$ is determined by
  $\ensuremath{\llbracket T[q(\sigma)] \rrbracket((\rho, a/x))} \approx
  \ensuremath{\llbracket T' \rrbracket((\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')}, a'/x))} \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R_T$.

  Furthermore, this $\mathcal{U}_i$-relatedness of types holds.
<!-- end lemma-90 -->
<!-- proof-89: body_md -->
We first establish the lifted substitution and the second claim.
  \begin{align*}
    &\semtyeq[\Gamma', x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}]{q(\sigma)}{q(\sigma')}{\Gamma, x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:sem-q} on $\sigma \approx \sigma'$ and $\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}$,
        using $\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}[\sigma] = \ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}$)} \\
    &(\Gamma', x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}) \approx (\Gamma', x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}) \searrow R_{\Gamma', x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}
      && \text{(carried by the lifted substitution)} \\
    &(\Gamma, x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}) \approx (\Gamma, x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}) \searrow R_{\Gamma, x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}
      && \text{(carried by the lifted substitution)} \\
    &\text{both head PERs are $\textsf{Nat}$}
      && \text{(by \textsc{U-Nat})} \\
    &(\rho, a/x) \approx (\rho', a'/x) \in R_{\Gamma', x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}
      && \text{(by \textsc{Ctx-Ext}'s biconditional)}
  \end{align*}
  Apply $\semtyeq[\Gamma, x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}]{T}{T'}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$ at $\Gamma', x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}$, the lifted
  substitution, and the env-pair above:
  \begin{align*}
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket T[q(\sigma)] \rrbracket((\rho, a/x))} \approx
      \ensuremath{\llbracket T' \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket q(\sigma') \rrbracket((\rho', a'/x))})} \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R_T
      && \text{(outer-left vs inner-right of the four-value pattern)}
  \end{align*}
  Bridge $\ensuremath{\llbracket q(\sigma') \rrbracket((\rho', a'/x))}$ to $(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')}, a'/x)$:
  \begin{align*}
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket q(\sigma') \rrbracket((\rho', a'/x))} \approx (\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')}, a'/x)
      \in R_{\Gamma, x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}
      && \text{(by \textsc{Ctx-Ext}, tail via $\sigma'$ at $\Uparrow$, head $a' \approx a'$)} \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket T' \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket q(\sigma') \rrbracket((\rho', a'/x))})} \approx
      \ensuremath{\llbracket T' \rrbracket((\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')}, a'/x))} \in \mathcal{U}_i
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:sem-ty-id} on $T' \approx T'$, derived from} \\
    & && \text{$T \approx T'$ via symmetry and transitivity)}
  \end{align*}
  By transitivity of $\mathcal{U}_i$ and \Cref{lem:univ-functional},
  $\ensuremath{\llbracket T[q(\sigma)] \rrbracket((\rho, a/x))} \approx
  \ensuremath{\llbracket T' \rrbracket((\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')}, a'/x))} \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R_T$,
  establishing the second claim.

  We prove the first claim by induction on $a \approx a' \in \textsf{Nat}$.

  \medskip\noindent
  \textbf{Case}
  \begin{mathpar}
    \inferrule[\textsc{Nat-Ze}]
    { }
    {\texttt{ze} \approx \texttt{ze} \in \textsf{Nat}}
  \end{mathpar}
  Here $a = a' = \texttt{ze}$.
  Apply $\semtyeq[\Gamma]{z}{z'}{T[\textsf{zero}/x]}$ at $\Gamma'$, $\sigma \approx \sigma'$,
  and $\rho \approx \rho' \in R'$ (this gives the four-value pattern of $z, z'$):
  \begin{align*}
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket z[\sigma] \rrbracket(\rho)} \searrow b,\;\; \ensuremath{\llbracket z' \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')})} \searrow b'
      && \text{(termination, by hypothesis on $z, z'$)} \\
    &b \approx b' \in R_z
      && \text{(outer-left vs inner-right of $z, z'$)} \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket  \rrbracket(\rho)} \approx
      \ensuremath{\llbracket T[\textsf{zero}/x] \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')})} \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R_z
      && \text{(corresponding type part)}
  \end{align*}
  Then by \textsc{rec-ze} applied to these evaluations:
  \begin{align*}
    &\mathsf{rec}(\texttt{ze},\, T[q(\sigma)],\, z[\sigma],\, s[q^2(\sigma)],\, \rho)
      \searrow b
      && \text{(by \textsc{rec-ze}, using $\ensuremath{\llbracket z[\sigma] \rrbracket(\rho)} \searrow b$)} \\
    &\mathsf{rec}(\texttt{ze},\, T',\, z',\, s',\, \ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')}) \searrow b'
      && \text{(by \textsc{rec-ze}, using $\ensuremath{\llbracket z' \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')})} \searrow b'$)}
  \end{align*}
  We must show $b \approx b' \in R_T$.
  Currently $b \approx b' \in R_z$ where $R_z$ is governed by
  $\ensuremath{\llbracket  \rrbracket(\rho)}$, while $R_T$ is governed by
  $\ensuremath{\llbracket T[q(\sigma)] \rrbracket((\rho, \texttt{ze}/x))}$ (substituted left, second-claim instance
  at $a = a' = \texttt{ze}$).
  We bridge $R_z \Leftrightarrow R_T$ via two type-hypothesis instantiations.

  \emph{Left bridge.}
  By \Cref{lem:sem-ext-pre} on $\semtyeq[\Gamma']{\sigma}{\sigma}{\Gamma}$
  (reflexive instance via \Cref{lem:sem-sym,lem:sem-trans}) and
  $\semtyeq[\Gamma']{\textsf{zero}[\sigma]}{\textsf{zero}[\sigma]}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}[\sigma]}$
  (using $\textsf{zero}[\sigma] = \textsf{zero}$, $\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}[\sigma] = \ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}$, and \Cref{lem:fund-ze}):
  \begin{align*}
    &\semtyeq[\Gamma']{(\sigma, \textsf{zero}/x)}{(\sigma, \textsf{zero}/x)}{\Gamma, x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:sem-ext-pre})}
  \end{align*}
  Apply $\semtyeq[\Gamma, x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}]{T}{T}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$ at $\Gamma'$, this substitution,
  and $\rho \approx \rho \in R'$ (reflexive):
  \begin{align*}
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket T[(\sigma, \textsf{zero}/x)] \rrbracket(\rho)} \approx
      \ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket (\sigma, \textsf{zero}/x) \rrbracket(\rho)})} \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R_z'
      && \text{(outer-left vs inner-left)} \\
    &T[(\sigma, \textsf{zero}/x)] = 
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:subst-ext-comm})} \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket (\sigma, \textsf{zero}/x) \rrbracket(\rho)} = (\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)}, \texttt{ze}/x)
      && \text{(by pointwise eval, ev-ze)} \\
    &R_z' \Leftrightarrow R_z
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:univ-functional} on shared
        $\ensuremath{\llbracket  \rrbracket(\rho)}$)}
  \end{align*}
  Hence
  $\ensuremath{\llbracket  \rrbracket(\rho)} \approx \ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket((\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)}, \texttt{ze}/x))}
   \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R_z$.

  \emph{Right bridge.}
  Symmetrically, instantiate $T$ at $(\ensuremath{\textsf{id}}, \textsf{zero}/x)$ over $\Gamma$ at the env-pair
  $\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)} \approx \ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')} \in R_\Gamma$ (carried by the
  semantic-substitution hypothesis):
  \begin{align*}
    &\semtyeq[\Gamma]{(\ensuremath{\textsf{id}}, \textsf{zero}/x)}{(\ensuremath{\textsf{id}}, \textsf{zero}/x)}{\Gamma, x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:sem-ext-pre} and \Cref{lem:fund-ze})} \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket T[\textsf{zero}/x] \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')})} \approx
      \ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket((\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')}, \texttt{ze}/x))} \in \mathcal{U}_i
      && \text{(outer-vs-inner of the four-value pattern of $T$)}
  \end{align*}

  \emph{Combining via the second claim.}
  The second claim (proved above) gives:
  \begin{align*}
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket T[q(\sigma)] \rrbracket((\rho, \texttt{ze}/x))} \approx
      \ensuremath{\llbracket T' \rrbracket((\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')}, \texttt{ze}/x))} \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R_T
  \end{align*}
  Chaining via the bridges (using \Cref{lem:univ-functional},
  \Cref{lem:univ-trans}, \Cref{lem:univ-sym}):
  \begin{align*}
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket  \rrbracket(\rho)}
      \approx \ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket((\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)}, \texttt{ze}/x))} \\
    & \quad \approx \ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket((\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')}, \texttt{ze}/x))} \\
    & \quad \approx \ensuremath{\llbracket T[q(\sigma)] \rrbracket((\rho, \texttt{ze}/x))} \in \mathcal{U}_i \\
    &R_z \Leftrightarrow R_T
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:univ-functional})}
  \end{align*}
  Hence $b \approx b' \in R_T$.

  \medskip\noindent
  \textbf{Case}
  \begin{mathpar}
    \inferrule[\textsc{Nat-Su}]
    {a_0 \approx a_0' \in \textsf{Nat}}
    {\texttt{su}(a_0) \approx \texttt{su}(a_0') \in \textsf{Nat}}
  \end{mathpar}
  with $a = \texttt{su}(a_0)$, $a' = \texttt{su}(a_0')$.
  By IH on $a_0 \approx a_0'$, there exist $b_0, b_0'$ with
  \begin{align*}
    &\mathsf{rec}(a_0,\, T[q(\sigma)],\, z[\sigma],\, s[q^2(\sigma)],\, \rho)
      \searrow b_0
      && \text{(by IH)} \\
    &\mathsf{rec}(a_0',\, T',\, z',\, s',\, \ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')}) \searrow b_0'
      && \text{(by IH)} \\
    &b_0 \approx b_0' \in R_T^0
      && \text{(by IH, with $R_T^0$ governed by $\ensuremath{\llbracket T[q(\sigma)] \rrbracket((\rho, a_0/x))}$)}
  \end{align*}
  We derive the evaluations of $s[q^2(\sigma)]$ and $s'$ from the hypothesis on $s, s'$.
  First, lift $\sigma, \sigma'$ over $\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}$ and $T$:
  \begin{align*}
    &\semtyeq[\Gamma', x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}]{q(\sigma)}{q(\sigma')}{\Gamma, x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:sem-q} on
        $\sigma \approx \sigma'$ and $\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}$;} \\
    & && \text{using $\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}[\sigma] = \ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}$)} \\
    &\semtyeq[\Gamma', x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}, y:T[q(\sigma)]]
        {q^2(\sigma)}{q^2(\sigma')}{\Gamma, x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}, y:T}
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:sem-q} again on $T$)}
  \end{align*}
  Build the env-pair via two applications of \textsc{Ctx-Ext}:
  \begin{align*}
    &(\rho, a_0/x) \approx (\rho', a_0'/x) \in R_{\Gamma', x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}
      && \text{(by \textsc{Ctx-Ext}, head PER $\textsf{Nat}$)} \\
    &(\rho, a_0/x, b_0/y) \approx (\rho', a_0'/x, b_0'/y)
      \in R_{\Gamma', x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}, y:T[q(\sigma)]}
      && \text{(by \textsc{Ctx-Ext}, head PER $R_T^0$)}
  \end{align*}
  Apply $\semtyeq[\Gamma, x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}, y:T]{s}{s'}{T[\Uparrow \circ \Uparrow, \textsf{succ}~x_1/x]}$ at $\Gamma', x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}, y:T[q(\sigma)]$,
  the doubly-lifted substitution $q^2(\sigma) \approx q^2(\sigma')$, and this env-pair
  (this gives the four-value pattern of $s, s'$):
  \begin{align*}
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket s[q^2(\sigma)] \rrbracket((\rho, a_0/x, b_0/y))} \searrow b
      && \text{(termination, by hypothesis on $s$)} \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket s' \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket q^2(\sigma') \rrbracket((\rho', a_0'/x, b_0'/y))})} \searrow b'_0
      && \text{(termination, by hypothesis on $s'$)} \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket s' \rrbracket((\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')}, a_0'/x, b_0'/y))} \searrow b'
      && \text{(termination, by reflexive instance $\semtyeq[\ldots]{s'}{s'}{\ldots}$)}
  \end{align*}
  By \textsc{rec-su}:
  \begin{align*}
