    &\mathsf{rec}(\texttt{su}(a_0),\, T[q(\sigma)],\, z[\sigma],\, s[q^2(\sigma)],\, \rho)
      \searrow b
      && \text{(by \textsc{rec-su}, using $\ensuremath{\llbracket s[q^2(\sigma)] \rrbracket((\rho, a_0/x, b_0/y))} \searrow b$)} \\
    &\mathsf{rec}(\texttt{su}(a_0'),\, T',\, z',\, s',\, \ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')}) \searrow b'
      && \text{(by \textsc{rec-su}, using $\ensuremath{\llbracket s' \rrbracket((\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')}, a_0'/x, b_0'/y))} \searrow b'$)}
  \end{align*}

  We must show $b \approx b' \in R_T$.
  Outer-left vs inner-right of the four-value pattern of $s, s'$:
  \begin{align*}
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket (T[\Uparrow \circ \Uparrow, \textsf{succ}~x_1/x])[q^2(\sigma)] \rrbracket((\rho, a_0/x, b_0/y))} \approx \\
    &\quad
      \ensuremath{\llbracket T[\Uparrow \circ \Uparrow, \textsf{succ}~x_1/x] \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket q^2(\sigma') \rrbracket((\rho', a_0'/x, b_0'/y))})}
      \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R_s
      && \text{(type part)} \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket s[q^2(\sigma)] \rrbracket((\rho, a_0/x, b_0/y))} \approx
      \ensuremath{\llbracket s' \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket q^2(\sigma') \rrbracket((\rho', a_0'/x, b_0'/y))})} \in R_s
      && \text{(term part, by hypothesis on $s, s'$)}
  \end{align*}
  where $R_s$ is the PER governed by $\ensuremath{\llbracket (T[\Uparrow \circ \Uparrow, \textsf{succ}~x_1/x])[q^2(\sigma)] \rrbracket((\rho, a_0/x, b_0/y))}$.
  Bridge $\ensuremath{\llbracket q^2(\sigma') \rrbracket((\rho', a_0'/x, b_0'/y))}$ to
  $(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')}, a_0'/x, b_0'/y)$ in $R_{\Gamma, x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}, y:T}$ analogously,
  then apply \Cref{lem:sem-ty-id} on $\semtyeq[\Gamma, x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}, y:T]{s'}{s'}{T[\Uparrow \circ \Uparrow, \textsf{succ}~x_1/x]}$
  (the reflexive instance):
  \begin{align*}
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket s' \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket q^2(\sigma') \rrbracket((\rho', a_0'/x, b_0'/y))})} \approx
      \ensuremath{\llbracket s' \rrbracket((\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')}, a_0'/x, b_0'/y))} \in R_s
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:sem-ty-id})}
  \end{align*}
  By transitivity, $b \approx b' \in R_s$.

  We bridge $R_s \Leftrightarrow R_T$, where $R_s$ is governed by
  $\ensuremath{\llbracket (T[\Uparrow \circ \Uparrow, \textsf{succ}~x_1/x])[q^2(\sigma)] \rrbracket((\rho, a_0/x, b_0/y))}$ and $R_T$ is
  governed by $\ensuremath{\llbracket T[q(\sigma)] \rrbracket((\rho, \texttt{su}(a_0)/x))}$ (the second-claim
  pattern instantiated at $\texttt{su}(a_0) \approx \texttt{su}(a_0')$):
  \begin{align*}
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket T[q(\sigma)] \rrbracket((\rho, \texttt{su}(a_0)/x))} \\
    &\quad \approx \ensuremath{\llbracket T' \rrbracket((\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')}, \texttt{su}(a_0')/x))}
      \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R_T
      && \text{(second claim)}
  \end{align*}
  All bridging uses syntactic substitution-composition lemmas
  (\Cref{lem:subst-assoc,lem:ext-comp,lem:subst-cat}) and instantiations of
  hypothesis on $T$.

  \emph{Bridge B1: collapse $(T[\Uparrow \circ \Uparrow, \textsf{succ}~x_1/x])[q^2(\sigma)]$ into a single substitution.}
  \begin{align*}
    (T[\Uparrow \circ \Uparrow, \textsf{succ}~x_1/x])[q^2(\sigma)]
    &= T[(\Uparrow \circ \Uparrow, \textsf{succ}~x_1/x) \circ q^2(\sigma)]
      \tag{by \Cref{lem:subst-assoc}} \\
    &= T[(\Uparrow \circ \Uparrow) \circ q^2(\sigma),\;
       \textsf{succ}~x_1[q^2(\sigma)]/x]
      \tag{by \Cref{lem:ext-comp}} \\
    &= T[\sigma \circ (\Uparrow \circ \Uparrow),\; \textsf{succ}~x_1/x]
      \tag{using $\textsf{succ}~x_1[q^2(\sigma)] = \textsf{succ}~x_1$ (since $q^2(\sigma)(1) = x_1$)} \\
    & \tag{and $(\Uparrow \circ \Uparrow) \circ q^2(\sigma) = \sigma \circ (\Uparrow \circ \Uparrow)$
       (\Cref{lem:wk-subst-comm})}
  \end{align*}
  Denote the collapsed substitution by
  $\tau := (\sigma \circ (\Uparrow \circ \Uparrow),\, \textsf{succ}~x_1/x)$, with
  $\judge[\Gamma', x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}, y:T[q(\sigma)]]{\tau : \Gamma, x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}$.

  \emph{Bridge B2: instantiate hypothesis on $T$ via $\tau$.}
  We show $\tau$ is a semantic substitution from $\Gamma', x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}, y:T[q(\sigma)]$
  to $\Gamma, x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}$.
  By \Cref{lem:sem-wk-shift} (twice) and \Cref{lem:sem-wk-comp}:
  $\semweak[\Gamma', x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}, y:T[q(\sigma)]]{\Uparrow \circ \Uparrow}{\Gamma'}$.
  Apply \Cref{lem:sem-wk-subst} to $\semtyeq[\Gamma']{\sigma}{\sigma}{\Gamma}$
  (reflexive, by \Cref{lem:sem-sym,lem:sem-trans}) and this semantic weakening:
  \begin{align*}
    &\semtyeq[\Gamma', x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}, y:T[q(\sigma)]]
       {\sigma \circ (\Uparrow \circ \Uparrow)}
       {\sigma \circ (\Uparrow \circ \Uparrow)}
       {\Gamma}
  \end{align*}
  By \Cref{lem:fund-var}, \Cref{lem:fund-su}:
  $\semtyeq[\Gamma', x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}, y:T[q(\sigma)]]
  {\textsf{succ}~x_1}{\textsf{succ}~x_1}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}$
  (lookup $x_1 : \ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}$ at the second slot of
  $\Gamma', x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}, y:T[q(\sigma)]$, with
  $\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}[\Uparrow] = \ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}$).
  By \Cref{lem:sem-ext-pre}:
  \begin{align*}
    &\semtyeq[\Gamma', x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}, y:T[q(\sigma)]]{\tau}{\tau}{\Gamma, x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}
      && \text{(\Cref{lem:sem-ext-pre})}
  \end{align*}
  Apply $\semtyeq[\Gamma, x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}]{T}{T}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$ at
  $\Gamma', x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}, y:T[q(\sigma)]$, $\tau \approx \tau$, and the
  reflexive env-pair
  $(\rho, a_0/x, b_0/y) \approx (\rho, a_0/x, b_0/y)
  \in R_{\Gamma', x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}, y:T[q(\sigma)]}$.
  Outer-left vs inner-left:
  \begin{align*}
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket T[\tau] \rrbracket((\rho, a_0/x, b_0/y))} \\
    &\quad \approx \ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \tau \rrbracket((\rho, a_0/x, b_0/y))})}
      \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R_{B2}
  \end{align*}
  By Bridge B1,
  \[
    T[\tau] = (T[\Uparrow \circ \Uparrow, \textsf{succ}~x_1/x])[q^2(\sigma)],
  \]
  so the outer-left is exactly
  \[
    \ensuremath{\llbracket (T[\Uparrow \circ \Uparrow, \textsf{succ}~x_1/x])[q^2(\sigma)] \rrbracket((\rho, a_0/x, b_0/y))}
  \]
  --- the value governing $R_s$.
  Hence $R_s \Leftrightarrow R_{B2}$.

  By pointwise definition of substitution evaluation:
  \begin{align*}
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket \tau \rrbracket((\rho, a_0/x, b_0/y))}
      = (\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \circ (\Uparrow \circ \Uparrow) \rrbracket((\rho, a_0/x, b_0/y))},\,
       \texttt{su}(a_0)/x) \\
    & \text{(pointwise; head: $\ensuremath{\llbracket \textsf{succ}~x_1 \rrbracket((\rho, a_0/x, b_0/y))} = \texttt{su}(a_0)$ via ev-su, ev-var)}
  \end{align*}
  We do \emph{not} equate the tail
  $\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \circ (\Uparrow \circ \Uparrow) \rrbracket((\rho, a_0/x, b_0/y))}$ with
  $\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)}$ definitionally --- such an equality is a
  substitution--evaluation commutation that does not hold for operational
  substitutions. Instead, we relate them in $R_\Gamma$ via the four-value
  pattern of $\sigma \circ (\Uparrow \circ \Uparrow) := \sigma[\Uparrow \circ \Uparrow]$
  established by \Cref{lem:sem-wk-subst}, and the four-value pattern of
  $\sigma$ itself:
  \begin{align*}
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma[\Uparrow \circ \Uparrow] \rrbracket((\rho, a_0/x, b_0/y))}
      \approx \ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \Uparrow \circ \Uparrow \rrbracket((\rho, a_0/x, b_0/y))})} \in R_\Gamma
      && \text{(four-value pattern of $\sigma[\Uparrow \circ \Uparrow]$,} \\
    & && \text{outer-left vs inner-left)} \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket \Uparrow \circ \Uparrow \rrbracket((\rho, a_0/x, b_0/y))}
      \approx \rho \in R_{\Gamma'}
      && \text{(four-value pattern of $\Uparrow \circ \Uparrow$,} \\
    & && \text{by \Cref{lem:sem-shift,lem:sem-wk-comp})} \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \Uparrow \circ \Uparrow \rrbracket((\rho, a_0/x, b_0/y))})}
      \approx \ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)} \in R_\Gamma
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:sem-ty-id} on the reflexive $\sigma$)}
  \end{align*}
  By transitivity of $R_\Gamma$:
  \begin{align*}
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \circ (\Uparrow \circ \Uparrow) \rrbracket((\rho, a_0/x, b_0/y))}
      \approx \ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)} \in R_\Gamma \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket \tau \rrbracket((\rho, a_0/x, b_0/y))} \approx (\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)},\, \texttt{su}(a_0)/x)
      \in R_{\Gamma, x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}
      && \text{(by \textsc{Ctx-Ext}, head $\texttt{su}(a_0) \approx \texttt{su}(a_0)$)}
  \end{align*}

  \emph{Bridge B3: instantiate hypothesis on $T$ via $q(\sigma)$.}
  Apply $\semtyeq[\Gamma, x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}]{T}{T}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$ at $\Gamma', x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}$, the lifted
  $q(\sigma) \approx q(\sigma)$, and reflexive
  $(\rho, \texttt{su}(a_0)/x) \approx (\rho, \texttt{su}(a_0)/x) \in R_{\Gamma', x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}$
  (head $\texttt{su}(a_0) \approx \texttt{su}(a_0)$ via \Cref{lem:nat-per} reflexivity).
  Outer-left vs inner-left:
  \begin{align*}
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket T[q(\sigma)] \rrbracket((\rho, \texttt{su}(a_0)/x))} \\
    &\quad \approx \ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket q(\sigma) \rrbracket((\rho, \texttt{su}(a_0)/x))})}
      \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R_{B3} \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket q(\sigma) \rrbracket((\rho, \texttt{su}(a_0)/x))}
      \approx (\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)}, \texttt{su}(a_0)/x) \in R_{\Gamma, x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}
      && \text{(by \textsc{Ctx-Ext})}
  \end{align*}

  \emph{Combining B2 and B3.}
  By B2's bridging,
  $\ensuremath{\llbracket \tau \rrbracket((\rho, a_0/x, b_0/y))} \approx (\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)}, \texttt{su}(a_0)/x)
   \in R_{\Gamma, x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}$.
  By B3's \textsc{Ctx-Ext} computation,
  $\ensuremath{\llbracket q(\sigma) \rrbracket((\rho, \texttt{su}(a_0)/x))} \approx (\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)}, \texttt{su}(a_0)/x)
   \in R_{\Gamma, x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}$ (PER-related, via the lifted-substitution evidence).
  Apply \Cref{lem:sem-ty-id} on $T$ to bridge the B3 inner-left:
  \begin{align*}
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket q(\sigma) \rrbracket((\rho, \texttt{su}(a_0)/x))})}
      \approx \ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket((\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)}, \texttt{su}(a_0)/x))} \in \mathcal{U}_i
      && \text{(\Cref{lem:sem-ty-id})}
  \end{align*}
  Both B2 and B3 inner-left values are now $\mathcal{U}_i$-related to the common value
  $\ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket((\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)}, \texttt{su}(a_0)/x))}$, so by transitivity and
  \Cref{lem:univ-functional}, $R_{B2} \Leftrightarrow R_{B3}$.

  Chaining: $R_s \Leftrightarrow R_{B2} \Leftrightarrow R_{B3} \Leftrightarrow R_T$.
  Hence $b \approx b' \in R_T$.

  \medskip\noindent
  \textbf{Case}
  \begin{mathpar}
    \inferrule[\textsc{Nat-Ne}]
    {e \approx e' \in \textsf{Ne}}
    {{\uparrow}^N(e) \approx {\uparrow}^N(e') \in \textsf{Nat}}
  \end{mathpar}
  with $a = {\uparrow}^N(e)$, $a' = {\uparrow}^N(e')$.
  Compute the eliminator outputs by \textsc{rec-ne}:
  \begin{align*}
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket T[q(\sigma)] \rrbracket((\rho, {\uparrow}^N(e)/x))} \searrow A
      && \text{(governing the left motive)} \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket T' \rrbracket((\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')}, {\uparrow}^N(e')/x))} \searrow A'
      && \text{(governing the right motive)} \\
    &A \approx A' \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R_T
      && \text{(by the second claim at ${\uparrow}^N(e) \approx {\uparrow}^N(e')$)} \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket z[\sigma] \rrbracket(\rho)} \searrow a_z,\;\;
      \ensuremath{\llbracket z' \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')})} \searrow a_z',\;\;
      a_z \approx a_z' \in R_z
      && \text{(by hypothesis on $z, z'$)} \\
    &b = {\uparrow}^A(\mathsf{rec}(T[q(\sigma)], a_z, s[q^2(\sigma)], \rho, e))
      && \text{(by \textsc{rec-ne})} \\
    &b' = {\uparrow}^{A'}(\mathsf{rec}(T', a_z', s', \ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')}, e'))
      && \text{(by \textsc{rec-ne})}
  \end{align*}

  We must show $b \approx b' \in R_T$.
  By \Cref{lem:ne-in-R} on $A \approx A' \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R_T$, it suffices to show
  \begin{align*}
    &\mathsf{rec}(T[q(\sigma)], a_z, s[q^2(\sigma)], \rho, e)
      \approx
      \mathsf{rec}(T', a_z', s', \ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')}, e') \in \textsf{Ne},
  \end{align*}
  i.e.\ for every depth $n$ both sides read back via $\textsf{R}^{\textsf{Ne}}_n$ to the same
  neutral normal form.
  By rule \textsc{Re-rec}:
  \begin{align*}
    &\textsf{R}^{\textsf{Ne}}_n(\mathsf{rec}(T[q(\sigma)], a_z, s[q^2(\sigma)], \rho, e))
      \searrow \ensuremath{\textsf{elim}_{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}~(x.\,W_T)~w_z~(x, y.\,w_s)~u}
  \end{align*}
  whenever
  \begin{align*}
    &\textsf{R}^{\textsf{Ty}}_{n+1}(A_x) \searrow W_T
      && \text{where $\ensuremath{\llbracket T[q(\sigma)] \rrbracket((\rho, {\uparrow}^N(\ell_n)/x))} \searrow A_x$} \\
    &\textsf{R}^{\textsf{Nf}}_n({\downarrow}^{A_z}(a_z)) \searrow w_z
      && \text{where $\ensuremath{\llbracket T[q(\sigma)] \rrbracket((\rho, \texttt{ze}/x))} \searrow A_z$} \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket s[q^2(\sigma)] \rrbracket((\rho, {\uparrow}^N(\ell_n)/x, {\uparrow}^{A_x}(\ell_{n+1})/y))}
      \searrow b_s \\
    &\textsf{R}^{\textsf{Nf}}_{n+2}({\downarrow}^{A_x^{\textsf{succ}~}}(b_s)) \searrow w_s
      && \text{where $\ensuremath{\llbracket T[q(\sigma)] \rrbracket((\rho, \texttt{su}({\uparrow}^N(\ell_n))/x))}
        \searrow A_x^{\textsf{succ}~}$} \\
    &\textsf{R}^{\textsf{Ne}}_n(e) \searrow u
  \end{align*}
  and analogously for the primed side, producing
  $\ensuremath{\textsf{elim}_{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}~(x.\,W_T')~w_z'~(x, y.\,w_s')~u'}$.
  We show each component reads back to the same syntactic form.

  \emph{Motive $W_T = W_T'$.}
  Apply the second claim of this lemma at the fresh-level relation
  ${\uparrow}^N(\ell_n) \approx {\uparrow}^N(\ell_n) \in \textsf{Nat}$ (by
  \textsc{Nat-Ne}, $\ell_n \approx \ell_n \in \textsf{Ne}$):
  \begin{align*}
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket T[q(\sigma)] \rrbracket((\rho, {\uparrow}^N(\ell_n)/x))} \approx
      \ensuremath{\llbracket T' \rrbracket((\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')}, {\uparrow}^N(\ell_n)/x))}
      \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R_T^\ell
      && \text{(second claim at $\ell_n$)} \\
    &W_T = W_T'
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:type-readback})}
  \end{align*}
  No separate env-pair construction is needed: the second claim is parametric
  in $a \approx a' \in \textsf{Nat}$ and directly relates the two motive values
  at envs over the heterogeneous source--target contexts.

  \emph{Zero branch $w_z = w_z'$.}
  By the \textsc{Nat-Ze} sub-case proved above,
  $a_z \approx a_z' \in R_T$-at-$\texttt{ze}$ (the PER governed by
  $\ensuremath{\llbracket T[q(\sigma)] \rrbracket((\rho, \texttt{ze}/x))}$, which equals $A_z$).
  By \Cref{lem:R-readback}:
  \begin{align*}
    &w_z = w_z'
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:R-readback})}
  \end{align*}

  \emph{Step branch $w_s = w_s'$.}
  We obtain $b_s \approx b_s'$ at fresh levels by replaying the
  \textsc{Nat-Su} case with $a_0 := {\uparrow}^N(\ell_n)$.
  First, lift $\sigma, \sigma'$ to handle the binders of $s$:
  \begin{align*}
    &\semtyeq[\Gamma', x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}]{q(\sigma)}{q(\sigma')}{\Gamma, x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:sem-q} on $\sigma \approx \sigma'$ and $\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}$)} \\
    &\semtyeq[\Gamma', x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}, y:T[q(\sigma)]]
       {q^2(\sigma)}{q^2(\sigma')}{\Gamma, x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}, y:T}
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:sem-q} again on $T$)}
  \end{align*}
  Build the env-pair via two applications of \textsc{Ctx-Ext}:
  \begin{align*}
    &{\uparrow}^N(\ell_n) \approx {\uparrow}^N(\ell_n) \in \textsf{Nat}
      && \text{(\textsc{Nat-Ne}, $\ell_n \approx \ell_n \in \textsf{Ne}$)} \\
    &(\rho, {\uparrow}^N(\ell_n)/x) \approx (\rho', {\uparrow}^N(\ell_n)/x)
      \in R_{\Gamma', x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}
      && \text{(\textsc{Ctx-Ext}, head $\textsf{Nat}$)} \\
    &{\uparrow}^{A_x}(\ell_{n+1}) \approx {\uparrow}^{A_x'}(\ell_{n+1}) \in R_T^\ell
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:ne-in-R} on $\ell_{n+1} \approx \ell_{n+1} \in \textsf{Ne}$)} \\
    &(\rho, {\uparrow}^N(\ell_n)/x, {\uparrow}^{A_x}(\ell_{n+1})/y) \\
    &\quad \approx (\rho', {\uparrow}^N(\ell_n)/x, {\uparrow}^{A_x'}(\ell_{n+1})/y)
      \in R_{\Gamma', x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}, y:T[q(\sigma)]}
      && \text{(\textsc{Ctx-Ext}, head $R_T^\ell$)}
  \end{align*}
  Apply $\semtyeq[\Gamma, x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}, y:T]{s}{s'}{T[\Uparrow \circ \Uparrow, \textsf{succ}~x_1/x]}$
  at $\Gamma', x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}, y:T[q(\sigma)]$, the doubly-lifted substitution
  $q^2(\sigma) \approx q^2(\sigma')$, and this env-pair.
  The four-value pattern of $s, s'$ gives:
  \begin{align*}
    &b_s \approx b_s' \in R_T^{step}
      && \text{(outer-left vs inner-right, parallel to the helper's} \\
    & && \text{Nat-Su case)}
  \end{align*}
  where $R_T^{step}$ is governed by
  $\ensuremath{\llbracket (T[\Uparrow \circ \Uparrow, \textsf{succ}~x_1/x])[q^2(\sigma)] \rrbracket((\rho, {\uparrow}^N(\ell_n)/x, {\uparrow}^{A_x}(\ell_{n+1})/y))}$.

  By the B1/B2/B3 bridging of the \textsc{Nat-Su} case (with $a_0$ replaced by
  ${\uparrow}^N(\ell_n)$):
  \begin{align*}
    &R_T^{step} \Leftrightarrow R_T^\ell\text{-at-}\texttt{su}({\uparrow}^N(\ell_n))
      && \text{(B1/B2/B3 bridges, \Cref{lem:univ-functional})}
  \end{align*}
  i.e.\ the PER at $\ensuremath{\llbracket T[q(\sigma)] \rrbracket((\rho, \texttt{su}({\uparrow}^N(\ell_n))/x))}$,
  which equals $A_x^{\textsf{succ}~}$.
  Hence $b_s \approx b_s' \in R_T^\ell$-at-$\texttt{su}(\ell_n)$, and:
  \begin{align*}
    &w_s = w_s'
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:R-readback})}
  \end{align*}

  \emph{Underlying neutral $u = u'$.}
  By hypothesis $e \approx e' \in \textsf{Ne}$:
  \begin{align*}
    &\textsf{R}^{\textsf{Ne}}_n(e) \searrow u,\;\; \textsf{R}^{\textsf{Ne}}_n(e') \searrow u
      && \text{(by definition of $\textsf{Ne}$)}
  \end{align*}

  Combining:
  \begin{align*}
    &\textsf{R}^{\textsf{Ne}}_n(\mathsf{rec}(T[q(\sigma)], a_z, s[q^2(\sigma)], \rho, e))
      \searrow \ensuremath{\textsf{elim}_{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}~(x.\,W_T)~w_z~(x, y.\,w_s)~u} \\
    &\textsf{R}^{\textsf{Ne}}_n(\mathsf{rec}(T', a_z', s', \ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')}, e'))
      \searrow \ensuremath{\textsf{elim}_{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}~(x.\,W_T)~w_z~(x, y.\,w_s)~u}
      && \text{(same syntactic form)} \\
    &\mathsf{rec}(T[q(\sigma)], a_z, s[q^2(\sigma)], \rho, e)
      \approx \mathsf{rec}(T', a_z', s', \ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')}, e') \in \textsf{Ne}
      && \text{(definition of $\textsf{Ne}$)}
  \end{align*}
  Hence $b \approx b' \in R_T$.
<!-- end proof-89 -->
<!-- lemma-91: body_md -->
\label{lem:fund-rec}
  If $\semtyeq[\Gamma, x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}]{T}{T'}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$,
  $\semtyeq[\Gamma]{z}{z'}{T[\textsf{zero}/x]}$,
  $\semtyeq[\Gamma, x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}, y:T]{s}{s'}{T[\Uparrow \circ \Uparrow, \textsf{succ}~x_1/x]}$, and
  $\semtyeq[\Gamma]{t}{t'}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}$,
  then $\semtyeq[\Gamma]{\ensuremath{\textsf{elim}_{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}~(x.\,T)~z~(x, y.\, s)~t}}{\ensuremath{\textsf{elim}_{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}~(x.\,T)~z'~(x, y.\, s')~t'}}{T[t/x]}$.
<!-- end lemma-91 -->
<!-- proof-90: body_md -->
Let $\Gamma' \approx \Gamma' \searrow R'$,
  $\semtyeq[\Gamma']{\sigma}{\sigma'}{\Gamma}$, and
  $\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}} :: \rho \approx \rho' \in R'$ be given.
  Write $\rho_\sigma := \ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)}$ and $\rho_{\sigma'} := \ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')}$.
  From $\semtyeq[\Gamma']{\sigma}{\sigma'}{\Gamma}$ at $\ensuremath{\textsf{id}}$, $\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}$:
  $\rho_\sigma \approx \rho_{\sigma'} \in R_\Gamma$ where
  $\Gamma \approx \Gamma \searrow R_\Gamma$.

  By $\semtyeq[\Gamma]{t}{t'}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}$ applied at $\Gamma'$, $\sigma \approx \sigma'$,
  $\rho \approx \rho' \in R'$:
  \begin{align*}
    &\{\ensuremath{\llbracket t[\sigma] \rrbracket(\rho)},\;
      \ensuremath{\llbracket t \rrbracket(\rho_\sigma)},\;
      \ensuremath{\llbracket t' \rrbracket(\rho_{\sigma'})},\;
      \ensuremath{\llbracket t'[\sigma'] \rrbracket(\rho')}\}
      \subseteq \textsf{Nat}
      && \text{(by hypothesis on $t, t'$)}
  \end{align*}

  Compute the four eliminator term values:
  \begin{align*}
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket (\ensuremath{\textsf{elim}_{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}~(x.\,T)~z~(x, y.\, s)~t})[\sigma] \rrbracket(\rho)}
      && \text{(definition of substitution} \\
    & \quad = \ensuremath{\llbracket \ensuremath{\textsf{elim}_{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}~(x.\,T[q(\sigma)])~z[\sigma]~(x, y.\, s[q^2(\sigma)])~t[\sigma]} \rrbracket(\rho)}
      && \text{on $\textsf{elim}_{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}$)} \\
    &\quad = \mathsf{rec}(\ensuremath{\llbracket t[\sigma] \rrbracket(\rho)},\,
      T[q(\sigma)],\, z[\sigma],\, s[q^2(\sigma)],\, \rho)
      && \text{(by ev-rec)} \\[4pt]
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket \ensuremath{\textsf{elim}_{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}~(x.\,T)~z~(x, y.\, s)~t} \rrbracket(\rho_\sigma)} \\
    & \quad = \mathsf{rec}(\ensuremath{\llbracket t \rrbracket(\rho_\sigma)},\, T,\, z,\, s,\, \rho_\sigma)
      && \text{(by ev-rec)}
  \end{align*}
  Analogous computations for the primed pair (using $z', s', t'$):
  $\mathsf{rec}(\ensuremath{\llbracket t'[\sigma'] \rrbracket(\rho')},\, T[q(\sigma')],\,
  z'[\sigma'],\, s'[q^2(\sigma')],\, \rho')$ and
  $\mathsf{rec}(\ensuremath{\llbracket t' \rrbracket(\rho_{\sigma'})},\, T,\, z',\, s',\,
  \rho_{\sigma'})$.

  Before applying the helpers, derive reflexive instances of all hypotheses
  (the helpers' RHS are in primed form; we sometimes need
  unprimed-to-unprimed instances):
  \begin{align*}
    &\semtyeq[\Gamma, x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}]{T}{T}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}
      && \text{(reflexive, by \Cref{lem:fund-sym,lem:fund-trans} on $T \approx T'$)} \\
    &\semtyeq[\Gamma]{z}{z}{T[\textsf{zero}/x]}
      && \text{(reflexive)} \\
    &\semtyeq[\Gamma, x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}, y:T]{s}{s}{T[\Uparrow \circ \Uparrow, \textsf{succ}~x_1/x]}
      && \text{(reflexive)} \\
    &\semtyeq[\Gamma]{t}{t}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}
      && \text{(reflexive)} \\
    &\semtyeq[\Gamma']{\sigma}{\sigma}{\Gamma}
      && \text{(reflexive)}
  \end{align*}
  (Primed analogues hold symmetrically.)

  \emph{Inner pair via the unsubstituted helper.}
  Apply \Cref{lem:sem-rec} at $T \approx T$ (reflexive), $z \approx z'$,
  $s \approx s'$, $R_\Gamma$, env-pair $\rho_\sigma \approx \rho_{\sigma'}$,
  and witness $\ensuremath{\llbracket t \rrbracket(\rho_\sigma)} \approx \ensuremath{\llbracket t' \rrbracket(\rho_{\sigma'})}
  \in \textsf{Nat}$ (inner-left vs inner-right of the four-value pattern of
  $t, t'$):
  \begin{align*}
    &\mathsf{rec}(\ensuremath{\llbracket t \rrbracket(\rho_\sigma)},\, T,\, z,\, s,\, \rho_\sigma)
      \searrow b_i \\
    &\mathsf{rec}(\ensuremath{\llbracket t' \rrbracket(\rho_{\sigma'})},\, T,\, z',\, s',\, \rho_{\sigma'})
      \searrow b_i' \\
    &b_i \approx b_i' \in R_T
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:sem-rec})}
  \end{align*}
  where $R_T$ is governed by
  $\ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket((\rho_\sigma, \ensuremath{\llbracket t \rrbracket(\rho_\sigma)}/x))} \approx
  \ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket((\rho_{\sigma'}, \ensuremath{\llbracket t' \rrbracket(\rho_{\sigma'})}/x))} \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R_T$.
  These match the goal's inner-left and inner-right term values.

  \emph{Outer-vs-inner via the one-sided helper.}
  Apply \Cref{lem:sem-rec-subst} at $T \approx T$, $z \approx z$, $s \approx s$
  (all reflexive), $\Gamma' \approx \Gamma' \searrow R'$,
  $\sigma \approx \sigma$ (reflexive),
  $\rho \approx \rho \in R'$ (reflexive), and witness
  $\ensuremath{\llbracket t[\sigma] \rrbracket(\rho)} \approx \ensuremath{\llbracket t \rrbracket(\rho_\sigma)} \in \textsf{Nat}$
  (outer-left vs inner-left of the four-value pattern of $t$):
  \begin{align*}
    &\mathsf{rec}(\ensuremath{\llbracket t[\sigma] \rrbracket(\rho)},\, T[q(\sigma)],\, z[\sigma],\,
      s[q^2(\sigma)],\, \rho) \searrow b_o \\
    &\mathsf{rec}(\ensuremath{\llbracket t \rrbracket(\rho_\sigma)},\, T,\, z,\, s,\, \rho_\sigma) \searrow b_i \\
    &b_o \approx b_i \in R_T^{oi}
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:sem-rec-subst})}
  \end{align*}
  where $R_T^{oi}$ is governed by
  $\ensuremath{\llbracket T[q(\sigma)] \rrbracket((\rho, \ensuremath{\llbracket t[\sigma] \rrbracket(\rho)}/x))} \approx
  \ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket((\rho_\sigma, \ensuremath{\llbracket t \rrbracket(\rho_\sigma)}/x))} \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R_T^{oi}$.
  By \Cref{lem:univ-functional}, $R_T^{oi} \Leftrightarrow R_T$.
  Hence $b_o \approx b_i \in R_T$.

  Apply \Cref{lem:sem-rec-subst} symmetrically at the primed reflexive
  instances ($T' \approx T'$, $z' \approx z'$, $s' \approx s'$,
  $\sigma' \approx \sigma'$, $\rho' \approx \rho' \in R'$), with witness
  $\ensuremath{\llbracket t'[\sigma'] \rrbracket(\rho')} \approx \ensuremath{\llbracket t' \rrbracket(\rho_{\sigma'})} \in \textsf{Nat}$:
  \begin{align*}
    &b_o' \approx b_i' \in R_T
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:sem-rec-subst} and \Cref{lem:univ-functional})}
  \end{align*}

  \emph{Combining.}
  We assemble the four goal term values:
  \begin{align*}
    &b_i \approx b_i' \in R_T
      && \text{(inner pair, above)} \\
    &b_o \approx b_i \in R_T
      && \text{(outer-vs-inner, left side, above)} \\
    &b_o' \approx b_i' \in R_T
      && \text{(outer-vs-inner, right side, above)} \\
    &b_o \approx b_o' \in R_T
      && \text{(by symmetry and transitivity of $R_T$)}
  \end{align*}
  Thus all four goal term values
  $\{b_o, b_i, b_i', b_o'\}$ are pairwise related in $R_T$.

  \emph{Type part.}
  The goal type is $T[t/x]$ on the LHS and $T[t'/x]$ on the RHS (by the syntactic
  conclusion's type, via the four-value pattern of the outer
  $\semtyeq[\Gamma]{\ensuremath{\textsf{elim}_{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}~(\ldots)~\ldots~(\ldots)~t}}{\ensuremath{\textsf{elim}_{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}~(\ldots)~\ldots~(\ldots)~t'}}{T[t/x]}$
  semantic judgment).
  We bridge the four goal type values via outer and inner instantiations of
  $T \approx T'$.

  \emph{Outer instantiation.}
  By \Cref{lem:sem-ext-pre} on $\semtyeq[\Gamma']{\sigma}{\sigma'}{\Gamma}$ and
  $\semtyeq[\Gamma]{t}{t'}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}$:
  \begin{align*}
    &\semtyeq[\Gamma']{(\sigma, t[\sigma]/x)}{(\sigma', t'[\sigma']/x)}{\Gamma, x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}
      && \text{(\Cref{lem:sem-ext-pre})}
  \end{align*}
  Apply $\semtyeq[\Gamma, x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}]{T}{T'}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$ at $\Gamma'$, this semantic
  substitution, and $\rho \approx \rho' \in R'$:
  \begin{align*}
    &\{\ensuremath{\llbracket T[\sigma, t[\sigma]/x] \rrbracket(\rho)},\;
      \ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket((\rho_\sigma, \ensuremath{\llbracket t[\sigma] \rrbracket(\rho)}/x))}, \\
    &\quad
      \ensuremath{\llbracket T' \rrbracket((\rho_{\sigma'}, \ensuremath{\llbracket t'[\sigma'] \rrbracket(\rho')}/x))},\;
      \ensuremath{\llbracket T'[\sigma', t'[\sigma']/x] \rrbracket(\rho')}\}
      \subseteq \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R_T^{out}
      && \text{(by hypothesis on $T \approx T'$)} \\
    &T[\sigma, t[\sigma]/x] = 
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:subst-ext-comm})} \\
    &T'[\sigma', t'[\sigma']/x] = (T'[t'/x])[\sigma']
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:subst-ext-comm})}
  \end{align*}
  Now the goal's outer-RHS type is $\ensuremath{\llbracket  \rrbracket(\rho')}$, but the
  outer instantiation gives $\ensuremath{\llbracket (T'[t'/x])[\sigma'] \rrbracket(\rho')}$.
  We show these coincide modulo $\mathcal{U}_i$:
  \begin{align*}
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket  \rrbracket(\rho')} \approx \ensuremath{\llbracket (T'[t'/x])[\sigma'] \rrbracket(\rho')} \in \mathcal{U}_i
      && \text{(four-value pattern of $T \approx T'$ at } \\
    & && \text{the outer-RHS instantiation, applied} \\
    & && \text{at $(\sigma', t'[\sigma']/x)$ with $\rho' \approx \rho' \in R'$)}
  \end{align*}
  So the four values lie in $\mathcal{U}_i \searrow R_T^{out}$ with the outer-LHS value
  exactly matching the goal's $\ensuremath{\llbracket  \rrbracket(\rho)}$ and the outer-RHS
  value matching the goal's $\ensuremath{\llbracket  \rrbracket(\rho')}$ (modulo
  $\mathcal{U}_i$, hence by \Cref{lem:univ-functional}).

  \emph{Inner instantiation.}
  By \Cref{lem:sem-ext-pre} over $\Gamma$ on $\semtyeq[\Gamma]{\ensuremath{\textsf{id}}}{\ensuremath{\textsf{id}}}{\Gamma}$
  and $\semtyeq[\Gamma]{t}{t'}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}$:
  \begin{align*}
    &\semtyeq[\Gamma]{(\ensuremath{\textsf{id}}, t/x)}{(\ensuremath{\textsf{id}}, t'/x)}{\Gamma, x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}
      && \text{(\Cref{lem:sem-ext-pre})}
  \end{align*}
  Apply $\semtyeq[\Gamma, x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}]{T}{T'}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$ at $\Gamma$, this semantic
  substitution, and $\rho_\sigma \approx \rho_{\sigma'} \in R_\Gamma$:
  \begin{align*}
    &\{\ensuremath{\llbracket T[\ensuremath{\textsf{id}}, t/x] \rrbracket(\rho_\sigma)},\;
      \ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket((\rho_\sigma, \ensuremath{\llbracket t \rrbracket(\rho_\sigma)}/x))}, \\
    &\quad
      \ensuremath{\llbracket T' \rrbracket((\rho_{\sigma'}, \ensuremath{\llbracket t' \rrbracket(\rho_{\sigma'})}/x))},\;
      \ensuremath{\llbracket T'[\ensuremath{\textsf{id}}, t'/x] \rrbracket(\rho_{\sigma'})}\}
      \subseteq \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R_T^{in}
      && \text{(by hypothesis on $T \approx T'$)} \\
    &T[\ensuremath{\textsf{id}}, t/x] = T[t/x]
      && \text{(definition of single substitution)} \\
    &T'[\ensuremath{\textsf{id}}, t'/x] = T'[t'/x]
      && \text{(definition of single substitution)}
  \end{align*}

  \emph{Bridging.}
  The inner-pair values
  $\ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket((\rho_\sigma, \ensuremath{\llbracket t \rrbracket(\rho_\sigma)}/x))}$ (shared between outer and
  inner instantiations) and
  $\ensuremath{\llbracket T' \rrbracket((\rho_{\sigma'}, \ensuremath{\llbracket t' \rrbracket(\rho_{\sigma'})}/x))}$ (shared) bridge the
  PERs:
  \begin{align*}
    &R_T^{out} \Leftrightarrow R_T^{in}
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:univ-functional} on shared inner values)} \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket((\rho_\sigma, \ensuremath{\llbracket t \rrbracket(\rho_\sigma)}/x))} \approx
     \ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket((\rho_{\sigma'}, \ensuremath{\llbracket t' \rrbracket(\rho_{\sigma'})}/x))} \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R_T
      && \text{(unsubstituted helper's $R_T$ governance)} \\
    &R_T^{in} \Leftrightarrow R_T
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:univ-functional} on the shared} \\
    & && \text{inner-LHS value with the helper's $R_T$)}
  \end{align*}
  Hence all four goal type values lie in $\mathcal{U}_i \searrow R_T$,
  with the term values $\{b_o, b_i, b_i', b_o'\}$ in $R_T$ as established.
<!-- end proof-90 -->
<!-- lemma-92: body_md -->
\label{lem:fund-subsump}
  If $\semtyeq[\Gamma]{T}{T}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$ and $\semtyeq[\Gamma]{t}{t}{S}$ and
  $\Gamma \vDash S \subseteq T$, then $\semtyeq[\Gamma]{t}{t}{T}$.
<!-- end lemma-92 -->
<!-- proof-91: body_md -->
Let $\Gamma' \approx \Gamma' \searrow R'$,
  $\semtyeq[\Gamma']{\sigma}{\sigma'}{\Gamma}$, and
  $\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}} :: \rho \approx \rho' \in R'$ be given.

  \emph{Type part.}
  By $\semtyeq[\Gamma]{T}{T}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$ at the given data:
  \begin{align*}
    &\{\ensuremath{\llbracket T[\sigma] \rrbracket(\rho)},\;
      \ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)})},\;
      \ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')})},\;
      \ensuremath{\llbracket T[\sigma'] \rrbracket(\rho')}\}
      \subseteq \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R_T
      && \text{(by hypothesis on $T$)}
  \end{align*}

  \emph{Term part.}
  By $\semtyeq[\Gamma]{t}{t}{S}$ at the given data:
  \begin{align*}
    &\{\ensuremath{\llbracket S[\sigma] \rrbracket(\rho)},\;
      \ensuremath{\llbracket S \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)})},\;
      \ensuremath{\llbracket S \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')})},\;
      \ensuremath{\llbracket S[\sigma'] \rrbracket(\rho')}\}
      \subseteq \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R_S
      && \text{(by hypothesis on $S$)} \\
    &\{\ensuremath{\llbracket t[\sigma] \rrbracket(\rho)},\;
      \ensuremath{\llbracket t \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)})},\;
      \ensuremath{\llbracket t \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')})},\;
      \ensuremath{\llbracket t[\sigma'] \rrbracket(\rho')}\}
      \subseteq R_S
      && \text{(by hypothesis on $t$)}
  \end{align*}

  By $\Gamma \vDash S \subseteq T$ at the given data:
  \begin{align*}
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket S[\sigma] \rrbracket(\rho)} \approx \ensuremath{\llbracket S \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)})} \in \mathcal{U}_i
      && \text{(by semantic subtyping, commutation)} \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket T[\sigma'] \rrbracket(\rho')} \approx \ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')})} \in \mathcal{U}_i
      && \text{(by semantic subtyping, commutation)} \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket S \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)})} \mathrel{<:_i} \ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')})}
      && \text{(by semantic subtyping)}
  \end{align*}
  By \Cref{lem:subty-respects} applied to the subtyping
  $\ensuremath{\llbracket S \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)})} \mathrel{<:_i} \ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')})}$
  together with $\ensuremath{\llbracket S \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)})} \approx \ensuremath{\llbracket S \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')})} \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R_S$
  and $\ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)})} \approx \ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')})} \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R_T$:
  \begin{align*}
    &R_S \subseteq R_T
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:subty-respects})}
  \end{align*}

  Hence the four term values, which lie in $R_S$, also lie in $R_T$:
  \begin{align*}
    &\{\ensuremath{\llbracket t[\sigma] \rrbracket(\rho)},\;
      \ensuremath{\llbracket t \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)})},\;
      \ensuremath{\llbracket t \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')})},\;
      \ensuremath{\llbracket t[\sigma'] \rrbracket(\rho')}\}
      \subseteq R_T
      && \text{(by $R_S \subseteq R_T$)}
  \end{align*}
<!-- end proof-91 -->
<!-- lemma-93: body_md -->
\label{lem:fund-beta}
  If $\semtyeq[\Gamma]{S}{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$ and $\semtyeq[\Gamma, x:S]{T}{T}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$ and
  $\semtyeq[\Gamma, x:S]{t}{t}{T}$ and $\semtyeq[\Gamma]{s}{s}{S}$,
  then $\semtyeq[\Gamma]{(\lambda x.\,t)\;s}{t[s/x]}{T[s/x]}$.
<!-- end lemma-93 -->
<!-- proof-92: body_md -->
Let $\Gamma' \approx \Gamma' \searrow R'$,
  $\semtyeq[\Gamma']{\sigma}{\sigma'}{\Gamma}$, and
  $\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}} :: \rho \approx \rho' \in R'$ be given.

  \emph{LHS computation at $\sigma, \rho$.}
  By the syntactic action of substitution on $\lambda$ and application, then
  ev-app/ev-lam/closure-application:
  \begin{align*}
    &((\lambda x.\,t)\;s)[\sigma]
      = (\lambda x.\,t[q(\sigma)])\;s[\sigma]
      && \text{(syntactic, definition of substitution)} \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket (\lambda x.\,t[q(\sigma)])\;s[\sigma] \rrbracket(\rho)}
      \searrow b_L
      \text{ where} \\
    &\quad \ensuremath{\llbracket \lambda x.\,t[q(\sigma)] \rrbracket(\rho)} \searrow \lambda(t[q(\sigma)], \rho)
      && \text{(ev-lam)} \\
    &\quad \ensuremath{\llbracket s[\sigma] \rrbracket(\rho)} \searrow a_s
      && \text{(some $a_s$)} \\
    &\quad \lambda(t[q(\sigma)], \rho) \cdot a_s \searrow b_L
      && \text{(closure application:} \\
    & && \text{$\ensuremath{\llbracket t[q(\sigma)] \rrbracket((\rho, a_s/x))} \searrow b_L$)}
  \end{align*}

  \emph{RHS expression at $\sigma, \rho$.}
  Using the sugar $[s/x] = [\ensuremath{\textsf{id}}, s/x]$ and \Cref{lem:subst-ext-comm,lem:q-ext}:
  \begin{align*}
    & = t[q(\sigma)][s[\sigma]/x] = t[\sigma, s[\sigma]/x]
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:subst-ext-comm,lem:q-ext})}
  \end{align*}
  Let $b_R$ satisfy $\ensuremath{\llbracket t[\sigma, s[\sigma]/x] \rrbracket(\rho)} \searrow b_R$ (existence
  via the four-value pattern below).
  We relate $b_L$ and $b_R$ in the term PER via the four-value pattern of $t$
  on the extended substitution.

  \emph{Relatedness.}
  By \Cref{lem:sem-ext-pre} on $\semtyeq[\Gamma']{\sigma}{\sigma'}{\Gamma}$ and
  $\semtyeq[\Gamma]{s}{s}{S}$:
  \begin{align*}
    &\semtyeq[\Gamma']{(\sigma, s[\sigma]/x)}{(\sigma', s[\sigma']/x)}{\Gamma, x:S}
      && \text{(\Cref{lem:sem-ext-pre})}
  \end{align*}
  Apply $\semtyeq[\Gamma, x:S]{t}{t}{T}$ at $\Gamma'$, this extended substitution,
  and $\rho \approx \rho' \in R'$.
  Let $R_T$ be the PER governing the four-value pattern of $t$ at this
  instantiation; concretely, $R_T$ is determined by the type four-value pattern
  of $T$ at the same env-pair (carried by semantic typing of $t : T$):
  \begin{align*}
    &\{\ensuremath{\llbracket T[\sigma, s[\sigma]/x] \rrbracket(\rho)},\;
      \ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket (\sigma, s[\sigma]/x) \rrbracket(\rho)})}, \\
    &\quad \ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket (\sigma', s[\sigma']/x) \rrbracket(\rho')})},\;
      \ensuremath{\llbracket T[\sigma', s[\sigma']/x] \rrbracket(\rho')}\}
      \subseteq \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R_T
  \end{align*}
  The term four-value pattern then gives:
  \begin{align*}
    &\{\ensuremath{\llbracket t[\sigma, s[\sigma]/x] \rrbracket(\rho)},\;
      \ensuremath{\llbracket t \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket (\sigma, s[\sigma]/x) \rrbracket(\rho)})}, \\
    &\quad \ensuremath{\llbracket t \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket (\sigma', s[\sigma']/x) \rrbracket(\rho')})},\;
      \ensuremath{\llbracket t[\sigma', s[\sigma']/x] \rrbracket(\rho')}\}
      \subseteq R_T
      && \text{(by hypothesis on $t$)}
  \end{align*}
  By the syntactic identity above (and analogously at $\sigma', \rho'$), the
  outer values coincide with the goal's RHS outer-values
  $\{\ensuremath{\llbracket  \rrbracket(\rho)}, \ensuremath{\llbracket  \rrbracket(\rho')}\}$.

  \emph{LHS values via four-value pattern of $t$ at $q(\sigma)$.}
  We bridge $b_L = \ensuremath{\llbracket t[q(\sigma)] \rrbracket((\rho, a_s/x))}$ to the inner-left value
  $\ensuremath{\llbracket t \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket (\sigma, s[\sigma]/x) \rrbracket(\rho)})}$ above.
  By \Cref{lem:sem-q} on $\semtyeq[\Gamma']{\sigma}{\sigma}{\Gamma}$ (reflexive,
  via \Cref{lem:sem-sym,lem:sem-trans}) and $\semtyeq[\Gamma]{S}{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$:
  \begin{align*}
    &\semtyeq[\Gamma', x:S[\sigma]]{q(\sigma)}{q(\sigma)}{\Gamma, x:S}
      && \text{(\Cref{lem:sem-q})}
  \end{align*}
  The reflexive env-pair $(\rho, a_s/x) \approx (\rho, a_s/x)$ in
  $R_{\Gamma', x:S[\sigma]}$ holds via \textsc{Ctx-Ext} (head $a_s \approx a_s$
  reflexively in the head PER, tail $\rho \approx \rho \in R'$).
  Apply $\semtyeq[\Gamma, x:S]{t}{t}{T}$ at $\Gamma', x:S[\sigma]$,
  $q(\sigma) \approx q(\sigma)$, and this env-pair (four-value pattern of $t$,
  outer-left vs inner-left):
  \begin{align*}
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket t[q(\sigma)] \rrbracket((\rho, a_s/x))}
      \approx \ensuremath{\llbracket t \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket q(\sigma) \rrbracket((\rho, a_s/x))})} \in R_T
      && \text{(four-value pattern of $t$)}
  \end{align*}
  Bridge $\ensuremath{\llbracket q(\sigma) \rrbracket((\rho, a_s/x))}$ to $\ensuremath{\llbracket (\sigma, s[\sigma]/x) \rrbracket(\rho)}$
  in $R_{\Gamma, x:S}$ pointwise. Both envs have head $a_s$:
  \begin{align*}
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket q(\sigma) \rrbracket((\rho, a_s/x))}
      = (\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma[\Uparrow] \rrbracket((\rho, a_s/x))},\, a_s/x)
      && \text{(by $q(\sigma) = (\sigma[\Uparrow], 0/x)$, pointwise eval)} \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket (\sigma, s[\sigma]/x) \rrbracket(\rho)}
      = (\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)},\, a_s/x)
      && \text{(pointwise eval; $\ensuremath{\llbracket s[\sigma] \rrbracket(\rho)} = a_s$)} \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma[\Uparrow] \rrbracket((\rho, a_s/x))}
      \approx \ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)} \in R_\Gamma
      && \text{(four-value pattern of $\sigma \approx \sigma$ at} \\
    & && \text{$\semweak[\Gamma', x:S[\sigma]]{\Uparrow}{\Gamma'}$, env} \\
    & && \text{$(\rho, a_s/x) \approx (\rho, a_s/x) \in R_{\Gamma', x:S[\sigma]}$;} \\
    & && \text{using $\ensuremath{\llbracket \Uparrow \rrbracket((\rho, a_s/x))} = \rho$ pointwise)} \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket q(\sigma) \rrbracket((\rho, a_s/x))}
      \approx \ensuremath{\llbracket (\sigma, s[\sigma]/x) \rrbracket(\rho)} \in R_{\Gamma, x:S}
      && \text{(by \textsc{Ctx-Ext}, head $a_s \approx a_s$ reflexively)}
  \end{align*}
  Apply \Cref{lem:sem-ty-id} on the reflexive instance
  $\semtyeq[\Gamma, x:S]{t}{t}{T}$ at this env-pair:
  \begin{align*}
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket t \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket q(\sigma) \rrbracket((\rho, a_s/x))})}
      \approx \ensuremath{\llbracket t \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket (\sigma, s[\sigma]/x) \rrbracket(\rho)})} \in R_T
      && \text{(\Cref{lem:sem-ty-id})}
  \end{align*}
  By transitivity, $b_L \approx \ensuremath{\llbracket t \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket (\sigma, s[\sigma]/x) \rrbracket(\rho)})}$
  in $R_T$ (the inner-left value of the relatedness pattern).
  Symmetrically for the primed side.

  Combining: all eight values (four LHS, four RHS) lie in $R_T$, so
  the LHS-RHS pair at each of the four positions is in $R_T$.

  \emph{Type part.}
  Already established: the type four-value pattern displayed above (in
  $\mathcal{U}_i \searrow R_T$) is the goal's $T[s/x]$ pattern, since
  $T[\sigma, s[\sigma]/x] = $ by the syntactic identity used for
  the term part.
<!-- end proof-92 -->
<!-- lemma-94: body_md -->
\label{lem:fund-eta}
  If $\semtyeq[\Gamma]{S}{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$ and $\semtyeq[\Gamma, x:S]{T}{T}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$ and
  $\semtyeq[\Gamma]{t}{t}{\Pi(x:S).\,T}$,
  then $\semtyeq[\Gamma]{t}{\lambda x.\,(t[\Uparrow]\;x)}{{\Pi(x:S).\,T}}$.
<!-- end lemma-94 -->
<!-- proof-93: body_md -->
Let $\Gamma' \approx \Gamma' \searrow R'$,
  $\semtyeq[\Gamma']{\sigma}{\sigma'}{\Gamma}$, and
  $\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}} :: \rho \approx \rho' \in R'$ be given.

  \emph{LHS values.}
  By $\semtyeq[\Gamma]{t}{t}{\Pi(x:S).\,T}$ at $\Gamma'$, $\sigma \approx \sigma'$,
  $\rho \approx \rho' \in R'$, the four evaluations of $t$ are related in the
  function PER $R$:
  \begin{align*}
    &\{\ensuremath{\llbracket t[\sigma] \rrbracket(\rho)},\;
      \ensuremath{\llbracket t \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)})},\;
      \ensuremath{\llbracket t \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')})},\;
      \ensuremath{\llbracket t[\sigma'] \rrbracket(\rho')}\}
      \subseteq R
      && \text{(by hypothesis on $t$)}
  \end{align*}
  with biconditional characterization
  $f \approx f' \in R \;\leftrightarrow\;
  (\forall \ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}_I :: a \approx a' \in R_I.\; f \cdot a \approx f' \cdot a' \in R_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}_I))$.

  \emph{RHS values.}
  The RHS evaluates on the $\sigma', \rho'$-side only:
  \begin{align*}
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket (\lambda x.\,(t[\Uparrow]\;x))[\sigma'] \rrbracket(\rho')}
      \searrow f_o
      && \text{(syntactic and ev-lam)} \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket \lambda x.\,(t[\Uparrow]\;x) \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')})}
      \searrow f_i
      && \text{(ev-lam)}
  \end{align*}
  where $f_o := \lambda(t[\Uparrow][q(\sigma')]\;x,\, \rho')$ and
  $f_i := \lambda(t[\Uparrow]\;x,\, \ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')})$.

  \emph{Step 1: $\ensuremath{\llbracket t[\sigma'] \rrbracket(\rho')} \approx f_o$ in $R$.}
  By the biconditional, suffices to show: for every
  $\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}_I :: a \approx a' \in R_I$,
  $\ensuremath{\llbracket t[\sigma'] \rrbracket(\rho')} \cdot a \approx f_o \cdot a' \in R_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}_I)$.

  Compute $f_o \cdot a'$:
  \begin{align*}
    &f_o \cdot a' = \ensuremath{\llbracket t[\Uparrow][q(\sigma')]\;x \rrbracket((\rho', a'/x))}
      && \text{(closure app)} \\
    &\quad = \ensuremath{\llbracket t[\Uparrow][q(\sigma')] \rrbracket((\rho', a'/x))} \cdot a'
      && \text{(ev-app)} \\
    &\quad = \ensuremath{\llbracket t[\sigma'[\Uparrow]] \rrbracket((\rho', a'/x))} \cdot a'
      && \text{(\Cref{lem:subst-assoc} and \Cref{lem:shift-ext}:} \\
    & && \text{$\Uparrow \circ q(\sigma') = \sigma'[\Uparrow]$)}
  \end{align*}
  Bridge $\ensuremath{\llbracket t[\sigma'[\Uparrow]] \rrbracket((\rho', a'/x))} \approx \ensuremath{\llbracket t[\sigma'] \rrbracket(\rho')}
   \in R$:
  \begin{align*}
    &\semweak[\Gamma', x:S[\sigma']]{\Uparrow}{\Gamma'}
      && \text{(\Cref{lem:sem-wk-shift})} \\
    &\semtyeq[\Gamma', x:S[\sigma']]{\sigma'[\Uparrow]}{\sigma'[\Uparrow]}{\Gamma}
      && \text{(\Cref{lem:sem-wk-subst} on $\sigma' \approx \sigma'$ refl.)}
  \end{align*}
  Apply hypothesis on $t$ at $\Gamma', x:S[\sigma']$, $\sigma'[\Uparrow] \approx
   \sigma'[\Uparrow]$, env-pair $(\rho', a'/x) \approx (\rho', a'/x) \in
   R_{\Gamma', x:S[\sigma']}$:
  \begin{align*}
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket t[\sigma'[\Uparrow]] \rrbracket((\rho', a'/x))} \\
    &\quad \approx \ensuremath{\llbracket t \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma'[\Uparrow] \rrbracket((\rho', a'/x))})} \in R
      && \text{(outer-left vs inner-left of $t$)}
  \end{align*}
  Apply hypothesis on $\sigma'$ at the same data
  ($\Uparrow$ as the weakening, env-pair as above), giving
  $\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma'[\Uparrow] \rrbracket((\rho', a'/x))} \approx \ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')} \in R_\Gamma$
  (using $\ensuremath{\llbracket \Uparrow \rrbracket((\rho', a'/x))} = \rho'$ pointwise).
  By \Cref{lem:sem-ty-id} on $t$:
  \begin{align*}
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket t \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma'[\Uparrow] \rrbracket((\rho', a'/x))})}
      \approx \ensuremath{\llbracket t \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')})} \in R
      && \text{(\Cref{lem:sem-ty-id})}
  \end{align*}
  Chained with $\ensuremath{\llbracket t \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')})} \approx \ensuremath{\llbracket t[\sigma'] \rrbracket(\rho')}
   \in R$ (four-value pattern of $t$, inner-left vs outer-left):
  \begin{align*}
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket t[\sigma'[\Uparrow]] \rrbracket((\rho', a'/x))}
      \approx \ensuremath{\llbracket t[\sigma'] \rrbracket(\rho')} \in R
      && \text{(transitivity)}
  \end{align*}
  Apply the biconditional of $R$ at $\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}_I$:
  $\ensuremath{\llbracket t[\sigma'[\Uparrow]] \rrbracket((\rho', a'/x))} \cdot a
   \approx \ensuremath{\llbracket t[\sigma'] \rrbracket(\rho')} \cdot a' \in R_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}_I)$.
  Since $f_o \cdot a' = \ensuremath{\llbracket t[\sigma'[\Uparrow]] \rrbracket((\rho', a'/x))} \cdot a'$, by
  symmetry of $R_O$ on the reflexive instance of
  $\ensuremath{\llbracket t[\sigma'] \rrbracket(\rho')} \approx \ensuremath{\llbracket t[\sigma'] \rrbracket(\rho')} \in R$ at
  $a \approx a'$:
  $\ensuremath{\llbracket t[\sigma'] \rrbracket(\rho')} \cdot a \approx f_o \cdot a' \in R_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}_I)$.

  \emph{Step 2: $\ensuremath{\llbracket t \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')})} \approx f_i$ in $R$.}
  Suffices to show: for every $\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}_I :: a \approx a' \in R_I$,
  $\ensuremath{\llbracket t \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')})} \cdot a \approx f_i \cdot a' \in R_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}_I)$.

  Compute:
  \begin{align*}
    &f_i \cdot a' = \ensuremath{\llbracket t[\Uparrow]\;x \rrbracket((\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')}, a'/x))}
      && \text{(closure app)} \\
    &\quad = \ensuremath{\llbracket t[\Uparrow] \rrbracket((\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')}, a'/x))} \cdot a'
      && \text{(ev-app)}
  \end{align*}
  Bridge $\ensuremath{\llbracket t[\Uparrow] \rrbracket((\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')}, a'/x))} \approx \ensuremath{\llbracket t \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')})}
   \in R$ via the four-value pattern of $t$ (reflexive) at the new context
  $\Gamma, x:S$, $\semweak[\Gamma, x:S]{\Uparrow}{\Gamma}$, env-pair
  $(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')}, a'/x) \approx (\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')}, a'/x)
   \in R_{\Gamma, x:S}$:
  outer-left $\ensuremath{\llbracket t[\Uparrow] \rrbracket((\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')}, a'/x))}$, inner-left
  $\ensuremath{\llbracket t \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \Uparrow \rrbracket((\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')}, a'/x))})} = \ensuremath{\llbracket t \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')})}$
  (pointwise).
  Apply biconditional at $\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}_I$ and the reflexive
  $\ensuremath{\llbracket t \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')})} \approx \ensuremath{\llbracket t \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')})}$ at
  $a \approx a'$:
  $\ensuremath{\llbracket t \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')})} \cdot a \approx f_i \cdot a' \in R_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}_I)$.

  \emph{Combining.}
  By the four-value pattern of $t$, all four LHS values are pairwise related
  in $R$. By Steps 1 and 2,
  $\ensuremath{\llbracket t[\sigma'] \rrbracket(\rho')} \approx f_o$ and
  $\ensuremath{\llbracket t \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')})} \approx f_i$ in $R$.
  By symmetry and transitivity of $R$, every LHS-RHS pair (e.g.
  $\ensuremath{\llbracket t[\sigma] \rrbracket(\rho)} \approx f_o$, $\ensuremath{\llbracket t \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)})} \approx f_i$,
  etc.) lies in $R$.

  \emph{Type part.}
  By \Cref{lem:fund-pi-wf} on $\semtyeq[\Gamma]{S}{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$ and
  $\semtyeq[\Gamma, x:S]{T}{T}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$, the four-value pattern of
  $\Pi(x:S).\,T$ in $\mathcal{U}_i$ is established. The goal's type is $\Pi(x:S).\,T$
  on both sides, exactly this pattern.
<!-- end proof-93 -->
<!-- lemma-95: body_md -->
\label{lem:fund-rec-ze}
  If $\semtyeq[\Gamma, x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}]{T}{T}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$ and
  $\semtyeq[\Gamma]{z}{z}{T[\textsf{zero}/x]}$ and
  $\semtyeq[\Gamma, x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}, y:T]{s}{s}{T[\Uparrow \circ \Uparrow, \textsf{succ}~x_1/x]}$,
  then $\semtyeq[\Gamma]{\ensuremath{\textsf{elim}_{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}~(x.\,T)~z~(x, y.\, s)~\textsf{zero}}}{z}{T[\textsf{zero}/x]}$.
<!-- end lemma-95 -->
<!-- proof-94: body_md -->
Let $\Gamma' \approx \Gamma' \searrow R'$,
  $\semtyeq[\Gamma']{\sigma}{\sigma'}{\Gamma}$, and
  $\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}} :: \rho \approx \rho' \in R'$ be given.
  Write $\rho_\sigma := \ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)}$ and $\rho_{\sigma'} := \ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')}$.

  \emph{LHS computation on the $\sigma, \rho$- and $\rho_\sigma$-side.}
  The LHS is $\ensuremath{\textsf{elim}_{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}~(x.\,T)~z~(x, y.\, s)~\textsf{zero}}$.
  Outer-LHS at $\sigma, \rho$:
  \begin{align*}
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket (\ensuremath{\textsf{elim}_{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}~(x.\,T)~z~(x, y.\, s)~\textsf{zero}})[\sigma] \rrbracket(\rho)} \\
    &\quad = \ensuremath{\llbracket \ensuremath{\textsf{elim}_{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}~(x.\,T[q(\sigma)])~z[\sigma]~(x, y.\, s[q^2(\sigma)])~\textsf{zero}} \rrbracket(\rho)}
      && \text{(definition of substitution on $\textsf{elim}_{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}$)} \\
    &\quad \searrow b
      && \text{(by ev-rec, $\ensuremath{\llbracket \textsf{zero} \rrbracket(\rho)} = \texttt{ze}$;} \\
    & && \text{$\mathsf{rec}(\texttt{ze}, T[q(\sigma)], z[\sigma], s[q^2(\sigma)], \rho) \searrow b$)} \\
    &b = \ensuremath{\llbracket z[\sigma] \rrbracket(\rho)}
      && \text{(by \textsc{rec-ze})}
  \end{align*}
  Inner-LHS at $\rho_\sigma$:
  \begin{align*}
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket \ensuremath{\textsf{elim}_{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}~(x.\,T)~z~(x, y.\, s)~\textsf{zero}} \rrbracket(\rho_\sigma)}
      \searrow b'
      && \text{(by ev-rec;} \\
    & && \text{$\mathsf{rec}(\texttt{ze}, T, z, s, \rho_\sigma) \searrow b'$)} \\
    &b' = \ensuremath{\llbracket z \rrbracket(\rho_\sigma)}
      && \text{(by \textsc{rec-ze})}
  \end{align*}

  \emph{RHS values on the $\sigma', \rho'$- and $\rho_{\sigma'}$-side.}
  The RHS is $z$, evaluated directly:
  \begin{align*}
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket z[\sigma'] \rrbracket(\rho')}
      && \text{(outer-RHS)} \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket z \rrbracket(\rho_{\sigma'})}
      && \text{(inner-RHS)}
  \end{align*}

  \emph{Relatedness.}
  By $\semtyeq[\Gamma]{z}{z}{T[\textsf{zero}/x]}$ at $\Gamma'$, $\sigma \approx \sigma'$,
  $\rho \approx \rho' \in R'$ (four-value pattern of $z$):
  \begin{align*}
    &\{\ensuremath{\llbracket z[\sigma] \rrbracket(\rho)},\;
      \ensuremath{\llbracket z \rrbracket(\rho_\sigma)},\;
      \ensuremath{\llbracket z \rrbracket(\rho_{\sigma'})},\;
      \ensuremath{\llbracket z[\sigma'] \rrbracket(\rho')}\}
      \subseteq R_z
      && \text{(by hypothesis on $z$)}
  \end{align*}
  where $R_z$ is the PER governed by the type four-value pattern of $T[\textsf{zero}/x]$.
  The LHS values $b, b'$ coincide with $\ensuremath{\llbracket z[\sigma] \rrbracket(\rho)}$ and
  $\ensuremath{\llbracket z \rrbracket(\rho_\sigma)}$ (the unprimed-side outer-LHS and inner-LHS of the $z$
  pattern).
  The RHS values $\ensuremath{\llbracket z[\sigma'] \rrbracket(\rho')}$ and $\ensuremath{\llbracket z \rrbracket(\rho_{\sigma'})}$ are
  exactly the primed-side outer-RHS and inner-RHS of the same pattern.
  Hence all four LHS-RHS pairs lie in $R_z$.

  Bridge $R_z \Leftrightarrow R_T$ (where $R_T$ is the goal's type PER, governed
  by $\ensuremath{\llbracket T[\textsf{zero}/x][\sigma] \rrbracket(\rho)}$): the goal's type is also $T[\textsf{zero}/x]$, so
  $R_z = R_T$ (functionality of $\mathcal{U}_i$, \Cref{lem:univ-functional}).
<!-- end proof-94 -->
<!-- lemma-96: body_md -->
\label{lem:fund-rec-su}
  If $\semtyeq[\Gamma, x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}]{T}{T}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$ and
  $\semtyeq[\Gamma]{z}{z}{T[\textsf{zero}/x]}$ and
  $\semtyeq[\Gamma, x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}, y:T]{s}{s}{T[\Uparrow \circ \Uparrow, \textsf{succ}~x_1/x]}$ and
  $\semtyeq[\Gamma]{t}{t}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}$,
  then
  $\semtyeq[\Gamma]
    {\ensuremath{\textsf{elim}_{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}~(x.\,T)~z~(x, y.\, s)~(\textsf{succ}~t)}}
    {s[t/x,\, \ensuremath{\textsf{elim}_{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}~(x.\,T)~z~(x, y.\, s)~t}/y]}
    {T[\textsf{succ}~t/x]}$.
<!-- end lemma-96 -->
<!-- proof-95: body_md -->
Let $\Gamma' \approx \Gamma' \searrow R'$,
  $\semtyeq[\Gamma']{\sigma}{\sigma'}{\Gamma}$, and
  $\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}} :: \rho \approx \rho' \in R'$ be given.
  Write $\rho_\sigma := \ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)}$ and $\rho_{\sigma'} := \ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')}$.
  Let $a = \ensuremath{\llbracket t \rrbracket(\rho_\sigma)}$, $a' = \ensuremath{\llbracket t \rrbracket(\rho_{\sigma'})}$,
  $b_t = \ensuremath{\llbracket t[\sigma] \rrbracket(\rho)}$, $b_{t'} = \ensuremath{\llbracket t[\sigma'] \rrbracket(\rho')}$.

  Denote $E := \ensuremath{\textsf{elim}_{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}~(x.\,T)~z~(x, y.\, s)~t}$ (the inner eliminator with scrutinee
  $t$; this is the recursive call appearing in the $\beta$-su rule).
  Define
  $c_t := \ensuremath{\llbracket E[\sigma] \rrbracket(\rho)}$,
  $c_{t'} := \ensuremath{\llbracket E[\sigma'] \rrbracket(\rho')}$,
  $c := \ensuremath{\llbracket E \rrbracket(\rho_\sigma)}$,
  $c' := \ensuremath{\llbracket E \rrbracket(\rho_{\sigma'})}$
  (the four evaluations of $E$ at the corresponding positions; existence by
  termination of evaluation).

  \emph{LHS computation.}
  By the syntactic action of substitution on $\textsf{elim}_{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}$, ev-rec, and rec-su:
  \begin{align*}
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket (\ensuremath{\textsf{elim}_{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}~(x.\,T)~z~(x, y.\, s)~(\textsf{succ}~t)})[\sigma] \rrbracket(\rho)} \\
    &\quad = \ensuremath{\llbracket \ensuremath{\textsf{elim}_{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}~(x.\,T[q(\sigma)])~z[\sigma]~(x, y.\, s[q^2(\sigma)])~(\textsf{succ}~t[\sigma])} \rrbracket(\rho)}
      && \text{(definition of substitution on $\textsf{elim}_{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}$)} \\
    &\quad \searrow b_L
      && \text{(by ev-rec, $\ensuremath{\llbracket \textsf{succ}~t[\sigma] \rrbracket(\rho)} = \texttt{su}(b_t)$)} \\
    &\mathsf{rec}(\texttt{su}(b_t),\, T[q(\sigma)],\, z[\sigma],\, s[q^2(\sigma)],\, \rho)
      \searrow b_L
      && \text{(rec-su needs predecessor's rec value)} \\
    &\mathsf{rec}(b_t,\, T[q(\sigma)],\, z[\sigma],\, s[q^2(\sigma)],\, \rho)
      \searrow c_t
      && \text{(by ev-rec on $E[\sigma]$ evaluated at $\rho$;} \\
    & && \text{$\ensuremath{\llbracket t[\sigma] \rrbracket(\rho)} = b_t$)} \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket s[q^2(\sigma)] \rrbracket((\rho,\, b_t/x,\, c_t/y))} \searrow b_L
      && \text{(by \textsc{rec-su})}
  \end{align*}

  At the inner position:
  \begin{align*}
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket \ensuremath{\textsf{elim}_{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}~(x.\,T)~z~(x, y.\, s)~(\textsf{succ}~t)} \rrbracket(\rho_\sigma)}
      \searrow b_I
      && \text{(by ev-rec)} \\
    &\mathsf{rec}(\texttt{su}(a),\, T,\, z,\, s,\, \rho_\sigma) \searrow b_I
      && \text{(rec-su)} \\
    &\mathsf{rec}(a,\, T,\, z,\, s,\, \rho_\sigma) \searrow c
      && \text{(by ev-rec on $E$ at $\rho_\sigma$;
       $\ensuremath{\llbracket t \rrbracket(\rho_\sigma)} = a$)} \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket s \rrbracket((\rho_\sigma,\, a/x,\, c/y))} \searrow b_I
      && \text{(by \textsc{rec-su})}
  \end{align*}

  \emph{RHS expression on the $\sigma', \rho'$-side.}
  The RHS appears on the right of $\approx$ in the goal, so the four-value
  pattern's RHS values are $\ensuremath{\llbracket  \rrbracket(\rho')}$ (outer-RHS)
  and $\ensuremath{\llbracket s[t/x, E/y] \rrbracket(\rho_{\sigma'})}$ (inner-RHS).
  By \Cref{lem:subst-assoc,lem:ext-comp,lem:q-ext}:
  \begin{align*}
    &
      = s[\sigma',\, t[\sigma']/x,\, E[\sigma']/y]
      && \text{(syntactic, composition of substitutions)}
  \end{align*}

  \emph{Doubly-extended semantic substitution.}
  We need the recursive call to be semantically valid: by \Cref{lem:fund-var},
  $\semtyeq[\Gamma, x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}]{x}{x}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}$.
  By \Cref{lem:fund-rec} on $T \approx T$, $z \approx z$, $s \approx s$
  (all reflexive hypotheses, using \Cref{lem:fund-sym,lem:fund-trans}) and
  $x \approx x$:
  \begin{align*}
    &\semtyeq[\Gamma, x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}]
      {\ensuremath{\textsf{elim}_{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}~(x.\,T)~z~(x, y.\, s)~x}}{\ensuremath{\textsf{elim}_{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}~(x.\,T)~z~(x, y.\, s)~x}}{T}
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:fund-rec}, scrutinee $x$;} \\
    & && \text{conclusion type $T[x/x] = T$)}
  \end{align*}
  By \Cref{lem:sem-ext-pre2} on $\semtyeq[\Gamma']{\sigma}{\sigma'}{\Gamma}$,
  $\semtyeq[\Gamma]{t}{t}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}$, and the above (with the head substitution
  computing $E[\sigma]$ on the LHS, $E[\sigma']$ on the RHS):
  \[
    \begin{aligned}
      &\Gamma' \vDash
       (\sigma,\, t[\sigma]/x,\, E[\sigma]/y) \\
      &\quad \approx
       (\sigma',\, t[\sigma']/x,\, E[\sigma']/y) :
       \Gamma, x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}, y:T.
    \end{aligned}
  \]

  \emph{Four-value pattern of $s$ at the doubly-extended substitution.}
  Apply $\semtyeq[\Gamma, x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}, y:T]{s}{s}{T[\Uparrow \circ \Uparrow, \textsf{succ}~x_1/x]}$
  at the above substitution and $\rho \approx \rho' \in R'$:
  \begin{align*}
    &\{\ensuremath{\llbracket s[\sigma, t[\sigma]/x, E[\sigma]/y] \rrbracket(\rho)},\;
      \ensuremath{\llbracket s \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket (\sigma, t[\sigma]/x, E[\sigma]/y) \rrbracket(\rho)})}, \\
    &\quad \ensuremath{\llbracket s \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket (\sigma', t[\sigma']/x, E[\sigma']/y) \rrbracket(\rho')})},\;
      \ensuremath{\llbracket s[\sigma', t[\sigma']/x, E[\sigma']/y] \rrbracket(\rho')}\}
      \subseteq R_O
      && \text{(by hypothesis on $s$)}
  \end{align*}
  By substitution-extension evaluation:
  \begin{align*}
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket (\sigma, t[\sigma]/x, E[\sigma]/y) \rrbracket(\rho)}
      = (\rho_\sigma, b_t/x, c_t/y)
      && \text{(pointwise; head eval, $\ensuremath{\llbracket E[\sigma] \rrbracket(\rho)} = c_t$)} \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket (\sigma', t[\sigma']/x, E[\sigma']/y) \rrbracket(\rho')}
      = (\rho_{\sigma'}, b_{t'}/x, c_{t'}/y)
      && \text{(symmetrically; $\ensuremath{\llbracket E[\sigma'] \rrbracket(\rho')} = c_{t'}$)}
  \end{align*}
  where $c_{t'}$ is the corresponding recursive-call value.
  Hence the four values of the pattern read:
  \begin{align*}
    &\{\ensuremath{\llbracket s[\sigma, t[\sigma]/x, E[\sigma]/y] \rrbracket(\rho)},\;
      \ensuremath{\llbracket s \rrbracket((\rho_\sigma, b_t/x, c_t/y))}, \\
    &\quad \ensuremath{\llbracket s \rrbracket((\rho_{\sigma'}, b_{t'}/x, c_{t'}/y))},\;
      \ensuremath{\llbracket s[\sigma', t[\sigma']/x, E[\sigma']/y] \rrbracket(\rho')}\}
      \subseteq R_O
  \end{align*}

  \emph{Identifying $R_O$.}
  $R_O$ is the PER returned by the type four-value pattern of
  $T[\Uparrow \circ \Uparrow, \textsf{succ}~x_1/x]$ at the same doubly-extended substitution.
  We bridge it to the PER at $\ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket((\rho_\sigma, \texttt{su}(a)/x))}$ (which is the
  goal's type $T[\textsf{succ}~t/x]$ evaluated at the inner position) via two steps.

  \emph{Step (a): collapse the iterated substitution.}
  Denote $\tau_* := (\sigma, t[\sigma]/x, E[\sigma]/y)$ (the doubly-extended
  substitution from $\Gamma'$ to $\Gamma, x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}, y:T$). The value
  $\ensuremath{\llbracket (T[\Uparrow \circ \Uparrow, \textsf{succ}~x_1/x])[\tau_*] \rrbracket(\rho)}$ governs $R_O$.
  By \Cref{lem:subst-assoc} and \Cref{lem:ext-comp}:
  \begin{align*}
    &(T[\Uparrow \circ \Uparrow, \textsf{succ}~x_1/x])[\tau_*]
      = T[(\Uparrow \circ \Uparrow, \textsf{succ}~x_1/x) \circ \tau_*]
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:subst-assoc})} \\
    &(\Uparrow \circ \Uparrow, \textsf{succ}~x_1/x) \circ \tau_*
      = ((\Uparrow \circ \Uparrow) \circ \tau_*,\,
         (\textsf{succ}~x_1)[\tau_*]/x)
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:ext-comp})} \\
    &(\Uparrow \circ \Uparrow) \circ \tau_* = \sigma
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:shift-ext} twice, dropping} \\
    & && \text{$E[\sigma]/y$ and $t[\sigma]/x$)} \\
    &(\textsf{succ}~x_1)[\tau_*] = \textsf{succ}~x_1[\tau_*] = \textsf{succ}~t[\sigma]
      && \text{(by syntactic substitution; $\tau_*(1) = t[\sigma]$)}
  \end{align*}
  Hence the collapsed substitution is $(\sigma,\, \textsf{succ}~t[\sigma]/x)$:
  \begin{align*}
    &(T[\Uparrow \circ \Uparrow, \textsf{succ}~x_1/x])[\tau_*]
      = T[\sigma,\, \textsf{succ}~t[\sigma]/x]
      && \text{(by combining the above)}
  \end{align*}

  \emph{Step (b): instantiate hypothesis on $T$ at the collapsed substitution.}
  By the IH on $\semtyeq[\Gamma, x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}]{T}{T}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$, applied at $\Gamma'$,
  the semantic substitution $\semtyeq[\Gamma']{(\sigma, \textsf{succ}~t[\sigma]/x)}{(\sigma', \textsf{succ}~t[\sigma']/x)}{\Gamma, x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}$
  (by \Cref{lem:sem-ext-pre} on $\sigma \approx \sigma'$ and
  $\textsf{succ}~t[\sigma] \approx \textsf{succ}~t[\sigma'] \in \textsf{Nat}$ via \textsc{Nat-Su}
  on the $t$-pattern), and $\rho \approx \rho' \in R'$:
  \begin{align*}
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket T[\sigma, \textsf{succ}~t[\sigma]/x] \rrbracket(\rho)} \\
    & \quad \approx \ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket (\sigma, \textsf{succ}~t[\sigma]/x) \rrbracket(\rho)})}
      \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R_O
      && \text{(four-value of $T$, outer-LHS vs inner-LHS)} \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket (\sigma, \textsf{succ}~t[\sigma]/x) \rrbracket(\rho)}
      = (\rho_\sigma, \texttt{su}(b_t)/x)
      && \text{(pointwise eval; $\ensuremath{\llbracket \textsf{succ}~t[\sigma] \rrbracket(\rho)} = \texttt{su}(b_t)$)}
  \end{align*}
  Bridge $\texttt{su}(b_t)$ to $\texttt{su}(a)$: from the four-value pattern of $t$,
  \[
    b_t = \ensuremath{\llbracket t[\sigma] \rrbracket(\rho)} \approx a = \ensuremath{\llbracket t \rrbracket(\rho_\sigma)}
    \in \textsf{Nat}
  \]
  (outer-LHS vs inner-LHS), so $\texttt{su}(b_t) \approx \texttt{su}(a)
  \in \textsf{Nat}$ by
  \textsc{Nat-Su}. By \Cref{lem:sem-ty-id} on $T$:
  \begin{align*}
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket((\rho_\sigma, \texttt{su}(b_t)/x))} \approx \ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket((\rho_\sigma, \texttt{su}(a)/x))}
      \in \mathcal{U}_i
      && \text{(\Cref{lem:sem-ty-id})}
  \end{align*}
  By transitivity and \Cref{lem:univ-functional}, $R_O$ is the PER at
  $\ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket((\rho_\sigma, \texttt{su}(a)/x))}$ --- the goal's type $T[\textsf{succ}~t/x]$ inner-LHS
  value (since $T[\textsf{succ}~t/x]$ evaluated at $\rho_\sigma$ equals $T$ at the
  inner-extended env, modulo the same bridge).

  \emph{LHS-RHS bridging.}
  The RHS outer-RHS value is
  $\ensuremath{\llbracket  \rrbracket(\rho')} = \ensuremath{\llbracket s[\sigma', t[\sigma']/x, E[\sigma']/y] \rrbracket(\rho')}$,
  which is the outer-RHS of the four-value pattern of $s$ above.
  Similarly, the RHS inner-RHS value
  $\ensuremath{\llbracket s[t/x, E/y] \rrbracket(\rho_{\sigma'})}$ relates to
  $\ensuremath{\llbracket s \rrbracket((\rho_{\sigma'}, b_{t'}/x, c_{t'}/y))}$ via the four-value pattern of
  $s$ on the primed side (analogous to the LHS-side bridging below).

  For LHS values (the $\sigma, \rho$- and $\rho_\sigma$-sides of the goal):
  the LHS computation gives $b_L = \ensuremath{\llbracket s[q^2(\sigma)] \rrbracket((\rho, b_t/x, c_t/y))}$
  at $\sigma, \rho$, and $b_I = \ensuremath{\llbracket s \rrbracket((\rho_\sigma, a/x, c/y))}$ at $\rho_\sigma$.
  We bridge $b_L$ to $\ensuremath{\llbracket s \rrbracket((\rho_\sigma, b_t/x, c_t/y))}$ (the inner-LHS of
  the four-value pattern) via the four-value pattern of $s \approx s$
  (reflexive) at $\Gamma', x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}, y:T[q(\sigma)]$, doubly-lifted substitution
  $q^2(\sigma) \approx q^2(\sigma)$, and reflexive env-pair
  $(\rho, b_t/x, c_t/y) \approx (\rho, b_t/x, c_t/y)$:
  \begin{align*}
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket s[q^2(\sigma)] \rrbracket((\rho, b_t/x, c_t/y))}
      \approx \ensuremath{\llbracket s \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket q^2(\sigma) \rrbracket((\rho, b_t/x, c_t/y))})} \in R_O
      && \text{(four-value pattern of $s$)} \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket q^2(\sigma) \rrbracket((\rho, b_t/x, c_t/y))}
      \approx (\rho_\sigma, b_t/x, c_t/y) \in R_{\Gamma, x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}, y:T}
      && \text{(by \textsc{Ctx-Ext} twice and the four-value} \\
    & && \text{pattern of $\sigma$ at $\Uparrow$ for the tail)} \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket s \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket q^2(\sigma) \rrbracket((\rho, b_t/x, c_t/y))})}
      \approx \ensuremath{\llbracket s \rrbracket((\rho_\sigma, b_t/x, c_t/y))} \in R_O
      && \text{(\Cref{lem:sem-ty-id} on $s$)}
  \end{align*}
  Hence by transitivity, $b_L \approx \ensuremath{\llbracket s \rrbracket((\rho_\sigma, b_t/x, c_t/y))}
   \in R_O$.

  For $b_I = \ensuremath{\llbracket s \rrbracket((\rho_\sigma, a/x, c/y))}$: bridge to
  $\ensuremath{\llbracket s \rrbracket((\rho_\sigma, b_t/x, c_t/y))}$ via \Cref{lem:sem-ty-id} on $s$ at
  the env-pair related by:
  \begin{align*}
    &b_t \approx a \in \textsf{Nat}
      && \text{(four-value pattern of $t$, outer-LHS vs inner-LHS)} \\
    &c_t \approx c \in R_T\text{-at-}a
      && \text{(four-value pattern of $E$ at $\sigma$, outer-LHS vs inner-LHS;} \\
    & && \text{using $E$ semantic by \Cref{lem:fund-rec})}
  \end{align*}
  giving $\ensuremath{\llbracket s \rrbracket((\rho_\sigma, b_t/x, c_t/y))} \approx \ensuremath{\llbracket s \rrbracket((\rho_\sigma, a/x, c/y))} = b_I
  \in R_O$.
  Hence $b_L \approx b_I$ in $R_O$, and both are PER-related to the four-value
  pattern's inner-LHS.

  Symmetrically for the primed side.
  Combining: all four LHS values ($\{b_L, b_I, b_I', b_L'\}$) are pairwise
  related to the four RHS values (the four-value pattern of $s$ outer/inner)
  in $R_O$, by transitivity through the inner-LHS/inner-RHS bridge.

  \emph{Type part.}
  The type four-value pattern is included in the application of
  $\semtyeq[\Gamma, x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}, y:T]{s}{s}{T[\Uparrow \circ \Uparrow, \textsf{succ}~x_1/x]}$
  above; by the same syntactic identity used for the term part, the goal's type
  $T[\textsf{succ}~t/x]$ pattern coincides with this type four-value pattern modulo the
  substitution-composition lemmas.
<!-- end proof-95 -->
<!-- lemma-97: body_md -->
\label{lem:fund-sub-univ}
  If $\ensuremath{\vDash \Gamma}$ and $i \le j$, then
  $\Gamma \vDash \ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}} \subseteq \ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{j}}$.
<!-- end lemma-97 -->
<!-- proof-96: body_md -->
By \Cref{lem:sem-ctx-per} on $\ensuremath{\vDash \Gamma}$ we obtain
  $\Gamma \approx \Gamma \searrow R_\Gamma$.  
  Let $\Gamma'$ with $\Gamma' \approx \Gamma' \searrow R'$,
  $\semtyeq[\Gamma']{\sigma}{\sigma'}{\Gamma}$, and
  $\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}} :: \rho \approx \rho' \in R'$ be given.  
  We verify the three clauses of $\Gamma \vDash \ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}} \subseteq \ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{j}}$ at
  the level $k := 1 + \max(i, j)$.  

  Since $\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}$ and $\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{j}}$ are closed terms, for any substitution
  $\tau$ and any environment $\rho_0$ we have $\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}[\tau] = \ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}$,
  $\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{j}}[\tau] = \ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{j}}$, and by evaluation of the universe constructor
  $\ensuremath{\llbracket \ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}} \rrbracket(\rho_0)} = U_i$, $\ensuremath{\llbracket \ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{j}} \rrbracket(\rho_0)} = U_j$.  

  \emph{Part (1).}
  \begin{align*}
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket \ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}[\sigma] \rrbracket(\rho)} = U_i
      && \text{(closed term + evaluation of $\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}$)} \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket \ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}} \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)})} = U_i
      && \text{(evaluation of $\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}$)} \\
    &U_i \approx U_i \in \mathcal{U}_k \searrow (\mathcal{U}_i)
      && \text{(by \textsc{U-Univ}, since $i < k$)} \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket \ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}[\sigma] \rrbracket(\rho)} \approx \ensuremath{\llbracket \ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}} \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)})}
      \in \mathcal{U}_k
      && \text{(reflexivity of the previous line)}
  \end{align*}

  \emph{Part (2).} Symmetrically:
  \begin{align*}
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket \ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{j}}[\sigma'] \rrbracket(\rho')} = U_j = \ensuremath{\llbracket \ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{j}} \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')})}
      && \text{(closed term + evaluation of $\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{j}}$)} \\
    &U_j \approx U_j \in \mathcal{U}_k \searrow (\mathcal{U}_j)
      && \text{(by \textsc{U-Univ}, since $j < k$)} \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket \ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{j}}[\sigma'] \rrbracket(\rho')} \approx \ensuremath{\llbracket \ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{j}} \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')})}
      \in \mathcal{U}_k
      && \text{(reflexivity)}
  \end{align*}

  \emph{Part (3).}
  By \textsc{$<$:-Univ} with $i \le j$ and $j < k$:
  \begin{align*}
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket \ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}} \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)})} = U_i \mathrel{<:_k} U_j
      = \ensuremath{\llbracket \ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{j}} \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')})}
      && \text{(by \textsc{$<$:-Univ})}
  \end{align*}
<!-- end proof-96 -->
<!-- lemma-98: body_md -->
\label{lem:fund-sub-pi}
  If $\semtyeq[\Gamma]{S_1}{S_1}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$,
  $\semtyeq[\Gamma]{S_2}{S_2}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$,
  $\semtyeq[\Gamma]{S_1}{S_2}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$,
  $\semtyeq[\Gamma, x:S_1]{T_1}{T_1}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$,
  $\semtyeq[\Gamma, x:S_2]{T_2}{T_2}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$, and
  $\Gamma, x:S_1 \vDash T_1 \subseteq T_2$, then
  $\Gamma \vDash \Pi(x:S_1).\,T_1 \subseteq \Pi(x:S_2).\,T_2$.
<!-- end lemma-98 -->
<!-- proof-97: body_md -->
Let $\Gamma'$ with $\Gamma' \approx \Gamma' \searrow R'$,
  $\semtyeq[\Gamma']{\sigma}{\sigma'}{\Gamma}$, and
  $\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}} :: \rho \approx \rho' \in R'$ be given.  
  Write $\rho_\sigma := \ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)}$ and
  $\rho_{\sigma'} := \ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')}$.  

  We must verify the three clauses of
  $\Gamma \vDash \Pi(x:S_1).\,T_1 \subseteq \Pi(x:S_2).\,T_2$.  
  Computing the four type values via substitution and evaluation of
  $\Pi$:
  \begin{align*}
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket (\Pi(x:S_1).\,T_1)[\sigma] \rrbracket(\rho)}
      = \Pi(\ensuremath{\llbracket S_1[\sigma] \rrbracket(\rho)},\; T_1[q(\sigma)],\; \rho)
      && \text{(by definition of substitution and evaluation on $\Pi$)} \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket \Pi(x:S_1).\,T_1 \rrbracket(\rho_\sigma)}
      = \Pi(\ensuremath{\llbracket S_1 \rrbracket(\rho_\sigma)},\; T_1,\; \rho_\sigma)
      && \text{(by evaluation on $\Pi$)} \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket \Pi(x:S_2).\,T_2 \rrbracket(\rho_{\sigma'})}
      = \Pi(\ensuremath{\llbracket S_2 \rrbracket(\rho_{\sigma'})},\; T_2,\; \rho_{\sigma'})
      && \text{(by evaluation on $\Pi$)} \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket (\Pi(x:S_2).\,T_2)[\sigma'] \rrbracket(\rho')}
      = \Pi(\ensuremath{\llbracket S_2[\sigma'] \rrbracket(\rho')},\; T_2[q(\sigma')],\; \rho')
      && \text{(by definition of substitution and evaluation on $\Pi$)}
  \end{align*}

  \emph{Part (1).}  
  By \Cref{lem:fund-pi-wf} applied to $\semtyeq[\Gamma]{S_1}{S_1}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$
  and $\semtyeq[\Gamma, x:S_1]{T_1}{T_1}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$, we obtain
  $\semtyeq[\Gamma]{\Pi(x:S_1).\,T_1}{\Pi(x:S_1).\,T_1}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$.  
  Instantiating its type-side four-value relation at
  $\semtyeq[\Gamma']{\sigma}{\sigma'}{\Gamma}$ and $\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}$, the
  outer-LHS-vs-inner-LHS leg yields:
  \begin{align*}
    &\Pi(\ensuremath{\llbracket S_1[\sigma] \rrbracket(\rho)},\, T_1[q(\sigma)],\, \rho)
      \approx \Pi(\ensuremath{\llbracket S_1 \rrbracket(\rho_\sigma)},\, T_1,\, \rho_\sigma)
      \in \mathcal{U}_i
      && \text{(part (1))}
  \end{align*}

  \emph{Part (2).}  
  Symmetrically, by \Cref{lem:fund-pi-wf} on $S_2$ and $T_2$ and the
  outer-RHS-vs-inner-RHS leg of its type-side four-value relation at the
  same data:
  \begin{align*}
    &\Pi(\ensuremath{\llbracket S_2 \rrbracket(\rho_{\sigma'})},\, T_2,\, \rho_{\sigma'})
      \approx \Pi(\ensuremath{\llbracket S_2[\sigma'] \rrbracket(\rho')},\, T_2[q(\sigma')],\, \rho')
      \in \mathcal{U}_i
      && \text{(part (2), via symmetry of $\mathcal{U}_i$)}
  \end{align*}

  \emph{Part (3).}  
  We must show
  $\Pi(\ensuremath{\llbracket S_1 \rrbracket(\rho_\sigma)}, T_1, \rho_\sigma) \mathrel{<:_i}
   \Pi(\ensuremath{\llbracket S_2 \rrbracket(\rho_{\sigma'})}, T_2, \rho_{\sigma'})$.  
  We apply \textsc{$<$:-Pi}, which requires:
  \begin{enumerate}
  \@idxitem[(a)] $\ensuremath{\llbracket S_1 \rrbracket(\rho_\sigma)} \approx \ensuremath{\llbracket S_2 \rrbracket(\rho_{\sigma'})}
    \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R_I$ for some $R_I$;
  \@idxitem[(b)] for every $\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}_I :: a \approx a' \in R_I$,
    $\ensuremath{\llbracket T_1 \rrbracket(\rho_\sigma, a/x)} \mathrel{<:_i}
     \ensuremath{\llbracket T_2 \rrbracket(\rho_{\sigma'}, a'/x)}$;
  \@idxitem[(c)] $\Pi(\ensuremath{\llbracket S_1 \rrbracket(\rho_\sigma)}, T_1, \rho_\sigma)
    \approx \Pi(\ensuremath{\llbracket S_1 \rrbracket(\rho_\sigma)}, T_1, \rho_\sigma) \in \mathcal{U}_i$ and
    $\Pi(\ensuremath{\llbracket S_2 \rrbracket(\rho_{\sigma'})}, T_2, \rho_{\sigma'})
    \approx \Pi(\ensuremath{\llbracket S_2 \rrbracket(\rho_{\sigma'})}, T_2, \rho_{\sigma'}) \in \mathcal{U}_i$.
  \end{enumerate}

  \emph{(a) Domain.}  
  Instantiate the type-side four-value relation of
  $\semtyeq[\Gamma]{S_1}{S_2}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$ at
  $\semtyeq[\Gamma']{\sigma}{\sigma'}{\Gamma}$ and $\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}$:
  \begin{align*}
    &\{\ensuremath{\llbracket S_1[\sigma] \rrbracket(\rho)},\;
      \ensuremath{\llbracket S_1 \rrbracket(\rho_\sigma)},\;
      \ensuremath{\llbracket S_2 \rrbracket(\rho_{\sigma'})},\;
      \ensuremath{\llbracket S_2[\sigma'] \rrbracket(\rho')}\}
      \subseteq \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R_I
      && \text{(by hypothesis on $S_1, S_2$)}
  \end{align*}
  The inner-LHS-vs-inner-RHS pair gives
  $\ensuremath{\llbracket S_1 \rrbracket(\rho_\sigma)} \approx \ensuremath{\llbracket S_2 \rrbracket(\rho_{\sigma'})} \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R_I$.  

  \emph{(b) Codomain.}  
  By \Cref{lem:sem-wk-q} on $\semtyeq[\Gamma']{\sigma}{\sigma'}{\Gamma}$ and
  $\semtyeq[\Gamma]{S_1}{S_1}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$:
  \[
    \semtyeq[\Gamma', x:S_1[\sigma]]{q(\sigma)}{q(\sigma')}{\Gamma, x:S_1}.
  \]
  By the first premise of the semantic substitution judgment, this carries
  $(\Gamma', x:S_1[\sigma]) \approx (\Gamma', x:S_1[\sigma]) \searrow R'_{x:S_1[\sigma]}$
  and $(\Gamma, x:S_1) \approx (\Gamma, x:S_1) \searrow R_{\Gamma,x:S_1}$.  

  Let $\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}_I :: a \approx a' \in R_I$ be given.  
  By the biconditional of $R'_{x:S_1[\sigma]}$ from \textsc{Ctx-Ext},
  $(\rho, a/x) \approx (\rho', a'/x) \in R'_{x:S_1[\sigma]}$ requires
  $\rho \approx \rho' \in R'$ (which we have via $\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}$) and
  $a \approx a' \in R_H'(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}})$ where $R_H'$ is the head family for
  $R'_{x:S_1[\sigma]}$, governed by
  $\ensuremath{\llbracket S_1[\sigma] \rrbracket(\rho)} \approx \ensuremath{\llbracket S_1[\sigma] \rrbracket(\rho')}
   \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R_H'(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}})$.  
  By \Cref{lem:univ-functional} on the same left type
  $\ensuremath{\llbracket S_1[\sigma] \rrbracket(\rho)}$ that governs both $R_I$
  (from \emph{(a)}) and $R_H'(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}})$, $R_I \Leftrightarrow R_H'(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}})$.  
  Hence $a \approx a' \in R_H'(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}})$, and
  $(\rho, a/x) \approx (\rho', a'/x) \in R'_{x:S_1[\sigma]}$.
