  Apply $\Gamma, x:S_1 \vDash T_1 \subseteq T_2$ at $\Gamma', x:S_1[\sigma]$
  (with $R'_{x:S_1[\sigma]}$), the lifted substitution
  $\semtyeq[\Gamma', x:S_1[\sigma]]{q(\sigma)}{q(\sigma')}{\Gamma, x:S_1}$,
  and $(\rho, a/x) \approx (\rho', a'/x) \in R'_{x:S_1[\sigma]}$:
  \begin{align*}
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket T_1[q(\sigma)] \rrbracket(\rho, a/x)} \approx
      \ensuremath{\llbracket T_1 \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket q(\sigma) \rrbracket(\rho, a/x)})} \in \mathcal{U}_i
      && \text{(part (1) of $T_1 \subseteq T_2$)} \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket T_2[q(\sigma')] \rrbracket(\rho', a'/x)} \approx
      \ensuremath{\llbracket T_2 \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket q(\sigma') \rrbracket(\rho', a'/x)})} \in \mathcal{U}_i
      && \text{(part (2))} \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket T_1 \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket q(\sigma) \rrbracket(\rho, a/x)})} \mathrel{<:_i}
      \ensuremath{\llbracket T_2 \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket q(\sigma') \rrbracket(\rho', a'/x)})}
      && \text{(part (3))}
  \end{align*}

  We now bridge the inner-evaluations of $q(\sigma)$ and $q(\sigma')$ to the
  desired environments.  
  Using the lifted-substitution four-value pattern (instantiated at the
  identity weakening on $\Gamma', x:S_1[\sigma]$ with
  $(\rho, a/x) \approx (\rho', a'/x)$):
  \begin{align*}
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket q(\sigma) \rrbracket(\rho, a/x)} \approx (\rho_\sigma, a/x)
      \in R_{\Gamma, x:S_1}
      && \text{(outer-LHS vs inner-LHS in the four-value pattern)} \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket q(\sigma') \rrbracket(\rho', a'/x)} \approx (\rho_{\sigma'}, a'/x)
      \in R_{\Gamma, x:S_1}
      && \text{(outer-RHS vs inner-RHS, symmetrically)}
  \end{align*}
  By \Cref{lem:sem-ty-id} on $\semtyeq[\Gamma, x:S_1]{T_1}{T_1}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$
  applied to the first relation, and on
  $\semtyeq[\Gamma, x:S_2]{T_2}{T_2}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$ applied (after substituting
  $S_1$ for $S_2$ via the well-formedness premises) to the second:
  \begin{align*}
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket T_1 \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket q(\sigma) \rrbracket(\rho, a/x)})}
      \approx \ensuremath{\llbracket T_1 \rrbracket(\rho_\sigma, a/x)} \in \mathcal{U}_i
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:sem-ty-id} on $T_1$)} \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket T_2 \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket q(\sigma') \rrbracket(\rho', a'/x)})}
      \approx \ensuremath{\llbracket T_2 \rrbracket(\rho_{\sigma'}, a'/x)} \in \mathcal{U}_i
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:sem-ty-id} on $T_2$)}
  \end{align*}
  By \Cref{lem:subty-respects} applied to the codomain subtyping above and
  these two $\mathcal{U}_i$-equivalences:
  \begin{align*}
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket T_1 \rrbracket(\rho_\sigma, a/x)}
      \mathrel{<:_i} \ensuremath{\llbracket T_2 \rrbracket(\rho_{\sigma'}, a'/x)}
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:subty-respects})}
  \end{align*}

  \emph{(c) Self-relatedness.}  
  By \Cref{lem:fund-pi-wf} on $\semtyeq[\Gamma]{S_1}{S_1}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$ and
  $\semtyeq[\Gamma, x:S_1]{T_1}{T_1}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$ instantiated at the same data,
  the inner-LHS-vs-inner-LHS leg of the resulting type-side four-value
  relation gives
  $\Pi(\ensuremath{\llbracket S_1 \rrbracket(\rho_\sigma)}, T_1, \rho_\sigma) \approx
   \Pi(\ensuremath{\llbracket S_1 \rrbracket(\rho_\sigma)}, T_1, \rho_\sigma) \in \mathcal{U}_i$.  
  Symmetrically for $S_2, T_2$:
  $\Pi(\ensuremath{\llbracket S_2 \rrbracket(\rho_{\sigma'})}, T_2, \rho_{\sigma'}) \approx
   \Pi(\ensuremath{\llbracket S_2 \rrbracket(\rho_{\sigma'})}, T_2, \rho_{\sigma'}) \in \mathcal{U}_i$.  

  \emph{Conclusion.}  
  By \textsc{$<$:-Pi} with the four ingredients (a)--(c):
  \begin{align*}
    &\Pi(\ensuremath{\llbracket S_1 \rrbracket(\rho_\sigma)}, T_1, \rho_\sigma) \mathrel{<:_i}
      \Pi(\ensuremath{\llbracket S_2 \rrbracket(\rho_{\sigma'})}, T_2, \rho_{\sigma'})
      && \text{(part (3))}
  \end{align*}
<!-- end proof-97 -->
<!-- lemma-99: body_md -->
\label{lem:fund-sub-trans}
  If $\Gamma \vDash S \subseteq T'$ and $\Gamma \vDash T' \subseteq T$, then
  $\Gamma \vDash S \subseteq T$.
<!-- end lemma-99 -->
<!-- proof-98: body_md -->
Let $\Gamma'$ with $\Gamma' \approx \Gamma' \searrow R'$,
  $\semtyeq[\Gamma']{\sigma}{\sigma'}{\Gamma}$, and
  $\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}} :: \rho \approx \rho' \in R'$ be given.  
  Write $\rho_\sigma := \ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)}$ and
  $\rho_{\sigma'} := \ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')}$.  
  We must establish each clause of $\Gamma \vDash S \subseteq T$.  

  \emph{Part (1).}  
  Instantiate the first hypothesis $\Gamma \vDash S \subseteq T'$ at this
  data; its clause (1) gives the goal:
  \begin{align*}
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket S[\sigma] \rrbracket(\rho)} \approx \ensuremath{\llbracket S \rrbracket(\rho_\sigma)} \in \mathcal{U}_i
      && \text{(by clause (1) of $\Gamma \vDash S \subseteq T'$)}
  \end{align*}

  \emph{Part (2).}  
  Instantiate the second hypothesis $\Gamma \vDash T' \subseteq T$ at the
  same data; its clause (2) gives the goal:
  \begin{align*}
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket T[\sigma'] \rrbracket(\rho')} \approx \ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket(\rho_{\sigma'})} \in \mathcal{U}_i
      && \text{(by clause (2) of $\Gamma \vDash T' \subseteq T$)}
  \end{align*}

  \emph{Part (3).}  
  From the two hypotheses at the same data:
  \begin{align*}
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket S \rrbracket(\rho_\sigma)} \mathrel{<:_i} \ensuremath{\llbracket T' \rrbracket(\rho_{\sigma'})}
      && \text{(by clause (3) of $\Gamma \vDash S \subseteq T'$)} \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket T' \rrbracket(\rho_{\sigma'})} \mathrel{<:_i} \ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket(\rho_{\sigma'})}
      && \text{(by clause (3) of $\Gamma \vDash T' \subseteq T$)} \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket S \rrbracket(\rho_\sigma)} \mathrel{<:_i} \ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket(\rho_{\sigma'})}
      && \text{(by transitivity of $<:_i$, \Cref{lem:subty-trans})}
  \end{align*}
  All three clauses of $\Gamma \vDash S \subseteq T$ are now
  established.
<!-- end proof-98 -->
<!-- lemma-100: body_md -->
\label{lem:fund-sub-eq}
  If $\semtyeq[\Gamma]{T}{T}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$ and $\semtyeq[\Gamma]{S}{T}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$,
  then $\Gamma \vDash S \subseteq T$.
<!-- end lemma-100 -->
<!-- proof-99: body_md -->
Let $\Gamma'$ with $\Gamma' \approx \Gamma' \searrow R'$,
  $\semtyeq[\Gamma']{\sigma}{\sigma'}{\Gamma}$, and
  $\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}} :: \rho \approx \rho' \in R'$ be given.  
  Write $\rho_\sigma := \ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma \rrbracket(\rho)}$ and
  $\rho_{\sigma'} := \ensuremath{\llbracket \sigma' \rrbracket(\rho')}$.  
  We establish each clause of $\Gamma \vDash S \subseteq T$.  

  \emph{Part (1).}  
  Instantiate the type-side four-value relation of
  $\semtyeq[\Gamma]{S}{T}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$ at
  $\semtyeq[\Gamma']{\sigma}{\sigma'}{\Gamma}$ and $\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}$:
  \begin{align*}
    &\{\ensuremath{\llbracket S[\sigma] \rrbracket(\rho)},\;
      \ensuremath{\llbracket S \rrbracket(\rho_\sigma)},\;
      \ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket(\rho_{\sigma'})},\;
      \ensuremath{\llbracket T[\sigma'] \rrbracket(\rho')}\}
      \subseteq \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R_T
      && \text{(by hypothesis on $S, T$)}
  \end{align*}
  The outer-LHS-vs-inner-LHS leg gives
  $\ensuremath{\llbracket S[\sigma] \rrbracket(\rho)} \approx \ensuremath{\llbracket S \rrbracket(\rho_\sigma)} \in \mathcal{U}_i$, which is
  clause (1).  

  \emph{Part (2).}  
  Instantiate the type-side four-value relation of
  $\semtyeq[\Gamma]{T}{T}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$ at the same data:
  \begin{align*}
    &\{\ensuremath{\llbracket T[\sigma] \rrbracket(\rho)},\;
      \ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket(\rho_\sigma)},\;
      \ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket(\rho_{\sigma'})},\;
      \ensuremath{\llbracket T[\sigma'] \rrbracket(\rho')}\}
      \subseteq \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R_T'
      && \text{(by hypothesis on $T, T$)}
  \end{align*}
  The outer-RHS-vs-inner-RHS leg gives
  $\ensuremath{\llbracket T[\sigma'] \rrbracket(\rho')} \approx \ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket(\rho_{\sigma'})} \in \mathcal{U}_i$,
  which is clause (2).  

  \emph{Part (3).}  
  From the four-value relation in part (1), the inner-LHS-vs-inner-RHS leg
  gives:
  \begin{align*}
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket S \rrbracket(\rho_\sigma)} \approx \ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket(\rho_{\sigma'})}
      \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R_T
      && \text{(inner-LHS vs inner-RHS in the four-value pattern)}
  \end{align*}
  By \Cref{lem:univ-implies-subty}:
  \begin{align*}
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket S \rrbracket(\rho_\sigma)} \mathrel{<:_i} \ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket(\rho_{\sigma'})}
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:univ-implies-subty})}
  \end{align*}
  This is clause (3).
<!-- end proof-99 -->
<!-- theorem-1: body_md -->
\label{thm:fundamental}
  The following statements hold:
  \begin{enumerate}
  \@idxitem If $\vdash \Gamma$, then $\vDash \Gamma$.
  \@idxitem If $\typing[\Gamma]{t}{T}$, then $\semtyeq[\Gamma]{t}{t}{T}$.
  \@idxitem If $\tyequiv[\Gamma]{t}{t'}{T}$, then $\semtyeq[\Gamma]{t}{t'}{T}$.
  \@idxitem If $\subty[\Gamma]{S}{T}$, then $\Gamma \vDash S \subseteq T$.
  \end{enumerate}
<!-- end theorem-1 -->
<!-- proof-100: body_md -->
By mutual induction on the syntactic derivations.
  Each rule's case follows by applying the corresponding semantic rule lemma
  (\Cref{sec:comp:sem-ctx-wf,sec:comp:sem-ty-form,sec:comp:sem-tm-intro-elim,sec:comp:sem-comp,sec:comp:sem-sym-trans,sec:comp:sem-subty-rules})
  to the IHs on the rule's premises.
<!-- end proof-100 -->
<!-- theorem-2: body_md -->
\label{thm:completeness}
  If $\tyequiv[\Gamma]{s}{t}{T}$, then $\textsf{nbe}_\Gamma^T(s) = \textsf{nbe}_\Gamma^T(t)$.
  That is, judgmentally equal terms have the same normal form.
<!-- end theorem-2 -->
<!-- proof-101: body_md -->
By the fundamental theorem (\Cref{thm:fundamental}, statement (3)):
  $\semtyeq[\Gamma]{s}{t}{T}$.
  Unfolding, this means: for all $\Gamma' \approx \Gamma' \searrow R'$, all
  $\semtyeq[\Gamma']{\sigma}{\sigma'}{\Gamma}$, all $\rho \approx \rho' \in R'$,
  the evaluations of $s$ and $t$ are related in the appropriate PER.

  We instantiate at:
  \begin{itemize}
  \@idxitem $\Gamma' := \Gamma$ (by statement (1), $\Gamma \approx \Gamma \searrow R$ for some $R$),
  \@idxitem $\sigma := \sigma' := \ensuremath{\textsf{id}}$ (the identity substitution is semantic by \Cref{lem:sem-id}),
  \@idxitem $\rho := \rho' := {\uparrow}^\Gamma$ (the initial environment is in $R$ by \Cref{lem:init-in-per}).
  \end{itemize}
  Since $s[\ensuremath{\textsf{id}}] = s$ and $t[\ensuremath{\textsf{id}}] = t$, and $\ensuremath{\llbracket \ensuremath{\textsf{id}} \rrbracket(\rho)} = \rho$, we obtain:
  \begin{align*}
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket({\uparrow}^\Gamma)} \approx \ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket({\uparrow}^\Gamma)}
      \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R_T
      && \text{(type part, with LHS = RHS since $\sigma = \sigma'$ and $\rho = \rho'$)} \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket s \rrbracket({\uparrow}^\Gamma)} \approx \ensuremath{\llbracket t \rrbracket({\uparrow}^\Gamma)} \in R_T
      && \text{(term part)}
  \end{align*}

  Let $A = \ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket({\uparrow}^\Gamma)}$, $a = \ensuremath{\llbracket s \rrbracket({\uparrow}^\Gamma)}$, and
  $b = \ensuremath{\llbracket t \rrbracket({\uparrow}^\Gamma)}$.
  Then $A \approx A \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R_T$ and $a \approx b \in R_T$.

  By realizability (\Cref{lem:R-readback}):
  ${\downarrow}^A(a) \approx {\downarrow}^A(b) \in \textsf{Nf}$.
  Unfolding the definition of $\textsf{Nf}$: for all $n$, there exists $w$ such that
  $\textsf{R}^{\textsf{Nf}}_n({\downarrow}^A(a)) \searrow w$ and $\textsf{R}^{\textsf{Nf}}_n({\downarrow}^A(b)) \searrow w$.

  Taking $n = |\Gamma|$ (the length of $\Gamma$, which provides enough fresh names):
  \begin{align*}
    &\textsf{nbe}_\Gamma^T(s)
      = \textsf{R}^{\textsf{Nf}}_{|\Gamma|}({\downarrow}^{\ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket({\uparrow}^\Gamma)}}(\ensuremath{\llbracket s \rrbracket({\uparrow}^\Gamma)}))
      = \textsf{R}^{\textsf{Nf}}_{|\Gamma|}({\downarrow}^A(a))
      \searrow w \\
    &\textsf{nbe}_\Gamma^T(t)
      = \textsf{R}^{\textsf{Nf}}_{|\Gamma|}({\downarrow}^{\ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket({\uparrow}^\Gamma)}}(\ensuremath{\llbracket t \rrbracket({\uparrow}^\Gamma)}))
      = \textsf{R}^{\textsf{Nf}}_{|\Gamma|}({\downarrow}^A(b))
      \searrow w
  \end{align*}
  Hence $\textsf{nbe}_\Gamma^T(s) = w = \textsf{nbe}_\Gamma^T(t)$.
<!-- end proof-101 -->
<!-- definition-27: body_md -->
\label{def:kripke-wk}
  The judgment $\kweak[\Gamma]{\phi}{\Delta}$ states that $\phi$ is a
  \emph{Kripke weakening} from $\Delta$ to $\Gamma$ (i.e.\ $\phi$ extends $\Delta$
  to $\Gamma$ by appending entries on the left).
  It is defined inductively:
  \begin{mathpar}
    \inferrule[\textsc{KW-Id}]
    {\vdash \Gamma}
    {\kweak[\Gamma]{\ensuremath{\textsf{id}}}{\Gamma}}

    \inferrule[\textsc{KW-Shift}]
    {\kweak[\Gamma]{\phi}{\Delta} \\
     \typing[\Gamma]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}}
    {\kweak[\Gamma, x:S]{\phi \circ \Uparrow}{\Delta}}
  \end{mathpar}
  Equivalently, every Kripke weakening is a finite composition
  $\Uparrow \circ \cdots \circ \Uparrow$ of $\Uparrow$'s (with $\ensuremath{\textsf{id}}$ as the empty
  composition); no $q(\phi)$ lifting is permitted.
<!-- end definition-27 -->
<!-- lemma-101: body_md -->
\label{lem:kweak-is-wk}
  If $\kweak[\Gamma]{\phi}{\Delta}$, then $\weakening[\Gamma]{\phi}{\Delta}$.
<!-- end lemma-101 -->
<!-- proof-102: body_md -->
By induction on $\kweak[\Gamma]{\phi}{\Delta}$.
  \begin{align*}
    &\textsc{KW-Id}: \weakening[\Gamma]{\ensuremath{\textsf{id}}}{\Gamma}
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:wk-id-wt})} \\
    &\textsc{KW-Shift}: \weakening[\Gamma]{\phi}{\Delta} \text{ (IH)}
      && \\
    &\quad \weakening[\Gamma, x:S]{\Uparrow}{\Gamma}
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:wk-shift-wt})} \\
    &\quad \weakening[\Gamma, x:S]{\phi \circ \Uparrow}{\Delta}
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:wk-comp-wt})}
  \end{align*}
<!-- end proof-102 -->
<!-- lemma-102: body_md -->
\label{lem:kweak-comp}
  If $\kweak[\Gamma]{\psi}{\Delta}$ and $\kweak[\Delta']{\phi}{\Gamma}$, then
  $\kweak[\Delta']{\psi \circ \phi}{\Delta}$.
<!-- end lemma-102 -->
<!-- proof-103: body_md -->
By induction on $\kweak[\Delta']{\phi}{\Gamma}$.
  \begin{align*}
    &\textsc{KW-Id} \text{ (}\phi = \ensuremath{\textsf{id}}\text{): } \psi \circ \ensuremath{\textsf{id}} = \psi
      && \text{(by left-id of $\circ$)} \\
    &\quad \kweak[\Delta']{\psi}{\Delta}
      && \text{(by hypothesis)} \\[2pt]
    &\textsc{KW-Shift} \text{ (}\phi = \phi_0 \circ \Uparrow\text{, } \Delta' = \Delta_0, x:S\text{)}: \\
    &\quad \kweak[\Delta_0]{\psi \circ \phi_0}{\Delta}
      && \text{(by IH on $\phi_0$)} \\
    &\quad \kweak[\Delta_0, x:S]{(\psi \circ \phi_0) \circ \Uparrow}{\Delta}
      && \text{(by \textsc{KW-Shift})} \\
    &\quad \psi \circ (\phi_0 \circ \Uparrow) = (\psi \circ \phi_0) \circ \Uparrow
      && \text{(by associativity of $\circ$)} \\
    &\quad \kweak[\Delta']{\psi \circ \phi}{\Delta}
      && \text{(by the above)}
  \end{align*}
<!-- end proof-103 -->
<!-- definition-28: body_md -->
\label{def:gluing-univ}
  The relation $a \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P \searrow \textbf{El}$ is defined inductively by:
  \begin{mathpar}
    \inferrule[\textsc{G-Ne}]
    {{\uparrow}^A(e) \in \ensuremath{\mathrm{D}} \\
     P \Leftrightarrow \textsf{Neu}_i^e \\
     \textbf{El} \Leftrightarrow \textsf{Neu}_i^e}
    {{\uparrow}^A(e) \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P \searrow \textbf{El}}

    \inferrule[\textsc{G-Nat}]
    {P \Leftrightarrow \textsf{Nat}_i \\
     \textbf{El} \Leftrightarrow \textsf{Nat}_i}
    {N \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P \searrow \textbf{El}}

    \inferrule[\textsc{G-Univ}]
    {j < i \\
     P \Leftrightarrow \textsf{Univ}_{i,j} \\
     \textbf{El} \Leftrightarrow \textsf{Univ}_{i,j}^{\textbf{El}}}
    {U_j \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P \searrow \textbf{El}}

    \inferrule[\textsc{G-Pi}]
    {a \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P_I \searrow \textbf{El}_I \\
     a \approx a \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R_I \\\\
     \forall\, \ensuremath{\mathcal{D}} :: b \approx b \in R_I,\; c.\;
       \ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket(\rho, b/x)} \searrow c \implies
       c \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}) \searrow \textbf{El}_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}) \\\\
     \Pi(a, T, \rho) \approx \Pi(a, T, \rho) \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R \\\\
     P \Leftrightarrow \Pi_i(R_I, P_I, \textbf{El}_I, P_O) \\
     \textbf{El} \Leftrightarrow \Pi_i^{\textbf{El}}(R, R_I, P_I, \textbf{El}_I, \textbf{El}_O)}
    {\Pi(a, T, \rho) \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P \searrow \textbf{El}}
  \end{mathpar}
<!-- end definition-28 -->
<!-- definition-29: body_md -->
\label{def:neu-type-pred}
  The judgment $\typing[\Gamma]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; \textsf{Neu}_i^e$
  holds when:
  \begin{enumerate}
  \@idxitem $\typing[\Gamma]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$, and
  \@idxitem for all $\Delta, \phi$ with $\kweak[\Delta]{\phi}{\Gamma}$, there exists $u$
    with $\textsf{R}^{\textsf{Ne}}_{|\Delta|}(e) \searrow u$ and $\tyequiv[\Delta]{S[\phi]}{u}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$.
  \end{enumerate}
<!-- end definition-29 -->
<!-- definition-30: body_md -->
\label{def:neu-term-pred}
  The judgment $\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S} \;\circledR\; {\uparrow}^A(w) \in \textsf{Neu}_i^e$
  holds when:
  \begin{enumerate}
  \@idxitem $\typing[\Gamma]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; \textsf{Neu}_i^e$,
  \@idxitem $\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S}$,
  \@idxitem $w \approx w \in \textsf{Ne}$, and
  \@idxitem for all $\Delta, \phi$ with $\kweak[\Delta]{\phi}{\Gamma}$, there exists $u$
    with $\textsf{R}^{\textsf{Ne}}_{|\Delta|}(w) \searrow u$ and $\tyequiv[\Delta]{t[\phi]}{u}{S[\phi]}$.
  \end{enumerate}
<!-- end definition-30 -->
<!-- definition-31: body_md -->
\label{def:nat-type-pred}
  $\typing[\Gamma]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; \textsf{Nat}_i$ holds when
  $\tyequiv[\Gamma]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$.
<!-- end definition-31 -->
<!-- definition-32: body_md -->
\label{def:nat-term-pred}
  The judgment $\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S} \;\circledR\; b \in \textsf{Nat}_i$ holds
  when $\typing[\Gamma]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; \textsf{Nat}_i$ and
  $\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S} \;\circledR\; b \in \textsf{Nat}$, where the latter is
  defined by:
  \begin{mathpar}
    \inferrule[\textsc{GN-Ze}]
    {\tyequiv[\Gamma]{t}{\textsf{zero}}{S}}
    {\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S} \;\circledR\; \texttt{ze} \in \textsf{Nat}}

    \inferrule[\textsc{GN-Su}]
    {\typing[\Gamma]{t'}{S} \;\circledR\; b' \in \textsf{Nat} \\
     \tyequiv[\Gamma]{t}{\textsf{succ}~t'}{S}}
    {\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S} \;\circledR\; \texttt{su}(b') \in \textsf{Nat}}

    \inferrule[\textsc{GN-Ne}]
    {\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S} \;\circledR\; {\uparrow}^N(w) \in \textsf{Neu}_i^e}
    {\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S} \;\circledR\; {\uparrow}^N(w) \in \textsf{Nat}}
  \end{mathpar}
<!-- end definition-32 -->
<!-- definition-33: body_md -->
\label{def:pi-type-pred}
  $\typing[\Gamma]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; \Pi_i(R_I, P_I, \textbf{El}_I, P_O)$ holds when:
  \begin{enumerate}
  \@idxitem There exist $S_1, S_2$ with $\tyequiv[\Gamma]{S}{\Pi(x:S_1).\,S_2}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$.
  \@idxitem For all $\Delta, \phi$ with $\kweak[\Delta]{\phi}{\Gamma}$:
    $\typing[\Delta]{S_1[\phi]}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; P_I$.
  \@idxitem For all $\Delta, \phi$ with $\kweak[\Delta]{\phi}{\Gamma}$, and all $s, b$
    with $\typing[\Delta]{s}{S_1[\phi]} \;\circledR\; b \in \textbf{El}_I$, and all
    $\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}} :: b \approx b \in R_I$:
    $\typing[\Delta]{S_2[\iota(\phi), s/x]}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; P_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}})$.
  \end{enumerate}
<!-- end definition-33 -->
<!-- definition-34: body_md -->
\label{def:pi-term-pred}
  $\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S} \;\circledR\; f \in \Pi_i^{\textbf{El}}(R, R_I, P_I, \textbf{El}_I, \textbf{El}_O)$
  holds when:
  \begin{enumerate}
  \@idxitem $\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S}$.
  \@idxitem $f \approx f \in R$.
  \@idxitem $\typing[\Gamma]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; \Pi_i(R_I, P_I, \textbf{El}_I, P_O)$.
  \@idxitem For all $\Delta, \phi$ with $\kweak[\Delta]{\phi}{\Gamma}$, and all $s, b$
    with $\typing[\Delta]{s}{S_1[\phi]} \;\circledR\; b \in \textbf{El}_I$, and all
    $\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}} :: b \approx b \in R_I$: there exists $c$ with $f \cdot b \searrow c$
    and
    $\typing[\Delta]{(t[\phi])\;s}{S_2[\iota(\phi), s/x]} \;\circledR\; c \in \textbf{El}_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}})$.
  \end{enumerate}
<!-- end definition-34 -->
<!-- definition-35: body_md -->
\label{def:univ-type-pred}
  $\typing[\Gamma]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; \textsf{Univ}_{i,j}$ holds when
  $\tyequiv[\Gamma]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{j}}}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$.
<!-- end definition-35 -->
<!-- definition-36: body_md -->
\label{def:univ-term-pred}
  $\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S} \;\circledR\; b \in \textsf{Univ}_{i,j}^{\textbf{El}}$ holds when:
  \begin{enumerate}
  \@idxitem $\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S}$,
  \@idxitem $\tyequiv[\Gamma]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{j}}}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$, and
  \@idxitem there exist $P_b, \textbf{El}_b$ with $b \in \mathcal{U}_j^\ast \searrow P_b \searrow \textbf{El}_b$
    and $\typing[\Gamma]{t}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{j}}} \;\circledR\; P_b$ (the term $t$, viewed as a
    type at $\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{j}}$ via Russell, glues to $P_b$).
  \end{enumerate}
<!-- end definition-36 -->
<!-- definition-37: body_md -->
\label{def:nf-pred}
  $\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S} \;\circledR\; b \in \textsf{Nf}_i^a$ holds when:
  \begin{enumerate}
  \@idxitem $\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S}$,
  \@idxitem ${\downarrow}^a(b) \approx {\downarrow}^a(b) \in \textsf{Nf}$, and
  \@idxitem for all $\Delta, \phi$ with $\kweak[\Delta]{\phi}{\Gamma}$, there exists
    $w$ with $\textsf{R}^{\textsf{Nf}}_{|\Delta|}({\downarrow}^a(b)) \searrow w$ and
    $\tyequiv[\Delta]{t[\phi]}{w}{S[\phi]}$.
  \end{enumerate}
<!-- end definition-37 -->
<!-- definition-38: body_md -->
\label{def:ne-pred}
  $\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S} \;\circledR\; w \in \textsf{Ne}_i^a$ holds when:
  \begin{enumerate}
  \@idxitem $\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S}$,
  \@idxitem $w \approx w \in \textsf{Ne}$, and
  \@idxitem for all $\Delta, \phi$ with $\kweak[\Delta]{\phi}{\Gamma}$, there exists
    $u$ with $\textsf{R}^{\textsf{Ne}}_{|\Delta|}(w) \searrow u$ and
    $\tyequiv[\Delta]{t[\phi]}{u}{S[\phi]}$.
  \end{enumerate}
<!-- end definition-38 -->
<!-- definition-39: body_md -->
\label{def:glu-wrapped}
  The wrappers package gluing-side data with a uniform interface,
  parameterized by a domain value $a \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast$. The judgment form
  distinguishes type-level from term-level use.
  \begin{enumerate}
  \@idxitem \emph{(Term-bottom)} $\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S} \;\circledR\; w \in \textsf{Bot}_i^a$
    holds when there exist $P, \textbf{El}$ with $a \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P \searrow \textbf{El}$
    and:
    \begin{enumerate}
    \@idxitem $\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S}$,
    \@idxitem $\typing[\Gamma]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; P$, and
    \@idxitem $\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S} \;\circledR\; w \in \textsf{Ne}_i^a$.
    \end{enumerate}
  \@idxitem \emph{(Type-top)} $\typing[\Gamma]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; \textsf{Top}_i^a$
    holds when:
    \begin{enumerate}
    \@idxitem $\typing[\Gamma]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$,
    \@idxitem $a \approx a \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R$ for some $R$, and
    \@idxitem for all $\Delta, \phi$ with $\kweak[\Delta]{\phi}{\Gamma}$, there
      exists $W$ with $\textsf{R}^{\textsf{Ty}}_{|\Delta|}(a) \searrow W$ and
      $\tyequiv[\Delta]{S[\phi]}{W}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$.
    \end{enumerate}
  \@idxitem \emph{(Term-top)} $\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S} \;\circledR\; b \in \textsf{Top}_i^a$
    holds when there exist $P, \textbf{El}$ with $a \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P \searrow \textbf{El}$
    and:
    \begin{enumerate}
    \@idxitem $\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S}$,
    \@idxitem $\typing[\Gamma]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; P$, and
    \@idxitem $\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S} \;\circledR\; b \in \textsf{Nf}_i^a$.
    \end{enumerate}
  \end{enumerate}
<!-- end definition-39 -->
<!-- definition-40: body_md -->
\label{def:ctx-gluing}
  Given a well-formed context $\Gamma$, the judgment $\Gamma \searrow \textsf{Sb}$
  defines a predicate $\textsf{Sb}$ on substitution--environment pairs
  $\judge[\Delta]{\sigma : \Gamma} \;\circledR\; \rho \in \textsf{Sb}$,
  inductively on $\Gamma$:
  \begin{mathpar}
    \inferrule[\textsc{G-Ctx-$\cdot$}]
    {\textsf{Sb} \Leftrightarrow (\judge[\Delta]{\sigma : \cdot})}
    {\cdot \searrow \textsf{Sb}}

    \inferrule[\textsc{G-Ctx-Ext}]
    {\Gamma \searrow \textsf{Sb}_T \\
     \typing[\Gamma]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \\\\
     \forall \Delta', \sigma_T, \rho_T.\;
       \judge[\Delta']{\sigma_T : \Gamma} \;\circledR\; \rho_T \in \textsf{Sb}_T
       \implies \\
     \quad \exists a, P, \textbf{El}.\;
       \ensuremath{\llbracket S \rrbracket(\rho_T)} \searrow a \;\wedge\;
       a \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P \searrow \textbf{El} \;\wedge\;
       \typing[\Delta']{S[\sigma_T]}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; P \\\\
     \textsf{Sb} \Leftrightarrow \textsf{Cons}_i(\Gamma, S, \textsf{Sb}_T)}
    {(\Gamma, x : S) \searrow \textsf{Sb}}
  \end{mathpar}
  Here $\textsf{Cons}_i(\Gamma, S, \textsf{Sb}_T)$ holds at any
  $\judge[\Delta]{\sigma : \Gamma, x:S} \;\circledR\; \rho$ when there exist
  $i, a, P, \textbf{El}$ with:
  \begin{enumerate}
  \@idxitem \emph{Substitution typing:} $\judge[\Delta]{\sigma : \Gamma, x:S}$,
  \@idxitem \emph{Tail:} $\judge[\Delta]{\Uparrow \circ \sigma : \Gamma}
    \;\circledR\; \rho[\Uparrow] \in \textsf{Sb}_T$,
  \@idxitem \emph{Type:} $\ensuremath{\llbracket S \rrbracket(\rho[\Uparrow])} \searrow a$,
    $a \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P \searrow \textbf{El}$, and
    $\typing[\Delta]{S[\Uparrow \circ \sigma]}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; P$, and
  \@idxitem \emph{Head:} $\typing[\Delta]{x_0[\sigma]}{S[\Uparrow \circ \sigma]}
    \;\circledR\; \rho(x_0) \in \textbf{El}$.
  \end{enumerate}
  Here $\Uparrow \circ \sigma$ drops the head, mapping index~$n$ to
  $\sigma(n+1)$; the corresponding drop operation $\rho[\Uparrow]$ on
  environments is from \Cref{sec:sem}.
<!-- end definition-40 -->
<!-- definition-41: body_md -->
\label{def:sound-semctx}
  We write $\Vdash \Gamma$ to mean that the context-gluing predicate exists
  for $\Gamma$:
  \[
    \Vdash \Gamma \quad \iff \quad
      \exists \textsf{Sb}.\; \Gamma \searrow \textsf{Sb}.
  \]
  Syntactic well-formedness $\vdash \Gamma$ is derivable as a consequence of
  $\Vdash \Gamma$ (proved next).
<!-- end definition-41 -->
<!-- lemma-103: body_md -->
\label{lem:vdash-implies-wf}
  If $\Vdash \Gamma$, then $\vdash \Gamma$.
<!-- end lemma-103 -->
<!-- proof-104: body_md -->
By induction on the derivation of $\Gamma \searrow \textsf{Sb}$.

  \medskip\noindent
  \textbf{Case}
  \begin{mathpar}
    \inferrule[\textsc{G-Ctx-$\cdot$}]
    {\textsf{Sb} \Leftrightarrow (\judge[\Delta]{\sigma : \cdot})}
    {\cdot \searrow \textsf{Sb}}
  \end{mathpar}
  $\vdash \cdot$ holds by \textsc{Ctx-Emp}.

  \medskip\noindent
  \textbf{Case}
  \begin{mathpar}
    \inferrule[\textsc{G-Ctx-Ext}]
    {\Gamma_0 \searrow \textsf{Sb}_T \\
     \typing[\Gamma_0]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \\\\
     \forall \Delta', \sigma_T, \rho_T.\;
       \judge[\Delta']{\sigma_T : \Gamma_0} \;\circledR\; \rho_T \in \textsf{Sb}_T
       \implies \\
     \quad \exists a, P, \textbf{El}.\;
       \ensuremath{\llbracket S \rrbracket(\rho_T)} \searrow a \;\wedge\;
       a \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P \searrow \textbf{El} \;\wedge\;
       \typing[\Delta']{S[\sigma_T]}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; P \\\\
     \textsf{Sb} \Leftrightarrow \textsf{Cons}_i(\Gamma_0, S, \textsf{Sb}_T)}
    {(\Gamma_0, x : S) \searrow \textsf{Sb}}
  \end{mathpar}
  \begin{align*}
    &\vdash \Gamma_0
      && \text{(by IH on $\Gamma_0 \searrow \textsf{Sb}_T$)} \\
    &\typing[\Gamma_0]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}
      && \text{(by \textsc{G-Ctx-Ext} premise)} \\
    &\vdash \Gamma_0, x:S
      && \text{(by \textsc{Ctx-Ext})}
  \end{align*}
<!-- end proof-104 -->
<!-- theorem-3: body_md -->
\label{thm:monotonicity}
  Suppose $a \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P \searrow \textbf{El}$ and
  $\kweak[\Delta']{\psi}{\Delta}$.
  \begin{enumerate}
  \@idxitem If $\typing[\Delta]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; P$, then
    $\typing[\Delta']{S[\psi]}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; P$.
  \@idxitem If $\typing[\Delta]{t}{S} \;\circledR\; b \in \textbf{El}$, then
    $\typing[\Delta']{t[\psi]}{S[\psi]} \;\circledR\; b \in \textbf{El}$.
  \end{enumerate}
<!-- end theorem-3 -->
<!-- proof-105: body_md -->
By induction on the derivation $a \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P \searrow \textbf{El}$.

  \medskip\noindent
  \textbf{Case}
  \begin{mathpar}
    \inferrule[\textsc{G-Ne}]
    {{\uparrow}^A(e) \in \ensuremath{\mathrm{D}} \\
     P \Leftrightarrow \textsf{Neu}_i^e \\
     \textbf{El} \Leftrightarrow \textsf{Neu}_i^e}
    {{\uparrow}^A(e) \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P \searrow \textbf{El}}
  \end{mathpar}

  \emph{Type predicate (1).}
  Assume $\typing[\Delta]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; \textsf{Neu}_i^e$.
  By \Cref{def:neu-type-pred}:
  \begin{align*}
    &\typing[\Delta]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}
      && \text{(by \Cref{def:neu-type-pred} clause 1)} \\
    &\forall \Delta'', \kweak[\Delta'']{\phi'}{\Delta}.\;
      \exists u.\; \textsf{R}^{\textsf{Ne}}_{|\Delta''|}(e) \searrow u \wedge
      \tyequiv[\Delta'']{S[\phi']}{u}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}
      && \text{(by \Cref{def:neu-type-pred} clause 2)}
  \end{align*}
  We must show $\typing[\Delta']{S[\psi]}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; \textsf{Neu}_i^e$.
  \begin{align*}
    &\typing[\Delta']{S[\psi]}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:kweak-is-wk} on $\psi$ and \Cref{lem:wk-typing})}
  \end{align*}
  For the Kripke condition: take any $\Delta''$ with $\kweak[\Delta'']{\phi'}{\Delta'}$.
  \begin{align*}
    &\kweak[\Delta'']{\psi \circ \phi'}{\Delta}
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:kweak-comp} on $\psi$ and $\phi'$)} \\
    &\exists u.\; \textsf{R}^{\textsf{Ne}}_{|\Delta''|}(e) \searrow u \wedge
      \tyequiv[\Delta'']{S[\psi \circ \phi']}{u}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}
      && \text{(by hypothesis on $S$ at the composed weakening)} \\
    &S[\psi \circ \phi'] = S[\psi][\phi']
      && \text{(by \Cref{sec:syn}'s substitution-composition law)} \\
    &\tyequiv[\Delta'']{S[\psi][\phi']}{u}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}
      && \text{(rewriting)}
  \end{align*}
  This establishes the Kripke condition for $S[\psi]$ at $\textsf{Neu}_i^e$.

  \emph{Term predicate (2).}
  Assume $\typing[\Delta]{t}{S} \;\circledR\; {\uparrow}^A(w) \in \textsf{Neu}_i^e$.
  By \Cref{def:neu-term-pred}:
  \begin{align*}
    &\typing[\Delta]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; \textsf{Neu}_i^e,\;
      \typing[\Delta]{t}{S},\;
      w \approx w \in \textsf{Ne}
      && \text{(\Cref{def:neu-term-pred} clauses 1--3)} \\
    &\forall \Delta'', \kweak[\Delta'']{\phi'}{\Delta}.\;
      \exists u.\; \textsf{R}^{\textsf{Ne}}_{|\Delta''|}(w) \searrow u \wedge
      \tyequiv[\Delta'']{t[\phi']}{u}{S[\phi']}
      && \text{(\Cref{def:neu-term-pred} clause 4)}
  \end{align*}
  By type-predicate monotonicity (just proved):
  $\typing[\Delta']{S[\psi]}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; \textsf{Neu}_i^e$.
  $\typing[\Delta']{t[\psi]}{S[\psi]}$ by \Cref{sec:props}.
  $w \approx w \in \textsf{Ne}$ unchanged.
  Kripke condition: for $\kweak[\Delta'']{\phi'}{\Delta'}$, by
  \Cref{lem:kweak-comp} $\kweak[\Delta'']{\psi \circ \phi'}{\Delta}$,
  hypothesis gives $\textsf{R}^{\textsf{Ne}}_{|\Delta''|}(w) \searrow u$ and
  $\tyequiv[\Delta'']{t[\psi \circ \phi']}{u}{S[\psi \circ \phi']}$.
  By substitution composition: $t[\psi \circ \phi'] = t[\psi][\phi']$ and
  $S[\psi \circ \phi'] = S[\psi][\phi']$.

  \medskip\noindent
  \textbf{Case}
  \begin{mathpar}
    \inferrule[\textsc{G-Nat}]
    {P \Leftrightarrow \textsf{Nat}_i \\
     \textbf{El} \Leftrightarrow \textsf{Nat}_i}
    {N \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P \searrow \textbf{El}}
  \end{mathpar}

  \emph{Type predicate (1).}
  Assume $\typing[\Delta]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; \textsf{Nat}_i$, i.e.\
  $\tyequiv[\Delta]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$.
  \begin{align*}
    &\tyequiv[\Delta']{S[\psi]}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}[\psi]}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:wk-typing})} \\
    &\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}[\psi] = \ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}
      && \text{(syntactic, $\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}$ closed)} \\
    &\tyequiv[\Delta']{S[\psi]}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}
      && \text{(rewriting)} \\
    &\typing[\Delta']{S[\psi]}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; \textsf{Nat}_i
      && \text{(by \Cref{def:nat-type-pred})}
  \end{align*}

  \emph{Term predicate (2).}
  Assume $\typing[\Delta]{t}{S} \;\circledR\; b \in \textsf{Nat}_i$.
  By inner induction on the derivation $b \in \textsf{Nat}$.

  \medskip\noindent
  \textbf{Sub-case}
  \begin{mathpar}
    \inferrule[\textsc{GN-Ze}]
    {\tyequiv[\Delta]{t}{\textsf{zero}}{S}}
    {\typing[\Delta]{t}{S} \;\circledR\; \texttt{ze} \in \textsf{Nat}}
  \end{mathpar}
  \begin{align*}
    &\tyequiv[\Delta']{t[\psi]}{\textsf{zero}[\psi]}{S[\psi]}
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:wk-typing})} \\
    &\textsf{zero}[\psi] = \textsf{zero}
      && \text{(syntactic, $\textsf{zero}$ closed)} \\
    &\tyequiv[\Delta']{t[\psi]}{\textsf{zero}}{S[\psi]}
      && \text{(rewriting)} \\
    &\typing[\Delta']{t[\psi]}{S[\psi]} \;\circledR\; \texttt{ze} \in \textsf{Nat}
      && \text{(by \textsc{GN-Ze})}
  \end{align*}

  \medskip\noindent
  \textbf{Sub-case}
  \begin{mathpar}
    \inferrule[\textsc{GN-Su}]
    {\typing[\Delta]{t'}{S} \;\circledR\; b' \in \textsf{Nat} \\
     \tyequiv[\Delta]{t}{\textsf{succ}~t'}{S}}
    {\typing[\Delta]{t}{S} \;\circledR\; \texttt{su}(b') \in \textsf{Nat}}
  \end{mathpar}
  \begin{align*}
    &\typing[\Delta']{t'[\psi]}{S[\psi]} \;\circledR\; b' \in \textsf{Nat}
      && \text{(by inner IH on $b'$)} \\
    &\tyequiv[\Delta']{t[\psi]}{(\textsf{succ}~t')[\psi]}{S[\psi]}
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:wk-typing})} \\
    &(\textsf{succ}~t')[\psi] = \textsf{succ}~(t'[\psi])
      && \text{(syntactic substitution on $\textsf{succ}~$)} \\
    &\tyequiv[\Delta']{t[\psi]}{\textsf{succ}~(t'[\psi])}{S[\psi]}
      && \text{(rewriting)} \\
    &\typing[\Delta']{t[\psi]}{S[\psi]} \;\circledR\; \texttt{su}(b') \in \textsf{Nat}
      && \text{(by \textsc{GN-Su} on the IH)}
  \end{align*}

  \medskip\noindent
  \textbf{Sub-case}
  \begin{mathpar}
    \inferrule[\textsc{GN-Ne}]
    {\typing[\Delta]{t}{S} \;\circledR\; {\uparrow}^N(w) \in \textsf{Neu}_i^e}
    {\typing[\Delta]{t}{S} \;\circledR\; {\uparrow}^N(w) \in \textsf{Nat}}
  \end{mathpar}
  \begin{align*}
    &\typing[\Delta']{t[\psi]}{S[\psi]} \;\circledR\; {\uparrow}^N(w) \in \textsf{Neu}_i^e
      && \text{(by the \textsc{G-Ne} case above, applied to $\textsf{Neu}_i^e$)} \\
    &\typing[\Delta']{t[\psi]}{S[\psi]} \;\circledR\; {\uparrow}^N(w) \in \textsf{Nat}
      && \text{(by \textsc{GN-Ne})}
  \end{align*}

  \medskip\noindent
  \textbf{Case}
  \begin{mathpar}
    \inferrule[\textsc{G-Univ}]
    {j < i \\
     P \Leftrightarrow \textsf{Univ}_{i,j} \\
     \textbf{El} \Leftrightarrow \textsf{Univ}_{i,j}^{\textbf{El}}}
    {U_j \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P \searrow \textbf{El}}
  \end{mathpar}

  \emph{Type predicate (1).}
  Assume $\typing[\Delta]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; \textsf{Univ}_{i,j}$, i.e.\
  $\tyequiv[\Delta]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{j}}}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$.
  \begin{align*}
    &\tyequiv[\Delta']{S[\psi]}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{j}}[\psi]}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:wk-typing})} \\
    &\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{j}}[\psi] = \ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{j}}
      && \text{(syntactic; $\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{j}}$ closed)} \\
    &\tyequiv[\Delta']{S[\psi]}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{j}}}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}
      && \text{(rewriting)} \\
    &\typing[\Delta']{S[\psi]}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; \textsf{Univ}_{i,j}
      && \text{(by \Cref{def:univ-type-pred})}
  \end{align*}

  \emph{Term predicate (2).}
  Assume $\typing[\Delta]{t}{S} \;\circledR\; b \in \textsf{Univ}_{i,j}^{\textbf{El}}$.
  By \Cref{def:univ-term-pred}, $b \in \mathcal{U}_j^\ast \searrow P_b \searrow \textbf{El}_b$
  for some $P_b, \textbf{El}_b$, with
  $\typing[\Delta]{t}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{j}}} \;\circledR\; P_b$ at level $j$ and
  $\tyequiv[\Delta]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{j}}}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$.
  \begin{align*}
    &\typing[\Delta']{t[\psi]}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{j}}[\psi]} \;\circledR\; P_b
      && \text{(by IH at level $j$ on $b \in \mathcal{U}_j^\ast$, type predicate)} \\
    &\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{j}}[\psi] = \ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{j}}
      && \text{(syntactic; $\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{j}}$ closed)} \\
    &\typing[\Delta']{t[\psi]}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{j}}} \;\circledR\; P_b
      && \text{(rewriting)} \\
    &\tyequiv[\Delta']{S[\psi]}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{j}}}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}
      && \text{(by type-predicate monotonicity (1) above)} \\
    &\typing[\Delta']{t[\psi]}{S[\psi]} \;\circledR\; b \in \textsf{Univ}_{i,j}^{\textbf{El}}
      && \text{(by \Cref{def:univ-term-pred} with the previous lines)}
  \end{align*}

  \medskip\noindent
  \textbf{Case}
  \begin{mathpar}
    \inferrule[\textsc{G-Pi}]
    {a \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P_I \searrow \textbf{El}_I \\
     a \approx a \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R_I \\\\
     \forall\, \ensuremath{\mathcal{D}} :: b \approx b \in R_I,\; c.\;
       \ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket(\rho, b/x)} \searrow c \implies
       c \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}) \searrow \textbf{El}_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}) \\\\
     \Pi(a, T, \rho) \approx \Pi(a, T, \rho) \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R \\\\
     P \Leftrightarrow \Pi_i(R_I, P_I, \textbf{El}_I, P_O) \\
     \textbf{El} \Leftrightarrow \Pi_i^{\textbf{El}}(R, R_I, P_I, \textbf{El}_I, \textbf{El}_O)}
    {\Pi(a, T, \rho) \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P \searrow \textbf{El}}
  \end{mathpar}

  \emph{Type predicate (1).}
  Assume $\typing[\Delta]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; \Pi_i(R_I, P_I, \textbf{El}_I, P_O)$.
  By \Cref{def:pi-type-pred}, this gives $S_1, S_2$ with
  $\tyequiv[\Delta]{S}{\Pi(x:S_1).\,S_2}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$ and the three clauses
  (well-formedness of $S$, domain-predicate, codomain-predicate). We must show
  $\typing[\Delta']{S[\psi]}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; \Pi_i(R_I, P_I, \textbf{El}_I, P_O)$.

  \emph{Clause 1: $\Pi$-shape equality.}
  \begin{align*}
    &\tyequiv[\Delta]{S}{\Pi(x:S_1).\,S_2}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}
      && \text{(by \Cref{def:pi-type-pred} clause 1)} \\
    &\tyequiv[\Delta']{S[\psi]}{(\Pi(x:S_1).\,S_2)[\psi]}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:wk-typing})} \\
    &(\Pi(x:S_1).\,S_2)[\psi] = \Pi(x:S_1[\psi]).\,(S_2[q(\psi)])
      && \text{(by syntactic substitution on $\Pi$)} \\
    &\tyequiv[\Delta']{S[\psi]}{\Pi(x:S_1[\psi]).\,(S_2[q(\psi)])}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}
      && \text{(rewriting)}
  \end{align*}

  \emph{Clause 2: domain-predicate at every Kripke extension of $\Delta'$.}
  Let $\kweak[\Delta'']{\phi'}{\Delta'}$ be arbitrary.
  \begin{align*}
    &\kweak[\Delta'']{\psi \circ \phi'}{\Delta}
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:kweak-comp})} \\
    &\typing[\Delta'']{S_1[\psi \circ \phi']}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; P_I
      && \text{(by hypothesis clause 2 at $\psi \circ \phi'$)} \\
    &S_1[\psi \circ \phi'] = (S_1[\psi])[\phi']
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:subst-assoc})} \\
    &\typing[\Delta'']{(S_1[\psi])[\phi']}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; P_I
      && \text{(rewriting)}
  \end{align*}

  \emph{Clause 3: codomain-predicate at every Kripke extension of $\Delta'$
  and every El-related $b$.}
  Let $\kweak[\Delta'']{\phi'}{\Delta'}$, $s, b, \ensuremath{\mathcal{D}} :: b \approx b \in R_I$ with
  $\typing[\Delta'']{s}{(S_1[\psi])[\phi']} \;\circledR\; b \in \textbf{El}_I$.
  \begin{align*}
    &\kweak[\Delta'']{\psi \circ \phi'}{\Delta}
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:kweak-comp})} \\
    &\typing[\Delta'']{s}{S_1[\psi \circ \phi']} \;\circledR\; b \in \textbf{El}_I
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:subst-assoc} on the type)} \\
    &\typing[\Delta'']{S_2[\iota(\psi \circ \phi'), s/x]}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}
      \;\circledR\; P_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}})
      && \text{(by hypothesis clause 3 at $\psi \circ \phi', s, b, \ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}$)}
  \end{align*}
  This is the required predicate at the Kripke weakening $\psi \circ \phi'$
  for $\Pi_i$ at $S[\psi]$ over $\Delta'$.

  \emph{Term predicate (2).}
  Assume $\typing[\Delta]{t}{S} \;\circledR\; f \in
  \Pi_i^{\textbf{El}}(R, R_I, P_I, \textbf{El}_I, \textbf{El}_O)$. We verify the four clauses of
  \Cref{def:pi-term-pred} at $\typing[\Delta']{t[\psi]}{S[\psi]}$ and value $f$.

  \emph{Clause 1: self-relatedness $f \approx f \in R$.} Unchanged by Kripke
  weakening (PER fact, independent of $\Delta$).

  \emph{Clause 2: $R_I$-coherence of $f$.} Unchanged for the same reason.

  \emph{Clause 3: type-readback of $f$ at $\Pi$-shape.} By type-predicate
  monotonicity (1) above, the $\Pi_i$-type predicate transfers to $S[\psi]$ over
  $\Delta'$, supplying the type-readback witnesses required by clause 3.

  \emph{Clause 4: application.}
  Let $\kweak[\Delta'']{\phi'}{\Delta'}$, $s, b, \ensuremath{\mathcal{D}} :: b \approx b \in R_I$ with
  $\typing[\Delta'']{s}{(S_1[\psi])[\phi']} \;\circledR\; b \in \textbf{El}_I$.
  \begin{align*}
    &\kweak[\Delta'']{\psi \circ \phi'}{\Delta}
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:kweak-comp})} \\
    &\typing[\Delta'']{s}{S_1[\psi \circ \phi']} \;\circledR\; b \in \textbf{El}_I
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:subst-assoc})} \\
    &f \cdot b \searrow c
      && \text{(by hypothesis clause 4 at $\psi \circ \phi', s, b, \ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}$)} \\
    &\typing[\Delta'']{(t[\psi \circ \phi'])\;s}{S_2[\iota(\psi \circ \phi'), s/x]}
      \;\circledR\; c \in \textbf{El}_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}})
      && \text{(by hypothesis clause 4)} \\
    &t[\psi \circ \phi'] = t[\psi][\phi']
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:subst-assoc})} \\
    &\typing[\Delta'']{t[\psi][\phi']\;s}{S_2[\iota(\psi \circ \phi'), s/x]}
      \;\circledR\; c \in \textbf{El}_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}})
      && \text{(rewriting)}
  \end{align*}
  This is the required form for $\Pi_i^{\textbf{El}}$ clause 4 at $t[\psi]$ over
  $\Delta'$ at the Kripke weakening $\psi \circ \phi'$.

  \emph{Clause 5: $R_I$-coherence under application.} Inherited from the
  original predicate's clause 5 by composition with $\psi$ as in clause 4.
<!-- end proof-105 -->
<!-- corollary-3: body_md -->
\label{cor:ctx-mono}
  If $\Gamma \searrow \textsf{Sb}$,
  $\judge[\Delta]{\sigma : \Gamma} \;\circledR\; \rho \in \textsf{Sb}$, and
  $\kweak[\Delta']{\psi}{\Delta}$, then
  $\judge[\Delta']{\sigma[\psi] : \Gamma} \;\circledR\; \rho \in \textsf{Sb}$.
<!-- end corollary-3 -->
<!-- proof-106: body_md -->
By induction on the context-gluing derivation $\Gamma \searrow \textsf{Sb}$.

  \medskip\noindent
  \textbf{Case}
  \begin{mathpar}
    \inferrule[\textsc{G-Ctx-$\cdot$}]
    {\textsf{Sb} \Leftrightarrow (\judge[\Delta]{\sigma : \cdot})}
    {\cdot \searrow \textsf{Sb}}
  \end{mathpar}
  \begin{align*}
    &\judge[\Delta]{\sigma : \cdot}
      && \text{(by hypothesis on $\sigma$)} \\
    &\judge[\Delta']{\sigma[\psi] : \cdot}
      && \text{(by substitution composition, \Cref{sec:syn})} \\
    &\judge[\Delta']{\sigma[\psi] : \cdot} \;\circledR\; \rho \in \textsf{Sb}
      && \text{(by $\textsf{Sb}$'s definition for $\cdot$)}
  \end{align*}

  \medskip\noindent
  \textbf{Case}
  \begin{mathpar}
    \inferrule[\textsc{G-Ctx-Ext}]
    {\Gamma_0 \searrow \textsf{Sb}_T \\
     \typing[\Gamma_0]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \\\\
     \forall \Delta'', \sigma_T, \rho_T.\;
       \judge[\Delta'']{\sigma_T : \Gamma_0} \;\circledR\; \rho_T \in \textsf{Sb}_T
       \implies \\
     \quad \exists a, P, \textbf{El}.\;
       \ensuremath{\llbracket S \rrbracket(\rho_T)} \searrow a \;\wedge\;
       a \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P \searrow \textbf{El} \;\wedge\;
       \typing[\Delta'']{S[\sigma_T]}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; P \\\\
     \textsf{Sb} \Leftrightarrow \textsf{Cons}_i(\Gamma_0, S, \textsf{Sb}_T)}
    {(\Gamma_0, x : S) \searrow \textsf{Sb}}
  \end{mathpar}
  Unfolding $\textsf{Cons}_i$ at $\sigma, \rho$ provides existential
  $a, P, \textbf{El}$ specific to this pair:
  \begin{align*}
    &\judge[\Delta]{\Uparrow \circ \sigma : \Gamma_0} \;\circledR\;
      \rho[\Uparrow] \in \textsf{Sb}_T
      && \text{(tail of $\textsf{Cons}_i$)} \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket S \rrbracket(\rho[\Uparrow])} \searrow a,\;
      a \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P \searrow \textbf{El}
      && \text{(type clause of $\textsf{Cons}_i$)} \\
    &\typing[\Delta]{S[\Uparrow \circ \sigma]}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; P
      && \text{(type clause of $\textsf{Cons}_i$)} \\
    &\typing[\Delta]{x_0[\sigma]}{S[\Uparrow \circ \sigma]} \;\circledR\;
      \rho(x_0) \in \textbf{El}
      && \text{(head of $\textsf{Cons}_i$)} \\
    &\judge[\Delta']{(\Uparrow \circ \sigma)[\psi] : \Gamma_0}
      \;\circledR\; \rho[\Uparrow] \in \textsf{Sb}_T
      && \text{(by IH on the smaller derivation
        $\Gamma_0 \searrow \textsf{Sb}_T$)} \\
    &(\Uparrow \circ \sigma)[\psi] = \Uparrow \circ (\sigma[\psi])
      && \text{(by associativity of $\circ$, \Cref{lem:subst-cat})} \\
    &\typing[\Delta']{S[\Uparrow \circ \sigma][\psi]}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; P
      && \text{(by \Cref{thm:monotonicity} on the type predicate)} \\
    &S[\Uparrow \circ \sigma][\psi] = S[\Uparrow \circ \sigma[\psi]]
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:subst-assoc} and the previous identity)} \\
    &\typing[\Delta']{x_0[\sigma][\psi]}{S[\Uparrow \circ \sigma][\psi]}
      \;\circledR\; \rho(x_0) \in \textbf{El}
      && \text{(by \Cref{thm:monotonicity} on the head)} \\
    &x_0[\sigma][\psi] = x_0[\sigma[\psi]]
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:subst-assoc})} \\
    &\typing[\Delta']{x_0[\sigma[\psi]]}{S[\Uparrow \circ \sigma[\psi]]}
      \;\circledR\; \rho(x_0) \in \textbf{El}
      && \text{(rewriting via the previous identities)} \\
    &\judge[\Delta']{\sigma[\psi] : \Gamma_0, x:S}
      \;\circledR\; \rho \in \textsf{Sb}
      && \text{(by $\textsf{Cons}_i$ assembly with the same $a, P, \textbf{El}$)}
  \end{align*}
<!-- end proof-106 -->
<!-- lemma-104: body_md -->
\label{lem:gluing-implies-per}
  If $a \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P \searrow \textbf{El}$, then there exists $R$ such that
  $a \approx a \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R$.
<!-- end lemma-104 -->
<!-- proof-107: body_md -->
By induction on the derivation $a \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast$.

  \medskip\noindent
  \textbf{Case}
  \begin{mathpar}
    \inferrule[\textsc{G-Ne}]
    {{\uparrow}^A(e) \in \ensuremath{\mathrm{D}}}
    {{\uparrow}^A(e) \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast}
  \end{mathpar}
  By \textsc{U-Ne} of \Cref{def:per-univ}: ${\uparrow}^A(e) \approx
  {\uparrow}^A(e) \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R$ with $R \Leftrightarrow \textsf{Neu}$,
  using $e \approx e \in \textsf{Ne}$ from $\mathcal{U}_i^\ast$'s implicit assumption.

  \medskip\noindent
  \textbf{Case}
  \begin{mathpar}
    \inferrule[\textsc{G-Nat}]
    { }
    {N \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast}
  \end{mathpar}
  By \textsc{U-Nat}: $N \approx N \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R$ with $R \Leftrightarrow
  \textsf{Nat}$.

  \medskip\noindent
  \textbf{Case}
  \begin{mathpar}
    \inferrule[\textsc{G-Univ}]
    {j < i}
    {U_j \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast}
  \end{mathpar}
  By \textsc{U-Univ}: $U_j \approx U_j \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R$ with $R \Leftrightarrow
  \mathcal{U}_j$.

  \medskip\noindent
  \textbf{Case}
  \begin{mathpar}
    \inferrule[\textsc{G-Pi}]
    {a \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P_I \searrow \textbf{El}_I \\
     a \approx a \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R_I \\\\
     \forall\, \ensuremath{\mathcal{D}} :: b \approx b \in R_I,\; c.\;
       \ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket(\rho, b/x)} \searrow c \implies
       c \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}) \searrow \textbf{El}_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}) \\\\
     \Pi(a, T, \rho) \approx \Pi(a, T, \rho) \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R \\\\
     P \Leftrightarrow \Pi_i(R_I, P_I, \textbf{El}_I, P_O) \\
     \textbf{El} \Leftrightarrow \Pi_i^{\textbf{El}}(R, R_I, P_I, \textbf{El}_I, \textbf{El}_O)}
    {\Pi(a, T, \rho) \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P \searrow \textbf{El}}
  \end{mathpar}
  The PER witness $R$ for $\Pi(a, T, \rho) \approx \Pi(a, T, \rho) \in \mathcal{U}_i$
  is packaged directly as a premise of \textsc{G-Pi}, hence is available
  immediately.
<!-- end proof-107 -->
<!-- lemma-105: body_md -->
\label{lem:gluing-typ-escape}
  If $a \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P \searrow \textbf{El}$ and
  $\typing[\Gamma]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; P$, then $\typing[\Gamma]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$.
<!-- end lemma-105 -->
<!-- proof-108: body_md -->
By case analysis on $a \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P \searrow \textbf{El}$.

  \medskip\noindent
  \textbf{Case}
  \begin{mathpar}
    \inferrule[\textsc{G-Ne}]
    {{\uparrow}^A(e) \in \ensuremath{\mathrm{D}} \\
     P \Leftrightarrow \textsf{Neu}_i^e \\
     \textbf{El} \Leftrightarrow \textsf{Neu}_i^e}
    {{\uparrow}^A(e) \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P \searrow \textbf{El}}
  \end{mathpar}
  \begin{align*}
    &\typing[\Gamma]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; \textsf{Neu}_i^e
      && \text{(by hypothesis with $P \Leftrightarrow \textsf{Neu}_i^e$)} \\
    &\typing[\Gamma]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}
      && \text{(by \Cref{def:neu-type-pred} clause 1)}
  \end{align*}

  \medskip\noindent
  \textbf{Case}
  \begin{mathpar}
    \inferrule[\textsc{G-Nat}]
    {P \Leftrightarrow \textsf{Nat}_i \\
     \textbf{El} \Leftrightarrow \textsf{Nat}_i}
    {N \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P \searrow \textbf{El}}
  \end{mathpar}
  \begin{align*}
    &\typing[\Gamma]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; \textsf{Nat}_i
      && \text{(by hypothesis)} \\
    &\tyequiv[\Gamma]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}
      && \text{(by \Cref{def:nat-type-pred})} \\
    &\typing[\Gamma]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}
      && \text{(by presupposition of judgmental equality)}
  \end{align*}

  \medskip\noindent
  \textbf{Case}
  \begin{mathpar}
    \inferrule[\textsc{G-Univ}]
    {j < i \\
     P \Leftrightarrow \textsf{Univ}_{i,j} \\
     \textbf{El} \Leftrightarrow \textsf{Univ}_{i,j}^{\textbf{El}}}
    {U_j \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P \searrow \textbf{El}}
  \end{mathpar}
  \begin{align*}
    &\typing[\Gamma]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; \textsf{Univ}_{i,j}
      && \text{(by hypothesis)} \\
    &\tyequiv[\Gamma]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{j}}}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}
      && \text{(by \Cref{def:univ-type-pred})} \\
    &\typing[\Gamma]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}
      && \text{(by presupposition of judgmental equality)}
  \end{align*}

  \medskip\noindent
  \textbf{Case}
  \begin{mathpar}
    \inferrule[\textsc{G-Pi}]
    {P \Leftrightarrow \Pi_i(R_I, P_I, \textbf{El}_I, P_O) \\
     \textbf{El} \Leftrightarrow \Pi_i^{\textbf{El}}(R, R_I, P_I, \textbf{El}_I, \textbf{El}_O)}
    {\Pi(a_I, T, \rho) \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P \searrow \textbf{El}}
  \end{mathpar}
  \begin{align*}
    &\typing[\Gamma]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; \Pi_i(R_I, P_I, \textbf{El}_I, P_O)
      && \text{(by hypothesis)} \\
    &\exists S_1, S_2.\;
      \tyequiv[\Gamma]{S}{\Pi(x:S_1).\,S_2}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}
      && \text{(by \Cref{def:pi-type-pred} clause 1)} \\
    &\typing[\Gamma]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}
      && \text{(by presupposition of judgmental equality)}
  \end{align*}
<!-- end proof-108 -->
<!-- lemma-106: body_md -->
\label{lem:gluing-trm-escape}
  If $a \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P \searrow \textbf{El}$ and
  $\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S} \;\circledR\; b \in \textbf{El}$, then $\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S}$
  and $\typing[\Gamma]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; P$.
<!-- end lemma-106 -->
<!-- proof-109: body_md -->
By case analysis on $a \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P \searrow \textbf{El}$.

  \medskip\noindent
  \textbf{Case}
  \begin{mathpar}
    \inferrule[\textsc{G-Ne}]
    {{\uparrow}^A(e) \in \ensuremath{\mathrm{D}} \\
     P \Leftrightarrow \textsf{Neu}_i^e \\
     \textbf{El} \Leftrightarrow \textsf{Neu}_i^e}
    {{\uparrow}^A(e) \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P \searrow \textbf{El}}
  \end{mathpar}
  \begin{align*}
    &\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S} \;\circledR\; b \in \textsf{Neu}_i^e
      && \text{(by hypothesis)} \\
    &\typing[\Gamma]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; \textsf{Neu}_i^e
      && \text{(by \Cref{def:neu-term-pred} clause 1)} \\
    &\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S}
      && \text{(by \Cref{def:neu-term-pred} clause 2)}
  \end{align*}

  \medskip\noindent
  \textbf{Case}
  \begin{mathpar}
    \inferrule[\textsc{G-Nat}]
    {P \Leftrightarrow \textsf{Nat}_i \\
     \textbf{El} \Leftrightarrow \textsf{Nat}_i}
    {N \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P \searrow \textbf{El}}
  \end{mathpar}
  \begin{align*}
    &\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S} \;\circledR\; b \in \textsf{Nat}_i
      && \text{(by hypothesis)} \\
    &\typing[\Gamma]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; \textsf{Nat}_i
      && \text{(by \Cref{def:nat-term-pred})}
  \end{align*}
  By inner induction on the $\textsf{Nat}$-derivation at $b$:
  \begin{itemize}
  \@idxitem[Sub-case]
    \begin{mathpar}
      \inferrule[\textsc{GN-Ze}]
      {\tyequiv[\Gamma]{t}{\textsf{zero}}{S}}
      {\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S} \;\circledR\; \texttt{ze} \in \textsf{Nat}}
    \end{mathpar}
    $\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S}$ by presupposition of $\tyequiv[\Gamma]{t}{\textsf{zero}}{S}$.
  \@idxitem[Sub-case]
    \begin{mathpar}
      \inferrule[\textsc{GN-Su}]
      {\typing[\Gamma]{t'}{S} \;\circledR\; b' \in \textsf{Nat} \\
       \tyequiv[\Gamma]{t}{\textsf{succ}~t'}{S}}
      {\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S} \;\circledR\; \texttt{su}(b') \in \textsf{Nat}}
    \end{mathpar}
    $\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S}$ by presupposition of $\tyequiv[\Gamma]{t}{\textsf{succ}~t'}{S}$.
  \@idxitem[Sub-case]
    \begin{mathpar}
      \inferrule[\textsc{GN-Ne}]
      {\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S} \;\circledR\; {\uparrow}^N(w) \in \textsf{Neu}_i^e}
      {\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S} \;\circledR\; {\uparrow}^N(w) \in \textsf{Nat}}
    \end{mathpar}
    $\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S}$ by \textsc{G-Ne} case (just proved) on the neutral
    premise.
  \end{itemize}

  \medskip\noindent
  \textbf{Case}
  \begin{mathpar}
    \inferrule[\textsc{G-Univ}]
    {j < i \\
     P \Leftrightarrow \textsf{Univ}_{i,j} \\
     \textbf{El} \Leftrightarrow \textsf{Univ}_{i,j}^{\textbf{El}}}
    {U_j \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P \searrow \textbf{El}}
  \end{mathpar}
  \begin{align*}
    &\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S} \;\circledR\; b \in \textsf{Univ}_{i,j}^{\textbf{El}}
      && \text{(by hypothesis)} \\
    &\typing[\Gamma]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; \textsf{Univ}_{i,j}
      && \text{(by \Cref{def:univ-term-pred} clause 1)} \\
    &\typing[\Gamma]{t}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{j}}} \;\circledR\; P_b
      && \text{(by \Cref{def:univ-term-pred} clause 2)} \\
    &\typing[\Gamma]{t}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{j}}}
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:gluing-typ-escape} on the previous line at level $j$)} \\
    &\tyequiv[\Gamma]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{j}}}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}
      && \text{(by \Cref{def:univ-type-pred})} \\
    &\subty[\Gamma]{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{j}}}{S}
      && \text{(by \textsc{Sub-Eq} from the symmetric equality)} \\
    &\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S}
      && \text{(by \textsc{Subsump})}
  \end{align*}

  \medskip\noindent
  \textbf{Case}
  \begin{mathpar}
    \inferrule[\textsc{G-Pi}]
    {P \Leftrightarrow \Pi_i(R_I, P_I, \textbf{El}_I, P_O) \\
     \textbf{El} \Leftrightarrow \Pi_i^{\textbf{El}}(R, R_I, P_I, \textbf{El}_I, \textbf{El}_O)}
    {\Pi(a_I, T, \rho) \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P \searrow \textbf{El}}
  \end{mathpar}
  \begin{align*}
    &\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S} \;\circledR\; b \in \Pi_i^{\textbf{El}}
      && \text{(by hypothesis)} \\
    &\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S}
      && \text{(by \Cref{def:pi-term-pred} clause 2)} \\
    &\typing[\Gamma]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; \Pi_i
      && \text{(by \Cref{def:pi-term-pred} clause 3)}
  \end{align*}
<!-- end proof-109 -->
<!-- lemma-107: body_md -->
\label{lem:gluing-functional}
  If $a \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P_1 \searrow \textbf{El}_1$ and
  $a \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P_2 \searrow \textbf{El}_2$, then
  $P_1 \Leftrightarrow P_2$ and $\textbf{El}_1 \Leftrightarrow \textbf{El}_2$.
<!-- end lemma-107 -->
<!-- proof-110: body_md -->
By induction on the first derivation $a \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast$, with case analysis
  on the second (which must end with the same rule, since each rule's
  conclusion form determines $a$ syntactically).

  \medskip\noindent
  \textbf{Case}
  \begin{mathpar}
    \inferrule[\textsc{G-Ne}]
    {{\uparrow}^A(e) \in \ensuremath{\mathrm{D}} \\
     P \Leftrightarrow \textsf{Neu}_i^e \\
     \textbf{El} \Leftrightarrow \textsf{Neu}_i^e}
    {{\uparrow}^A(e) \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P \searrow \textbf{El}}
  \end{mathpar}
  \begin{align*}
    &P_1 \Leftrightarrow \textsf{Neu}_i^e
      && \text{(by \textsc{G-Ne} on the first derivation)} \\
    &P_2 \Leftrightarrow \textsf{Neu}_i^e
      && \text{(by \textsc{G-Ne} on the second derivation)} \\
    &P_1 \Leftrightarrow P_2
      && \text{(transitivity)} \\
    &\textbf{El}_1 \Leftrightarrow \textsf{Neu}_i^e \Leftrightarrow \textbf{El}_2
      && \text{(symmetrically)}
  \end{align*}

  \medskip\noindent
  \textbf{Case}
  \begin{mathpar}
    \inferrule[\textsc{G-Nat}]
    {P \Leftrightarrow \textsf{Nat}_i \\
     \textbf{El} \Leftrightarrow \textsf{Nat}_i}
    {N \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P \searrow \textbf{El}}
  \end{mathpar}
  \begin{align*}
    &P_1 \Leftrightarrow \textsf{Nat}_i \Leftrightarrow P_2,\;
      \textbf{El}_1 \Leftrightarrow \textsf{Nat}_i \Leftrightarrow \textbf{El}_2
      && \text{(by \textsc{G-Nat} on both derivations)}
  \end{align*}

  \medskip\noindent
  \textbf{Case}
  \begin{mathpar}
    \inferrule[\textsc{G-Univ}]
    {j < i \\
     P \Leftrightarrow \textsf{Univ}_{i,j} \\
     \textbf{El} \Leftrightarrow \textsf{Univ}_{i,j}^{\textbf{El}}}
    {U_j \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P \searrow \textbf{El}}
  \end{mathpar}
  Both derivations fix the same $j < i$, so $P_1 \Leftrightarrow
  \textsf{Univ}_{i,j} \Leftrightarrow P_2$ and $\textbf{El}_1 \Leftrightarrow
  \textsf{Univ}_{i,j}^{\textbf{El}} \Leftrightarrow \textbf{El}_2$.

  \medskip\noindent
  \textbf{Case}
  \begin{mathpar}
    \inferrule[\textsc{G-Pi}]
    {a \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P_I \searrow \textbf{El}_I \\
     a \approx a \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R_I \\\\
     \forall\, \ensuremath{\mathcal{D}} :: b \approx b \in R_I,\; c.\;
       \ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket(\rho, b/x)} \searrow c \implies
       c \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}) \searrow \textbf{El}_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}) \\\\
     \Pi(a, T, \rho) \approx \Pi(a, T, \rho) \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R \\\\
     P \Leftrightarrow \Pi_i(R_I, P_I, \textbf{El}_I, P_O) \\
     \textbf{El} \Leftrightarrow \Pi_i^{\textbf{El}}(R, R_I, P_I, \textbf{El}_I, \textbf{El}_O)}
    {\Pi(a, T, \rho) \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P \searrow \textbf{El}}
  \end{mathpar}
  Let the two derivations have inner data $(P_I^{(1)}, \textbf{El}_I^{(1)}, R_I^{(1)},
  P_O^{(1)}, \textbf{El}_O^{(1)}, R^{(1)})$ and $(P_I^{(2)}, \ldots)$ respectively.
  \begin{align*}
    &P_I^{(1)} \Leftrightarrow P_I^{(2)},\;
      \textbf{El}_I^{(1)} \Leftrightarrow \textbf{El}_I^{(2)}
      && \text{(by IH on the inner $a \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast$)} \\
    &R_I^{(1)} \Leftrightarrow R_I^{(2)},\;
      R^{(1)} \Leftrightarrow R^{(2)}
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:univ-functional} on the inner $\mathcal{U}_i$ judgments)} \\
    &\forall \ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}.\; P_O^{(1)}(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}) \Leftrightarrow P_O^{(2)}(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}),\;
      \textbf{El}_O^{(1)}(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}) \Leftrightarrow \textbf{El}_O^{(2)}(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}})
      && \text{(by IH on the codomain fibers, pointwise in $\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}$)} \\
    &P_1 \Leftrightarrow \Pi_i(R_I^{(1)}, P_I^{(1)}, \textbf{El}_I^{(1)}, P_O^{(1)})
      \Leftrightarrow \Pi_i(R_I^{(2)}, P_I^{(2)}, \textbf{El}_I^{(2)}, P_O^{(2)}) \\
    & \quad \Leftrightarrow P_2
      && \text{(by congruence of $\Pi_i$)} \\
    &\textbf{El}_1 \Leftrightarrow \Pi_i^{\textbf{El}}(\ldots) \Leftrightarrow \textbf{El}_2
      && \text{(symmetrically)}
  \end{align*}
<!-- end proof-110 -->
<!-- lemma-108: body_md -->
\label{lem:gluing-cumul}
  Suppose $i \le j$, $a \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P \searrow \textbf{El}$, and
  $a \in \mathcal{U}_j^\ast \searrow P' \searrow \textbf{El}'$. Then:
  \begin{enumerate}
  \@idxitem \emph{Type-predicate raising:} If $\typing[\Gamma]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}
    \;\circledR\; P$, then $\typing[\Gamma]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{j}}} \;\circledR\; P'$.
  \@idxitem \emph{Term-predicate raising:} If $\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S} \;\circledR\;
    b \in \textbf{El}$, then $\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S} \;\circledR\; b \in \textbf{El}'$.
  \@idxitem \emph{Term-predicate lowering (under type-predicate at level $i$):}
    If $\typing[\Gamma]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; P$ and
    $\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S} \;\circledR\; b \in \textbf{El}'$, then
    $\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S} \;\circledR\; b \in \textbf{El}$.
  \end{enumerate}
  Existence of $P', \textbf{El}'$ at level $j$ follows from re-applying the gluing
  rules at level $j$ to the same data.
<!-- end lemma-108 -->
<!-- proof-111: body_md -->
Since the gluing rules at level $i$ and level $j$ agree on the syntactic
  shape of $a$, the second derivation $a \in \mathcal{U}_j^\ast \searrow P' \searrow \textbf{El}'$
  must end with the same rule (\textsc{G-Ne}, \textsc{G-Nat}, \textsc{G-Univ},
  or \textsc{G-Pi}) as the first. We proceed by induction on
  $a \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P \searrow \textbf{El}$, with sub-case-analysis on the
  rule shared by the two derivations.

  \medskip\noindent
  \textbf{Case}
  \begin{mathpar}
    \inferrule[\textsc{G-Ne}]
    {{\uparrow}^A(e) \in \ensuremath{\mathrm{D}} \\
     P \Leftrightarrow \textsf{Neu}_i^e \\
     \textbf{El} \Leftrightarrow \textsf{Neu}_i^e}
    {{\uparrow}^A(e) \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P \searrow \textbf{El}}
  \end{mathpar}
  Then $P' \Leftrightarrow \textsf{Neu}_j^e$ and $\textbf{El}' \Leftrightarrow \textsf{Neu}_j^e$.
  But $\textsf{Neu}_*^e$ does not depend on the index
  (\Cref{def:neu-type-pred,def:neu-term-pred}), so $P \Leftrightarrow P'$ and
  $\textbf{El} \Leftrightarrow \textbf{El}'$. All three claims (1)--(3) hold trivially.

  \medskip\noindent
  \textbf{Case}
  \begin{mathpar}
    \inferrule[\textsc{G-Nat}]
    {P \Leftrightarrow \textsf{Nat}_i \\
     \textbf{El} \Leftrightarrow \textsf{Nat}_i}
    {N \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P \searrow \textbf{El}}
  \end{mathpar}
  Then $P' \Leftrightarrow \textsf{Nat}_j$ and $\textbf{El}' \Leftrightarrow \textsf{Nat}_j$.

  \emph{Type-predicate raising (1):} given $\typing[\Gamma]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}
  \;\circledR\; \textsf{Nat}_i$:
  \begin{align*}
    &\tyequiv[\Gamma]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}
      && \text{(by \Cref{def:nat-type-pred})} \\
    &\tyequiv[\Gamma]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{j}}}
      && \text{(by cumulativity of universes, $i \le j$, \Cref{sec:rules})} \\
    &\typing[\Gamma]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{j}}} \;\circledR\; \textsf{Nat}_j
      && \text{(by \Cref{def:nat-type-pred} at level $j$)}
  \end{align*}

  \emph{Term-predicate raising (2):} given $\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S} \;\circledR\;
  b \in \textsf{Nat}_i$, by inner induction on the $\textsf{Nat}$-derivation at
  $b$. Each sub-case (\textsc{GN-Ze, GN-Su, GN-Ne}) constructs the same
  derivation at level $j$, since the constructors $\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}, \textsf{zero}, \textsf{succ}~$ and the
  neutral predicate $\textsf{Neu}_*^e$ are level-independent. The
  type-predicate part upgrades via (1).

  \emph{Term-predicate lowering (3):} given $\typing[\Gamma]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}
  \;\circledR\; \textsf{Nat}_i$ and $\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S} \;\circledR\; b
  \in \textsf{Nat}_j$. By inner induction on the $\textsf{Nat}$-derivation at
  $b$ (level-$j$); each sub-case re-uses the level-independent constructors and
  re-derives the $\textsf{Nat}$-predicate at level $i$, with the type-predicate
  part already provided by hypothesis.

  \medskip\noindent
  \textbf{Case}
  \begin{mathpar}
    \inferrule[\textsc{G-Univ}]
    {k < i \\
     P \Leftrightarrow \textsf{Univ}_{i,k} \\
     \textbf{El} \Leftrightarrow \textsf{Univ}_{i,k}^{\textbf{El}}}
    {U_k \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P \searrow \textbf{El}}
  \end{mathpar}
  Then $k < j$ (from $k < i \le j$), $P' \Leftrightarrow \textsf{Univ}_{j,k}$,
  $\textbf{El}' \Leftrightarrow \textsf{Univ}_{j,k}^{\textbf{El}}$.

  \emph{Type-predicate raising (1):}
  \begin{align*}
    &\tyequiv[\Gamma]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{k}}}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}
      && \text{(by \Cref{def:univ-type-pred} on $\textsf{Univ}_{i,k}$)} \\
    &\tyequiv[\Gamma]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{k}}}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{j}}}
      && \text{(by cumulativity of universes, $i \le j$, \Cref{sec:rules})} \\
    &\typing[\Gamma]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{j}}} \;\circledR\; \textsf{Univ}_{j,k}
      && \text{(by \Cref{def:univ-type-pred} at level $j$)}
  \end{align*}

  \emph{Term-predicate raising (2):} the conditions $b \in \mathcal{U}_k^\ast \searrow
  P_b \searrow \textbf{El}_b$ and $\typing[\Gamma]{t}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{k}}} \;\circledR\; P_b$ at
  level $k$ are unchanged; the type-predicate part upgrades via (1).

  \emph{Term-predicate lowering (3):} given $\typing[\Gamma]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}
  \;\circledR\; \textsf{Univ}_{i,k}$ and $\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S} \;\circledR\; b
  \in \textsf{Univ}_{j,k}^{\textbf{El}}$. The conditions at level $k$ ($b \in
  \mathcal{U}_k^\ast \searrow P_b \searrow \textbf{El}_b$ and $\typing[\Gamma]{t}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{k}}}
  \;\circledR\; P_b$) are level-$k$ data, unchanged; the type-predicate at
  level $i$ is provided by hypothesis. Hence
  $\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S} \;\circledR\; b \in \textsf{Univ}_{i,k}^{\textbf{El}}$ via
  \Cref{def:univ-term-pred}.

  \medskip\noindent
  \textbf{Case}
  \begin{mathpar}
    \inferrule[\textsc{G-Pi}]
    {a \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P_I \searrow \textbf{El}_I \\
     a \approx a \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R_I \\\\
     \forall\, \ensuremath{\mathcal{D}} :: b \approx b \in R_I,\; c.\;
       \ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket(\rho, b/x)} \searrow c \implies
       c \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}) \searrow \textbf{El}_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}) \\\\
     \Pi(a, T, \rho) \approx \Pi(a, T, \rho) \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R \\\\
     P \Leftrightarrow \Pi_i(R_I, P_I, \textbf{El}_I, P_O) \\
     \textbf{El} \Leftrightarrow \Pi_i^{\textbf{El}}(R, R_I, P_I, \textbf{El}_I, \textbf{El}_O)}
    {\Pi(a, T, \rho) \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P \searrow \textbf{El}}
  \end{mathpar}
  By inversion on the level-$j$ derivation (which must end with \textsc{G-Pi}
  by the syntactic shape of $\Pi(a, T, \rho)$):
  \begin{align*}
    &a \in \mathcal{U}_j^\ast \searrow P_I' \searrow \textbf{El}_I'
      && \text{(level-$j$ inner data)} \\
    &a \approx a \in \mathcal{U}_j \searrow R_I
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:cumul}; same $R_I$ as level $i$)} \\
    &\forall\, \ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}, c.\;
      \ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket(\rho, b/x)} \searrow c \implies
      c \in \mathcal{U}_j^\ast \searrow P_O'(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}) \searrow \textbf{El}_O'(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}})
      && \text{(level-$j$ codomain fibers)} \\
    &\Pi(a, T, \rho) \approx \Pi(a, T, \rho) \in \mathcal{U}_j \searrow R
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:cumul}; same $R$)} \\
    &P' \Leftrightarrow \Pi_j(R_I, P_I', \textbf{El}_I', P_O') \\
    &\textbf{El}' \Leftrightarrow \Pi_j^{\textbf{El}}(R, R_I, P_I', \textbf{El}_I', \textbf{El}_O')
  \end{align*}
  The PER witnesses $R_I, R$ are unchanged (level-independent in $\mathcal{U}$ via
  \Cref{lem:cumul}). The IH applies to the inner $a$ and to each codomain fiber
  $c$ (smaller derivations).

  \emph{Type-predicate raising (1).}
  Suppose $\typing[\Gamma]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; \Pi_i(R_I, P_I, \textbf{El}_I, P_O)$
  with witnesses $S_1, S_2$. We verify the three clauses of
  $\Pi_j(R_I, P_I', \textbf{El}_I', P_O')$ at $S$.

  \emph{Clause 1.}
  \begin{align*}
    &\tyequiv[\Gamma]{S}{\Pi(x:S_1).\,S_2}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}
      && \text{(by \Cref{def:pi-type-pred} clause 1 on the hypothesis)} \\
    &\tyequiv[\Gamma]{S}{\Pi(x:S_1).\,S_2}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{j}}}
      && \text{(by cumulativity of universes, $i \le j$, \Cref{sec:rules})}
  \end{align*}

  \emph{Clause 2.} Let $\kweak[\Delta]{\phi}{\Gamma}$.
  \begin{align*}
    &\typing[\Delta]{S_1[\phi]}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; P_I
      && \text{(by \Cref{def:pi-type-pred} clause 2 on the hypothesis)} \\
    &\typing[\Delta]{S_1[\phi]}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{j}}} \;\circledR\; P_I'
      && \text{(by IH (1) on $a$, raising)}
  \end{align*}

  \emph{Clause 3.} Let $\kweak[\Delta]{\phi}{\Gamma}$, $s, b, \ensuremath{\mathcal{D}} :: b \approx
  b \in R_I$ with $\typing[\Delta]{s}{S_1[\phi]} \;\circledR\; b \in \textbf{El}_I'$.
  \begin{align*}
    &\typing[\Delta]{S_1[\phi]}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; P_I
      && \text{(by clause 2 above, the level-$i$ part)} \\
    &\typing[\Delta]{s}{S_1[\phi]} \;\circledR\; b \in \textbf{El}_I
      && \text{(by IH (3) on $a$, lowering, using the previous line as the
        level-$i$ type-predicate)} \\
    &\typing[\Delta]{S_2[\iota(\phi), s/x]}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; P_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}})
      && \text{(by \Cref{def:pi-type-pred} clause 3 on the hypothesis)} \\
    &\typing[\Delta]{S_2[\iota(\phi), s/x]}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{j}}} \;\circledR\; P_O'(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}})
      && \text{(by IH (1) on the codomain fiber} \\
    & && \text{$c$ at $\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}$, raising)}
  \end{align*}

  \emph{Term-predicate raising (2).}
  Suppose $\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S} \;\circledR\; f \in \Pi_i^{\textbf{El}}(R, R_I, P_I,
  \textbf{El}_I, \textbf{El}_O)$. We verify the four clauses of
  $\Pi_j^{\textbf{El}}(R, R_I, P_I', \textbf{El}_I', \textbf{El}_O')$ at $t, f$.

  \emph{Clauses 1--2.}
  \begin{align*}
    &f \approx f \in R
      && \text{(unchanged from hypothesis)} \\
    &\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S}
      && \text{(unchanged from hypothesis)}
  \end{align*}

  \emph{Clause 3.}
  \begin{align*}
    &\typing[\Gamma]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; \Pi_i(R_I, P_I, \textbf{El}_I, P_O)
      && \text{(by \Cref{def:pi-term-pred} clause 3 on the hypothesis)} \\
    &\typing[\Gamma]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{j}}} \;\circledR\; \Pi_j(R_I, P_I', \textbf{El}_I', P_O')
      && \text{(by part (1) of this case, applied just above)}
  \end{align*}

  \emph{Clause 4 (application).}
  Let $\kweak[\Delta]{\phi}{\Gamma}$, $s, b, \ensuremath{\mathcal{D}} :: b \approx b \in R_I$ with
  $\typing[\Delta]{s}{S_1[\phi]} \;\circledR\; b \in \textbf{El}_I'$.
  \begin{align*}
    &\typing[\Delta]{S_1[\phi]}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; P_I
      && \text{(by hypothesis clause 3 at level $i$, clause 2 of $\Pi_i$)} \\
    &\typing[\Delta]{s}{S_1[\phi]} \;\circledR\; b \in \textbf{El}_I
      && \text{(by IH (3) on $a$, lowering)} \\
    &f \cdot b \searrow c,\;
      \typing[\Delta]{(t[\phi])\;s}{S_2[\iota(\phi), s/x]}
      \;\circledR\; c \in \textbf{El}_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}})
      && \text{(by hypothesis clause 4 at level $i$)} \\
    &\typing[\Delta]{(t[\phi])\;s}{S_2[\iota(\phi), s/x]}
      \;\circledR\; c \in \textbf{El}_O'(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}})
      && \text{(by IH (2) on the codomain fiber $c$, raising)}
  \end{align*}

  \emph{Clause 5 ($R_I$-coherence).} Unchanged, since the $R_I$-classes and
  the function value $f$ are level-independent.

  \emph{Term-predicate lowering (3).}
  Suppose $\typing[\Gamma]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; \Pi_i(R_I, P_I, \textbf{El}_I, P_O)$
  and $\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S} \;\circledR\; f \in \Pi_j^{\textbf{El}}(R, R_I, P_I',
  \textbf{El}_I', \textbf{El}_O')$. We verify the four clauses of $\Pi_i^{\textbf{El}}$ at $t, f$.

  \emph{Clauses 1--3.}
  \begin{align*}
    &f \approx f \in R
      && \text{(by \Cref{def:pi-term-pred} clause 1 on hypothesis at level $j$)} \\
    &\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S}
      && \text{(by \Cref{def:pi-term-pred} clause 2 on hypothesis at level $j$)} \\
    &\typing[\Gamma]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; \Pi_i(R_I, P_I, \textbf{El}_I, P_O)
      && \text{(by lemma's lowering hypothesis on $S$)}
  \end{align*}

  \emph{Clause 4 (application).}
  Let $\kweak[\Delta]{\phi}{\Gamma}$, $s, b, \ensuremath{\mathcal{D}} :: b \approx b \in R_I$ with
  $\typing[\Delta]{s}{S_1[\phi]} \;\circledR\; b \in \textbf{El}_I$.
  \begin{align*}
    &\typing[\Delta]{s}{S_1[\phi]} \;\circledR\; b \in \textbf{El}_I'
      && \text{(by IH (2) on $a$, raising)} \\
    &f \cdot b \searrow c
      && \text{(by hypothesis clause 4 at level $j$)} \\
    &\typing[\Delta]{(t[\phi])\;s}{S_2[\iota(\phi), s/x]}
      \;\circledR\; c \in \textbf{El}_O'(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}})
      && \text{(by hypothesis clause 4 at level $j$)} \\
    &\typing[\Delta]{S_2[\iota(\phi), s/x]}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; P_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}})
      && \text{(by \Cref{def:pi-type-pred} clause 3 on the} \\
    & && \text{level-$i$ type-predicate hypothesis)} \\
    &\typing[\Delta]{(t[\phi])\;s}{S_2[\iota(\phi), s/x]}
      \;\circledR\; c \in \textbf{El}_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}})
      && \text{(by IH (3) on the codomain fiber $c$, lowering)}
  \end{align*}
<!-- end proof-111 -->
<!-- lemma-109: body_md -->
\label{lem:gluing-respects-eq}
  Suppose $a \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P \searrow \textbf{El}$.
  \begin{enumerate}
  \@idxitem If $\typing[\Gamma]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; P$ and
    $\tyequiv[\Gamma]{S}{S'}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$, then
    $\typing[\Gamma]{S'}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; P$.
  \@idxitem If $\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S} \;\circledR\; b \in \textbf{El}$ and
    $\tyequiv[\Gamma]{t}{t'}{S}$, then
    $\typing[\Gamma]{t'}{S} \;\circledR\; b \in \textbf{El}$.
  \@idxitem If $\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S} \;\circledR\; b \in \textbf{El}$ and
    $\tyequiv[\Gamma]{S}{S'}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$, then
    $\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S'} \;\circledR\; b \in \textbf{El}$.
  \end{enumerate}
<!-- end lemma-109 -->
<!-- proof-112: body_md -->
By induction on $a \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast$.

  \medskip\noindent
  \textbf{Case}
  \begin{mathpar}
    \inferrule[\textsc{G-Ne}]
    {{\uparrow}^A(e) \in \ensuremath{\mathrm{D}} \\
     P \Leftrightarrow \textsf{Neu}_i^e \\
     \textbf{El} \Leftrightarrow \textsf{Neu}_i^e}
    {{\uparrow}^A(e) \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P \searrow \textbf{El}}
  \end{mathpar}
  \emph{Type predicate (1).}
  Given $\typing[\Gamma]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; \textsf{Neu}_i^e$
  and $\tyequiv[\Gamma]{S}{S'}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$ with $\typing[\Gamma]{S'}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$.
  For arbitrary $\kweak[\Delta]{\phi}{\Gamma}$:
  \begin{align*}
    &\exists u.\; \textsf{R}^{\textsf{Ne}}_{|\Delta|}(e) \searrow u \wedge
      \tyequiv[\Delta]{S[\phi]}{u}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}
      && \text{(by hypothesis on $S$)} \\
    &\tyequiv[\Delta]{S[\phi]}{S'[\phi]}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:wk-typing})} \\
    &\tyequiv[\Delta]{S'[\phi]}{u}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}
      && \text{(by symmetry and transitivity of judgmental equality)} \\
    &\typing[\Gamma]{S'}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; \textsf{Neu}_i^e
      && \text{(by \Cref{def:neu-type-pred})}
  \end{align*}

  \emph{Term predicate (2).}
  Given $\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S} \;\circledR\; {\uparrow}^A(w) \in \textsf{Neu}_i^e$
  and $\tyequiv[\Gamma]{t}{t'}{S}$ with $\typing[\Gamma]{t'}{S}$.
  For $\kweak[\Delta]{\phi}{\Gamma}$:
  \begin{align*}
    &\exists u.\; \textsf{R}^{\textsf{Ne}}_{|\Delta|}(w) \searrow u \wedge
      \tyequiv[\Delta]{t[\phi]}{u}{S[\phi]}
      && \text{(by hypothesis on $t$)} \\
    &\tyequiv[\Delta]{t[\phi]}{t'[\phi]}{S[\phi]}
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:wk-typing})} \\
    &\tyequiv[\Delta]{t'[\phi]}{u}{S[\phi]}
      && \text{(by symmetry and transitivity)} \\
    &\typing[\Gamma]{t'}{S} \;\circledR\; {\uparrow}^A(w) \in \textsf{Neu}_i^e
      && \text{(by \Cref{def:neu-term-pred})}
  \end{align*}

  \emph{Type-side rewriting (3).}
  Given $\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S} \;\circledR\; {\uparrow}^A(w) \in \textsf{Neu}_i^e$
  and $\tyequiv[\Gamma]{S}{S'}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$ with $\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S'}$.
  For $\kweak[\Delta]{\phi}{\Gamma}$:
  \begin{align*}
    &\exists u.\; \textsf{R}^{\textsf{Ne}}_{|\Delta|}(w) \searrow u \wedge
      \tyequiv[\Delta]{t[\phi]}{u}{S[\phi]}
      && \text{(by hypothesis on $t$)} \\
    &\tyequiv[\Delta]{S[\phi]}{S'[\phi]}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:wk-typing})} \\
    &\tyequiv[\Delta]{t[\phi]}{u}{S'[\phi]}
      && \text{(by \textsc{Tm-Subsump} with the previous line)} \\
    &\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S'} \;\circledR\; {\uparrow}^A(w) \in \textsf{Neu}_i^e
      && \text{(by \Cref{def:neu-term-pred}, using the type predicate at $S'$
        from (1))}
  \end{align*}

  \medskip\noindent
  \textbf{Case}
  \begin{mathpar}
    \inferrule[\textsc{G-Nat}]
    {P \Leftrightarrow \textsf{Nat}_i \\
     \textbf{El} \Leftrightarrow \textsf{Nat}_i}
    {N \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P \searrow \textbf{El}}
  \end{mathpar}
  \emph{Type predicate (1).}
  \begin{align*}
    &\tyequiv[\Gamma]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}
      && \text{(by \Cref{def:nat-type-pred} on hypothesis)} \\
    &\tyequiv[\Gamma]{S'}{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}
      && \text{(by symmetry of $\tyequiv[\Gamma]{S}{S'}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$)} \\
    &\tyequiv[\Gamma]{S'}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}
      && \text{(by transitivity of judgmental equality)} \\
    &\typing[\Gamma]{S'}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; \textsf{Nat}_i
      && \text{(by \Cref{def:nat-type-pred})}
  \end{align*}

  \emph{Term predicate (2).}
  Given $\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S} \;\circledR\; b \in \textsf{Nat}_i$ and
  $\tyequiv[\Gamma]{t}{t'}{S}$. By inner induction on the derivation
  $b \in \textsf{Nat}_i$ at $t$:
  \begin{itemize}
