  \@idxitem[Sub-case]
    \begin{mathpar}
      \inferrule[\textsc{GN-Ze}]
      {\tyequiv[\Gamma]{t}{\textsf{zero}}{S}}
      {\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S} \;\circledR\; \texttt{ze} \in \textsf{Nat}}
    \end{mathpar}
    \begin{align*}
      &\tyequiv[\Gamma]{t'}{t}{S}
        && \text{(by symmetry of $\tyequiv[\Gamma]{t}{t'}{S}$)} \\
      &\tyequiv[\Gamma]{t'}{\textsf{zero}}{S}
        && \text{(by transitivity)} \\
      &\typing[\Gamma]{t'}{S} \;\circledR\; \texttt{ze} \in \textsf{Nat}
        && \text{(by \textsc{GN-Ze})}
    \end{align*}
  \@idxitem[Sub-case]
    \begin{mathpar}
      \inferrule[\textsc{GN-Su}]
      {\typing[\Gamma]{t_0}{S} \;\circledR\; b' \in \textsf{Nat} \\
       \tyequiv[\Gamma]{t}{\textsf{succ}~t_0}{S}}
      {\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S} \;\circledR\; \texttt{su}(b') \in \textsf{Nat}}
    \end{mathpar}
    \begin{align*}
      &\tyequiv[\Gamma]{t'}{\textsf{succ}~t_0}{S}
        && \text{(by symmetry/transitivity, as above)} \\
      &\typing[\Gamma]{t_0}{S} \;\circledR\; b' \in \textsf{Nat}
        && \text{(unchanged, hypothesis on $t_0$)} \\
      &\typing[\Gamma]{t'}{S} \;\circledR\; \texttt{su}(b') \in \textsf{Nat}
        && \text{(by \textsc{GN-Su})}
    \end{align*}
  \@idxitem[Sub-case]
    \begin{mathpar}
      \inferrule[\textsc{GN-Ne}]
      {\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S} \;\circledR\; w \in \textsf{Ne}_i^N}
      {\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S} \;\circledR\; {\uparrow}^N(w) \in \textsf{Nat}}
    \end{mathpar}
    \begin{align*}
      &\typing[\Gamma]{t'}{S} \;\circledR\; w \in \textsf{Ne}_i^N
        && \text{(by the \textsc{G-Ne} case (2) above on the neutral predicate)} \\
      &\typing[\Gamma]{t'}{S} \;\circledR\; {\uparrow}^N(w) \in \textsf{Nat}
        && \text{(by \textsc{GN-Ne})}
    \end{align*}
  \end{itemize}

  \emph{Type-side rewriting (3).}
  Given $\tyequiv[\Gamma]{S}{S'}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$. Then $\tyequiv[\Gamma]{S'}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$
  by symmetry/transitivity with $\tyequiv[\Gamma]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$. The
  $\textsf{Nat}$-derivation transfers to $\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S'}$ since each
  sub-case's hypotheses involve $S$ only through $\tyequiv[\Gamma]{t}{w}{S}$
  for some $w$, which becomes $\tyequiv[\Gamma]{t}{w}{S'}$ via \textsc{Tm-Subsump}.

  \medskip\noindent
  \textbf{Case}
  \begin{mathpar}
    \inferrule[\textsc{G-Univ}]
    {j < i \\
     P \Leftrightarrow \textsf{Univ}_{i,j} \\
     \textbf{El} \Leftrightarrow \textsf{Univ}_{i,j}^{\textbf{El}}}
    {U_j \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P \searrow \textbf{El}}
  \end{mathpar}
  \emph{Type predicate (1).}
  \begin{align*}
    &\tyequiv[\Gamma]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{j}}}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}
      && \text{(by \Cref{def:univ-type-pred})} \\
    &\tyequiv[\Gamma]{S'}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{j}}}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}
      && \text{(by symmetry/transitivity with the assumed equality)} \\
    &\typing[\Gamma]{S'}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; \textsf{Univ}_{i,j}
      && \text{(by \Cref{def:univ-type-pred})}
  \end{align*}

  \emph{Term predicate (2).}
  Given $\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S} \;\circledR\; b \in \textsf{Univ}_{i,j}^{\textbf{El}}$
  and $\tyequiv[\Gamma]{t}{t'}{S}$. By \Cref{def:univ-term-pred},
  $b \in \mathcal{U}_j^\ast \searrow P_b \searrow \textbf{El}_b$ with
  $\typing[\Gamma]{t}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{j}}} \;\circledR\; P_b$ and
  $\tyequiv[\Gamma]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{j}}}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$.
  \begin{align*}
    &\tyequiv[\Gamma]{t}{t'}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{j}}}
      && \text{(by judgmental-equality conversion under
        $\tyequiv[\Gamma]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{j}}}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$)} \\
    &\typing[\Gamma]{t'}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{j}}} \;\circledR\; P_b
      && \text{(by IH on $P_b$ at level $j$, type-predicate part)} \\
    &\typing[\Gamma]{t'}{S} \;\circledR\; b \in \textsf{Univ}_{i,j}^{\textbf{El}}
      && \text{(by \Cref{def:univ-term-pred} with $\tyequiv[\Gamma]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{j}}}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$)}
  \end{align*}

  \emph{Type-side rewriting (3).}
  Given $\tyequiv[\Gamma]{S}{S'}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$. Then
  $\tyequiv[\Gamma]{S'}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{j}}}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$ by transitivity, and the universe
  term predicate at $S'$ holds with the same data $b, P_b, \textbf{El}_b$.

  \medskip\noindent
  \textbf{Case}
  \begin{mathpar}
    \inferrule[\textsc{G-Pi}]
    {a \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P_I \searrow \textbf{El}_I \\
     a \approx a \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R_I \\\\
     \forall\, \ensuremath{\mathcal{D}} :: b \approx b \in R_I,\; c.\;
       \ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket(\rho, b/x)} \searrow c \implies
       c \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}) \searrow \textbf{El}_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}) \\\\
     \Pi(a, T, \rho) \approx \Pi(a, T, \rho) \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R \\\\
     P \Leftrightarrow \Pi_i(\ldots) \\
     \textbf{El} \Leftrightarrow \Pi_i^{\textbf{El}}(\ldots)}
    {\Pi(a, T, \rho) \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P \searrow \textbf{El}}
  \end{mathpar}
  \emph{Type predicate (1).}
  Given $\typing[\Gamma]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; \Pi_i(R_I, P_I, \textbf{El}_I, P_O)$
  and $\tyequiv[\Gamma]{S}{S'}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$. By \Cref{def:pi-type-pred} clause~1,
  $\tyequiv[\Gamma]{S}{\Pi(x:S_1).\,S_2}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$ for some $S_1, S_2$.
  \begin{align*}
    &\tyequiv[\Gamma]{S'}{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}
      && \text{(by symmetry of $\tyequiv[\Gamma]{S}{S'}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$)} \\
    &\tyequiv[\Gamma]{S'}{\Pi(x:S_1).\,S_2}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}
      && \text{(by transitivity with the previous line)}
  \end{align*}
  Clauses 2--3 of $\Pi_i$ for $S'$ at any $\kweak[\Delta]{\phi}{\Gamma}$ require
  the same data on $S_1[\phi]$ and $S_2[\iota(\phi), s/x]$ as the original
  predicate; these are exactly the data already satisfied by hypothesis on
  $S$, since the data depend on $S_1, S_2$ rather than on the outer type $S$.

  \emph{Term predicate (2).}
  Given $\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S} \;\circledR\; f \in
  \Pi_i^{\textbf{El}}(R, R_I, P_I, \textbf{El}_I, \textbf{El}_O)$ and $\tyequiv[\Gamma]{t}{t'}{S}$ with
  $\typing[\Gamma]{t'}{S}$. We verify the four clauses of \Cref{def:pi-term-pred}
  at $t'$ and value $f$.
  \begin{enumerate}
  \@idxitem Self-relatedness $f \approx f \in R$ does not depend on $t$.
  \@idxitem $R_I$-coherence: a property of $f$, not of $t$.
  \@idxitem Type-readback: clause~3 of $\Pi_i^{\textbf{El}}$ matches clause~3 of $\Pi_i$ on
    $S$ at $t$, and is preserved by part (1) above on $S'$ unchanged.
  \@idxitem Application: let $\kweak[\Delta]{\phi}{\Gamma}$, $s, b, \ensuremath{\mathcal{D}} :: b \approx b \in R_I$
    with $\typing[\Delta]{s}{S_1[\phi]} \;\circledR\; b \in \textbf{El}_I$.
    \begin{align*}
      &f \cdot b \searrow c
        && \text{(by hypothesis clause 4 on $f$)} \\
      &\typing[\Delta]{(t[\phi])\;s}{S_2[\iota(\phi), s/x]}
        \;\circledR\; c \in \textbf{El}_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}})
        && \text{(by hypothesis clause 4)} \\
      &\tyequiv[\Delta]{t[\phi]}{t'[\phi]}{S[\phi]}
        && \text{(by \Cref{lem:wk-typing})} \\
      &\tyequiv[\Delta]{(t[\phi])\;s}{(t'[\phi])\;s}{S_2[\iota(\phi), s/x]}
        && \text{(by \textsc{App-Cong} on the previous line,} \\
    & && \text{after observing that $S[\phi]$ on the function side} \\
    & && \text{reduces to $\Pi(x:S_1[\phi]).\,(S_2[q(\phi)])$)} \\
      &\typing[\Delta]{(t'[\phi])\;s}{S_2[\iota(\phi), s/x]}
        \;\circledR\; c \in \textbf{El}_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}})
        && \text{(by IH (2) on $\textbf{El}_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}})$ applied} \\
    & && \text{to the equality above)}
    \end{align*}
  \@idxitem $R_I$-coherence under application: a property of $f$ via clauses 4
    parametrically; transfers from $t$ to $t'$ alongside clause 4.
  \end{enumerate}

  \emph{Type-side rewriting (3).}
  Given $\tyequiv[\Gamma]{S}{S'}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$ with $\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S'}$.
  Clauses 1, 4 of $\Pi_i^{\textbf{El}}$ depend on $S$ only through $S_2[\iota(\phi), s/x]$
  (the codomain instantiation), which is invariant under the equation
  $S \approx S'$. Clause 3's $\Pi$-shape readback transfers via part (1)
  applied to the universe-equation. Hence
  $\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S'} \;\circledR\; f \in \Pi_i^{\textbf{El}}$.
<!-- end proof-112 -->
<!-- lemma-110: body_md -->
\label{lem:gluing-univ-equiv}
  If $a \approx a' \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R$ and $a \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P \searrow \textbf{El}$,
  then $a' \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P \searrow \textbf{El}$.
<!-- end lemma-110 -->
<!-- proof-113: body_md -->
By induction on $a \approx a' \in \mathcal{U}_i$.

  \medskip\noindent
  \textbf{Case}
  \begin{mathpar}
    \inferrule[\textsc{U-Ne}]
    {b \approx b' \in \textsf{Ne} \\ R \Leftrightarrow \textsf{Neu}}
    {{\uparrow}^A(b) \approx {\uparrow}^{A'}(b') \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R}
  \end{mathpar}
  $a = {\uparrow}^A(b)$, $a' = {\uparrow}^{A'}(b')$.
  $a \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast$ via \textsc{G-Ne} with $P \Leftrightarrow \textbf{El} \Leftrightarrow
  \textsf{Neu}_i^b$.
  By definition of $\textsf{Ne}$ ($b \approx b' \in \textsf{Ne}$), readbacks of $b$ and $b'$
  coincide, so $\textsf{Neu}_i^b \Leftrightarrow \textsf{Neu}_i^{b'}$.
  Hence $a' \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast$ via \textsc{G-Ne} with the same predicates.

  \medskip\noindent
  \textbf{Case}
  \begin{mathpar}
    \inferrule[\textsc{U-Univ}]
    {j < i \\ R \Leftrightarrow \mathcal{U}_j}
    {U_j \approx U_j \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R}
  \end{mathpar}
  $a = a' = U_j$; the conclusion is immediate.

  \medskip\noindent
  \textbf{Case}
  \begin{mathpar}
    \inferrule[\textsc{U-Nat}]
    {R \Leftrightarrow \textsf{Nat}}
    {N \approx N \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R}
  \end{mathpar}
  $a = a' = N$; immediate.

  \medskip\noindent
  \textbf{Case}
  \begin{mathpar}
    \inferrule[\textsc{U-Pi}]
    {a_I \approx a_I' \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R_I \\
     R_I \text{ is a PER} \\\\
     \forall\, \ensuremath{\mathcal{D}} :: b \approx b' \in R_I.\;
       \ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket(\rho, b/x)} \approx \ensuremath{\llbracket T' \rrbracket(\rho', b'/x)} \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}) \\\\
     \forall\, f, f'.\; f \approx f' \in R \;\leftrightarrow\;
       (\forall\, \ensuremath{\mathcal{D}} :: b \approx b' \in R_I.\;
        f \cdot b \approx f' \cdot b' \in R_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}))}
    {\Pi(a_I, T, \rho) \approx \Pi(a_I', T', \rho') \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R}
  \end{mathpar}
  $a = \Pi(a_I, T, \rho)$, $a' = \Pi(a_I', T', \rho')$.
  $a \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast$ via \textsc{G-Pi} provides inner data
  $a_I \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P_I \searrow \textbf{El}_I$ and a codomain clause:
  for any $\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}} :: b \approx b \in R_I$ and $c$ with $\ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket(\rho, b/x)}
  \searrow c$, $c \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}) \searrow \textbf{El}_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}})$.
  \begin{align*}
    &a_I \approx a_I' \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R_I
      && \text{(from the \textsc{U-Pi} premise)} \\
    &a_I' \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P_I \searrow \textbf{El}_I
      && \text{(by IH on $a_I \approx a_I' \in \mathcal{U}_i$ and $a_I \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast$)} \\
    &\forall \ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}' :: b' \approx b' \in R_I, c'.\;
      \ensuremath{\llbracket T' \rrbracket(\rho', b'/x)} \searrow c' \\
    & \quad \implies c' \approx c' \in \mathcal{U}_i
      && \text{(by symmetry/transitivity from the \textsc{U-Pi} premise)} \\
    &\forall \ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}' :: b' \approx b' \in R_I, c'.\;
      \ensuremath{\llbracket T' \rrbracket(\rho', b'/x)} \searrow c' \\
    & \quad \implies
      c' \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}') \searrow \textbf{El}_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}')
      && \text{(by IH on the codomain fibers,} \\
    & && \text{transporting from $c \approx c'$)} \\
    &\Pi(a_I', T', \rho') \approx \Pi(a_I', T', \rho') \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:univ-sym,lem:univ-trans})} \\
    &\Pi(a_I', T', \rho') \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P \searrow \textbf{El}
      && \text{(by \textsc{G-Pi} at the previous data, with the same $P, \textbf{El}$)}
  \end{align*}
<!-- end proof-113 -->
<!-- lemma-111: body_md -->
\label{lem:per-implies-gluing}
  If $a \approx a \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R$, then there exist $P, \textbf{El}$ with
  $a \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P \searrow \textbf{El}$.
<!-- end lemma-111 -->
<!-- proof-114: body_md -->
By induction on $a \approx a \in \mathcal{U}_i$.

  \medskip\noindent
  \textbf{Case}
  \begin{mathpar}
    \inferrule[\textsc{U-Ne}]
    {b \approx b \in \textsf{Ne} \\ R \Leftrightarrow \textsf{Neu}}
    {{\uparrow}^A(b) \approx {\uparrow}^A(b) \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R}
  \end{mathpar}
  \begin{align*}
    &{\uparrow}^A(b) \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast
      \searrow \textsf{Neu}_i^b
      \searrow \textsf{Neu}_i^b
      && \text{(by \textsc{G-Ne} on $b$)}
  \end{align*}

  \medskip\noindent
  \textbf{Case}
  \begin{mathpar}
    \inferrule[\textsc{U-Univ}]
    {j < i \\ R \Leftrightarrow \mathcal{U}_j}
    {U_j \approx U_j \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R}
  \end{mathpar}
  \begin{align*}
    &U_j \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast
      \searrow \textsf{Univ}_{i,j}
      \searrow \textsf{Univ}_{i,j}^{\textbf{El}}
      && \text{(by \textsc{G-Univ} at $j < i$)}
  \end{align*}

  \medskip\noindent
  \textbf{Case}
  \begin{mathpar}
    \inferrule[\textsc{U-Nat}]
    {R \Leftrightarrow \textsf{Nat}}
    {N \approx N \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R}
  \end{mathpar}
  \begin{align*}
    &N \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow \textsf{Nat}_i \searrow \textsf{Nat}_i
      && \text{(by \textsc{G-Nat})}
  \end{align*}

  \medskip\noindent
  \textbf{Case}
  \begin{mathpar}
    \inferrule[\textsc{U-Pi}]
    {a_I \approx a_I \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R_I \\
     R_I \text{ is a PER} \\\\
     \forall\, \ensuremath{\mathcal{D}} :: b \approx b \in R_I.\;
       \ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket(\rho, b/x)} \approx \ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket(\rho, b/x)} \in \mathcal{U}_i
         \searrow R_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}) \\\\
     \forall\, f, f'.\; f \approx f' \in R \;\leftrightarrow\;
       (\forall\, \ensuremath{\mathcal{D}} :: b \approx b' \in R_I.\;
        f \cdot b \approx f' \cdot b' \in R_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}))}
    {\Pi(a_I, T, \rho) \approx \Pi(a_I, T, \rho) \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R}
  \end{mathpar}
  \begin{align*}
    &a_I \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P_I \searrow \textbf{El}_I
      && \tag{by IH} \\
    &\forall\, \ensuremath{\mathcal{D}} :: b \approx b \in R_I,\; c.\;
      \ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket(\rho, b/x)} \searrow c \\
    & \quad \implies c \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast
        \searrow P_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}) \searrow \textbf{El}_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}})
      && \tag{by IH} \\
    &\Pi(a_I, T, \rho) \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast
      \searrow \Pi_i(R_I, P_I, \textbf{El}_I, P_O)
      \searrow \Pi_i^{\textbf{El}}(R, R_I, P_I, \textbf{El}_I, \textbf{El}_O)
      && \text{(by \textsc{G-Pi})}
  \end{align*}
<!-- end proof-114 -->
<!-- lemma-112: body_md -->
\label{lem:el-per-equiv}
  Suppose $a \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P \searrow \textbf{El}$ and
  $a \approx a \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R$.
  If $\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S} \;\circledR\; b \in \textbf{El}$ and $b \approx b' \in R$,
  then $\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S} \;\circledR\; b' \in \textbf{El}$.
<!-- end lemma-112 -->
<!-- proof-115: body_md -->
By induction on $a \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast$.

  \medskip\noindent
  \textbf{Case}
  \begin{mathpar}
    \inferrule[\textsc{G-Ne}]
    {{\uparrow}^A(e) \in \ensuremath{\mathrm{D}} \\
     P \Leftrightarrow \textsf{Neu}_i^e \\
     \textbf{El} \Leftrightarrow \textsf{Neu}_i^e}
    {{\uparrow}^A(e) \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P \searrow \textbf{El}}
  \end{mathpar}
  $R \Leftrightarrow \textsf{Neu}$. From $\textbf{El} \Leftrightarrow \textsf{Neu}_i^e$,
  $b = {\uparrow}^{A_0}(w)$ with $w \approx w \in \textsf{Ne}$.
  $b \approx b' \in R \Leftrightarrow \textsf{Neu}$ gives
  $b' = {\uparrow}^{A_0'}(w')$ with $w \approx w' \in \textsf{Ne}$.
  \begin{align*}
    &\forall \kweak[\Delta]{\phi}{\Gamma}.\;
      \exists u.\; \textsf{R}^{\textsf{Ne}}_{|\Delta|}(w) \searrow u \wedge
      \tyequiv[\Delta]{t[\phi]}{u}{S[\phi]}
      && \text{(hypothesis on $b = {\uparrow}^{A_0}(w)$)} \\
    &\textsf{R}^{\textsf{Ne}}_{|\Delta|}(w') \searrow u
      && \text{(by definition of $\textsf{Ne}$, $w \approx w'$ read back to the same $u$)} \\
    &\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S} \;\circledR\; {\uparrow}^{A_0'}(w') \in \textsf{Neu}_i^e
      && \text{(by \Cref{def:neu-term-pred})}
  \end{align*}

  \medskip\noindent
  \textbf{Case}
  \begin{mathpar}
    \inferrule[\textsc{G-Nat}]
    {P \Leftrightarrow \textsf{Nat}_i \\
     \textbf{El} \Leftrightarrow \textsf{Nat}_i}
    {N \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P \searrow \textbf{El}}
  \end{mathpar}
  $R \Leftrightarrow \textsf{Nat}$, and $b \approx b' \in \textsf{Nat}$.
  By inner induction on the $\textsf{Nat}$ derivation (\Cref{def:per-nat}).

  \medskip\noindent
  \textbf{Sub-case}
  \begin{mathpar}
    \inferrule[\textsc{Nat-Ze}]
    { }
    {\texttt{ze} \approx \texttt{ze} \in \textsf{Nat}}
  \end{mathpar}
  $b = b' = \texttt{ze}$; the predicate is unchanged.

  \medskip\noindent
  \textbf{Sub-case}
  \begin{mathpar}
    \inferrule[\textsc{Nat-Su}]
    {b_0 \approx b_0' \in \textsf{Nat}}
    {\texttt{su}(b_0) \approx \texttt{su}(b_0') \in \textsf{Nat}}
  \end{mathpar}
  $b = \texttt{su}(b_0)$, $b' = \texttt{su}(b_0')$. The $\textsf{Nat}$-predicate derivation
  for $b$ uses \textsc{GN-Su} from a derivation for some $t_0$ at $b_0$:
  \begin{align*}
    &\typing[\Gamma]{t_0}{S} \;\circledR\; b_0 \in \textsf{Nat}
      && \text{(from the \textsc{GN-Su} premise)} \\
    &\tyequiv[\Gamma]{t}{\textsf{succ}~t_0}{S}
      && \text{(from the \textsc{GN-Su} premise)} \\
    &\typing[\Gamma]{t_0}{S} \;\circledR\; b_0' \in \textsf{Nat}
      && \text{(by inner IH)} \\
    &\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S} \;\circledR\; \texttt{su}(b_0') \in \textsf{Nat}
      && \text{(by \textsc{GN-Su} repackaging)}
  \end{align*}

  \medskip\noindent
  \textbf{Sub-case}
  \begin{mathpar}
    \inferrule[\textsc{Nat-Ne}]
    {e \approx e' \in \textsf{Ne}}
    {{\uparrow}^N(e) \approx {\uparrow}^N(e') \in \textsf{Nat}}
  \end{mathpar}
  $b = {\uparrow}^N(e)$, $b' = {\uparrow}^N(e')$. The $\textsf{Nat}$-predicate
  derivation for $b$ uses \textsc{GN-Ne} from a neutral predicate at $e$:
  \begin{align*}
    &\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S} \;\circledR\; e \in \textsf{Ne}_i^N
      && \text{(from the \textsc{GN-Ne} premise)} \\
    &\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S} \;\circledR\; e' \in \textsf{Ne}_i^N
      && \text{(by readback equality: $e \approx e' \in \textsf{Ne}$ implies
        $\textsf{R}^{\textsf{Ne}}(e) = \textsf{R}^{\textsf{Ne}}(e')$ at every depth)} \\
    &\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S} \;\circledR\; {\uparrow}^N(e') \in \textsf{Nat}
      && \text{(by \textsc{GN-Ne})}
  \end{align*}

  \medskip\noindent
  \textbf{Case}
  \begin{mathpar}
    \inferrule[\textsc{G-Univ}]
    {j < i \\
     P \Leftrightarrow \textsf{Univ}_{i,j} \\
     \textbf{El} \Leftrightarrow \textsf{Univ}_{i,j}^{\textbf{El}}}
    {U_j \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P \searrow \textbf{El}}
  \end{mathpar}
  $R \Leftrightarrow \mathcal{U}_j$. By \Cref{def:univ-term-pred}, $b \in \mathcal{U}_j^\ast
  \searrow P_b \searrow \textbf{El}_b$ with $\typing[\Gamma]{t}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{j}}} \;\circledR\; P_b$,
  and $b \approx b' \in \mathcal{U}_j$.
  \begin{align*}
    &b' \in \mathcal{U}_j^\ast \searrow P_b \searrow \textbf{El}_b
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:gluing-univ-equiv} at level $j$ on $b \approx b'$)} \\
    &\typing[\Gamma]{t}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{j}}} \;\circledR\; P_b
      && \text{(unchanged from hypothesis)} \\
    &\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S} \;\circledR\; b' \in \textsf{Univ}_{i,j}^{\textbf{El}}
      && \text{(by \Cref{def:univ-term-pred} with the
        previous lines} \\
    & && \text{and $\tyequiv[\Gamma]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{j}}}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$)}
  \end{align*}

  \medskip\noindent
  \textbf{Case}
  \begin{mathpar}
    \inferrule[\textsc{G-Pi}]
    {a \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P_I \searrow \textbf{El}_I \\
     a \approx a \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R_I \\\\
     \forall\, \ensuremath{\mathcal{D}} :: b_0 \approx b_0 \in R_I,\; c.\;
       \ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket(\rho, b_0/x)} \searrow c \implies
       c \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}) \searrow \textbf{El}_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}) \\\\
     \Pi(a, T, \rho) \approx \Pi(a, T, \rho) \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R \\\\
     P \Leftrightarrow \Pi_i(\ldots) \\
     \textbf{El} \Leftrightarrow \Pi_i^{\textbf{El}}(\ldots)}
    {\Pi(a, T, \rho) \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P \searrow \textbf{El}}
  \end{mathpar}
  Hypothesis: $\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S} \;\circledR\; f \in
  \Pi_i^{\textbf{El}}(R, R_I, P_I, \textbf{El}_I, \textbf{El}_O)$ and $f \approx f' \in R$. We verify
  the four clauses of \Cref{def:pi-term-pred} at $f'$.
  \begin{enumerate}
  \@idxitem Self-relatedness $f' \approx f' \in R$: by PER symmetry and transitivity
    on $f \approx f' \in R$ (\Cref{lem:univ-sym,lem:univ-trans}).
  \@idxitem $R_I$-coherence of $f'$: clause (2) is a property of $R$-classes; since
    $f, f'$ are in the same $R$-class, the coherence transfers.
  \@idxitem Type-readback of $f'$: clause (3) depends only on $S$ and the
    $\Pi$-shape, not on the function value, so it transfers verbatim.
  \@idxitem Application: let $\kweak[\Delta]{\phi}{\Gamma}$, $s, b_0, \ensuremath{\mathcal{D}} :: b_0 \approx b_0 \in R_I$
    with $\typing[\Delta]{s}{S_1[\phi]} \;\circledR\; b_0 \in \textbf{El}_I$.
    \begin{align*}
      &f \cdot b_0 \searrow c
        && \text{(by hypothesis on $f$, clause (4))} \\
      &\typing[\Delta]{(t[\phi])\;s}{S_2[\iota(\phi), s/x]}
        \;\circledR\; c \in \textbf{El}_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}})
        && \text{(by hypothesis on $f$, clause (4))} \\
      &f \cdot b_0 \approx f' \cdot b_0 \in R_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}})
        && \text{(by the application clause of $R$ for $f \approx f' \in R$
          at $b_0 \approx b_0 \in R_I$)} \\
      &\exists c'.\; f' \cdot b_0 \searrow c',\; c \approx c' \in R_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}})
        && \text{(by determinism of evaluation and the previous line)} \\
      &\typing[\Delta]{(t[\phi])\;s}{S_2[\iota(\phi), s/x]}
        \;\circledR\; c' \in \textbf{El}_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}})
        && \text{(by IH on the codomain fiber $\textbf{El}_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}})$, applied to $c \approx c'$)}
    \end{align*}
  \@idxitem $R_I$-coherence under application: a property of the $R$-class on the
    codomain; transfers as in clauses (1)--(2).
  \end{enumerate}
<!-- end proof-115 -->
<!-- lemma-113: body_md -->
\label{lem:gluing-subty-typ}
  Suppose $a_1 \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P_1 \searrow \textbf{El}_1$,
  $a_2 \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P_2 \searrow \textbf{El}_2$, and $a_1 \mathrel{<:_i} a_2$
  (semantic subtyping from \Cref{sec:comp}).
  If $\typing[\Gamma]{S_1}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; P_1$ and
  $\typing[\Gamma]{S_2}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; P_2$, then $\subty[\Gamma]{S_1}{S_2}$.
<!-- end lemma-113 -->
<!-- proof-116: body_md -->
By induction on $a_1 \mathrel{<:_i} a_2$.

  \medskip\noindent
  \textbf{Case}
  \begin{mathpar}
    \inferrule[\textsc{$<$:-Ne}]
    {b \approx b' \in \textsf{Ne}}
    {{\uparrow}^A(b) \mathrel{<:_i} {\uparrow}^{A'}(b')}
  \end{mathpar}
  $P_1 \Leftrightarrow \textsf{Neu}_i^b$, $P_2 \Leftrightarrow \textsf{Neu}_i^{b'}$.
  The hypothesis $b \approx b' \in \textsf{Ne}$ implies $\textsf{R}^{\textsf{Ne}}_n(b)$ and $\textsf{R}^{\textsf{Ne}}_n(b')$
  produce the same syntactic neutral at every depth.
  \begin{align*}
    &\textsf{R}^{\textsf{Ne}}_{|\Gamma|}(b) \searrow u,\;
      \tyequiv[\Gamma]{S_1}{u}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}
      && \text{(by \Cref{def:neu-type-pred} on $S_1$ at $\phi = \ensuremath{\textsf{id}}$)} \\
    &\textsf{R}^{\textsf{Ne}}_{|\Gamma|}(b') \searrow u
      && \text{(by $b \approx b' \in \textsf{Ne}$, same readback)} \\
    &\tyequiv[\Gamma]{S_2}{u}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}
      && \text{(by \Cref{def:neu-type-pred} on $S_2$ at $\phi = \ensuremath{\textsf{id}}$)} \\
    &\tyequiv[\Gamma]{S_1}{S_2}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}
      && \text{(by symmetry/transitivity of judgmental equality)} \\
    &\subty[\Gamma]{S_1}{S_2}
      && \text{(by \textsc{Sub-Eq} on the previous line)}
  \end{align*}

  \medskip\noindent
  \textbf{Case}
  \begin{mathpar}
    \inferrule[\textsc{$<$:-Univ}]
    {j \le k \\ k < i}
    {U_j \mathrel{<:_i} U_k}
  \end{mathpar}
  $P_1 \Leftrightarrow \textsf{Univ}_{i,j}$, $P_2 \Leftrightarrow
  \textsf{Univ}_{i,k}$.
  \begin{align*}
    &\tyequiv[\Gamma]{S_1}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{j}}}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}
      && \text{(by \Cref{def:univ-type-pred} on $\textsf{Univ}_{i,j}$)} \\
    &\tyequiv[\Gamma]{S_2}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{k}}}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}
      && \text{(by \Cref{def:univ-type-pred} on $\textsf{Univ}_{i,k}$)} \\
    &\subty[\Gamma]{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{j}}}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{k}}}
      && \text{(by \textsc{Sub-Univ} from $j \le k$)} \\
    &\subty[\Gamma]{S_1}{S_2}
      && \text{(by \textsc{Sub-Trans} via the equalities and the previous line)}
  \end{align*}

  \medskip\noindent
  \textbf{Case}
  \begin{mathpar}
    \inferrule[\textsc{$<$:-Nat}]
    { }
    {N \mathrel{<:_i} N}
  \end{mathpar}
  $P_1 \Leftrightarrow P_2 \Leftrightarrow \textsf{Nat}_i$.
  \begin{align*}
    &\tyequiv[\Gamma]{S_1}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}
      && \text{(by \Cref{def:nat-type-pred} on $S_1$)} \\
    &\tyequiv[\Gamma]{S_2}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}
      && \text{(by \Cref{def:nat-type-pred} on $S_2$)} \\
    &\tyequiv[\Gamma]{S_1}{S_2}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}
      && \text{(by symmetry/transitivity through $\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}$)} \\
    &\subty[\Gamma]{S_1}{S_2}
      && \text{(by \textsc{Sub-Eq})}
  \end{align*}

  \medskip\noindent
  \textbf{Case}
  \begin{mathpar}
    \inferrule[\textsc{$<$:-Pi}]
    {A \approx A' \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R_I \\
     \forall\, \ensuremath{\mathcal{D}} :: a \approx a' \in R_I.\;
       \ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket(\rho, a/x)} \mathrel{<:_i} \ensuremath{\llbracket T' \rrbracket(\rho', a'/x)} \\\\
     \Pi(A, T, \rho) \approx \Pi(A, T, \rho) \in \mathcal{U}_i \\
     \Pi(A', T', \rho') \approx \Pi(A', T', \rho') \in \mathcal{U}_i}
    {\Pi(A, T, \rho) \mathrel{<:_i} \Pi(A', T', \rho')}
  \end{mathpar}
  $P_1 \Leftrightarrow \Pi_i(R_I, P_I, \textbf{El}_I, P_O)$,
  $P_2 \Leftrightarrow \Pi_i(R_I', P_I', \textbf{El}_I', P_O')$.
  The domain PERs are related by \emph{equality}
  ($A \approx A' \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R_I$, so $R_I = R_I'$ via
  \Cref{lem:univ-functional}; correspondingly $P_I \Leftrightarrow P_I'$,
  $\textbf{El}_I \Leftrightarrow \textbf{El}_I'$ via \Cref{lem:gluing-univ-equiv}).

  Given $\typing[\Gamma]{S_1}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; \Pi_i(\ldots)$ at shape
  $\Pi(x:S_{1,1}).\,S_{1,2}$ and similarly $S_2$ at $\Pi(x:S_{2,1}).\,S_{2,2}$
  (both by \Cref{def:pi-type-pred} clause 1).
  \begin{align*}
    &\typing[\Gamma]{S_{1,1}}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; P_I
      && \text{(by \Cref{def:pi-type-pred} clause 2 on $S_1$ at $\phi = \ensuremath{\textsf{id}}$)} \\
    &\typing[\Gamma]{S_{2,1}}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; P_I
      && \text{(symmetrically on $S_2$, using $P_I' \Leftrightarrow P_I$)} \\
    &\tyequiv[\Gamma]{S_{1,1}}{S_{2,1}}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:gluing-functional} on the two predicates at $a = A$)} \\
    &\subty[\Gamma, x:S_{1,1}]{S_{1,2}}{S_{2,2}}
      && \text{(by IH on the codomain subtyping at fresh variable $x$ at $A$)} \\
    &\subty[\Gamma]{\Pi(x:S_{1,1}).\,S_{1,2}}{\Pi(x:S_{2,1}).\,S_{2,2}}
      && \text{(by \textsc{Sub-Pi})} \\
    &\subty[\Gamma]{S_1}{S_2}
      && \text{(by \textsc{Sub-Eq} with the $\Pi$-shape equalities)}
  \end{align*}
<!-- end proof-116 -->
<!-- lemma-114: body_md -->
\label{lem:gluing-subty}
  Suppose $a_1 \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P_1 \searrow \textbf{El}_1$,
  $a_2 \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P_2 \searrow \textbf{El}_2$, and $a_1 \mathrel{<:_i} a_2$.
  If $\typing[\Gamma]{S_2}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; P_2$ and
  $\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S_1} \;\circledR\; b \in \textbf{El}_1$, then
  $\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S_2} \;\circledR\; b \in \textbf{El}_2$.
<!-- end lemma-114 -->
<!-- proof-117: body_md -->
By induction on $a_1 \mathrel{<:_i} a_2$. Each case extracts the type
  predicate at $S_1$ from the term predicate (via the relevant
  $\textbf{El}$-definition) and then applies \Cref{lem:gluing-subty-typ} to obtain
  $\subty[\Gamma]{S_1}{S_2}$.

  \medskip\noindent
  \textbf{Case}
  \begin{mathpar}
    \inferrule[\textsc{$<$:-Ne}]
    {b \approx b' \in \textsf{Ne}}
    {{\uparrow}^A(b) \mathrel{<:_i} {\uparrow}^{A'}(b')}
  \end{mathpar}
  $P_1 \Leftrightarrow \textbf{El}_1 \Leftrightarrow \textsf{Neu}_i^b$,
  $P_2 \Leftrightarrow \textbf{El}_2 \Leftrightarrow \textsf{Neu}_i^{b'}$. Given
  $\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S_1} \;\circledR\; w \in \textsf{Neu}_i^b$.
  \begin{align*}
    &\typing[\Gamma]{S_1}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; \textsf{Neu}_i^b
      && \text{(by \Cref{def:neu-term-pred} on the hypothesis)} \\
    &\subty[\Gamma]{S_1}{S_2}
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:gluing-subty-typ} on $S_1, S_2, P_1, P_2$)}
  \end{align*}
  For each $\kweak[\Delta]{\phi}{\Gamma}$, by \Cref{def:neu-term-pred}:
  \begin{align*}
    &\exists v.\; \textsf{R}^{\textsf{Ne}}_{|\Delta|}(w) \searrow v \wedge
      \tyequiv[\Delta]{t[\phi]}{v}{S_1[\phi]}
      && \text{(Kripke condition at $w$)} \\
    &\subty[\Delta]{S_1[\phi]}{S_2[\phi]}
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:wk-typing} on the previous-block subtyping)} \\
    &\tyequiv[\Delta]{t[\phi]}{v}{S_2[\phi]}
      && \text{(by \textsc{Tm-Subsump} on the previous two lines)}
  \end{align*}
  Combining with $b \approx b' \in \textsf{Ne}$ (same readback at every depth) and
  the type predicate at $S_2$ (hypothesis), \Cref{def:neu-term-pred} gives
  $\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S_2} \;\circledR\; w \in \textsf{Neu}_i^{b'}$.

  \medskip\noindent
  \textbf{Case}
  \begin{mathpar}
    \inferrule[\textsc{$<$:-Univ}]
    {j \le k \\ k < i}
    {U_j \mathrel{<:_i} U_k}
  \end{mathpar}
  $\textbf{El}_1 \Leftrightarrow \textsf{Univ}_{i,j}^{\textbf{El}}$,
  $\textbf{El}_2 \Leftrightarrow \textsf{Univ}_{i,k}^{\textbf{El}}$. Given $\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S_1}
  \;\circledR\; b \in \textsf{Univ}_{i,j}^{\textbf{El}}$, so by
  \Cref{def:univ-term-pred}: $b \in \mathcal{U}_j^\ast \searrow P_b \searrow \textbf{El}_b$
  and $\typing[\Gamma]{t}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{j}}} \;\circledR\; P_b$.
  \begin{align*}
    &\exists P_b', \textbf{El}_b'.\; b \in \mathcal{U}_k^\ast \searrow P_b' \searrow \textbf{El}_b'
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:gluing-cumul} existence at $k$, since $j \le k$)} \\
    &\typing[\Gamma]{t}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{k}}} \;\circledR\; P_b'
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:gluing-cumul} (1) raising on $b$ from $j$ to $k$)} \\
    &\typing[\Gamma]{S_2}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; \textsf{Univ}_{i,k}
      && \text{(by hypothesis $P_2 = \textsf{Univ}_{i,k}$)} \\
    &\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S_2} \;\circledR\; b \in \textsf{Univ}_{i,k}^{\textbf{El}}
      && \text{(by \Cref{def:univ-term-pred} with the previous lines)}
  \end{align*}

  \medskip\noindent
  \textbf{Case}
  \begin{mathpar}
    \inferrule[\textsc{$<$:-Nat}]
    { }
    {N \mathrel{<:_i} N}
  \end{mathpar}
  $P_1 \Leftrightarrow \textbf{El}_1 \Leftrightarrow P_2 \Leftrightarrow \textbf{El}_2
  \Leftrightarrow \textsf{Nat}_i$. Given $\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S_1}
  \;\circledR\; b \in \textsf{Nat}_i$.
  \begin{align*}
    &\typing[\Gamma]{S_1}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; \textsf{Nat}_i
      && \text{(by \Cref{def:nat-term-pred} on the hypothesis)} \\
    &\subty[\Gamma]{S_1}{S_2}
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:gluing-subty-typ})} \\
    &\tyequiv[\Gamma]{S_1}{S_2}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}
      && \text{(by \Cref{def:nat-type-pred} on $S_1$ and $S_2$, both equal $\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}$)} \\
    &\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S_2} \;\circledR\; b \in \textsf{Nat}_i
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:gluing-respects-eq} (3) on $a = N$)}
  \end{align*}

  \medskip\noindent
  \textbf{Case}
  \begin{mathpar}
    \inferrule[\textsc{$<$:-Pi}]
    {A \approx A' \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R_I \\
     \forall\, \ensuremath{\mathcal{D}} :: a \approx a' \in R_I.\;
       \ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket(\rho, a/x)} \mathrel{<:_i} \ensuremath{\llbracket T' \rrbracket(\rho', a'/x)} \\\\
     \Pi(A, T, \rho) \approx \Pi(A, T, \rho) \in \mathcal{U}_i \\
     \Pi(A', T', \rho') \approx \Pi(A', T', \rho') \in \mathcal{U}_i}
    {\Pi(A, T, \rho) \mathrel{<:_i} \Pi(A', T', \rho')}
  \end{mathpar}
  $P_1 \Leftrightarrow \Pi_i(R_I, P_I, \textbf{El}_I, P_O)$,
  $\textbf{El}_1 \Leftrightarrow \Pi_i^{\textbf{El}}(R, R_I, P_I, \textbf{El}_I, \textbf{El}_O)$,
  $P_2 \Leftrightarrow \Pi_i(R_I, P_I, \textbf{El}_I, P_O')$,
  $\textbf{El}_2 \Leftrightarrow \Pi_i^{\textbf{El}}(R', R_I, P_I, \textbf{El}_I, \textbf{El}_O')$
  ($R_I, P_I, \textbf{El}_I$ shared via \Cref{lem:gluing-univ-equiv}, as the domains
  are PER-equal). The hypothesis $P_2$ has shape $\Pi(x:S_{2,1}).\,S_{2,2}$;
  similarly $S_1$ has shape $\Pi(x:S_{1,1}).\,S_{1,2}$ from the term-predicate
  hypothesis on $\textbf{El}_1$ via \Cref{def:pi-term-pred} clause 3.

  \emph{Setup: subtyping at the syntactic Pi-shapes.}
  \begin{align*}
    &\typing[\Gamma]{S_1}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; \Pi_i(R_I, P_I, \textbf{El}_I, P_O)
      && \text{(by \Cref{def:pi-term-pred} clause 3 on $f \in \textbf{El}_1$)} \\
    &\subty[\Gamma]{S_1}{S_2}
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:gluing-subty-typ})}
  \end{align*}

  Given $\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S_1} \;\circledR\; f \in \Pi_i^{\textbf{El}}$ at $\textbf{El}_1$.
  We verify the four clauses of $\textbf{El}_2 \Leftrightarrow \Pi_i^{\textbf{El}}(R', R_I,
  P_I, \textbf{El}_I, \textbf{El}_O')$ at $S_2, t, f$.

  \emph{Clause 1.}
  \begin{align*}
    &f \approx f \in R
      && \text{(by hypothesis clause 1 on $f \in \textbf{El}_1$)} \\
    &f \approx f \in R'
      && \text{(by \textsc{U-Pi}'s biconditional: domains equal,} \\
    & && \text{codomains $R_O \mathrel{<:_i} R_O'$ from the inner subtyping)}
  \end{align*}

  \emph{Clause 2.}
  \begin{align*}
    &\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S_1}
      && \text{(by hypothesis clause 2 on $f \in \textbf{El}_1$)} \\
    &\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S_2}
      && \text{(by \textsc{Subsump} with $\subty[\Gamma]{S_1}{S_2}$)}
  \end{align*}

  \emph{Clause 3.} $\typing[\Gamma]{S_2}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\;
  \Pi_i(R_I, P_I, \textbf{El}_I, P_O')$ holds directly by the lemma's hypothesis on
  $S_2, P_2$.

  \emph{Clause 4 (application).} Let $\kweak[\Delta]{\phi}{\Gamma}$, $s, b_0,
  \ensuremath{\mathcal{D}} :: b_0 \approx b_0 \in R_I$ with
  $\typing[\Delta]{s}{S_{2,1}[\phi]} \;\circledR\; b_0 \in \textbf{El}_I$.
  \begin{align*}
    &\typing[\Gamma]{S_{1,1}}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; P_I,\;
      \typing[\Gamma]{S_{2,1}}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; P_I
      && \text{(by clause 2 of $\Pi_i$ on $S_1, S_2$ at $\phi = \ensuremath{\textsf{id}}$)} \\
    &\tyequiv[\Gamma]{S_{1,1}}{S_{2,1}}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:gluing-functional} on the two predicates)} \\
    &\tyequiv[\Delta]{S_{1,1}[\phi]}{S_{2,1}[\phi]}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:wk-typing})} \\
    &\typing[\Delta]{s}{S_{1,1}[\phi]} \;\circledR\; b_0 \in \textbf{El}_I
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:gluing-respects-eq} (3) on the equality above)} \\
    &f \cdot b_0 \searrow c,\;
      \typing[\Delta]{(t[\phi])\;s}{S_{1,2}[\iota(\phi), s/x]}
      \;\circledR\; c \in \textbf{El}_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}})
      && \text{(by hypothesis clause 4 on $f \in \textbf{El}_1$)} \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket(\rho, b_0/x)} \mathrel{<:_i} \ensuremath{\llbracket T' \rrbracket(\rho', b_0/x)}
      && \text{(by codomain subtyping at $\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}} :: b_0 \approx b_0 \in R_I$)} \\
    &\typing[\Delta]{S_{2,2}[\iota(\phi), s/x]}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; P_O'(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}})
      && \text{(by clause 3 of $\Pi_i$ on $S_2$ at $\phi, s, b_0, \ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}$)} \\
    &\typing[\Delta]{(t[\phi])\;s}{S_{2,2}[\iota(\phi), s/x]}
      \;\circledR\; c \in \textbf{El}_O'(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}})
      && \text{(by IH (term-transfer) on the codomain subtyping at $\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}$,} \\
    & && \text{using the previous-line type-predicate at level $i$)}
  \end{align*}

  \emph{Clause 5 ($R_I$-coherence under application).} Inherited from
  clause 5 on $f \in \textbf{El}_1$, alongside the codomain subtyping: an
  $R_I$-class of arguments produces an $R_O'$-class of results in the
  codomain via clause 4.
<!-- end proof-117 -->
<!-- theorem-4: body_md -->
\label{thm:gluing-realizability}
  Suppose $a \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P \searrow \textbf{El}$.
  \begin{enumerate}
  \@idxitem\label{thm:bot-implies-el}
    \emph{($\textsf{Bot}$ enters $\textbf{El}$.)} If
    $\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S} \;\circledR\; w \in \textsf{Bot}_i^a$, then
    $\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S} \;\circledR\; {\uparrow}^a(w) \in \textbf{El}$.
  \@idxitem\label{thm:el-implies-nf}
    \emph{($\textbf{El}$ enters $\textsf{Top}$.)} If
    $\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S} \;\circledR\; b \in \textbf{El}$ and
    $b \approx b \in R$ (where $a \approx a \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R$), then
    $\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S} \;\circledR\; b \in \textsf{Top}_i^a$.
  \@idxitem\label{thm:gluing-types-readback}
    \emph{($P$ enters $\textsf{Top}$.)} If $\typing[\Gamma]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; P$,
    then $\typing[\Gamma]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; \textsf{Top}_i^a$.
  \end{enumerate}
<!-- end theorem-4 -->
<!-- proof-118: body_md -->
By simultaneous induction on the lexicographic pair
  $(i,\; a \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P \searrow \textbf{El})$: the outer induction on the
  level~$i$ provides the IH at strictly smaller levels, used in the
  \textsc{G-Univ} case; the inner induction on the gluing derivation provides
  the IH at structurally smaller derivations at the same level~$i$.

  \medskip\noindent
  \textbf{Case}
  \begin{mathpar}
    \inferrule[\textsc{G-Ne}]
    {a = {\uparrow}^A(e) \\
     P \Leftrightarrow \textsf{Neu}_i^e \\
     \textbf{El} \Leftrightarrow \textsf{Neu}_i^e}
    {{\uparrow}^A(e) \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast}
  \end{mathpar}
  \begin{enumerate}
  \@idxitem \emph{$\textsf{Bot}$ enters $\textbf{El}$.} Suppose
    $\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S} \;\circledR\; w \in \textsf{Bot}_i^a$. Unpacking
    \Cref{def:glu-wrapped} clauses (a)--(c) yields
    $\typing[\Gamma]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; \textsf{Neu}_i^e$ (the $P$-side
    component) and $\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S} \;\circledR\; w \in \textsf{Ne}_i^a$.
    These are exactly the four clauses of \Cref{def:neu-term-pred} for the
    term ${\uparrow}^A(w)$, hence
    $\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S} \;\circledR\; {\uparrow}^A(w) \in \textbf{El} \Leftrightarrow
    \textsf{Neu}_i^e$.
  \@idxitem \emph{$\textbf{El}$ enters $\textsf{Top}$.} Suppose
    $\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S} \;\circledR\; {\uparrow}^A(w) \in \textsf{Neu}_i^e$
    and ${\uparrow}^A(w) \approx {\uparrow}^A(w) \in R$. We assemble the three
    clauses of \Cref{def:glu-wrapped}(c). The type-side gluing
    $\typing[\Gamma]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; P \Leftrightarrow \textsf{Neu}_i^e$
    is the inner component of $\textsf{Neu}_i^e$ at term level. For
    $\textsf{Nf}_i^a$: for each $\kweak[\Delta]{\phi}{\Gamma}$, by \textsc{Rf-ne}:
    \begin{align*}
      &\textsf{R}^{\textsf{Nf}}_{|\Delta|}({\downarrow}^{{\uparrow}^A(e)}({\uparrow}^A(w))) \searrow v
        && \text{(via $\textsf{R}^{\textsf{Ne}}_{|\Delta|}(w) \searrow v$, by \textsc{Rf-ne})} \\
      &\tyequiv[\Delta]{t[\phi]}{v}{S[\phi]}
        && \text{(by \Cref{def:neu-term-pred})}
    \end{align*}
    This satisfies $\textsf{Nf}_i^a$, and packaged with $\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S}$ and
    the type gluing yields $\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S} \;\circledR\; {\uparrow}^A(w)
    \in \textsf{Top}_i^a$.
  \@idxitem \emph{$P$ enters $\textsf{Top}$.} Hypothesis:
    $\typing[\Gamma]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; \textsf{Neu}_i^e$. We assemble
    the three clauses of \Cref{def:glu-wrapped}(b). The first clause
    $\typing[\Gamma]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$ is part of $\textsf{Neu}_i^e$. For
    $a \approx a \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R$: by \Cref{lem:gluing-implies-per},
    the binary relation $R$ exists. For each
    $\kweak[\Delta]{\phi}{\Gamma}$:
    \begin{align*}
      &\textsf{R}^{\textsf{Ne}}_{|\Delta|}(e) \searrow u
        && \text{(by \Cref{def:neu-type-pred} applied to $\textsf{Neu}_i^e$)} \\
      &\textsf{R}^{\textsf{Ty}}_{|\Delta|}({\uparrow}^A(e)) \searrow u
        && \text{(by \textsc{Rty-ne})} \\
      &\tyequiv[\Delta]{S[\phi]}{u}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}
        && \text{(by \Cref{def:neu-type-pred})}
    \end{align*}
  \end{enumerate}

  \medskip\noindent
  \textbf{Case}
  \begin{mathpar}
    \inferrule[\textsc{G-Nat}]
    {P \Leftrightarrow \textsf{Nat}_i \\
     \textbf{El} \Leftrightarrow \textsf{Nat}_i}
    {N \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast}
  \end{mathpar}
  \begin{enumerate}
  \@idxitem \emph{$\textsf{Bot}$ enters $\textbf{El}$.} Suppose
    $\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S} \;\circledR\; w \in \textsf{Bot}_i^N$. Unpacking
    \Cref{def:glu-wrapped}(a) yields
    $\typing[\Gamma]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; \textsf{Nat}_i$ (which by
    \Cref{def:nat-type-pred} gives $\tyequiv[\Gamma]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$) and
    $\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S} \;\circledR\; w \in \textsf{Ne}_i^N$. The premises of
    \textsc{GN-Ne} are exactly these, hence ${\uparrow}^N(w) \in \textsf{Nat}_i$
    at $t$.
  \@idxitem \emph{$\textbf{El}$ enters $\textsf{Top}$.} Given
    $\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S} \;\circledR\; b \in \textsf{Nat}_i$ and
    $b \approx b \in R$ (where $R$ is the Nat-PER closure), we establish the
    three clauses of \Cref{def:glu-wrapped}(c). The type-side
    $\typing[\Gamma]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; \textsf{Nat}_i$ is part of
    \Cref{def:nat-term-pred}; for $\textsf{Nf}_i^N$, by inner induction on
    the derivation of $b \in \textsf{Nat}_i$.
    \begin{itemize}
    \@idxitem[Sub-case]
      \begin{mathpar}
        \inferrule[\textsc{GN-Ze}]
        {\tyequiv[\Gamma]{t}{\textsf{zero}}{S}}
        {\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S} \;\circledR\; \texttt{ze} \in \textsf{Nat}}
      \end{mathpar}
      For each $\kweak[\Delta]{\phi}{\Gamma}$:
      \begin{align*}
        &\textsf{R}^{\textsf{Nf}}_{|\Delta|}({\downarrow}^N(\texttt{ze})) \searrow \textsf{zero}
          && \text{(by \textsc{Rf-ze})} \\
        &\tyequiv[\Delta]{t[\phi]}{\textsf{zero}}{S[\phi]}
          && \text{(by \Cref{lem:wk-typing} on the hypothesis)}
      \end{align*}
    \@idxitem[Sub-case]
      \begin{mathpar}
        \inferrule[\textsc{GN-Su}]
        {\typing[\Gamma]{t'}{S} \;\circledR\; b' \in \textsf{Nat} \\
         \tyequiv[\Gamma]{t}{\textsf{succ}~t'}{S}}
        {\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S} \;\circledR\; \texttt{su}(b') \in \textsf{Nat}}
      \end{mathpar}
      For each $\kweak[\Delta]{\phi}{\Gamma}$:
      \begin{align*}
        &\textsf{R}^{\textsf{Nf}}_{|\Delta|}({\downarrow}^N(b')) \searrow w'
          && \text{(by inner IH on $b'$)} \\
        &\tyequiv[\Delta]{t'[\phi]}{w'}{S[\phi]}
          && \text{(by inner IH on $b'$)} \\
        &\textsf{R}^{\textsf{Nf}}_{|\Delta|}({\downarrow}^N(\texttt{su}(b'))) \searrow \textsf{succ}~w'
          && \text{(by \textsc{Rf-su})} \\
        &\tyequiv[\Delta]{\textsf{succ}~t'[\phi]}{\textsf{succ}~w'}{S[\phi]}
          && \text{(by \textsc{Su-Cong} on the previous line)} \\
        &\tyequiv[\Delta]{t[\phi]}{\textsf{succ}~w'}{S[\phi]}
          && \text{(by transitivity with the \textsc{GN-Su} hypothesis)}
      \end{align*}
    \@idxitem[Sub-case]
      \begin{mathpar}
        \inferrule[\textsc{GN-Ne}]
        {\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S} \;\circledR\; {\uparrow}^N(w) \in \textsf{Neu}_i^e}
        {\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S} \;\circledR\; {\uparrow}^N(w) \in \textsf{Nat}}
      \end{mathpar}
      For each $\kweak[\Delta]{\phi}{\Gamma}$:
      \begin{align*}
        &\textsf{R}^{\textsf{Ne}}_{|\Delta|}(w) \searrow v
          && \text{(by hypothesis on $w \in \textsf{Ne}_i^a$)} \\
        &\textsf{R}^{\textsf{Nf}}_{|\Delta|}({\downarrow}^N({\uparrow}^N(w))) \searrow v
          && \text{(by \textsc{Rf-ne})} \\
        &\tyequiv[\Delta]{t[\phi]}{v}{S[\phi]}
          && \text{(by hypothesis on $w$)}
      \end{align*}
    \end{itemize}
  \@idxitem \emph{$P$ enters $\textsf{Top}$.} Hypothesis:
    $\typing[\Gamma]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; \textsf{Nat}_i$. We assemble the
    three clauses of \Cref{def:glu-wrapped}(b). The first clause
    $\typing[\Gamma]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$ is part of \Cref{def:nat-type-pred} via
    presupposition. For $N \approx N \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R_N$: immediate by the
    PER definition. For each $\kweak[\Delta]{\phi}{\Gamma}$:
    \begin{align*}
      &\textsf{R}^{\textsf{Ty}}_{|\Delta|}(N) \searrow \ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}
        && \text{(by \textsc{Rty-N})} \\
      &\tyequiv[\Delta]{S[\phi]}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}
        && \text{(by \Cref{def:nat-type-pred})}
    \end{align*}
  \end{enumerate}

  \medskip\noindent
  \textbf{Case}
  \begin{mathpar}
    \inferrule[\textsc{G-Pi}]
    {a = \Pi(a_I, T, \rho) \\
     a_I \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P_I \searrow \textbf{El}_I \\\\
     \forall\,\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}} :: b \approx b \in R_I,\; c.\;
       \ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket(\rho, b/x)} \searrow c \implies
       c \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}) \searrow \textbf{El}_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}) \\\\
     P \Leftrightarrow \Pi_i(R_I, P_I, P_O) \\
     \textbf{El} \Leftrightarrow \Pi_i^{\textbf{El}}(R, R_I, P_I, \textbf{El}_I, \textbf{El}_O)}
    {\Pi(a_I, T, \rho) \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast}
  \end{mathpar}
  By inner IH-(1) on $a_I$, neutral inhabitants enter $\textbf{El}_I$; by inner IH-(2) on
  $a_I$, $\textbf{El}_I$-elements read back; analogously for $\textbf{El}_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}})$ at each
  $\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}$.
  \begin{enumerate}
  \@idxitem \emph{$\textsf{Bot}$ enters $\textbf{El}$.} Suppose
    \[
      \typing[\Gamma]{t}{S} \;\circledR\; w \in \textsf{Bot}_i^a.
    \]
    Unpacking \Cref{def:glu-wrapped}(a) yields
    \[
      \typing[\Gamma]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\;
      \Pi_i(R_I, P_I, \textbf{El}_I, P_O)
    \]
    together with
    $\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S} \;\circledR\; w \in \textsf{Ne}_i^a$.
    We verify the four clauses of \Cref{def:pi-term-pred}
    for ${\uparrow}^a(w)$.
    \begin{enumerate}
    \@idxitem[(1)] Self-relatedness ${\uparrow}^a(w) \approx {\uparrow}^a(w) \in R$
      holds by \textsc{U-Ne} of the PER closure.
    \@idxitem[(2)] Coherence under $R_I$: trivial because the function value does not
      depend on a representative of $R_I$ on the left of the predicate.
    \@idxitem[(3)] For each $\kweak[\Delta]{\phi}{\Gamma}$, $\textsf{R}^{\textsf{Ne}}_{|\Delta|}(w) \searrow v$
      by hypothesis on $w \in \textsf{Ne}$, so the type readback obligation holds via
      \Cref{def:pi-type-pred}.
    \@idxitem[(4)] Application: given $\kweak[\Delta]{\phi}{\Gamma}$ and
      $\typing[\Delta]{s}{S_1[\phi]} \;\circledR\; b \in \textbf{El}_I$ with
      $\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}} :: b \approx b \in R_I$ (by inner IH-(1) bridging through
      \Cref{lem:gluing-implies-per}, applied to $b$):
      \begin{align*}
        &\ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket(\rho, b/x)} \searrow c_b
          && \text{(evaluation of $T$ at $\rho, b/x$; well-defined since
            $\Pi(a_I, T, \rho) \approx \Pi(a_I, T, \rho) \in \mathcal{U}_i$)} \\
        &c_b \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}) \searrow \textbf{El}_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}})
          && \text{(by the \textsc{G-Pi} codomain clause applied to $\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}$ and $c_b$)} \\
        &b \in \textsf{Nf}_i^{a_I}
          && \text{(by inner IH-(2) on $a_I$ applied to $b \in \textbf{El}_I$)} \\
        &\textsf{R}^{\textsf{Nf}}_{|\Delta|}({\downarrow}^{a_I}(b)) \searrow u_b
          && \text{(by the previous line)} \\
        &{\uparrow}^a(w) \cdot b \searrow
          {\uparrow}^{c_b}(w \;\$\; {\downarrow}^{a_I}(b))
          && \text{(by neutral application)} \\
        &w \;\$\; {\downarrow}^{a_I}(b) \in \textsf{Ne}_i^{c_b}
          && \text{(by \textsc{Rne-app}, using
            $\textsf{R}^{\textsf{Ne}}_{|\Delta|}(w)$ and $u_b$)} \\
        &\typing[\Delta]{(t[\phi])\;s}{S_2[\iota(\phi), s/x]} \\
        & \quad \;\circledR\;
          {\uparrow}^{c_b}(w \;\$\; {\downarrow}^{a_I}(b)) \in \textbf{El}_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}})
          && \text{(by inner IH-(1) on $c_b$)}
      \end{align*}
    \end{enumerate}
  \@idxitem \emph{$\textbf{El}$ enters $\textsf{Top}$.} Suppose
    $\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S} \;\circledR\; f \in \Pi_i^{\textbf{El}}(R, R_I, P_I, \textbf{El}_I, \textbf{El}_O)$
    and $f \approx f \in R$. We assemble the three clauses of
    \Cref{def:glu-wrapped}(c). The type-side $\typing[\Gamma]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}
    \;\circledR\; \Pi_i(R_I, P_I, \textbf{El}_I, P_O)$ is part of
    \Cref{def:pi-term-pred}; the term-typing $\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S}$ likewise.
    For $\textsf{Nf}_i^a$, for
    each $\kweak[\Delta]{\phi}{\Gamma}$, set $n := |\Delta|$ and form
    $\Delta' := \Delta, x' : S_1[\phi]$ together with the lifted Kripke weakening
    $\phi \circ \Uparrow$ (by \textsc{KW-Shift}; \Cref{lem:kweak-comp}).
    \begin{align*}
      &\typing[\Delta']{x'}{S_1[\phi \circ \Uparrow]}
        \;\circledR\; {\uparrow}^{a_I}(\ell_n) \in \textbf{El}_I
        && \text{(by inner IH-(1) on $a_I$ applied to $\ell_n$)} \\
      &f \cdot {\uparrow}^{a_I}(\ell_n) \searrow c
        && \text{(by clause (4) of $\Pi_i^{\textbf{El}}$ on $f$)} \\
      &\typing[\Delta']{(t[\phi \circ \Uparrow])\;x'}
                       {S_2[\iota(\phi \circ \Uparrow), x'/x]}
        \;\circledR\; c \in \textbf{El}_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}')
        && \text{(by clause (4) on $f$, with $\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}'$ the witness from line 1)} \\
      &c \in \textsf{Nf}_i^{c_{\ell_n}}
        && \text{(by inner IH-(2) on $c_{\ell_n} \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast$)} \\
      &\textsf{R}^{\textsf{Nf}}_{n+1}({\downarrow}^{c_{\ell_n}}(c)) \searrow v
        && \text{(by the previous line)} \\
      &\tyequiv[\Delta']{(t[\phi \circ \Uparrow])\;x'}{v}
                       {S_2[\iota(\phi \circ \Uparrow), x'/x]}
        && \text{(by inner IH-(2) on $c_{\ell_n}$)} \\
      &\textsf{R}^{\textsf{Nf}}_n({\downarrow}^a(f)) \searrow \lambda x.\,v
        && \text{(by \textsc{Rf-Pi}, using the previous line)} \\
      &\tyequiv[\Delta]{t[\phi]}{\lambda x.\,(t[\phi \circ \Uparrow])\;x'}
                       {S[\phi]}
        && \text{(by \textsc{$\Pi$-$\eta$})} \\
      &\tyequiv[\Delta]{t[\phi]}{\lambda x.\,v}{S[\phi]}
        && \text{(by congruence with the $\textsf{R}^{\textsf{Nf}}$ equality)}
    \end{align*}
  \@idxitem \emph{$P$ enters $\textsf{Top}$.} Hypothesis: $\typing[\Gamma]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}
    \;\circledR\; \Pi_i(R_I, P_I, \textbf{El}_I, P_O)$. We assemble the three clauses
    of \Cref{def:glu-wrapped}(b). The first clause $\typing[\Gamma]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$
    is part of \Cref{def:pi-type-pred}. For $a \approx a \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R$:
    by \Cref{lem:gluing-implies-per} on the components $a_I$ and $c$ at each
    $\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}$, the binary closure exists. For each
    $\kweak[\Delta]{\phi}{\Gamma}$, set $n := |\Delta|$:
    \begin{align*}
      &\textsf{R}^{\textsf{Ty}}_n(a_I) \searrow W_S,\;
        \tyequiv[\Delta]{S_1[\phi]}{W_S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}
        && \text{(by inner IH-(3) on $a_I$)} \\
      &\ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket(\rho, {\uparrow}^{a_I}(\ell_n)/x)} \searrow c_{\ell_n}
        && \text{(by \Cref{def:pi-type-pred})} \\
      &\textsf{R}^{\textsf{Ty}}_{n+1}(c_{\ell_n}) \searrow W_T
        && \text{(by inner IH-(3) on $c_{\ell_n}$)} \\
      &\tyequiv[\Delta, x' : S_1[\phi]]{S_2[\iota(\phi \circ \Uparrow), x'/x]}
                                       {W_T}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}
        && \text{(by inner IH-(3) on $c_{\ell_n}$)} \\
      &\textsf{R}^{\textsf{Ty}}_n(\Pi(a_I, T, \rho)) \searrow \Pi(x:W_S).\,W_T
        && \text{(by \textsc{Rty-Pi})} \\
      &\tyequiv[\Delta]{S[\phi]}{\Pi(x:W_S).\,W_T}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}
        && \text{(by \Cref{def:pi-type-pred} clauses 1--3 and \textsc{$\Pi$-Cong})}
    \end{align*}
  \end{enumerate}

  \medskip\noindent
  \textbf{Case}
  \begin{mathpar}
    \inferrule[\textsc{G-Univ}]
    {j < i \\
     P \Leftrightarrow \textsf{Univ}_{i,j} \\
     \textbf{El} \Leftrightarrow \textsf{Univ}_{i,j}^{\textbf{El}}}
    {U_j \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast}
  \end{mathpar}
  Since $j < i$, the outer-IH applies at level $j$ to every value $b \in \mathcal{U}_j^\ast$.
  \begin{enumerate}
  \@idxitem \emph{$\textsf{Bot}$ enters $\textbf{El}$.} Suppose
    $\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S} \;\circledR\; w \in \textsf{Bot}_i^{U_j}$. Unpacking
    \Cref{def:glu-wrapped}(a) yields $\typing[\Gamma]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\;
    \textsf{Univ}_{i,j}$ and $\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S} \;\circledR\; w \in
    \textsf{Ne}_i^{U_j}$. Apply \textsc{G-Ne} at level $j$:
    \begin{align*}
      &{\uparrow}^A(w) \in \mathcal{U}_j^\ast \searrow \textsf{Neu}_j^e \searrow \textsf{Neu}_j^e
        && \text{(by \textsc{G-Ne} at level $j$)} \\
      &\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S} \;\circledR\; {\uparrow}^A(w) \in \mathcal{U}_j^\ast
        && \text{(by \Cref{def:univ-term-pred} clause (1) with the previous line)} \\
      &\typing[\Gamma]{t}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{j}}} \;\circledR\; \textsf{Neu}_j^e
        && \text{(by \Cref{def:univ-term-pred} clause (2);} \\
    & && \text{the type predicate attached to ${\uparrow}^A(w)$ is} \\
    & && \text{$\textsf{Neu}_j^e$, which by hypothesis on $w$ inhabits} \\
    & && \text{the type-predicate condition; the equality} \\
    & && \text{$\tyequiv[\Gamma]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{j}}}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$ comes from \Cref{def:univ-type-pred})}
    \end{align*}
  \@idxitem \emph{$\textbf{El}$ enters $\textsf{Top}$.} Suppose
    $\typing[\Gamma]{t}{S} \;\circledR\; b \in \textsf{Univ}_{i,j}^{\textbf{El}}$ and
    $b \approx b \in R$. By \Cref{def:univ-term-pred}, $b \in \mathcal{U}_j^\ast
    \searrow P_b \searrow \textbf{El}_b$ for some $P_b, \textbf{El}_b$, with
    $\typing[\Gamma]{t}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{j}}} \;\circledR\; P_b$ at the type level. We
    assemble \Cref{def:glu-wrapped}(c). The $P$-side
    $\typing[\Gamma]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; \textsf{Univ}_{i,j}$ comes from
    \Cref{def:univ-term-pred}; for $\textsf{Nf}_i^{U_j}$, for each
    $\kweak[\Delta]{\phi}{\Gamma}$, $n := |\Delta|$:
    \begin{align*}
      &\textsf{R}^{\textsf{Ty}}_n(b) \searrow W
        && \text{(by outer-IH-(3) on $b \in \mathcal{U}_j^\ast$)} \\
      &\tyequiv[\Delta]{t[\phi]}{W}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{j}}}
        && \text{(by outer-IH-(3) on $b$)} \\
      &\textsf{R}^{\textsf{Nf}}_n({\downarrow}^{U_j}(b)) \searrow W
        && \text{(by \textsc{Rf-Univ})} \\
      &\tyequiv[\Delta]{t[\phi]}{W}{S[\phi]}
        && \text{(by \Cref{def:univ-type-pred}:
          $\tyequiv[\Delta]{S[\phi]}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{j}}}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$,} \\
      & && \text{and \textsc{Subsump} from the $\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{j}}$-equality)}
    \end{align*}
  \@idxitem \emph{$P$ enters $\textsf{Top}$.} Hypothesis: $\typing[\Gamma]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}
    \;\circledR\; \textsf{Univ}_{i,j}$. We assemble
    \Cref{def:glu-wrapped}(b). The first clause is from
    \Cref{def:univ-type-pred}; for $U_j \approx U_j \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R$,
    immediate from \textsc{U-Univ} of the PER. For each
    $\kweak[\Delta]{\phi}{\Gamma}$:
    \begin{align*}
      &\textsf{R}^{\textsf{Ty}}_{|\Delta|}(U_j) \searrow \ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{j}}
        && \text{(by \textsc{Rty-Univ})} \\
      &\tyequiv[\Delta]{S[\phi]}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{j}}}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}
        && \text{(by \Cref{def:univ-type-pred})}
    \end{align*}
  \end{enumerate}
<!-- end proof-118 -->
<!-- lemma-115: body_md -->
\label{lem:init-env-valid}
  If $\Gamma \searrow \textsf{Sb}$, then
  $\judge[\Gamma]{\ensuremath{\textsf{id}} : \Gamma} \;\circledR\; {\uparrow}^\Gamma \in \textsf{Sb}$.
<!-- end lemma-115 -->
<!-- proof-119: body_md -->
By induction on $\Gamma \searrow \textsf{Sb}$.

  \medskip\noindent
  \textbf{Case}
  \begin{mathpar}
    \inferrule[\textsc{G-Ctx-$\cdot$}]
    {\textsf{Sb} \Leftrightarrow (\judge[\Delta]{\sigma : \cdot})}
    {\cdot \searrow \textsf{Sb}}
  \end{mathpar}
  $\judge[\cdot]{\ensuremath{\textsf{id}} : \cdot}$ holds trivially, hence
  $\judge[\cdot]{\ensuremath{\textsf{id}} : \cdot} \;\circledR\; {\uparrow}^\cdot \in \textsf{Sb}$.

  \medskip\noindent
  \textbf{Case}
  \begin{mathpar}
    \inferrule[\textsc{G-Ctx-Ext}]
    {\Gamma' \searrow \textsf{Sb}' \\
     \typing[\Gamma']{S_k}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \\\\
     \forall \Delta_0, \sigma_T, \rho_T.\;
       \judge[\Delta_0]{\sigma_T : \Gamma'} \;\circledR\; \rho_T \in \textsf{Sb}'
       \implies \\
     \quad \exists a, P, \textbf{El}.\;
       \ensuremath{\llbracket S_k \rrbracket(\rho_T)} \searrow a \;\wedge\;
       a \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P \searrow \textbf{El} \;\wedge\;
       \typing[\Delta_0]{S_k[\sigma_T]}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; P \\\\
     \textsf{Sb} \Leftrightarrow \textsf{Cons}_i(\Gamma', S_k, \textsf{Sb}')}
    {(\Gamma', x_k : S_k) \searrow \textsf{Sb}}
  \end{mathpar}
  Set $\Gamma := \Gamma', x_k : S_k$ with $|\Gamma| = k+1$.
  \begin{align*}
    &\judge[\Gamma']{\ensuremath{\textsf{id}} : \Gamma'} \;\circledR\; {\uparrow}^{\Gamma'} \in \textsf{Sb}'
      && \text{(by IH on $\Gamma' \searrow \textsf{Sb}'$)} \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket S_k \rrbracket({\uparrow}^{\Gamma'})} \searrow A_k,\;
      A_k \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P_k \searrow \textbf{El}_k
      && \text{(by the universal type-clause of \textsc{G-Ctx-Ext}} \\
    & && \text{instantiated at $\ensuremath{\textsf{id}}, {\uparrow}^{\Gamma'}$)} \\
    &\typing[\Gamma']{S_k[\ensuremath{\textsf{id}}]}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; P_k
      && \text{(type clause at the same instantiation)} \\
    &\typing[\Gamma']{S_k}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; P_k
      && \text{(using $S_k[\ensuremath{\textsf{id}}] = S_k$)}
  \end{align*}
  We supply the head witness for $\textsf{Cons}_i$:
  \begin{align*}
    &{\uparrow}^\Gamma = ({\uparrow}^{\Gamma'},\, {\uparrow}^{A_k}(\ell_k)/x_k)
      && \text{(by \Cref{def:init-env})} \\
    &\typing[\Gamma]{x_k}{S_k[\Uparrow]}
      && \text{(by \textsc{Var-Hd})} \\
    &\textsf{R}^{\textsf{Ne}}_{|\Delta'|}(\ell_k) \searrow x_{|\Delta'| - k - 1}
      \text{ for each $\kweak[\Delta']{\phi}{\Gamma}$}
      && \text{(by \textsc{Rne-var}, the level-reading rule for $\ell_k$)} \\
    &\tyequiv[\Delta']{x_k[\phi]}{x_{|\Delta'| - k - 1}}{S_k[\Uparrow][\phi]}
      && \text{(by the syntactic action of $\phi$ on the variable $x_k$)} \\
    &\typing[\Gamma]{x_k}{S_k[\Uparrow]} \;\circledR\;
      \ell_k \in \textsf{Ne}_i^{A_k}
      && \text{(by \Cref{def:neu-term-pred}, using the previous two lines)} \\
    &\typing[\Gamma]{x_k}{S_k[\Uparrow]} \;\circledR\;
      {\uparrow}^{A_k}(\ell_k) \in \textbf{El}_k
      && \text{(by \Cref{thm:gluing-realizability} part (1) on $A_k$)} \\
    &\judge[\Gamma]{\ensuremath{\textsf{id}} : \Gamma} \;\circledR\;
      {\uparrow}^\Gamma \in \textsf{Sb}
      && \text{(by $\textsf{Cons}_i$ assembly: tail (IH) and head witness above)}
  \end{align*}
<!-- end proof-119 -->
<!-- lemma-116: body_md -->
\label{lem:fund-sound-ctx-emp}
  $\Vdash \cdot$.
<!-- end lemma-116 -->
<!-- proof-120: body_md -->
By \textsc{G-Ctx-$\cdot$}: $\cdot \searrow \textsf{Sb}$ where
  $\textsf{Sb} \Leftrightarrow (\judge[\Delta]{\sigma : \cdot})$.
  Hence $\Vdash \cdot$ by \Cref{def:sound-semctx}.
<!-- end proof-120 -->
<!-- lemma-117: body_md -->
\label{lem:fund-sound-ctx-ext}
  If $\Vdash \Gamma$ and $\Semtyp[\Gamma]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$, then $\Vdash \Gamma, x:S$.
<!-- end lemma-117 -->
<!-- proof-121: body_md -->
By $\Vdash \Gamma$, fix $\Gamma \searrow \textsf{Sb}_T$ for some $\textsf{Sb}_T$.
  We supply each premise of \textsc{G-Ctx-Ext}.

  \emph{Syntactic typing of $S$.}
  By \Cref{lem:init-env-valid} on $\Gamma \searrow \textsf{Sb}_T$, the initial
  pair $\judge[\Gamma]{\ensuremath{\textsf{id}} : \Gamma} \;\circledR\; {\uparrow}^\Gamma \in \textsf{Sb}_T$
  is in $\textsf{Sb}_T$. By $\Semtyp[\Gamma]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$ at this pair,
  $\typing[\Gamma]{S[\ensuremath{\textsf{id}}]}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; P$ for some $P$, hence
  $\typing[\Gamma]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$ by \Cref{lem:gluing-typ-escape} (using
  $S[\ensuremath{\textsf{id}}] = S$).

  \emph{Universal type-clause.}
  Let $\judge[\Delta']{\sigma_T : \Gamma} \;\circledR\; \rho_T \in \textsf{Sb}_T$
  be arbitrary. By $\Semtyp[\Gamma]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$ at $\sigma_T, \rho_T$:
  \begin{align*}
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket S \rrbracket(\rho_T)} \searrow a,\;
      a \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P \searrow \textbf{El}
      && \text{(by $\Semtyp[\Gamma]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$ at $\sigma_T, \rho_T$)} \\
    &\typing[\Delta']{S[\sigma_T]}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; P
      && \text{(by $\Semtyp[\Gamma]{S}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$, type part)}
  \end{align*}
  This supplies the universal-clause witness for the given
  $\sigma_T, \rho_T$.

  By \textsc{G-Ctx-Ext}: $(\Gamma, x:S) \searrow \textsf{Sb}$ where
  $\textsf{Sb} \Leftrightarrow \textsf{Cons}_i(\Gamma, S, \textsf{Sb}_T)$.
  Hence $\Vdash \Gamma, x:S$ by \Cref{def:sound-semctx}.
<!-- end proof-121 -->
<!-- lemma-118: body_md -->
\label{lem:fund-sound-var}
  If $\Vdash \Gamma$ and $x : S \in \Gamma$, then $\Semtyp[\Gamma]{x}{S}$.
<!-- end lemma-118 -->
<!-- proof-122: body_md -->
By $\Vdash \Gamma$, fix $\Gamma \searrow \textsf{Sb}$ and let
  $\judge[\Delta]{\sigma : \Gamma} \;\circledR\; \rho \in \textsf{Sb}$ be given.
  We proceed by induction on the lookup derivation $x : S \in \Gamma$.

  \medskip\noindent
  \textbf{Case}
  \begin{mathpar}
    \inferrule[\textsc{Var-Hd}]
    { }
    {x_0 : T[\Uparrow] \in \Gamma_0, x_0 : T}
  \end{mathpar}
  Here $\Gamma = \Gamma_0, x_0:T$ and $S = T[\Uparrow]$. We must show
  $\Semtyp[\Gamma]{x_0}{T[\Uparrow]}$: for the given
  $\judge[\Delta]{\sigma : \Gamma} \;\circledR\; \rho \in \textsf{Sb}$,
  evaluating $T[\Uparrow]$ at $\rho$ yields a value $a^\ast$ with
  $a^\ast \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P^\ast \searrow \textbf{El}^\ast$, and:
  \begin{enumerate}
  \@idxitem $\typing[\Delta]{T[\Uparrow \circ \sigma]}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; P^\ast$, and
  \@idxitem $\typing[\Delta]{x_0[\sigma]}{T[\Uparrow \circ \sigma]} \;\circledR\;
    \ensuremath{\llbracket x_0 \rrbracket(\rho)} \in \textbf{El}^\ast$.
  \end{enumerate}

  Since $\Gamma = \Gamma_0, x_0:T$, the gluing $\Gamma \searrow \textsf{Sb}$
  is by \textsc{G-Ctx-Ext} on $\Gamma_0 \searrow \textsf{Sb}_{T_0}$ with
  $\typing[\Gamma_0]{T}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$, and
  $\textsf{Sb} \Leftrightarrow \textsf{Cons}_i(\Gamma_0, T, \textsf{Sb}_{T_0})$.
  Unfolding $\textsf{Cons}_i$ at our $\sigma, \rho$ (which provides existential
  $a, P, \textbf{El}$ specific to this $\sigma, \rho$):
  \begin{align*}
    &\judge[\Delta]{\Uparrow \circ \sigma : \Gamma_0} \;\circledR\;
      \rho[\Uparrow] \in \textsf{Sb}_{T_0}
      && \text{(tail of $\textsf{Cons}_i$)} \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket(\rho[\Uparrow])} \searrow a,\;
      a \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P \searrow \textbf{El}
      && \text{(type clause of $\textsf{Cons}_i$)} \\
    &\typing[\Delta]{T[\Uparrow \circ \sigma]}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; P
      && \text{(type clause of $\textsf{Cons}_i$)} \\
    &\typing[\Delta]{x_0[\sigma]}{T[\Uparrow \circ \sigma]} \;\circledR\;
      \rho(x_0) \in \textbf{El}
      && \text{(head of $\textsf{Cons}_i$)} \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket x_0 \rrbracket(\rho)} = \rho(x_0)
      && \text{(by \textsc{ev-var})}
  \end{align*}

  \emph{Establishing the goal $\ensuremath{\llbracket T[\Uparrow] \rrbracket(\rho)} \searrow a^\ast$ at the
  same $(P, \textbf{El})$.}
  The $\textsf{Cons}_i$ type clause gives $\ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket(\rho[\Uparrow])} \searrow a$,
  but the goal needs $\ensuremath{\llbracket T[\Uparrow] \rrbracket(\rho)} \searrow a^\ast$. By
  \Cref{thm:fundamental} of \Cref{sec:comp} on $\typing[\Gamma_0]{T}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$,
  $\semtyeq[\Gamma_0]{T}{T}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$. Instantiate this at $\Uparrow$ and $\rho$
  (self-related in $R_\Gamma$):
  \begin{align*}
    &\semweak[\Gamma]{\Uparrow}{\Gamma_0}
      && \text{(by \textsc{KW-Shift})} \\
    &\semtyeq[\Gamma]{\Uparrow}{\Uparrow}{\Gamma_0}
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:sem-wk})} \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket T[\Uparrow] \rrbracket(\rho)} \approx \ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \Uparrow \rrbracket(\rho)})} \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R
      && \text{(four-value pattern of $\semtyeq[\Gamma_0]{T}{T}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$ at
        $\Uparrow, \rho$)} \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket \Uparrow \rrbracket(\rho)} = \rho[\Uparrow]
      && \text{(by definition of weakening evaluation, \Cref{sec:sem})} \\
    &a^\ast \approx a \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R
      && \text{(rewriting $\ensuremath{\llbracket T[\Uparrow] \rrbracket(\rho)} = a^\ast$ and
        $\ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket(\rho[\Uparrow])} = a$)} \\
    &a^\ast \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P \searrow \textbf{El}
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:gluing-univ-equiv} from
        $a \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P \searrow \textbf{El}$)}
  \end{align*}
  This supplies the goal evaluation $\ensuremath{\llbracket T[\Uparrow] \rrbracket(\rho)} \searrow a^\ast$
  with $a^\ast \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P \searrow \textbf{El}$, where $(P, \textbf{El})$ are
  the same predicates packaged by $\textsf{Cons}_i$. Clauses (1) and (2) of
  $\Semtyp[\Gamma]{x_0}{T[\Uparrow]}$ are exactly the $\textsf{Cons}_i$ type
  clause $\typing[\Delta]{T[\Uparrow \circ \sigma]}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; P$
  and the head's $\textbf{El}$-witness $\rho(x_0) = \ensuremath{\llbracket x_0 \rrbracket(\rho)}$ above.

  \medskip\noindent
  \textbf{Case}
  \begin{mathpar}
    \inferrule[\textsc{Var-Tl}]
    {y : S' \in \Gamma_0}
    {1{+}y : S'[\Uparrow] \in \Gamma_0, z:T}
  \end{mathpar}
  Here $\Gamma = \Gamma_0, z:T$, $x = 1{+}y$ for some $y$ with $y : S' \in \Gamma_0$,
  and $S = S'[\Uparrow]$. We must show $\Semtyp[\Gamma]{1{+}y}{S'[\Uparrow]}$:
  evaluating $S'[\Uparrow]$ at $\rho$ yields a value $a^\ast$ in
  $\mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P^\ast \searrow \textbf{El}^\ast$, with the type and term
  predicates at $\sigma, \rho$.
  $\textsf{Sb}$ unfolds to $\textsf{Cons}_i$ at $\sigma, \rho$, giving the
  tail $\Uparrow \circ \sigma, \rho[\Uparrow] \in \textsf{Sb}_T$.

  \emph{Apply IH on the tail.}
  \begin{align*}
    &\judge[\Delta]{\Uparrow \circ \sigma : \Gamma_0}
      \;\circledR\; \rho[\Uparrow] \in \textsf{Sb}_T
      && \text{(tail of $\textsf{Cons}_i$)} \\
    &y : S' \in \Gamma_0
      && \text{(premise)} \\
    &\Semtyp[\Gamma_0]{y}{S'}
      && \text{(by IH on the shorter lookup derivation,} \\
    & && \text{with $\Vdash \Gamma_0$ from $\Vdash \Gamma$ via the tail)} \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket S' \rrbracket(\rho[\Uparrow])} \searrow b,\;
      b \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P' \searrow \textbf{El}'
      && \text{(by IH on $S'$ at $\Uparrow \circ \sigma, \rho[\Uparrow]$)} \\
    &\typing[\Delta]{S'[\Uparrow \circ \sigma]}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; P'
      && \text{(by IH on $S'$, type part)} \\
    &\typing[\Delta]{y[\Uparrow \circ \sigma]}{S'[\Uparrow \circ \sigma]}
      \;\circledR\; \ensuremath{\llbracket y \rrbracket(\rho[\Uparrow])} \in \textbf{El}'
      && \text{(by IH on $y$, term part)}
  \end{align*}

  \emph{Bridging the goal evaluation $\ensuremath{\llbracket S'[\Uparrow] \rrbracket(\rho)}$ to $b$.}
  By \Cref{thm:fundamental} of \Cref{sec:comp} on $\typing[\Gamma_0]{S'}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$
  (extracted from the IH via \Cref{lem:gluing-typ-escape}):
  $\semtyeq[\Gamma_0]{S'}{S'}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$. Instantiating at $\Uparrow$ and $\rho$
  (self-related in $R_\Gamma$):
  \begin{align*}
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket \Uparrow \rrbracket(\rho)} = \rho[\Uparrow]
      && \text{(by definition of weakening evaluation, \Cref{sec:sem})} \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket S'[\Uparrow] \rrbracket(\rho)} \approx \ensuremath{\llbracket S' \rrbracket(\rho[\Uparrow])} \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R'
      && \text{(four-value pattern of $\semtyeq[\Gamma_0]{S'}{S'}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$ at
        $\Uparrow, \rho$)} \\
    &a^\ast \approx b \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R'
      && \text{(rewriting $\ensuremath{\llbracket S'[\Uparrow] \rrbracket(\rho)} = a^\ast$ and
        $\ensuremath{\llbracket S' \rrbracket(\rho[\Uparrow])} = b$)} \\
    &a^\ast \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P' \searrow \textbf{El}'
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:gluing-univ-equiv} from
        $b \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P' \searrow \textbf{El}'$)}
  \end{align*}
  The term-side equality $\ensuremath{\llbracket 1{+}y \rrbracket(\rho)} = \ensuremath{\llbracket y \rrbracket(\rho[\Uparrow])}$ holds
  directly: $\ensuremath{\llbracket 1{+}y \rrbracket(\rho)} = \rho(1{+}y) = \rho[\Uparrow](y) = \ensuremath{\llbracket y \rrbracket(\rho[\Uparrow])}$
  (variable lookup), so no bridging is needed for the term side.

  \emph{Assembling the goal.}
  \begin{align*}
    &(1{+}y)[\sigma] = y[\Uparrow \circ \sigma]
      && \text{(by syntactic action and \Cref{lem:subst-assoc})} \\
    &S'[\Uparrow][\sigma] = S'[\Uparrow \circ \sigma]
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:subst-assoc})} \\
    &\typing[\Delta]{(1{+}y)[\sigma]}{S'[\Uparrow][\sigma]}
      \;\circledR\; \ensuremath{\llbracket 1{+}y \rrbracket(\rho)} \in \textbf{El}'
      && \text{(rewriting the IH instance via the previous identities)}
  \end{align*}
  This supplies the goal at $a^\ast \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P' \searrow \textbf{El}'$.
<!-- end proof-122 -->
<!-- lemma-119: body_md -->
\label{lem:fund-sound-u-wf}
  If $\Vdash \Gamma$ and $j < i$, then $\Semtyp[\Gamma]{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{j}}}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$.
<!-- end lemma-119 -->
<!-- proof-123: body_md -->
By $\Vdash \Gamma$, fix $\Gamma \searrow \textsf{Sb}$ and let
  $\judge[\Delta]{\sigma : \Gamma} \;\circledR\; \rho \in \textsf{Sb}$ be given.
  Type is $\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}$, sitting at universe-level $1+i$. We establish the four
  clauses of $\Semtyp[\Gamma]{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{j}}}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$ at $a = U_i$,
  $P = \textsf{Univ}_{1+i, i}$, $\textbf{El} = \textsf{Univ}_{1+i, i}^{\textbf{El}}$.
  \begin{align*}
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket \ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}} \rrbracket(\rho)} \searrow U_i
      && \text{(by \textsc{ev-U})} \tag*{[clause 1]} \\
    &U_i \in \mathcal{U}_{1+i}^\ast \searrow \textsf{Univ}_{1+i, i} \searrow
      \textsf{Univ}_{1+i, i}^{\textbf{El}}
      && \text{(by \textsc{G-Univ})} \tag*{[clause 2]} \\
    &\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}[\sigma] = \ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}
      && \text{(syntactic; closed)} \\
    &\tyequiv[\Delta]{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}[\sigma]}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{1+i}}}
      && \text{(by reflexivity)} \\
    &\typing[\Delta]{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}[\sigma]}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{1+i}}} \;\circledR\;
      \textsf{Univ}_{1+i, i}
      && \text{(by \Cref{def:univ-type-pred})} \tag*{[clause 3]} \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket \ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{j}} \rrbracket(\rho)} \searrow U_j
      && \text{(by \textsc{ev-U})} \\
    &U_j \in \mathcal{U}_{1+j}^\ast \searrow \textsf{Univ}_{1+j, j} \searrow
      \textsf{Univ}_{1+j, j}^{\textbf{El}}
      && \text{(by \textsc{G-Univ} at level $1+j$)} \\
    &U_j \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow \textsf{Univ}_{i, j} \searrow
      \textsf{Univ}_{i, j}^{\textbf{El}}
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:gluing-cumul} from $1+j \le i$, since $j < i$)} \\
    &\tyequiv[\Delta]{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{j}}[\sigma]}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{j}}}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}
      && \text{(by reflexivity, $j < i$)} \\
    &\typing[\Delta]{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{j}}[\sigma]}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\;
      U_j \in \textsf{Univ}_{1+i, i}^{\textbf{El}}
      && \text{(by \Cref{def:univ-term-pred} on $U_j \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow
        \textsf{Univ}_{i,j} \searrow \textsf{Univ}_{i,j}^{\textbf{El}}$)}
      \tag*{[clause 4]}
  \end{align*}
<!-- end proof-123 -->
<!-- lemma-120: body_md -->
\label{lem:fund-sound-n-wf}
  If $\Vdash \Gamma$, then $\Semtyp[\Gamma]{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$ for every $i$.
<!-- end lemma-120 -->
<!-- proof-124: body_md -->
By $\Vdash \Gamma$, fix $\Gamma \searrow \textsf{Sb}$ and let
  $\judge[\Delta]{\sigma : \Gamma} \;\circledR\; \rho \in \textsf{Sb}$ be given.
  We establish the four clauses of $\Semtyp[\Gamma]{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$ at
  $a = U_i$, $P = \textsf{Univ}_{1+i, i}$, $\textbf{El} = \textsf{Univ}_{1+i, i}^{\textbf{El}}$.
  \begin{align*}
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket \ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}} \rrbracket(\rho)} \searrow U_i
      && \text{(by \textsc{ev-U})} \tag*{[clause 1]} \\
    &U_i \in \mathcal{U}_{1+i}^\ast \searrow \textsf{Univ}_{1+i, i}
        \searrow \textsf{Univ}_{1+i, i}^{\textbf{El}}
      && \text{(by \textsc{G-Univ})} \tag*{[clause 2]} \\
    &\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}[\sigma] = \ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}
      && \text{(syntactic; closed)} \\
    &\tyequiv[\Delta]{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}[\sigma]}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{1+i}}}
      && \text{(by reflexivity)} \\
    &\typing[\Delta]{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}[\sigma]}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{1+i}}} \;\circledR\;
      \textsf{Univ}_{1+i, i}
      && \text{(by \Cref{def:univ-type-pred})} \tag*{[clause 3]} \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket \ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}} \rrbracket(\rho)} \searrow N
      && \text{(by \textsc{ev-N})} \\
    &N \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow \textsf{Nat}_i \searrow \textsf{Nat}_i
      && \text{(by \textsc{G-Nat})} \\
    &\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}[\sigma] = \ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}
      && \text{(syntactic; closed)} \\
    &\tyequiv[\Delta]{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}[\sigma]}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}
      && \text{(by reflexivity)} \\
    &\typing[\Delta]{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}[\sigma]}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\;
      N \in \textsf{Univ}_{1+i, i}^{\textbf{El}}
      && \text{(by \Cref{def:univ-term-pred} on $N \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast$)}
      \tag*{[clause 4]}
  \end{align*}
<!-- end proof-124 -->
<!-- lemma-121: body_md -->
\label{lem:fund-sound-pi-wf}
  If $\Semtyp[\Gamma]{S_1}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$ and $\Semtyp[\Gamma, x:S_1]{S_2}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$,
  then $\Semtyp[\Gamma]{\Pi(x:S_1).\,S_2}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$.
<!-- end lemma-121 -->
<!-- proof-125: body_md -->
Fix $\Gamma \searrow \textsf{Sb}$ from $\Semtyp[\Gamma]{S_1}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$ and
  $\Gamma, x:S_1 \searrow \textsf{Sb}'$ from $\Semtyp[\Gamma, x:S_1]{S_2}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$.
  By inversion on \textsc{G-Ctx-Ext} for the latter,
  $\textsf{Sb}' \Leftrightarrow \textsf{Cons}_i(\Gamma, S_1, \textsf{Sb})$
  (using $\textsf{Sb}$ uniqueness up to biimplication via
  \Cref{lem:gluing-functional}).

  Let $\judge[\Delta]{\sigma : \Gamma} \;\circledR\; \rho \in \textsf{Sb}$ be given.
  By hypothesis on $S_1$ at $\sigma, \rho$:
  \begin{align*}
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket S_1 \rrbracket(\rho)} \searrow a_I,\;
      a_I \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P_I \searrow \textbf{El}_I
      && \text{(by hypothesis on $S_1$)} \\
    &\typing[\Delta]{S_1[\sigma]}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; P_I
      && \text{(by hypothesis on $S_1$, type part at level $1+i$)} \\
    &a_I \approx a_I \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R_I
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:gluing-implies-per})} \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket \Pi(x:S_1).\,S_2 \rrbracket(\rho)} \searrow \Pi(a_I,\, S_2,\, \rho)
      && \text{(by \textsc{ev-Pi})}
  \end{align*}
  By syntactic substitution:
  \begin{align*}
    &(\Pi(x:S_1).\,S_2)[\sigma] = \Pi(x:S_1[\sigma]).\,(S_2[q(\sigma)])
      && \text{(definition of substitution on $\Pi$)}
  \end{align*}
  We construct $\Pi(a_I, S_2, \rho) \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast$ by \textsc{G-Pi}, deriving
  each premise. We first establish the PER-side membership of the $\Pi$, which
  introduces the codomain PER family $R_O$ used below.

  \emph{PER-side: $\Pi(a_I, S_2, \rho) \approx \Pi(a_I, S_2, \rho) \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R$.}
  \begin{align*}
    &\typing[\Gamma]{S_1}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:gluing-typ-escape} on hypothesis $S_1$)} \\
    &\typing[\Gamma, x:S_1]{S_2}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:gluing-typ-escape} on hypothesis $S_2$)} \\
    &\typing[\Gamma]{\Pi(x:S_1).\,S_2}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}
      && \text{(by \textsc{$\Pi$-Wf})} \\
    &\semtyeq[\Gamma]{\Pi(x:S_1).\,S_2}{\Pi(x:S_1).\,S_2}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}
      && \text{(by \Cref{thm:fundamental} of \Cref{sec:comp})} \\
    &\Pi(a_I, S_2, \rho) \approx \Pi(a_I, S_2, \rho) \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R
      && \text{(by instantiating at $\sigma, \rho$ self-related in $R_\Gamma$)}
  \end{align*}
  Inverting the resulting \textsc{U-Pi} witness yields the codomain PER
  family: for every $\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}} :: b \approx b \in R_I$,
  $\ensuremath{\llbracket S_2 \rrbracket((\rho, b/x))} \approx \ensuremath{\llbracket S_2 \rrbracket((\rho, b/x))} \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow
  R_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}})$.

  \emph{Codomain gluing.} Let $\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}} :: b \approx b \in R_I$ and $c$ with
  $\ensuremath{\llbracket S_2 \rrbracket((\rho, b/x))} \searrow c$ be given.
  \begin{align*}
    &c \approx c \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}})
      && \text{(by the codomain PER family established above)} \\
    &c \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}) \searrow \textbf{El}_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}})
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:per-implies-gluing})}
  \end{align*}
  This defines $P_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}), \textbf{El}_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}})$; functionality in $\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}$ follows from
  \Cref{lem:gluing-functional}, since glu-univ-elem predicates at a fixed
  domain value are unique up to logical equivalence.

  Combining all premises:
  \begin{align*}
    &\Pi(a_I, S_2, \rho) \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow
      \Pi_i(R_I, P_I, \textbf{El}_I, P_O) \searrow \Pi_i^{\textbf{El}}(R, R_I, P_I, \textbf{El}_I, \textbf{El}_O)
      && \text{(by \textsc{G-Pi})}
  \end{align*}
