  \emph{Type-predicate $\Pi_i$ at $(\Pi(x:S_1).\,S_2)[\sigma]$.} We verify the
  three clauses of \Cref{def:pi-type-pred}.

  \emph{Clause 1.}
  \begin{align*}
    &(\Pi(x:S_1).\,S_2)[\sigma] = \Pi(x:S_1[\sigma]).\,(S_2[q(\sigma)])
      && \text{(syntactic substitution on $\Pi$)} \\
    &\tyequiv[\Delta]{(\Pi(x:S_1).\,S_2)[\sigma]}
                     {\Pi(x:S_1[\sigma]).\,(S_2[q(\sigma)])}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}
      && \text{(by reflexivity)}
  \end{align*}

  \emph{Clause 2 (domain Kripke).} For each $\kweak[\Delta'']{\phi'}{\Delta}$:
  \begin{align*}
    &\judge[\Delta'']{\sigma[\phi'] : \Gamma}
      \;\circledR\; \rho \in \textsf{Sb}
      && \text{(by \Cref{cor:ctx-mono})} \\
    &\typing[\Delta'']{S_1[\sigma[\phi']]}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; P_I
      && \text{(by hypothesis on $S_1$, type part at $\sigma[\phi'], \rho$)} \\
    &S_1[\sigma][\phi'] = S_1[\sigma[\phi']]
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:subst-assoc})} \\
    &\typing[\Delta'']{S_1[\sigma][\phi']}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; P_I
      && \text{(rewriting)}
  \end{align*}

  \emph{Clause 3 (codomain Kripke).} For each $\kweak[\Delta'']{\phi'}{\Delta}$,
  $s', b', \ensuremath{\mathcal{D}} :: b' \approx b' \in R_I$ with
  $\typing[\Delta'']{s'}{S_1[\sigma][\phi']} \;\circledR\; b' \in \textbf{El}_I$,
  set $\sigma_*' := (\sigma[\phi'],\, s'/x)$. We first transport the
  substitution into $\textsf{Sb}'$, then unpack
  $\Semtyp[\Gamma, x:S_1]{S_2}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$ at the resulting pair.
  \begin{align*}
    &\judge[\Delta'']{\sigma[\phi'] : \Gamma}
      \;\circledR\; \rho \in \textsf{Sb}
      && \text{(by \Cref{cor:ctx-mono} on the substitution-environment pair)} \\
    &\judge[\Delta'']{\sigma_*' : \Gamma, x:S_1}
      \;\circledR\; (\rho, b'/x) \in \textsf{Sb}'
      && \text{(by \textsc{G-Ctx-Ext}'s $\textsf{Cons}_i$, head: $b' \in \textbf{El}_I$)}
  \end{align*}
  Instantiating $\Semtyp[\Gamma, x:S_1]{S_2}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$ at $\sigma_*',
  (\rho, b'/x)$ yields the four clauses of \Cref{sec:sound:sem-rules}'s
  semantic typing judgment at $a = U_i$, $P = \textsf{Univ}_{1+i,i}$,
  $\textbf{El} = \textsf{Univ}_{1+i,i}^{\textbf{El}}$. The fourth clause states
  $\typing[\Delta'']{S_2[\sigma_*']}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}[\sigma_*']} \;\circledR\;
  \ensuremath{\llbracket S_2 \rrbracket((\rho, b'/x))} \in \textsf{Univ}_{1+i,i}^{\textbf{El}}$.
  Unpacking \Cref{def:univ-term-pred}:
  \begin{align*}
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket S_2 \rrbracket((\rho, b'/x))} \searrow c_{b'}
      && \text{(evaluation; deterministic)} \\
    &c_{b'} \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P_{b'} \searrow \textbf{El}_{b'}
      && \text{(by \Cref{def:univ-term-pred} clause (3))} \\
    &\typing[\Delta'']{S_2[\sigma_*']}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; P_{b'}
      && \text{(by \Cref{def:univ-term-pred} clause (3), Russell type-side gluing)}
  \end{align*}
  By \Cref{lem:gluing-functional} (the gluing-model membership $c_{b'} \in
  \mathcal{U}_i^\ast$ uniquely determines its predicates up to extensional
  equivalence), $P_{b'} \Leftrightarrow P_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}})$ and $\textbf{El}_{b'}
  \Leftrightarrow \textbf{El}_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}})$, where $P_O, \textbf{El}_O$ are the codomain
  predicates established in the Codomain-gluing block. Rewriting:
  \begin{align*}
    &c_{b'} \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}) \searrow \textbf{El}_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}})
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:gluing-functional})} \\
    &S_2[\sigma_*'] = S_2[(\sigma[\phi'], s'/x)] = S_2[q(\sigma)][\phi', s'/x]
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:q-ext-gen})} \\
    &\typing[\Delta'']{S_2[q(\sigma)][\phi', s'/x]}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}
      \;\circledR\; P_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}})
      && \text{(rewriting the previous type-gluing line)}
  \end{align*}
  Combining the three clauses of $\Pi_i$:
  \begin{align*}
    &\typing[\Delta]{\Pi(x:S_1[\sigma]).\,(S_2[q(\sigma)])}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}
      \;\circledR\; \Pi_i(R_I, P_I, \textbf{El}_I, P_O)
      && \text{(by \Cref{def:pi-type-pred} clauses 1--3)} \\
    &\typing[\Delta]{(\Pi(x:S_1).\,S_2)[\sigma]}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}
      \;\circledR\; \Pi_i(R_I, P_I, \textbf{El}_I, P_O)
      && \text{(by clause 1's equality on the LHS)}
  \end{align*}
  For the term predicate at $\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{1+i}}$, $\Pi(a_I, S_2, \rho) \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast$ by
  the previous derivation, the four clauses of $\Semtyp[\Gamma]{\Pi(x:S_1).\,S_2}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$
  at $a = U_i$, $P = \textsf{Univ}_{1+i, i}$, $\textbf{El} = \textsf{Univ}_{1+i, i}^{\textbf{El}}$:
  \begin{align*}
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket \ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}} \rrbracket(\rho)} \searrow U_i
      && \text{(by \textsc{ev-U})} \tag*{[clause 1]} \\
    &U_i \in \mathcal{U}_{1+i}^\ast \searrow \textsf{Univ}_{1+i, i} \searrow
      \textsf{Univ}_{1+i, i}^{\textbf{El}}
      && \text{(by \textsc{G-Univ})} \tag*{[clause 2]} \\
    &\typing[\Delta]{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}[\sigma]}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{1+i}}} \;\circledR\;
      \textsf{Univ}_{1+i, i}
      && \text{(by \Cref{def:univ-type-pred} with $\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}[\sigma] = \ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}$)}
      \tag*{[clause 3]} \\
    &\typing[\Delta]{(\Pi(x:S_1).\,S_2)[\sigma]}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}
      \;\circledR\; \Pi(a_I, S_2, \rho) \in \textsf{Univ}_{1+i, i}^{\textbf{El}}
      && \text{(by \Cref{def:univ-term-pred} on the $\Pi$-gluing above)}
      \tag*{[clause 4]}
  \end{align*}
<!-- end proof-125 -->
<!-- lemma-122: body_md -->
\label{lem:fund-sound-ze}
  If $\Vdash \Gamma$, then $\Semtyp[\Gamma]{\textsf{zero}}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}$.
<!-- end lemma-122 -->
<!-- proof-126: body_md -->
By $\Vdash \Gamma$, fix $\Gamma \searrow \textsf{Sb}$ and let
  $\judge[\Delta]{\sigma : \Gamma} \;\circledR\; \rho \in \textsf{Sb}$ be given.
  We establish the four clauses of $\Semtyp[\Gamma]{\textsf{zero}}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}$ at $a = N$,
  $P = \textsf{Nat}_i$, $\textbf{El} = \textsf{Nat}_i$.
  \begin{align*}
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket \ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}} \rrbracket(\rho)} \searrow N
      && \text{(by \textsc{ev-N})} \tag*{[clause 1]} \\
    &N \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow \textsf{Nat}_i \searrow \textsf{Nat}_i
      && \text{(by \textsc{G-Nat})} \tag*{[clause 2]} \\
    &\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}[\sigma] = \ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}
      && \text{(syntactic; closed)} \\
    &\tyequiv[\Delta]{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}[\sigma]}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}
      && \text{(by reflexivity)} \\
    &\typing[\Delta]{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}[\sigma]}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; \textsf{Nat}_i
      && \text{(by \Cref{def:nat-type-pred})} \tag*{[clause 3]} \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket \textsf{zero} \rrbracket(\rho)} \searrow \texttt{ze}
      && \text{(by \textsc{ev-ze})} \\
    &\textsf{zero}[\sigma] = \textsf{zero}
      && \text{(syntactic; closed)} \\
    &\tyequiv[\Delta]{\textsf{zero}[\sigma]}{\textsf{zero}}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}[\sigma]}
      && \text{(by reflexivity)} \\
    &\typing[\Delta]{\textsf{zero}[\sigma]}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}[\sigma]} \;\circledR\;
      \texttt{ze} \in \textsf{Nat}_i
      && \text{(by \textsc{GN-Ze} combined with the type predicate}\\
    & && \text{above, \Cref{def:nat-term-pred})} \tag*{[clause 4]}
  \end{align*}
<!-- end proof-126 -->
<!-- lemma-123: body_md -->
\label{lem:fund-sound-su}
  If $\Semtyp[\Gamma]{t}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}$, then $\Semtyp[\Gamma]{\textsf{succ}~t}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}$.
<!-- end lemma-123 -->
<!-- proof-127: body_md -->
$\Vdash \Gamma$ is presupposed by the hypothesis $\Semtyp[\Gamma]{t}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}$.
  Fix $\Gamma \searrow \textsf{Sb}$ and let
  $\judge[\Delta]{\sigma : \Gamma} \;\circledR\; \rho \in \textsf{Sb}$ be given.
  We establish the four clauses of $\Semtyp[\Gamma]{\textsf{succ}~t}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}$ at
  $a = N$, $P = \textsf{Nat}_i$, $\textbf{El} = \textsf{Nat}_i$.
  \begin{align*}
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket \ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}} \rrbracket(\rho)} \searrow N
      && \text{(by \textsc{ev-N})} \tag*{[clause 1]} \\
    &N \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow \textsf{Nat}_i \searrow \textsf{Nat}_i
      && \text{(by \textsc{G-Nat})} \tag*{[clause 2]} \\
    &\typing[\Delta]{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}[\sigma]}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; \textsf{Nat}_i
      && \text{(by \Cref{def:nat-type-pred} with $\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}[\sigma] = \ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}$)}
      \tag*{[clause 3]} \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket t \rrbracket(\rho)} \searrow b
      && \text{(by hypothesis on $t$)} \\
    &\typing[\Delta]{t[\sigma]}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}[\sigma]} \;\circledR\;
      b \in \textsf{Nat}_i
      && \text{(by hypothesis on $t$, term part)} \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket \textsf{succ}~t \rrbracket(\rho)} \searrow \texttt{su}(b)
      && \text{(by \textsc{ev-su})} \\
    &(\textsf{succ}~t)[\sigma] = \textsf{succ}~t[\sigma]
      && \text{(syntactic substitution on $\textsf{succ}~$)} \\
    &\typing[\Delta]{(\textsf{succ}~t)[\sigma]}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}[\sigma]} \;\circledR\;
      \texttt{su}(b) \in \textsf{Nat}_i
      && \text{(by \textsc{GN-Su} combined with the type predicate above,}\\
    & && \text{\Cref{def:nat-term-pred})} \tag*{[clause 4]}
  \end{align*}
<!-- end proof-127 -->
<!-- lemma-124: body_md -->
\label{lem:fund-sound-lam}
  If $\Semtyp[\Gamma]{S_1}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$, $\Semtyp[\Gamma, x:S_1]{S_2}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$,
  and $\Semtyp[\Gamma, x:S_1]{t}{S_2}$, then
  $\Semtyp[\Gamma]{\lambda x.\,t}{\Pi(x:S_1).\,S_2}$.
<!-- end lemma-124 -->
<!-- proof-128: body_md -->
$\Vdash \Gamma$ is presupposed; fix $\Gamma \searrow \textsf{Sb}_\Gamma$
  and $\Gamma, x:S_1 \searrow \textsf{Sb}_{\Gamma,x:S_1}$ where, by inversion
  on \textsc{G-Ctx-Ext}, $\textsf{Sb}_{\Gamma,x:S_1} \Leftrightarrow
  \textsf{Cons}_i(\Gamma, S_1, \textsf{Sb}_\Gamma)$. By
  \Cref{lem:gluing-typ-escape} on the hypotheses:
  \begin{align*}
    &\typing[\Gamma]{S_1}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:gluing-typ-escape} on the $S_1$ hypothesis)} \\
    &\typing[\Gamma, x:S_1]{S_2}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:gluing-typ-escape} on the $S_2$ hypothesis)} \\
    &\typing[\Gamma, x:S_1]{t}{S_2}
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:gluing-trm-escape} on the $t$ hypothesis)} \\
    &\typing[\Gamma]{\lambda x.\,t}{\Pi(x:S_1).\,S_2}
      && \text{(by \textsc{$\lambda$-I})}
  \end{align*}
  By \Cref{lem:fund-sound-pi-wf} on the $S_1, S_2$ hypotheses,
  $\Semtyp[\Gamma]{\Pi(x:S_1).\,S_2}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$.

  Let $\judge[\Delta]{\sigma : \Gamma} \;\circledR\; \rho \in
  \textsf{Sb}_\Gamma$ be given.
  \begin{align*}
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket S_1 \rrbracket(\rho)} \searrow a_I,\;
      a_I \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P_I \searrow \textbf{El}_I
      && \text{(by hypothesis on $S_1$, evaluation and gluing clauses)} \\
    &a_I \approx a_I \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R_I
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:gluing-implies-per})} \\
    &\typing[\Delta]{S_1[\sigma]}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; P_I
      && \text{(by hypothesis on $S_1$, type clause)} \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket \Pi(x:S_1).\,S_2 \rrbracket(\rho)} \searrow \Pi(a_I,\, S_2,\, \rho)
      && \text{(by \textsc{ev-Pi})} \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket \lambda x.\,t \rrbracket(\rho)} \searrow \lambda(t, \rho)
      && \text{(by \textsc{ev-lam})} \\
    &\Pi(a_I, S_2, \rho) \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \\
    & \quad \searrow \Pi_i(R_I, P_I, \textbf{El}_I, P_O)
      \searrow \Pi_i^{\textbf{El}}(R, R_I, P_I, \textbf{El}_I, \textbf{El}_O)
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:fund-sound-pi-wf}, gluing clause)} \\
    &\typing[\Delta]{(\Pi(x:S_1).\,S_2)[\sigma]}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}
      \;\circledR\; \Pi_i(R_I, P_I, \textbf{El}_I, P_O)
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:fund-sound-pi-wf}, type clause)}
  \end{align*}
  We assemble the four clauses of $\Semtyp[\Gamma]{\lambda x.\,t}
  {\Pi(x:S_1).\,S_2}$ at $a := \Pi(a_I, S_2, \rho)$,
  $P := \Pi_i(R_I, P_I, \textbf{El}_I, P_O)$,
  $\textbf{El} := \Pi_i^{\textbf{El}}(R, R_I, P_I, \textbf{El}_I, \textbf{El}_O)$:
  \begin{align*}
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket \Pi(x:S_1).\,S_2 \rrbracket(\rho)} \searrow \Pi(a_I, S_2, \rho)
      && \tag*{[clause 1]} \\
    &\Pi(a_I, S_2, \rho) \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P \searrow \textbf{El}
      && \tag*{[clause 2]} \\
    &\typing[\Delta]{(\Pi(x:S_1).\,S_2)[\sigma]}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; P
      && \tag*{[clause 3]}
  \end{align*}
  All three are restated from the per-substitution data block. For
  clause~(4), we must show
  $\typing[\Delta]{(\lambda x.\,t)[\sigma]}{(\Pi(x:S_1).\,S_2)[\sigma]}
  \;\circledR\; \lambda(t, \rho) \in \textbf{El}$. We verify the four sub-clauses
  of \Cref{def:pi-term-pred}.

  \emph{Sub-clause (1): $\typing[\Delta]{(\lambda x.\,t)[\sigma]}
  {(\Pi(x:S_1).\,S_2)[\sigma]}$.} By syntactic substitution applied to
  $\typing[\Gamma]{\lambda x.\,t}{\Pi(x:S_1).\,S_2}$ along
  $\judge[\Delta]{\sigma : \Gamma}$.

  \emph{Sub-clause (2): $\lambda(t, \rho) \approx \lambda(t, \rho) \in R$.}
  By \Cref{thm:fundamental} of \Cref{sec:comp} on
  $\typing[\Gamma]{\lambda x.\,t}{\Pi(x:S_1).\,S_2}$, instantiated at
  $\rho \approx \rho \in \ensuremath{\llbracket \Gamma \rrbracket}$ (self-related via
  \Cref{lem:gluing-implies-per}):
  $\lambda(t, \rho) \approx \lambda(t, \rho) \in R$.

  \emph{Sub-clause (3): $\typing[\Delta]{(\Pi(x:S_1).\,S_2)[\sigma]}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}
  \;\circledR\; \Pi_i(R_I, P_I, \textbf{El}_I, P_O)$.} Established above from
  \Cref{lem:fund-sound-pi-wf}.

  \emph{Sub-clause (4): application.} Given $\kweak[\Delta']{\phi}{\Delta}$
  and $s, b$ with $\typing[\Delta']{s}{S_1[\sigma][\phi]} \;\circledR\; b
  \in \textbf{El}_I$, and $\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}} :: b \approx b \in R_I$ (by
  \Cref{lem:gluing-implies-per} on $b \in \textbf{El}_I$). Set $\sigma_*' :=
  (\sigma[\phi],\, s/x)$.
  \begin{align*}
    &\judge[\Delta']{\sigma[\phi] : \Gamma}
      \;\circledR\; \rho \in \textsf{Sb}_\Gamma
      && \text{(by \Cref{cor:ctx-mono} on $\sigma, \rho$ along $\phi$)} \\
    &\typing[\Delta']{S_1[\sigma[\phi]]}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; P_I
      && \text{(by hypothesis on $S_1$ at $\sigma[\phi], \rho$, type clause)} \\
    &S_1[\sigma][\phi] = S_1[\sigma[\phi]]
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:subst-assoc})} \\
    &\typing[\Delta']{s}{S_1[\sigma[\phi]]} \;\circledR\; b \in \textbf{El}_I
      && \text{(rewriting via the previous line)} \\
    &\judge[\Delta']{\sigma_*' : \Gamma, x:S_1}
      \;\circledR\; (\rho, b/x) \in \textsf{Sb}_{\Gamma,x:S_1}
      && \text{(by $\textsf{Cons}_i$ on the type-side $P_I$ and the
        term-side $b \in \textbf{El}_I$,} \\
    & && \text{realized by $s$ at $S_1[\sigma[\phi]]$)}
  \end{align*}
  Instantiate the $t$-hypothesis at $\sigma_*', (\rho, b/x)$:
  \begin{align*}
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket t \rrbracket((\rho, b/x))} \searrow c
      && \text{(by hypothesis on $t$, evaluation clause)} \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket S_2 \rrbracket((\rho, b/x))} \searrow a'
      && \text{(by hypothesis on $t$, type-eval clause)} \\
    &a' \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P' \searrow \textbf{El}'
      && \text{(by hypothesis on $t$, gluing clause)} \\
    &\typing[\Delta']{t[\sigma_*']}{S_2[\sigma_*']}
      \;\circledR\; c \in \textbf{El}'
      && \text{(by hypothesis on $t$, term clause)} \\
    &P' \Leftrightarrow P_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}),\;\;
      \textbf{El}' \Leftrightarrow \textbf{El}_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}})
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:gluing-functional}: same $a'$
        as in} \\
    & && \text{\Cref{lem:fund-sound-pi-wf}; gluing-model
        predicates at} \\
    & && \text{a fixed value are unique up to logical
        equivalence)} \\
    &\typing[\Delta']{t[\sigma_*']}{S_2[\sigma_*']}
      \;\circledR\; c \in \textbf{El}_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}})
      && \text{(rewriting via the previous line)} \\
    &\lambda(t, \rho) \cdot b \searrow c
      && \text{(by \textsc{ev-app-clos})}
  \end{align*}
  Compute syntactic identities for the resulting term and type:
  \begin{align*}
    &(\lambda x.\,t)[\sigma] = \lambda x.\,(t[q(\sigma)])
      && \text{(by syntactic substitution on $\lambda$)} \\
    &(\lambda x.\,(t[q(\sigma)]))[\phi] = \lambda x.\,(t[q(\sigma)][q(\phi)])
      && \text{(by syntactic substitution on $\lambda$ along $\phi$)} \\
    &t[q(\sigma)][q(\phi)] = t[q(\sigma) \circ q(\phi)] = t[q(\sigma[\phi])]
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:subst-assoc} and \Cref{lem:subst-q-comp})} \\
    &(\lambda x.\,t)[\sigma][\phi] = \lambda x.\,(t[q(\sigma[\phi])])
      && \text{(combining)} \\
    &t[q(\sigma[\phi])][s/x] = t[\sigma_*']
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:q-ext})} \\
    &S_2[q(\sigma[\phi])][s/x] = S_2[\sigma_*']
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:q-ext})}
  \end{align*}
  Apply the $\beta$-rule with premises
  $\typing[\Delta']{S_1[\sigma[\phi]]}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$ (escaped above);
  $\typing[\Delta', x:S_1[\sigma[\phi]]]{S_2[q(\sigma[\phi])]}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$ (by
  substitution typing on the $S_2$ escape along $q(\sigma[\phi])$);
  $\typing[\Delta', x:S_1[\sigma[\phi]]]{t[q(\sigma[\phi])]}
  {S_2[q(\sigma[\phi])]}$ (by substitution typing on the $t$ escape); and
  $\typing[\Delta']{s}{S_1[\sigma[\phi]]}$ (escape on $s$):
  \begin{align*}
    &\tyequiv[\Delta']{(\lambda x.\,(t[q(\sigma[\phi])]))\;s}
                     {t[q(\sigma[\phi])][s/x]}
                     {S_2[q(\sigma[\phi])][s/x]}
      && \text{(by $\beta$)} \\
    &\tyequiv[\Delta']{(\lambda x.\,t)[\sigma][\phi]\;s}
                     {t[\sigma_*']}
                     {S_2[\sigma_*']}
      && \text{(rewriting)} \\
    &\typing[\Delta']{(\lambda x.\,t)[\sigma][\phi]\;s}{S_2[\sigma_*']}
      \;\circledR\; c \in \textbf{El}_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}})
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:gluing-respects-eq})} \\
    &S_2[\sigma_*'] = S_2[q(\sigma)][\iota(\phi), s/x]
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:q-ext-gen})} \\
    &\typing[\Delta']{(\lambda x.\,t)[\sigma][\phi]\;s}
                    {S_2[q(\sigma)][\iota(\phi), s/x]}
      \;\circledR\; c \in \textbf{El}_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}})
      && \text{(rewriting; matches} \\
    & && \text{\Cref{def:pi-term-pred} clause~(4))}
  \end{align*}
<!-- end proof-128 -->
<!-- lemma-125: body_md -->
\label{lem:fund-sound-app}
  If $\Semtyp[\Gamma, x:S_1]{S_2}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$,
  $\Semtyp[\Gamma]{r}{\Pi(x:S_1).\,S_2}$, and $\Semtyp[\Gamma]{s}{S_1}$,
  then $\Semtyp[\Gamma]{r\;s}{S_2[s/x]}$.
<!-- end lemma-125 -->
<!-- proof-129: body_md -->
$\Vdash \Gamma$ and $\Vdash \Gamma, x:S_1$ are presupposed.
  Fix $\Gamma \searrow \textsf{Sb}_\Gamma$ and
  $(\Gamma, x:S_1) \searrow \textsf{Sb}_{\Gamma,x:S_1}$ where
  $\textsf{Sb}_{\Gamma,x:S_1} \Leftrightarrow
  \textsf{Cons}_i(\Gamma, S_1, \textsf{Sb}_\Gamma)$ by \textsc{G-Ctx-Ext}.
  Let $\judge[\Delta]{\sigma : \Gamma} \;\circledR\; \rho \in
  \textsf{Sb}_\Gamma$ be given.

  \emph{Unpacking the hypotheses.}
  \begin{align*}
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket r \rrbracket(\rho)} \searrow f
      && \text{(by hypothesis on $r$, evaluation clause)} \\
    &\typing[\Delta]{r[\sigma]}{(\Pi(x:S_1).\,S_2)[\sigma]} \;\circledR\;
      f \in \Pi_i^{\textbf{El}}(R, R_I, P_I, \textbf{El}_I, \textbf{El}_O)
      && \text{(by hypothesis on $r$, term clause)} \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket s \rrbracket(\rho)} \searrow b
      && \text{(by hypothesis on $s$, evaluation clause)} \\
    &\typing[\Delta]{s[\sigma]}{S_1[\sigma]} \;\circledR\; b \in \textbf{El}_I
      && \text{(by hypothesis on $s$, term clause)} \\
    &b \approx b \in R_I
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:gluing-implies-per})}
  \end{align*}
  Let $\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}} :: b \approx b \in R_I$. Here $P_O, \textbf{El}_O$ are functions of
  $\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}$, supplied by the $\Pi$-gluing of $f$.

  \emph{Building the substitution-environment pair for $S_2$.} Set
  $\sigma_* := (\sigma,\, s[\sigma]/x)$.
  \begin{align*}
    &\judge[\Delta]{\sigma_* : \Gamma, x:S_1}
      \;\circledR\; (\rho, b/x) \in \textsf{Sb}_{\Gamma,x:S_1}
      && \text{(by $\textsf{Cons}_i$ on $\sigma, \rho \in
        \textsf{Sb}_\Gamma$ and the term} \\
    & && \text{gluing of $s[\sigma]$, taking the trailing weakening
        as $\ensuremath{\textsf{id}}$)}
  \end{align*}

  \emph{Instantiating the codomain semantic typing.} Apply
  $\Semtyp[\Gamma, x:S_1]{S_2}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$ at $\sigma_*, (\rho, b/x)$:
  \begin{align*}
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket S_2 \rrbracket((\rho, b/x))} \searrow a_2
      && \text{(by hypothesis on $S_2$, evaluation clause)} \\
    &a_2 \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P_2 \searrow \textbf{El}_2
      && \text{(by hypothesis on $S_2$, gluing clause)} \\
    &\typing[\Delta]{S_2[\sigma_*]}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; P_2
      && \text{(by hypothesis on $S_2$, type clause)}
  \end{align*}

  \emph{Reconciling $(P_2, \textbf{El}_2)$ with $(P_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}), \textbf{El}_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}))$.} The
  $\Pi$-gluing of $f$, by \textsc{G-Pi}, requires
  $\ensuremath{\llbracket S_2 \rrbracket((\rho, b/x))} \searrow c$ implies $c \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow
  P_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}) \searrow \textbf{El}_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}})$. By determinism, $c = a_2$, so
  $a_2 \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}) \searrow \textbf{El}_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}})$.
  By \Cref{lem:gluing-functional}, gluing-model predicates at a fixed
  domain value are unique up to logical equivalence:
  \begin{align*}
    &P_2 \Leftrightarrow P_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}),\quad
      \textbf{El}_2 \Leftrightarrow \textbf{El}_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}})
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:gluing-functional})}
  \end{align*}

  \emph{Application via the $\Pi$-gluing of $f$.} Instantiate the
  application clause (\Cref{def:pi-term-pred} clause~(4)) on $f$ at the
  identity Kripke weakening $\ensuremath{\textsf{id}}$, term $s[\sigma]$,
  value $b$, witness $\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}$:
  \begin{align*}
    &f \cdot b \searrow c
      && \text{(by clause (4) on $f$)} \\
    &\typing[\Delta]{(r[\sigma][\ensuremath{\textsf{id}}])\;s[\sigma]}
      {S_2[\iota(\ensuremath{\textsf{id}}) \circ q(\sigma),\, s[\sigma]/x]}
      \;\circledR\; c \in \textbf{El}_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}})
      && \text{(by clause (4) on $f$)} \\
    &r[\sigma][\ensuremath{\textsf{id}}] = r[\sigma]
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:subst-id})} \\
    &\iota(\ensuremath{\textsf{id}}) = \ensuremath{\textsf{id}}
      && \text{(by definition of $\iota$ on the identity weakening)} \\
    &S_2[\iota(\ensuremath{\textsf{id}}) \circ q(\sigma),\, s[\sigma]/x] = S_2[\sigma_*]
      && \text{(via \Cref{lem:q-ext} and identity absorption)} \\
    &\typing[\Delta]{(r[\sigma])\;s[\sigma]}{S_2[\sigma_*]}
      \;\circledR\; c \in \textbf{El}_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}})
      && \text{(rewriting the previous gluing line)}
  \end{align*}

  \emph{Type rewriting from $S_2[\sigma_*]$ to $S_2[s/x][\sigma]$.}
  \begin{align*}
    &S_2[\sigma_*] = S_2[(\sigma, s[\sigma]/x)] = S_2[q(\sigma)][s[\sigma]/x]
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:q-ext})} \\
    &S_2[s/x][\sigma] = S_2[\sigma, s[\sigma]/x] = S_2[\sigma_*]
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:subst-ext-comm})}
  \end{align*}

  \emph{Bridging $\ensuremath{\llbracket S_2[s/x] \rrbracket(\rho)}$ to $a_2$.} With operational
  substitutions, $\ensuremath{\llbracket S_2[s/x] \rrbracket(\rho)}$ does not directly evaluate to
  $a_2$. By \Cref{thm:fundamental} of \Cref{sec:comp} on
  $\typing[\Gamma, x:S_1]{S_2}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$ (escaped from the $S_2$
  hypothesis), we obtain $\semtyeq[\Gamma, x:S_1]{S_2}{S_2}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$. By
  \Cref{thm:fundamental} on the substitution typing
  $\judge[\Gamma]{(\ensuremath{\textsf{id}}, s/x) : \Gamma, x:S_1}$ (derivable from
  $\typing[\Gamma]{s}{S_1}$ via the substitution-extension rule), we
  obtain $\semtyeq[\Gamma]{(\ensuremath{\textsf{id}}, s/x)}{(\ensuremath{\textsf{id}}, s/x)}{\Gamma, x:S_1}$.
  Instantiate $\semtyeq[\Gamma, x:S_1]{S_2}{S_2}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$ at outer context
  $\Gamma$, this semantic substitution, and $\rho \approx \rho \in
  \ensuremath{\llbracket \Gamma \rrbracket}$ (the latter from $\rho \in \textsf{Sb}_\Gamma$ via
  \Cref{lem:gluing-implies-per}). The four-value pattern of
  \Cref{def:sem-term-eq} yields:
  \begin{align*}
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket (\ensuremath{\textsf{id}}, s/x) \rrbracket(\rho)} \searrow (\rho, b/x)
      && \text{(by \textsc{ev-ext} on $\ensuremath{\llbracket \ensuremath{\textsf{id}} \rrbracket(\rho)} \searrow \rho$
        and $\ensuremath{\llbracket s \rrbracket(\rho)} \searrow b$)} \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket S_2[(\ensuremath{\textsf{id}}, s/x)] \rrbracket(\rho)} \searrow a_2'
      && \text{(by the four-value pattern, outer left value)} \\
    &S_2[s/x] = S_2[(\ensuremath{\textsf{id}}, s/x)]
      && \text{(by definition: single-substitution sugar)} \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket S_2[s/x] \rrbracket(\rho)} \searrow a_2'
      && \text{(rewriting)} \\
    &a_2' \approx \ensuremath{\llbracket S_2 \rrbracket((\rho, b/x))} \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}})
      && \text{(by the four-value pattern, outer-inner relatedness)} \\
    &a_2' \approx a_2 \in \mathcal{U}_i \searrow R_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}})
      && \text{(by determinism: $\ensuremath{\llbracket S_2 \rrbracket((\rho, b/x))} = a_2$)} \\
    &a_2' \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P_2 \searrow \textbf{El}_2
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:gluing-univ-equiv} symmetric form on
        $a_2 \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast$)}
  \end{align*}

  \emph{Assembling the four clauses of $\Semtyp[\Gamma]{r\;s}{S_2[s/x]}$.}
  At $a := a_2'$, $P := P_2$, $\textbf{El} := \textbf{El}_2$:
  \begin{align*}
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket S_2[s/x] \rrbracket(\rho)} \searrow a_2'
      && \tag*{[clause 1]} \\
    &a_2' \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P_2 \searrow \textbf{El}_2
      && \tag*{[clause 2]} \\
    &\typing[\Delta]{S_2[s/x][\sigma]}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; P_2
      && \text{(rewriting $S_2[\sigma_*] = S_2[s/x][\sigma]$ on the
        type-clause line)} \tag*{[clause 3]} \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket r\;s \rrbracket(\rho)} \searrow c
      && \text{(by \textsc{ev-app} on $\ensuremath{\llbracket r \rrbracket(\rho)} \searrow f$,
        $\ensuremath{\llbracket s \rrbracket(\rho)} \searrow b$, $f \cdot b \searrow c$)} \\
    &(r\;s)[\sigma] = r[\sigma]\;s[\sigma]
      && \text{(by syntactic substitution on application)} \\
    &\typing[\Delta]{r\;s[\sigma]}{S_2[\sigma_*]}
      \;\circledR\; c \in \textbf{El}_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}})
      && \text{(established above)} \\
    &\typing[\Delta]{(r\;s)[\sigma]}{S_2[s/x][\sigma]}
      \;\circledR\; c \in \textbf{El}_2
      && \text{(rewriting via $S_2[\sigma_*] = S_2[s/x][\sigma]$
        and $\textbf{El}_O(\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}) \Leftrightarrow \textbf{El}_2$)} \tag*{[clause 4]}
  \end{align*}
<!-- end proof-129 -->
<!-- lemma-126: body_md -->
\label{lem:fund-sound-rec-helper}
  Suppose $\Semtyp[\Gamma, x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}]{T}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$,
  $\Semtyp[\Gamma]{z}{T[\textsf{zero}/x]}$, and
  $\Semtyp[\Gamma, x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}, y:T]{s}{T[\Uparrow \circ \Uparrow, \textsf{succ}~x_1/x]}$.
  Let $\judge[\Delta]{\sigma : \Gamma} \;\circledR\; \rho \in \textsf{Sb}$ be
  given, with $\textsf{Sb}$ from $\Vdash \Gamma$. For any $t_*$ and $b$ with
  $\typing[\Delta]{t_*}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}} \;\circledR\; b \in \textsf{Nat}_i$, and any
  $a, P, \textbf{El}$ with $\ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket((\rho, b/x))} \searrow a$ and
  $a \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P \searrow \textbf{El}$, there exists $r$ with
  $\mathsf{rec}(b, T, z, s, \rho) \searrow r$ and
  $\typing[\Delta]{\ensuremath{\textsf{elim}_{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}~(x.\,T[q(\sigma)])~z[\sigma]~(x, y.\,s[q(q(\sigma))])~t_*}}
                  {T[\sigma, t_*/x]}
  \;\circledR\; r \in \textbf{El}$.
<!-- end lemma-126 -->
<!-- proof-130: body_md -->
Write $E := \ensuremath{\textsf{elim}_{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}~(x.\,T[q(\sigma)])~z[\sigma]~(x, y.\,s[q(q(\sigma))])~t_*}$
  for the syntactic recursor under $\sigma$. By inner induction on
  $b \in \textsf{Nat}$ (\Cref{def:nat-term-pred}).

  \medskip\noindent
  \textbf{Case}
  \begin{mathpar}
    \inferrule[\textsc{GN-Ze}]
    {\tyequiv[\Delta]{t_*}{\textsf{zero}}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}}
    {\typing[\Delta]{t_*}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}} \;\circledR\; \texttt{ze} \in \textsf{Nat}}
  \end{mathpar}
  Here $b = \texttt{ze}$, so the helper's hypothesis specializes to
  $\ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket((\rho, \texttt{ze}/x))} \searrow a$.
  \begin{align*}
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket T[\textsf{zero}/x] \rrbracket(\rho)} \searrow a^{ze}
      && \text{(by hypothesis on $z$, type-evaluation clause)} \\
    &a^{ze} \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P^{ze} \searrow \textbf{El}^{ze}
      && \text{(by hypothesis on $z$, gluing clause)} \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket z \rrbracket(\rho)} \searrow r_z
      && \text{(by hypothesis on $z$, evaluation clause)} \\
    &\typing[\Delta]{z[\sigma]}{T[\textsf{zero}/x][\sigma]}
      \;\circledR\; r_z \in \textbf{El}^{ze}
      && \text{(by hypothesis on $z$, term clause)} \\
    &\mathsf{rec}(\texttt{ze}, T, z, s, \rho) \searrow r_z
      && \text{(by \textsc{rec-ze})} \\
    &a^{ze} \approx a \in \mathcal{U}_i
      && \text{(by completeness on
        $\typing[\Gamma, x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}]{T}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$ instantiated at} \\
    & && \text{$(\ensuremath{\textsf{id}}, \textsf{zero}/x)$; both evaluations
        produce the same value modulo $\mathcal{U}_i$)} \\
    &\textbf{El}^{ze} \Leftrightarrow \textbf{El}
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:gluing-functional}: gluing-model
        predicates at} \\
    & && \text{the same value are unique up to logical equivalence)} \\
    &T[\textsf{zero}/x][\sigma] = T[\sigma, \textsf{zero}/x]
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:subst-ext-comm})} \\
    &\tyequiv[\Delta]{T[\sigma, \textsf{zero}/x]}{T[\sigma, t_*/x]}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}
      && \text{(by \Cref{cor:subst-head-eq} on
        $\typing[\Gamma, x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}]{T}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$ from
        \Cref{lem:gluing-typ-escape},} \\
    & && \text{the substitution $\sigma$, and the head equality
        $\tyequiv[\Delta]{\textsf{zero}}{t_*}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}$} \\
    & && \text{from $\tyequiv[\Delta]{t_*}{\textsf{zero}}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}$ by symmetry)} \\
    &\tyequiv[\Delta]{E}{z[\sigma]}{T[\sigma, t_*/x]}
      && \text{(by the $\beta$-zero rule combined with
        $\tyequiv[\Delta]{t_*}{\textsf{zero}}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}$)} \\
    &\typing[\Delta]{E}{T[\sigma, t_*/x]}
      \;\circledR\; r_z \in \textbf{El}
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:gluing-respects-eq} on the previous
        lines)}
  \end{align*}
  Take $r := r_z$.

  \medskip\noindent
  \textbf{Case}
  \begin{mathpar}
    \inferrule[\textsc{GN-Su}]
    {\typing[\Delta]{t_*'}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}} \;\circledR\; b' \in \textsf{Nat} \\
     \tyequiv[\Delta]{t_*}{\textsf{succ}~t_*'}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}}
    {\typing[\Delta]{t_*}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}} \;\circledR\; \texttt{su}(b') \in \textsf{Nat}}
  \end{mathpar}
  Here $b = \texttt{su}(b')$.

  \emph{Predecessor via inner IH.}
  We need to apply the helper inductively at $t_*', b'$. By
  \Cref{thm:fundamental} of \Cref{sec:comp} on
  $\typing[\Gamma, x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}]{T}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$ instantiated at the related
  environments $(\rho, b'/x) \approx (\rho, b'/x) \in \ensuremath{\llbracket \Gamma, x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}} \rrbracket}$
  (using $b' \in R_\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}$ via \Cref{lem:gluing-implies-per} on the inner
  predecessor):
  \begin{align*}
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket((\rho, b'/x))} \searrow a'
      && \text{(by completeness on $T$)} \\
    &a' \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P' \searrow \textbf{El}'
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:per-implies-gluing} on $a' \approx a' \in \mathcal{U}_i$)} \\
    &\mathsf{rec}(b', T, z, s, \rho) \searrow r',\;
      \typing[\Delta]{E'}{T[\sigma, t_*'/x]} \;\circledR\; r' \in \textbf{El}'
      && \text{(by inner IH on $b', t_*', a', P', \textbf{El}'$;} \\
    & && \text{$E' := \ensuremath{\textsf{elim}_{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}~(x.\,T[q(\sigma)])~z[\sigma]~(x, y.\,s[q(q(\sigma))])~t_*'}$)}
  \end{align*}

  \emph{Step instantiation.} Set
  $\sigma_{\text{step}} := (\sigma, t_*'/x, E'/y)$ and
  $\rho_{\text{step}} := (\rho, b'/x, r'/y)$.
  \begin{align*}
    &\judge[\Delta]{(\sigma, t_*'/x) : \Gamma, x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}
      \;\circledR\; (\rho, b'/x) \in \textsf{Sb}_{x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}
      && \text{(by $\textsf{Cons}_0$ on
        $\typing[\Delta]{t_*'}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}[\sigma]} \;\circledR\; b' \in \textsf{Nat}_i$,} \\
    & && \text{after rewriting $\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}[\sigma] = \ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}$)} \\
    &\judge[\Delta]{\sigma_{\text{step}} : \Gamma, x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}, y:T}
      \;\circledR\; \rho_{\text{step}} \in \textsf{Sb}_{x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}},y:T}
      && \text{(by $\textsf{Cons}_i$ on the previous line, head
        $r' \in \textbf{El}'$,} \\
    & && \text{type bridged via \Cref{lem:gluing-respects-eq})} \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket T[\Uparrow \circ \Uparrow, \textsf{succ}~x_1/x] \rrbracket(\rho_{\text{step}})}
      \searrow a^{su}
      && \text{(by hypothesis on $s$, type-evaluation clause)} \\
    &a^{su} \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P^{su} \searrow \textbf{El}^{su}
      && \text{(by hypothesis on $s$, gluing clause)} \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket s \rrbracket(\rho_{\text{step}})} \searrow r_s
      && \text{(by hypothesis on $s$, evaluation clause)} \\
    &\typing[\Delta]
      {s[\sigma_{\text{step}}]}
      {T[\Uparrow \circ \Uparrow, \textsf{succ}~x_1/x][\sigma_{\text{step}}]}
      \;\circledR\; r_s \in \textbf{El}^{su}
      && \text{(by hypothesis on $s$, term clause)} \\
    &\mathsf{rec}(\texttt{su}(b'), T, z, s, \rho) \searrow r_s
      && \text{(by \textsc{rec-su} on $\mathsf{rec}(b', \ldots) \searrow r'$
        and $\ensuremath{\llbracket s \rrbracket(\rho_{\text{step}})} \searrow r_s$)}
  \end{align*}

  \emph{Type rewriting for the step branch.} We compute the substituted
  motive type:
  \begin{align*}
    &T[\Uparrow \circ \Uparrow, \textsf{succ}~x_1/x][\sigma_{\text{step}}]
      = T[(\Uparrow \circ \Uparrow, \textsf{succ}~x_1/x) \circ \sigma_{\text{step}}]
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:subst-assoc})} \\
    &(\Uparrow \circ \Uparrow, \textsf{succ}~x_1/x) \circ \sigma_{\text{step}}
      = (\Uparrow \circ \Uparrow \circ \sigma_{\text{step}},\,
         \textsf{succ}~x_1[\sigma_{\text{step}}]/x)
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:ext-comp})} \\
    &\Uparrow \circ \sigma_{\text{step}} = (\sigma, t_*'/x),\;
      \Uparrow \circ (\sigma, t_*'/x) = \sigma
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:shift-ext})} \\
    &\Uparrow \circ \Uparrow \circ \sigma_{\text{step}} = \sigma
      && \text{(combining)} \\
    &x_1[\sigma_{\text{step}}] = t_*'
      && \text{(de Bruijn lookup at index 1 in $\sigma_{\text{step}}$)} \\
    &\textsf{succ}~x_1[\sigma_{\text{step}}] = \textsf{succ}~x_1[\sigma_{\text{step}}]
      = \textsf{succ}~t_*'
      && \text{(by syntactic substitution on $\textsf{succ}~$)} \\
    &T[\Uparrow \circ \Uparrow, \textsf{succ}~x_1/x][\sigma_{\text{step}}]
      = T[\sigma, \textsf{succ}~t_*'/x]
      && \text{(combining the previous lines)} \\
    &\tyequiv[\Delta]{T[\sigma, \textsf{succ}~t_*'/x]}{T[\sigma, t_*/x]}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}
      && \text{(by \Cref{cor:subst-head-eq} on
        $\typing[\Gamma, x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}]{T}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$, the} \\
    & && \text{substitution $\sigma$, and the head equality
        $\tyequiv[\Delta]{\textsf{succ}~t_*'}{t_*}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}$} \\
    & && \text{from $\tyequiv[\Delta]{t_*}{\textsf{succ}~t_*'}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}$ by symmetry)}
  \end{align*}

  \emph{Functionality.} By the type rewriting,
  $T[\Uparrow \circ \Uparrow, \textsf{succ}~x_1/x][\sigma_{\text{step}}]
  = T[\sigma, \textsf{succ}~t_*'/x]$, whose evaluation is
  $\ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket((\rho, \texttt{su}(b')/x))} \searrow a$ (the helper's hypothesis on
  $a$ at $b = \texttt{su}(b')$). Hence $a^{su} \approx a \in \mathcal{U}_i$ by
  completeness on $\typing[\Gamma, x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}]{T}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$, and
  $\textbf{El}^{su} \Leftrightarrow \textbf{El}$ by \Cref{lem:gluing-functional}.

  \emph{Conclusion.}
  \begin{align*}
    &\tyequiv[\Delta]{E}{s[\sigma_{\text{step}}]}{T[\sigma, t_*/x]}
      && \text{(by the $\beta$-su rule combined with
        $\tyequiv[\Delta]{t_*}{\textsf{succ}~t_*'}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}$ and the type rewriting)} \\
    &\typing[\Delta]{E}{T[\sigma, t_*/x]}
      \;\circledR\; r_s \in \textbf{El}
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:gluing-respects-eq})}
  \end{align*}
  Take $r := r_s$.

  \medskip\noindent
  \textbf{Case}
  \begin{mathpar}
    \inferrule[\textsc{GN-Ne}]
    {\typing[\Delta]{t_*}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}} \;\circledR\;
      {\uparrow}^N(e) \in \textsf{Neu}_i^e}
    {\typing[\Delta]{t_*}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}} \;\circledR\;
      {\uparrow}^N(e) \in \textsf{Nat}}
  \end{mathpar}
  Here $b = {\uparrow}^N(e)$, with the type-side neutral predicate giving
  $\textsf{R}^{\textsf{Ne}}_n(e) \searrow u_e$ and $\tyequiv[\Delta'']{t_*[\phi]}{u_e}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}$ for
  every $\kweak[\Delta'']{\phi}{\Delta}$, $n := |\Delta''|$.

  \emph{Reduction step.} The helper's hypothesis specializes to
  $\ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket((\rho, {\uparrow}^N(e)/x))} \searrow a$.
  \begin{align*}
    &\mathsf{rec}({\uparrow}^N(e), T, z, s, \rho)
      \searrow {\uparrow}^a(\mathsf{rec}(T, a_z, s, \rho, e))
      && \text{(by \textsc{rec-ne}, where
        $\ensuremath{\llbracket z \rrbracket(\rho)} \searrow a_z$)} \\
    &{\uparrow}^N(e) \approx {\uparrow}^N(e) \in R_\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}
      && \text{(by \textsc{U-Ne})}
  \end{align*}

  \emph{Recursor as a neutral.} We verify $\mathsf{rec}(T, a_z, s, \rho, e) \in
  \textsf{Ne}_i^a$ at the term $E$. For each $\kweak[\Delta'']{\phi}{\Delta}$, set
  $n := |\Delta''|$ and assemble the four readback components:
  \begin{align*}
    &\textsf{R}^{\textsf{Ne}}_n(e) \searrow u_e,\;
      \tyequiv[\Delta'']{t_*[\phi]}{u_e}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}
      && \text{(by hypothesis on $e$, neutral readback)} \\
    &\textsf{R}^{\textsf{Ty}}_{n+1}(a) \searrow W_T,\;
      \tyequiv[\Delta'', x':\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}]
        {T[q(\sigma)][\iota(\phi), x'/x]}{W_T}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}
      && \text{(by \Cref{thm:gluing-realizability} part (3)
        on} \\
    & && \text{$a \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast$, at the Kripke weakening
        to $\Delta'', x':\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}$)} \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket T[\textsf{zero}/x] \rrbracket(\rho)} \searrow A_z',\;
      A_z' \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P_z' \searrow \textbf{El}_z'
      && \text{(by hypothesis on $z$ via
        $\Semtyp[\Gamma]{z}{T[\textsf{zero}/x]}$,} \\
    & && \text{type-evaluation and gluing clauses)} \\
    &\typing[\Delta]{z[\sigma]}{T[\textsf{zero}/x][\sigma]}
      \;\circledR\; a_z \in \textbf{El}_z'
      && \text{(by hypothesis on $z$, term clause; with
        $a_z := \ensuremath{\llbracket z \rrbracket(\rho)}$)} \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket((\rho, \texttt{ze}/x))} \searrow A_z
      && \text{(type evaluation; the form required by
        \textsc{Re-rec})} \\
    &A_z' \approx A_z \in \mathcal{U}_i
      && \text{(by completeness on
        $\typing[\Gamma, x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}]{T}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$ instantiated} \\
    & && \text{at the substitution $(\ensuremath{\textsf{id}}, \textsf{zero}/x)$)} \\
    &A_z \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P_z \searrow \textbf{El}_z,\;
      \textbf{El}_z' \Leftrightarrow \textbf{El}_z
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:gluing-univ-equiv} and
        \Cref{lem:gluing-functional})} \\
    &\textsf{R}^{\textsf{Nf}}_n({\downarrow}^{A_z}(a_z)) \searrow w_z
      && \text{(by \Cref{thm:gluing-realizability} part (2) on
        $a_z \in \textbf{El}_z$)} \\
    &\tyequiv[\Delta''] {z[\sigma][\phi]}{w_z}{T[\textsf{zero}/x][\sigma][\phi]}
      && \text{(after term-side type-bridging via
        \Cref{lem:gluing-respects-eq})} \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket((\rho, \texttt{su}({\uparrow}^N(\ell_n))/x))} \searrow A_s
      && \text{(type evaluation at the fresh-step head $\texttt{su}(\ell_n)$)} \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket s \rrbracket(\rho, {\uparrow}^N(\ell_n)/x,
            {\uparrow}^{A_p}(\ell_{n+1})/y)} \searrow b_s
      && \text{(step branch evaluated at the fresh-neutral pair,} \\
    & && \text{where $A_p := \ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket((\rho, {\uparrow}^N(\ell_n)/x))}$)} \\
    &\textsf{R}^{\textsf{Nf}}_{n+2}({\downarrow}^{A_s}(b_s)) \searrow w_s
      && \text{(by \Cref{thm:gluing-realizability} part (2) on
        the step value)} \\
    &\Delta_s \vdash s[q(q(\sigma))][\iota(\iota(\phi))]
      \approx w_s \\
    & \qquad : T[q(\sigma)][\iota(\phi), \textsf{succ}~x'/x]
      && \text{(at the corresponding type, where} \\
    & && \text{$\Delta_s := \Delta'', x':\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}},
        y':T[q(\sigma)][\iota(\phi), x'/x]$)} \\
    &\textsf{R}^{\textsf{Ne}}_n(\mathsf{rec}(T, a_z, s, \rho, e)) \\
    & \quad \searrow \ensuremath{\textsf{elim}_{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}~(x.\,W_T)~w_z~(x, y.\,w_s)~u_e}
      && \text{(by \textsc{Rne-rec})} \\
    &\Delta'' \vdash E[\phi] \approx
      \ensuremath{\textsf{elim}_{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}~(x.\,W_T)~w_z~(x, y.\,w_s)~u_e} \\
    & \qquad : T[\sigma,\, t_*/x][\phi]
      && \text{(by \textsc{N-E-Cong} on the four
        readback equalities)}
  \end{align*}

  \emph{Type-side gluing.} The helper's hypothesis already gives the
  type-side gluing of $T[\sigma, t_*/x]$ at $P$ (via the outer
  $\Semtyp[\Gamma, x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}]{T}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$ instantiation that produced
  $a, P, \textbf{El}$).

  \emph{Conclusion.}
  \begin{align*}
    &\typing[\Delta]{E}{T[\sigma, t_*/x]} \;\circledR\;
      \mathsf{rec}(T, a_z, s, \rho, e) \in \textsf{Ne}_i^a
      && \text{(by \Cref{def:neu-term-pred} from the previous block)} \\
    &\typing[\Delta]{E}{T[\sigma, t_*/x]} \;\circledR\;
      {\uparrow}^a(\mathsf{rec}(T, a_z, s, \rho, e)) \in \textbf{El}
      && \text{(by \Cref{thm:gluing-realizability} part (1) on
        $a \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast$)}
  \end{align*}
  Take $r := {\uparrow}^a(\mathsf{rec}(T, a_z, s, \rho, e))$.
<!-- end proof-130 -->
<!-- lemma-127: body_md -->
\label{lem:fund-sound-rec}
  If $\Semtyp[\Gamma, x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}]{T}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$, $\Semtyp[\Gamma]{z}{T[\textsf{zero}/x]}$,
  $\Semtyp[\Gamma, x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}, y:T]{s}{T[\Uparrow \circ \Uparrow, \textsf{succ}~x_1/x]}$, and
  $\Semtyp[\Gamma]{t}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}$, then
  $\Semtyp[\Gamma]{\ensuremath{\textsf{elim}_{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}~(x.\,T)~z~(x, y.\,s)~t}}{T[t/x]}$.
<!-- end lemma-127 -->
<!-- proof-131: body_md -->
$\Vdash \Gamma$ is presupposed by the hypotheses.
  Fix $\Gamma \searrow \textsf{Sb}$ and let
  $\judge[\Delta]{\sigma : \Gamma} \;\circledR\; \rho \in \textsf{Sb}$ be given.
  \begin{align*}
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket t \rrbracket(\rho)} \searrow a
      && \text{(by hypothesis on $t$, evaluation clause)} \\
    &\typing[\Delta]{t[\sigma]}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}[\sigma]} \;\circledR\; a \in \textsf{Nat}_i
      && \text{(by hypothesis on $t$, term clause)} \\
    &\tyequiv[\Delta]{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}[\sigma]}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{0}}}
      && \text{(syntactic; closed)} \\
    &\typing[\Delta]{t[\sigma]}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}} \;\circledR\; a \in \textsf{Nat}_i
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:gluing-respects-eq})}
  \end{align*}
  Build the substitution pair for $T$:
  \begin{align*}
    &\sigma_T := (\sigma, t[\sigma]/x)
      && \text{(definition)} \\
    &\judge[\Delta]{\sigma_T : \Gamma, x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}
      \;\circledR\; (\rho, a/x) \in \textsf{Sb}_{x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}
      && \text{(by $\textsf{Cons}_0$ on $\textsf{Sb}$, head $a \in \textsf{Nat}_i$
        realized by $t[\sigma]$)} \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket((\rho, a/x))} \searrow a_T
      && \text{(by hypothesis on $T$ at $\sigma_T, (\rho, a/x)$)} \\
    &a_T \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P_T \searrow \textbf{El}_T
      && \text{(by hypothesis on $T$, gluing clause)} \\
    &\typing[\Delta]{T[\sigma_T]}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; P_T
      && \text{(by hypothesis on $T$, type clause)}
  \end{align*}
  By \Cref{lem:fund-sound-rec-helper} on $t_* := t[\sigma]$, $b := a$, with
  the data above:
  \begin{align*}
    &\mathsf{rec}(a, T, z, s, \rho) \searrow r
      && \text{(by helper)} \\
    &\typing[\Delta]
      {\ensuremath{\textsf{elim}_{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}~(x.\,T[q(\sigma)])~z[\sigma]~(x, y.\,s[q(q(\sigma))])~t[\sigma]}}
      {T[\sigma, t[\sigma]/x]}
      \;\circledR\; r \in \textbf{El}_T
      && \text{(by helper)} \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket \ensuremath{\textsf{elim}_{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}~(x.\,T)~z~(x, y.\,s)~t} \rrbracket(\rho)} \searrow r
      && \text{(by \textsc{ev-rec})} \\
    &(\ensuremath{\textsf{elim}_{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}~(x.\,T)~z~(x, y.\,s)~t})[\sigma]
      && \text{(by syntactic} \\
    & \quad = \ensuremath{\textsf{elim}_{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}~(x.\,T[q(\sigma)])~z[\sigma]~(x, y.\,s[q(q(\sigma))])~t[\sigma]}
      && \text{substitution on $\textsf{elim}_{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}$)} \\
    &T[\sigma_T] = T[\sigma, t[\sigma]/x] = T[t/x][\sigma]
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:subst-ext-comm})}
  \end{align*}
  We assemble the four clauses of $
  \Semjudge[$]{f : o}
r the conclusion at $a :=
  a_T$, $P := P_T$, $\textbf{El} := \textbf{El}_T$:
  \begin{align*}
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket T[t/x] \rrbracket(\rho)} \searrow a_T
      && \text{(via the equality $\ensuremath{\llbracket T[t/x] \rrbracket(\rho)} = \ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket((\rho, a/x))}$
        established by} \\
    & && \text{\Cref{thm:fundamental} of \Cref{sec:comp} on
        $\typing[\Gamma, x:\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}]{T}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$)}
      \tag*{[clause 1]} \\
    &a_T \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P_T \searrow \textbf{El}_T
      && \text{(established above)} \tag*{[clause 2]} \\
    &\typing[\Delta]{T[t/x][\sigma]}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; P_T
      && \text{(by rewriting the $T[\sigma_T]$ identity)} \tag*{[clause 3]} \\
    &\typing[\Delta]{(\ensuremath{\textsf{elim}_{\ensuremath{\texttt{Nat}}}~(x.\,T)~z~(x, y.\,s)~t})[\sigma]}{T[t/x][\sigma]} \\
    & \quad \;\circledR\; r \in \textbf{El}_T
      && \text{(by rewriting via the syntactic identity above)}
      \tag*{[clause 4]}
  \end{align*}
<!-- end proof-131 -->
<!-- lemma-128: body_md -->
\label{lem:fund-sound-subsump}
  If $\Semtyp[\Gamma]{t}{S}$, $\Semtyp[\Gamma]{T}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}}$, and
  $\subty[\Gamma]{S}{T}$, then $\Semtyp[\Gamma]{t}{T}$.
<!-- end lemma-128 -->
<!-- proof-132: body_md -->
$\Vdash \Gamma$ is presupposed by the hypotheses.
  Fix $\Gamma \searrow \textsf{Sb}$ and let
  $\judge[\Delta]{\sigma : \Gamma} \;\circledR\; \rho \in \textsf{Sb}$ be given.
  By \Cref{thm:fundamental} of \Cref{sec:comp} on $\subty[\Gamma]{S}{T}$,
  we obtain the semantic subtyping judgment $\Gamma \vDash S \subseteq T$
  (\Cref{def:sem-subty-judge}).
  \begin{align*}
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket S \rrbracket(\rho)} \searrow a_S,\;
      a_S \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P_S \searrow \textbf{El}_S
      && \text{(by hypothesis on $t$, evaluation and gluing clauses)} \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket(\rho)} \searrow a_T,\;
      a_T \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P_T \searrow \textbf{El}_T
      && \text{(by hypothesis on $T$, evaluation and gluing clauses)} \\
    &\typing[\Delta]{t[\sigma]}{S[\sigma]} \;\circledR\;
      \ensuremath{\llbracket t \rrbracket(\rho)} \in \textbf{El}_S
      && \text{(by hypothesis on $t$, term clause)} \\
    &\rho \approx \rho \in R_\Gamma
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:gluing-implies-per} on
        $\rho \in \textsf{Sb}$)} \\
    &\semtyeq[\Gamma]{\ensuremath{\textsf{id}}}{\ensuremath{\textsf{id}}}{\Gamma}
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:sem-id})} \\
    &a_S \mathrel{<:_i} a_T
      && \text{(by $\Gamma \vDash S \subseteq T$ instantiated at} \\
    & && \text{the identity semantic substitution and
        $\rho \approx \rho$:} \\
    & && \text{the inner-pair relation gives
        $\ensuremath{\llbracket S \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \ensuremath{\textsf{id}} \rrbracket(\rho)})} \mathrel{<:_i}
        \ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket(\ensuremath{\llbracket \ensuremath{\textsf{id}} \rrbracket(\rho)})}$,} \\
    & && \text{which is $\ensuremath{\llbracket S \rrbracket(\rho)} \mathrel{<:_i}
        \ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket(\rho)}$)} \\
    &\typing[\Delta]{T[\sigma]}{\ensuremath{\texttt{Ty}_{i}}} \;\circledR\; P_T
      && \text{(by hypothesis on $T$, type clause)} \\
    &\typing[\Delta]{t[\sigma]}{T[\sigma]} \;\circledR\;
      \ensuremath{\llbracket t \rrbracket(\rho)} \in \textbf{El}_T
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:gluing-subty} on $a_S \mathrel{<:_i} a_T$,
        $a_S \in \textbf{El}_S$,} \\
    & && \text{and $T[\sigma] \;\circledR\; P_T$)}
  \end{align*}
<!-- end proof-132 -->
<!-- theorem-5: body_md -->
\label{thm:fundamental-sound}\hfill
  \begin{enumerate}
  \@idxitem If $\vdash \Gamma$, then $\Vdash \Gamma$.
  \@idxitem If $\typing[\Gamma]{t}{T}$, then $\Vdash \Gamma$ and
    $\Semtyp[\Gamma]{t}{T}$.
  \end{enumerate}
<!-- end theorem-5 -->
<!-- proof-133: body_md -->
By simultaneous induction on the well-formedness derivation $\vdash \Gamma$
  and the typing derivation $\typing[\Gamma]{t}{T}$. The presupposition
  $\vdash \Gamma$ inherent in $\typing[\Gamma]{t}{T}$ produces $\Vdash \Gamma$
  through part (1) at each step; semantic rules in
  \Cref{sec:sound:sem-rules} consume $\Vdash \Gamma$ wherever needed.
  Each case applies the corresponding semantic-rule lemma:
  \begin{itemize}
  \@idxitem Context cases: \Cref{lem:fund-sound-ctx-emp,lem:fund-sound-ctx-ext}.
  \@idxitem Term cases: \Cref{lem:fund-sound-var,lem:fund-sound-u-wf, 
    lem:fund-sound-n-wf,lem:fund-sound-pi-wf,lem:fund-sound-ze, 
    lem:fund-sound-su,lem:fund-sound-lam,lem:fund-sound-app, 
    lem:fund-sound-rec,lem:fund-sound-subsump}.
  \end{itemize}
  Each lemma's $\Vdash$-hypotheses are supplied by part~(1) on the
  corresponding $\vdash$-premise of its syntactic rule; its
  $
  \Semjudge[$]{- : h}
ypotheses are the IHs from the typing premises.
<!-- end proof-133 -->
<!-- theorem-6: body_md -->
\label{thm:soundness}
  If $\typing[\Gamma]{t}{T}$, then $\textsf{nbe}^T_\Gamma(t) = v$ for some $v$ with
  $\tyequiv[\Gamma]{t}{v}{T}$.
<!-- end theorem-6 -->
<!-- proof-134: body_md -->
\begin{align*}
    &\Vdash \Gamma,\;
      \Semtyp[\Gamma]{t}{T}
      && \text{(by \Cref{thm:fundamental-sound} part (2))} \\
    &\Gamma \searrow \textsf{Sb}
      && \text{(by \Cref{def:sound-semctx} on $\Vdash \Gamma$)} \\
    &\judge[\Gamma]{\ensuremath{\textsf{id}} : \Gamma} \;\circledR\; {\uparrow}^\Gamma \in \textsf{Sb}
      && \text{(by \Cref{lem:init-env-valid} on $\Gamma \searrow \textsf{Sb}$)} \\
    &\ensuremath{\llbracket T \rrbracket({\uparrow}^\Gamma)} \searrow a,\;
      a \in \mathcal{U}_i^\ast \searrow P \searrow \textbf{El}
      && \text{(unfolding $\Vdash$ at $\ensuremath{\textsf{id}}, {\uparrow}^\Gamma$)} \\
    &\typing[\Gamma]{t[\ensuremath{\textsf{id}}]}{T[\ensuremath{\textsf{id}}]} \;\circledR\; \ensuremath{\llbracket t \rrbracket({\uparrow}^\Gamma)} \in \textbf{El}
      && \text{(unfolding $\Vdash$ at $\ensuremath{\textsf{id}}, {\uparrow}^\Gamma$)} \\
    &T[\ensuremath{\textsf{id}}] = T,\; t[\ensuremath{\textsf{id}}] = t
      && \text{(by left-id of substitution)} \\
    &\typing[\Gamma]{t}{T} \;\circledR\; b \in \textsf{Nf}_i^a
      \text{ where } b = \ensuremath{\llbracket t \rrbracket({\uparrow}^\Gamma)}
      && \text{(by \Cref{thm:gluing-realizability} part (2))} \\
    &\textsf{R}^{\textsf{Nf}}_{|\Gamma|}({\downarrow}^a(b)) \searrow v,\;
      \tyequiv[\Gamma]{t[\ensuremath{\textsf{id}}]}{v}{T[\ensuremath{\textsf{id}}]}
      && \text{(Kripke condition at $\phi = \ensuremath{\textsf{id}}$)} \\
    &\tyequiv[\Gamma]{t}{v}{T}
      && \text{(using $t[\ensuremath{\textsf{id}}] = t, T[\ensuremath{\textsf{id}}] = T$)} \\
    &\textsf{nbe}^T_\Gamma(t) = v
      && \text{(by \Cref{def:nbe}: evaluation followed by readback)}
  \end{align*}
<!-- end proof-134 -->
<!-- corollary-4: body_md -->
\label{cor:decidability}
  Given $\typing[\Gamma]{s}{T}$ and $\typing[\Gamma]{t}{T}$, the judgment
  $\tyequiv[\Gamma]{s}{t}{T}$ is decidable.
<!-- end corollary-4 -->
<!-- proof-135: body_md -->
By soundness, $\tyequiv[\Gamma]{s}{\textsf{nbe}_\Gamma^T(s)}{T}$ and
  $\tyequiv[\Gamma]{t}{\textsf{nbe}_\Gamma^T(t)}{T}$.
  By completeness, $\tyequiv[\Gamma]{s}{t}{T}$ iff
  $\textsf{nbe}_\Gamma^T(s) = \textsf{nbe}_\Gamma^T(t)$.
  Comparing normal forms is decidable.
<!-- end proof-135 -->
